Tonsot loupi laltouna a tou dingin ;
Athoutai, athou tai,
Halleluiyah athou tai.
Alhan ngau moh ahi, Lhandampu Jesu ;
Khuhsin song moh ahin, Pakai Jesu.
Thinan ahenjou poi, Lhandampu Jesu ;
Lhan sin song phujalta, Pakai Jesu.
Reference: Doh is C. s
Jesu seinan kajai,
"Tha lhom nahi ngut nai ;
Tha lhom chaten thum un,
Pekim inge Keiman."
Ka bat jouse chu, Jesun asalhai,
Ka chonsetna jouse jong ;
Aman asop lheng tai.
Imacha kanei poi,
Na lungset ngehna ding ;
Nangman neisop thengin,
Calvary thisan chun.
Keima kathi tenga,
Ka lhagao van kal teng ;
Jesun eilhat jallin,
Kei vangam lhung ta ding.
Lal touna kadin teng,
Ama ang sunga chun ;
Ka galvon pailhang ting,
Jesu ang sunga chun.
Reference: Doh is E♭. m

songs.title: CHONSET LUNGDON GIM PO MANG DING

lines: Chonset lungdon gim pomang ding,
I neiyui golpha Jesu ;
I jakai ipoh lut thei diu,
Pathen henga taona a ;
Lungdong lungmong mo hesoh a,
I ding gim ithoh jiu ham ?
I lhut lou jeh jiu Pathen heng,
I taonauva ijakai.
I neiyum thunoh le lhepna,
Lungjin lungdonna um em ?
Lung lhalouvin um jingu te,
Pathen heng lhut in taona ;
Mu nau hitem golpha adang ,
Ei thoh khompia ginchat thei ?
I hatmonau Jesun ahei,
Taovun aheng lhut soh un.
Hatmo le pohgih po ihim?
I lel um pohgih pohna ;
I beldiu Jesu aum nai,
Taonan aheng lhut soh un ;
Gollin nadeimoa napai em ?
Taovin Pakai heng lhut in ;
A bante nia nang huhhinga,
Nangman nomsa tading chu.
Reference: Doh is F. s

songs.title: KA LUNG KA PHU NI KA KOP NI

lines: Kalung kaphu ni kanop ni,
Pakai Jesu le Pathen a ;
Kalung navah ni, nomsah ni,
Seichoi lenge kho vannoi ja.
Ka nopni, kipa ni,
Jesun kachonset soplheng ta ;
A min a taoje eihil e,
Niseh a kipa jingna thu ;
Ka nopni, kipani,
Jesun ka chonset sop lheng ta.
Ka molso tai thu loupi pen,
Jesu kapu kei aseijui ;
Aman eikou, ken kajuiye,
A thupha keiman phong lenge.
Lu tah a keiman kitepna,
Long louvin Pathen ah um hen ;
Kahin laisen jong, kathin jong,
Thu loupi penna kanei ding.
Reference: Doh is G. sₗ
Ka hoina kul Jesu Christa,
Khopi huiya Jesu ka bel ;
I tobang lungdon um jongle,
Khopi huiya Jesu kabel.
Ka lungdonna a Jesu kom ka bel ken,
Ka lungdonna, ka lung donna ;
Ka lungdonna a Jesu chu ka kulpi,
Khopi huiya Jesu ka bel.
Khopi huiyin eipha jongle,
Khopi huiya Jesu ka bel ;
Setto louna chu lha ponge,
I tihchan hijong le Jesu.
Ka kiselna ka van Kulpi,
Khopi huiya Jesu ka bel ;
I tobang hahsa hung jong le,
Khopi huiya ka bel Nangma.
Reference: Doh is F. sₗ

songs.title: NEI KOU O GIN KA JAI

lines: Nei kou O gin kajai,
Nangma koma dingin ;
Nei soptheng dingin Calvarya,
Na thisan longlha chun.
Pakai ka hunge,
Tun Nang kom jonin ;
Thisan chun neisop thengin,
Calvarya longlha chun.
Chonse kahi vangin,
Na heng kahin jon e ;
Tha neipen neisop thengsel in,
Ka thensel masang sen.
Jesun eikouve kei,
Tahsan det kichen din ;
Lungset tahsan nop kichen din,
Lei le van chunga din.
Chonset hat gam sunga,
Thahat eipei Jesun ;
Lungset tah-in kei eilamtoi,
Phattheina eiboh-e.
Reference: Doh is E♭. d

songs.title: LUNGSET TAH IN VANGAM KHOPI JOTNA

lines: Lungset tah-in vangam khopi jotna,
Lam nei hil in ;
Jan muthim a lamdih a nei puiyin,
Nei lamkaiyin ;
A gamlai tin ka lungkham deh sampoi,
Kal khat khat in nanung nung jui nange.
Eipui dih jing thei Nang kana jui dan,
Ka nom chon len ;
Kei chonna jeng bou aphan ka ngaiton,
Ka chonkhel tai ;
Ka kichatna a jong kana hoithon,
Lungset themin hichu nei ngaidamin.
Na banin neikol jing jengin tukal,
Nei kai jingin ;
Muthim a jong bitkeiyin nei puiyin,
Nei lamkaiyin ;
Tona thisa ka sopi ngai jouse,
Mu kit tange jing niso teng chuleh.
Reference: Doh is G. m

songs.title: NANG NA HUNG DING O LHANDAMPU

lines: Nang nahung ding O Lhandampu,
Nang nahung ding vo Lengpa ;
Pao tinin Nangma vahchoi ding,
Vahchoi O tang talou ding ;
Nang nahung ding na thi jal a,
Ponjal laiya lhanga chun ;
Cholte kipa sah sohta ding,
Nopni loupi ni hiding.
Nang nahung ding (2)
Lam kim a ikimu diu ;
Nang nahung teng, Nang kamu diu,
Leiya nalen lai mel a;
Nang nahung ding, (2)
Pakai, Nang ka ngai chungnung ;
Na vaihom nikho ka ngah lel,
Tonsot a ka vahchoi ding.
Nang nahung ding hesoh genthei,
Ka le lhiso beita ding ;
Chonsetna kisei kit lou ding,
Jing noso emsel jing le;
Nang nahung ding Huhhing Jesu,
Dei le ngai dang umlou ding ;
Chu gam hoi le loupina chu,
Thisan a nalhat ahi.
Nang nahung ding ka ngah jingui,
Thonlou kinepna ging chan ;
Phat le nikho ngah lel louvin,
Ngah jingin, Nang ka sangui ;
Nang nahung ding Antheng jong a,
Nahung kit ding ka heuve ;
Tua Antheng ijonkhom bangun,
Van a jong ijonkhom diu.
Reference: Doh is C. d
Cross phung jonin ka hunge,
Mi genthei hesoh lengvai ;
Keima mi chonse chungnung,
Tun vang lhatdam ka chang tai.
Pakai Nang ka tahsan e,
Calvary van Kelngoi nou ;
Ka kun e na Cross noiya,
Nei lungset in nei huh in.
Chonset in eihen sot tai,
Lungin Nang ka lha ngaiyin ;
Nem heocha neikou kajai,
Ka hung tai Nang lim jonin.
Kalung le kanei jouse,
Abonchan Nang ka petai ;
Ka lhagao le ka tahsa,
A bonchan Nanga hihen.
Jesu hung keima hinna,
Aman kei eisop theng tai ;
Atonsot atonsot in,
Loupi jinghen Kelngoi nou.
Reference: Doh is G. sₗ

songs.title: JESU HENG JON IN KA HUNG UI

lines: Jesu heng jon in kahung ui,
Ka jaovin eilam to nau,
A phat na chu ka tahsanun,
A hepia kakipah ui.
Kahung-ui inlam jon in kahung-ui,
Muthim'a kon khovah lam kahin jon ui,
Kahung-ui in lam jon in kahung ui,
Kahung ui tujan in ah.
Jesu heng jon in kahung ui,
Kahing na ding un athi,
Keiho eilem nom un ahi,
Ngaidam din eingah jing un ahi.
Jesu heng jonin kahung ui,
Cross phung chu kahin jon un,
Eilhat nau kin achai na din,
Lamdang neilou kahiuve.
Reference: Doh is G. d
Iti nop hitam Pakaiya,
Ki ngaiya cholnga ding ;
Na thahat chun nei tung dingin,
Ka lung lhahna channa.
Na lunggel lungkhamna jouse,
Sep lhan abonchan Achunga ;
Na lunggel lungkhamna jouse,
Aman na khankho ding agelnai.
Ka lunggel jouse Nachunga,
Ngaleng Nalung ahi ;
Ka lung hesoh genthei jouse,
Nangman na hesoh nai.
Na mi lungset khoto ging chan,
Nangma lam jeng kavei ;
Ka lungdon hesoh na channa,
Nangman lungmon neipen.
I bol'a ka lungkham ding ham ?
Khonung thu ding gelna ;
Ipi ka kichatpi ding ham ?
Pakaiya kingai leng.
Reference: Doh is A♭. sₗ
Um kahi Jesu khut’a,
A angsung lim dam'a ;
Eilungset kemlou lim’a,
Ka lhan nomsa jing ding ;
Ngai temuvin Vantil ten,
Ka din la asauve ;
Van chung gamtheng em nom'a,
Van gam khovah noma.
Um kahi Jesu khut'a,
A ang sung lim dam'a ;
Ei lungset kemlou lim'a,
Ka lhan nomsa jing ding.
Um kahi Jesu khut'a,
Lungdonna um talou ;
Leiset lung ngai beita ding,
Chonset leng talou ding ;
Ka ongtai gimna a kon,
Kichat tijat umlou ;
Chomkhat lungdon le genthei,
Ka le lhiso na dim.
Jesu keima lung kaina,
Keima huhnan athi ;
Songpi bang hen ka tahsan,
Det jing hen Christa ahi ;
Nei umpin, nei ngah jingin,
Jan muthim bei kahsen;
Jing khovah hoi kamu man,
Vah jing van gam nom'a.
Reference: Doh is G. m
Jesu lhalim noiya chun,
Cholngah nom aum;
Tong gimte le pohgihte din,
Heng le koma jol le gol din;
Jesu lhalim noiya chun,
Cholngah nom aum;
Jesu lhalim noiya chun,
Ol aum.
Ol aum, mon aum, nop aum,
Jesu lhalim noiya chun.
Jesu lhalim noiya chun,
Cham le lungmon a um ;
Cham le thilpha hettoh theina,
Nop le lung ol kem talou ding ;
Jesu lhalim noiya chun,
Cham le lungmon um ;
Jesu lhalim noiya chun,
Cham aum.
Jesu lhalim noiya chun,
Kipa thanop um ;
Kipa thusim seiding aum,
Kipa thanop chungnung ahi ;
Jesu lhalim noiya chun,
Kipa thanop um ;
Jesu lhalim noiya chun,
Nop aum.
Reference: Doh is F. m
Pathen henga tao dinga lungnem'a kunpet hi,
Iti noptam Huhhingpa anga taopet hi !
Tahsan'a bel ihiu le Aman eihuhhing diu,
Chol dinga olna ahi, tao hi iti nop tam !
Tao hi lung ol pet, (2)
Chol dinga olna ahi,
Tao hi iti nop tam !
Pathen henga tao dinga lungnem'a kunpet hi,
"Nalung khamnau jouse ka ang a seplhauvin" ;
Tia lungset khoto tah a eiseipeh tengu le,
Chol dinga olna ahi, tao hi iti nop tam !
Pathen henga tao dinga lungnem'a kunpet hi,
Ama lung tohte gentheina amu soh in ;
Alungset lhaving noiya ni tinin ahoiye,
Chol dinga olna ahi, tao hi iti nop tam !
Reference: Doh is E♭. d

songs.title: JING NISO EMSEL A KAJING THO TENG

lines: Jing niso emsel'a ka jingtho teng,
Nisa hoi chun lhumtih nei talou ding ;
Tonsotna avah emhoi chullou ding,
Chonse keima kalung lhaisel tading.
Kalung lhaisel ta ding, (2)
Jing niso emsel'a ka jingtho teng ;
Kalung lhaisel tading, (2)
Jing niso emsel'a ka jingtho teng.
Na loupi mailhai mel chu kamu teng,
Lhatsa nacha deite na ngongkoi ding ;
Lungset thilpeh-in kot chu nahon teng,
Chonse keima kalung lhaisel tading.
Che masa ka ngaicheng mel kamu teng,
Iti kipa'ngem ken ngongkoi cheh ding;
Ka dinga naphat ken simjoulou ding,
Chonse keima kalung lhaisel tading.
Eihuhhingpa Christa mel kamu teng,
Kei jal'a athi ken sumil lou ding ;
Tonsot chullou lan ken vahchoi tange,
Chonse keima kalung lhaisel tading.
Reference: Doh is G. m

songs.title: CHOLNA JAN THIM LUNGDON NA HIN

lines: Cholna janthim lungdonna hin,
Meipi jing bangin eitom;
Kho hungvah ding kon ahitai,
Van'a ni hungsoh ding chu ;
Zion molsang vum'a kona,
Eikounau O jau hitin ;
Kipah tah-a kikhom soh ding,
Leng ahung teng le.
Gentheite kipah un,
Na loupina diu ni chu ahung naitai ;
Gentheite kipah un, Leng chungnung,
I ngau chu hung ding ahitai.
Jesu thisan'a lhatsate,
So le lhum lam'a konin ;
Kipah in hung kikhomun tin,
Olna gam tep noma chun ;
Vannoi chitin le namtin mi,
Gam tina kon hung ho chu ;
Kipah tah a kikhom soh ding,
Leng ahung teng le.
Asun ajan a ngah ho chu,
Tahsan'a athua nunga ;
Tang louva ana tong jing ho,
Lhagao chemjam pante chu ;
Vannoi leiset thim lah a hi,
A thaomei vah jing ho chu ;
Kipah thanom'a khomsoh ding,
Leng ahung teng le.
Reference: Doh is A♭. d

songs.title: JING NISO VAH NIA MIHEM CHAPA AHUNG NI LE

lines: Jing niso vah loupi nia Mihem Chapa ahung nile,
A vah loupi chungnung chu imu dingu ;
Kol kimvel'a kon'a amite akoukhom teng chule,
Alhatsa te kikhop loupi ni hi ding.
Kikhoppi chungnung ni hi ding,
Nop kemlou gam'a kikhoppi loupi ;
Chungnung ni hi ding,
Kikhoppi chungnung ni hi ngei ding,
Lhatsa hingte kikhop loupi ni hi ding.
Jesun nunnom'a thite akouva atho tengu le,
Lhankhuh thim sung le twikhanglen a kona ;
Vou kikhel'a vanlai jol'a alamto dingu ahi,
Iti kipa thanop a umta dingem.
Van khopi vah hoi sunga chu inhoi tamtah i-muva,
Olna twipi pang chu ilhun tengu le ;
Thinan eikhensau i-ngai chengseu toh ichenkhom tengle,
Kikhop ni kilamto loupi ni hi ding.
Leng chu hung tei ding ahi, ahung phat anai tul tul tai,
Ei tepnau nopni loupi chu imu diu ;
Chuteng le mitphet kah louva ivouvu hi kikhel ding,
Ama koma ichen jing dingu hita.
Reference: Doh is C. m
Ngaiyun mi chonse ten, Leiset man ni thu ding ;
Leng hat chungnung tah khat Laltouna atouve.
Hung kum teiding Jesu Christa, (2)
Vantil theng asang aja toh.
Leiset gam kimvel'a, A vantil asol'a ;
Molle twiya cheuva, mi chomkhom sohkei ding.
Jesun michonsete jouse, (2)
A lelut ding meidil sunga.
Chu tengle mi chonpha, Ama lung toh jouse ;
Van'a apuitou ding, Pathen lhai la sading.
Gou kemlou hin kemlou pentin,
Ol kemlou nop kemlou pentin ;
Kemlouva nomsa jing jeng ding.
Mi chonsete vang chu, ago ding meidil'a ;
A thu ngailouse chu, leiset na um laiya.
Gimtan neilouna meikonga, (2)
Tonsot'a gimthoh jing jeng ding.
Reference: Doh is B♭. d
I din dingu Leng anga,
Vantil toh la isah ding ;
Olle van gam nom'a,
Lui pang em'a ilen diu ;
Pathen vahchoi la sading,
Olle van gam nom'a.
I din dingu Leng anga,
Vantilto la isah diu ;
Loupi hen Leng chungnung chu,
Halleluijah, Halleluijah !
I din diu Leng ang sunga.
Van'a jola kisa ding,
I din diu Leng ang sunga ;
Olle van gam nom'a,
Gim hesoh bei sohta ding ;
I gimnau ichaisoh teng ;
Olle van gam nom'a.
Chen kalha thil lu choiyin,
Leng chungnung lamto dingin ;
Olle van gam noma,
Akhopi muh a kunin ;
Alhalim noiya umin,
Olle van gam noma.
Reference: Doh is B♭ d

songs.title: GAM LOUPI TAH HUNG LHUNG DING

lines: Gam loupitah hunglhung ding
Ka nga jing chu van chunga um,
A kum tin'a Mithengte punkhomna chu ;
Ni kemin chu gam loupi hunglhun ding chu asunaiye,
Pathen gam hunglhun ding chu anai ta-e.
He! Pathen gam hunglhun ding chu anaita e,
Pathen gam hunglhun ding chu anaita e ;
Kigo demin vo kalung, sumkon a eihin kou ding,
Pakai Jesun, hung lang ding loupi tah a.
Pathen gam loupi le aloupi gotsa chu kinemin,
Chule Pakai hungna ding lam kat jingin ;
Hichun vannoi leiset chonsetnan
Eihen eihung lha ding,
Pathen gam hunglhun ding chu anai ta-e.
Pathen gam hunglhun ni le
Pakai ngaitah chu imu diu,
Gam hunglhunna Pakai chu hung kilang ding !
Halleluiyah athisan'a eilhatpau chu vahchoiyun,
Pathen gam hunglhun ding chu anai ta-e.
Vannoi leiset min angah sottan
Alung lhadel tauve,
Tijat in mihemte lung adonghel tai ;
Pathen gam Thupha chu hilleu hitin suhal uhite,
Pathen gam hunglhun ding anai tah jeh in.
Reference: Doh is B♭ sₗ

songs.title: KIPA MAN HOM DING A PAKAI HUNG TENG

lines: Kipaman hom dinga Pakai hung teng,
Isan diu hinpo nan tem ?
I tahsan jingu ahung toh nadem ?
I nga jing Pakai Jesu.
Ti nau hitem phasa dem cheh a um,
Kahi van chunga kal dia,
I kigin jingu ahung toh nadem ?
Ama lam jeng chu isan jinga.
Jingpi phalvah-in hung kum khattou hen,
Eiho eihin kou taule ;
Pakai anga inatoh ikum teng,
Apha lheh e tinan tem ?
Aman eidalhah peh u tahsan chu,
Pha tah a ching jing dinga ;
Lung thengsel'a ichin cheh nah uvem ?
Van'a nop channa dinga.
Jan khangkimin i-Pakaiyu hung leh,
I nga jing hung toh nantem ?
Kiging jinga um chu anunnom ding,
Van'a tonsotna nom ding.
Reference: Doh is B♭. sₗ

songs.title: PATHEN SUMKON AGIN'A LEI HI AUM LOU TENG

lines: Pathen sumkon aginna lei hi aumlou teng chuleh,
Tonsot hinna khovah a niso tengle ;
Akhop teng alungtohte luipi pang gal langkhat lam'a,
Chua min kikouna sunga ka um ding.
Chua min kikouna sunga,
Chua min kikouna sunga ;
Chua min kikouna sunga,
Chua min kikouna sunga ka um ding.
Chu ni jingkah vahhoiya Christan mithi athosah a,
Athokit loupi achanni diu chule ;
A lhenchomte kikhop nile a in'u vanchung gam'a,
Chua min kikouna sunga ka umding.
Pathen na tonging kate niso a pat nilhum geiyin,
Ami ngailut kidang chu seichoi lenge ;
Chule i-natoh ijoa ihin nikho bulhin tengle,
Chua min kikouna sunga ka umding.
Reference: Doh is A♭. d

songs.title: MUTHIM UM TALOU DING JESU HUNG TENG

lines: Muthim um talou ding Jesu hung teng, (3)
A ngailut cheng puikhom’a.
A ngailut cheng puikhom’a. (2)
Muthim um talou ding Jesu hung teng,
A ngailut cheng puikhom’a.
Lungdonna beita ding Jesu hung teng,(2)
Jing khovah loupia Jesu hungteng,
A ngailut cheng puikhom’a.
Kana um talou ding Jesu hung teng. (3)
Mithengte lakhoma Jesu hungteng,
A ngailut cheng puikhom’a.
Kikhen kit talou ding Jesu hung teng,(3)
Kilemna la sading Jesu hungteng,
A ngailut cheng puikhom’a.
Reference: Doh is F. d

songs.title: JESU HUNG KIT DING KHATVEI LEH

lines: Jesu hung kit ding khatvei le, ahung ding kigingin!
Avan inom’a kon hung ding, ahung ding kiging un!
I Pakaiyu dihtah ahi,
Ama lhenchomte nunnom ding ;
Apa Laltouna anga din, ahungding kigingin!
Na neipa hung ding phat na kigin nam?
Lungmona kham’a na kigin nah em?
Jingkah, sun, jan hetthei lou ;
Ngim’a vah nam na thaomei,
Lung detna na ginnah em na neipa?
Ama leiya hungkit loi ding, ahung ding kigingin,
Alet alal akipan tai, ahung ding kigingin!
Vana Halleluijah ging ding,
Huhhingna hinpo ding Jesun ;
Na Lengpa lamdot din navon, ahung ding kigingin!
Veuvin ahunge kigingin, ahung ding kigingin!
Sumkon’a eikouvah dingu, ahung phat kigingin!
Lhagao nei mite jouse chu,
Thupi tana ahin kou chu,
Pakai anga idin cheh diu, ahung phat kigingin!
Reference: Doh is G. sₗ

songs.title: THINGPEL A KITHATPA THUJOP CHENGSE LE

lines: Thingpel’a kithatpa thujop chengse le,
Pathen Chapa changkhat tahsan chengse chun ;
Sochatna chamkim’a anei ding ahi,
Aman huhhingna thahat anei jeh chun.
Sopi Pakaiyin nangma nakou kouve,
Ami lungset khoto chu manbei ahi ;
Mi chonse lhatnan athisan alongin,
Ama bou huhhing chamkim soh thei ahi.
Koi hijongle Pathen Thupha jop chan chu,
Chonset keuna a thisan tahsan chan chu ;
Tonsot hin kemlou anei ding ahi,
Aman huhhingna thahat anei jeh chun.
Koi hile alung heiya chonset pailha,
Pakai lutna dinga lungkot honga chun ;
Ahuhhing chamkim’a nomsa ding ahi,
Huhhing ding sadem’a um ahijeh chun.
Reference: Doh is A. sₗ
Chonset suhgenthei Lhagao ho,
Jesu tahsan leuchun ;
Aman olsah taovin nate,
Athu tahsan leu chun.
Tahsan jengun, tahsan jengun,
Tahsan jengun tun ;
Huhhing teiding, huhhing tei ding,
Nang na huhhing ding.
Jesun athisan lu ason,
Hinna nom ei peuve ;
Thisan luiya chun kiphum’un,
Buh banga sop bang ding.
Jesu lampi dihtah ahi,
Olna gamnom jotna ;
Geisang louvin tahsan loiyin,
Phatthei nachan kim ding.
Ahile gam loupi jonin,
Hung lhauvin loi theng a ;
Gam loupia innom’a cheng din,
Nop kemlou van in’ah.
Reference: Doh is G. sₗ

songs.title: NAGA CHE NAM NANGMA JESU HENGA CHU

lines: Nagache nam nangma Jesu henga chun,
Athisan in na kisop theng nam ?
A milungsetna chu na kinem nam nang?
Athisan in na kisop theng nam?
Athisan … thenga chun,
Na chonset nasop theng soh nah em?
Navon nen chu kicheh a ngimsel soh nam?
A thisan chun na kisop theng soh nam?
Niseh in Jesu koma na umjing nam?
Thisana na ki soptheng hinam?
Ama chu lungmona na neinam nangma,
Athisan in na kisop theng nam?
Hung toh nantem ahung nile Moulang chun,
A thisan’a navon athen soh ;
Phasadem nan tem nalha vana kaldin,
A thisanin na kisop theng nam ?
Na chonset nen bena navon chu pailhan,
A thisan in kisil thengin tun ;
Nang dingin hinna twidung khat alonge,
Hia chun na chonset soptheng tan.
Reference: Doh is A♭. mₗ
Tonsot na chenna ding,
Hoi laiya in sa nahim ?
Khopi hui mutlhuh theina ham ?
Chonset neldi chung hintem?
Song chunga hin hung san,
In hung san apang det din ;
Christa jeng bou, Christa jeng bou,
Sochatna Songpi ahi.
Khopi hui anun'a,
Na in ahin nuh teng leh ;
Nellei chunga insa nangma,
Lung mongin umnan natem ?
Khopi hui nun kah in,
In mundet ding ki ngaiton ;
Na lung gel’in hung san tu man,
Longlou Songpi chung ahin.
Reference: Doh is B♭ sₗ

songs.title: VEOVIN IHINNA DING UN JESU CROSS CHUNGA

lines: Veuvin ihinna dingun Jesu Cross chunga,
Eihuhnan athisan along lhai ;
Ven, mi chonsen tun ven kihuhhing sah loiyin,
Nangma huhna along toh pa chu.
Ven ! Ven ! Ven hing in,
Hinna dinga Cross chunga kikhenbeh Jesu ;
Genthei tah in athi nang chunan.
Hungun michonsen hung ven nahinna ding un,
Cross chunga um Jesu khu tunin ;
Jesu hilou nasam gim le genthei thoh a,
Tonsot hinkem lou nang na pea chu.
Na chonsetna jouse hinpon Jesu koma,
Hung seplhan Ama soptheng dingin ;
Thonmon soplhante Aman athisan lu chun,
Theng tante na chonset nen jouse.
Chonset muthim’a hitih chanpi na ihmun,
Na umjinge Ama helouvin ;
Vo michonse tun hungin Jesu henga chun,
Khatvei hungven na sochatna din.
Reference: Doh is G. d

songs.title: KA HENG A HUNG UVIN ATI JESUN

lines: “Ka henga hung’uvin” ati Jesun,
Hinna Pakai nalung kipa sah chun ;
“Lungkham’a lung gentheiya umte ho,
Ka henga hungun ken olsah inge".
Hungun keima henga hungun,
Ka henga hungun keiman olsah inge ;
Keiman ol penge, keiman ol penge.
Chonset pohna a pohgih lengvai ho,
Jesun na khoton na kouvui hungun ;
Na lungdon hesoh bei sohna dingin,
“Ka henga hungun keiman ol penge.”
Chonset le suhkhel’a thiding kon ho,
Khangun, Pathen kichauvin lung gel’un ;
Na tahsanmo pailhan tahsanin tun,
“Ka henga hungun keiman ol penge.”
Reference: Doh is F. m

songs.title: JESUN NAKOU KOU LAIHIN CHONSE HUNGIN

lines: Jesun nakou kou laihin, chonse hungin,
Nang dinga katao lai hin, chonse hungin ;
Ama neiphat tu ahi, chonse hungin,
Ama hetphat tu ahi, chonse hungin.
Na chonset poh nalel’em, chonse hungin,
Jesun napoh ngai jang ding , chonse hungin,
Jesun nang dalha lou ding, chonse hungin,
Jesun tun nang na sange, chonse hungin.
Ama lungset sunga chun, chonse hungin,
Phattheina hung kisan in, chonse hungin ;
Jesun nakou petcha hin, chonse hungin,
Nang katao peh pet’u hin, chonse hungin.
Reference: Doh is F. m

songs.title: HUNG KIHEI JIN VAH MANGSA LUNG GENTHEI

lines: Hung kiheiyin vah mangsa lung genthei,
Ven Jesu Christan naching jinge nang ;
Na hol’in na ngah e huhhing dingin,
Geisang louvin Ama tahsan loiyin.
Lungdam sel’in nakouve nang Jesun,
Phaten ngaiyin Jesun nakou chu ;
Lung lhaisel’in nakouve nang Jesun,
“Hungun” tin lungset’in eikouvui.
Na manlouna dingin nangah jinge,
Hitih chan nangma vah manga nahi ;
Nangma chu-nan thi genthei athoh tai,
Ami ngailut kidang chu seitheilou.
Athu ngaiyin lang alungsetna hen,
Cross chunga nachonset a pomang tai ;
Tonsot hin kemlou chu namu sah tai,
Na chonset jouse angaidam soh tai.
Hungin lamlui lamdih hungjot kit’in,
Hinna kotpi Jesua hunglut loiyin ;
Lung lhaisel’in nakouve nang Jesun,
Lhachom kit talou ding nang akom’a.
Reference: Doh is G. sₗ
Damsel chan katong lhum’ui,
Hiche nigup sunga hin ;
Ka kikhom tauve tunin,
Pathen lhai la ka sauve ;
{Hiche Pathen nipha hi,
Van tonsot ol kihetna.} (2)
Mi lungset them’a Jesun,
Ka setnau soptheng soh-in ;
Chonse ho taona ngaiyin,
Ka khelnau ngaidam soh-in ;
{Bei hen leiset lung ngaina,
Ka lungu Nanga kai hen.} (2)
Nangma ka lhaipet chau hin,
Ka lungu sunem soh-in ;
Hiche hou-in thenga hin,
Hung kiphong in Pathen Nang ;
{Van’a kon an kemlou chu,
Kei ho neihin pe cheh un.} (2)
Reference: Doh is G. d
Gamtu thim noiya navale,
Jin le hoiya ding nahim?
Leiset gam thim lai najot chu,
Nalung olmo lou hinam?
Vanchung gam jon kahiuve,
Hung kipat in lhonu hite;
Pathen min vahchoiyu hite.
Kahinai 'Jinle' neite chu,
Ahivanga olmo lou;
Eiching pau to kalhon nai kei,
Ama vang chu kasong e.
Hoiya umam nalamkai pau,
Kamu hih in ka olmoi;
Chutia nachingpa aumle,
Amala akimu pon.
Heng kimulou ahivanga,
Eipuile phatah ahi;
Gimna jousea eihuh in kei,
Kagal asumang sohji.
Jingle nalampi masanga,
Vetan nathina ding chun;
Nangma hinchup jeng tale chun,
Nache tei ngam ding hinam?
Reference: Doh is G.

songs.title: HUNG UN GEL UN SOPI TE, JESUN EILUNGSET NA

lines: Hungun gel’un sopite Jesun ei lungset na,
I chonset suhmang nadin, I lungu ngaitou te.
I ding lung phamo ihim ?
I lung thoinau i-ham ?
I monau phongjal leu hen,
Aman subei tante.
Keima Christa tahsansa, Ama lam sangsa hing,
Ka lung thoi kittan keima, tun kalung olmo tai.
Twilen soh bang lung detlou,
Mi lengvai olmo jing ;
Tha neilou mi dammo ken,
Hoiya olna mung-em ?
Hijongle na huhhingpa, Getsemania ngaiton,
Nang chonset pohmangna a, Athisan ul'a long.
Thingpel a aumpet chun,
Athisan along lhai ;
Nang chonset jal’in athi,
Henge tun tahsan tan.
Lungin tun jong atahsan lou nahi nah laiyem ?
A khophang bul’a kunin, ichonset beina din.
Chutobang Jesu chu ken,
Nahsah mon ngai ponge ;
Ka thi nungle Akom’a,
Ka lut jel theina din.
Reference: Doh is E. sₗ
Zion molsang chung vum'a
Gal upa thithei louvin,
Eikou ui galsat dingin,
Gal sat-a umte.
Ngaiyun sumkon gin ngei khu,
Veuvin Pathen ponlap khu,
Gal sangja ahung nai tai,
Chem le thal dom in.
Hung un mi chonse chate,
Sochatna ding lung pu-vin,
I dougal a sumang tai,
I lamkai Jesun.
Lhan sung a nithum cham in,
Thina dougal sat chai jin,
Loupi tah min len tah in,
A kaltou kit tai.
Leiset mihem mai vea,
Pathen mit'a jahcha pa,
Galsat petna kisel chun,
Ka nung juida hen.
Nu le pa, sopi dalha,
Thal le hem lah nohngam pa,
Thi le man kicha lou pan,
Ka nung hin jui hen.
Kon ute galsat ding in,
Theu hite Satan loi chu,
Theu hite dana gam chu,
Chonset pailhau te.
Nopna munnom tup ute,
Nop le ol kem louna chu,
Mang thei lou Pathen gam’a,
Lut teiding goute.
Reference: Doh is A.

songs.title: GAL SAM UN SATAN GAL AHUNG NAI TAI

lines: Gal sam’un Satan gal ahung naitai,
Christa din ponlap dom sangun ;
Galvon von’un dingdet cheh uvin,
Athu theng chu lum le phon sung in.
Kon’un galmi loi kisemtoh un lang,
Pangdet cheh un thu hi ban tol’un ;
Malam nouvin Hosana tin ao-vun,
Christa gal lamkai pipen ahi.
Gal hahsa hen lang itobang jong le,
I jo tei diu ahi thon mo’a ;
Khovah lum sungin lhagao chem pan un,
Jona chu eiho chan ding ahi.
Vo! Vannoi Pathen ka kounau ngaijin,
Nei hu’vin na milungset chun ;
Galsat kichaiya gal kijo teng le,
Lallukhuh kasan theina ding un.
Reference: Doh is B♭. sₗ

songs.title: CHRISTIAN SEPAI KONUN, GAL SAT IN CHEUVIN

lines: Christian Sepai kon un, galsat in cheuvin,
Jesu lam jeng veuvin, I-Lamkaipau chu ;
Leng Christa akontai, Satan galsat din,
Ama alamkai tai ponlap che veuvin.
Christian sepai kon’un,
Satan galsat din ;
Jesu lam jeng veuvin,
I-Lamkai pau chu.
Galmi janel banga Pathen mite kon,
Mitheng ho chena nung juiya ihiuve ;
A chom chom iumpoi, I boncha pumkhat,
I kinepnau jong khat, I kainau khat bou.
Leiset lengho gamle, A lalnau mang ding,
Christa Houbung vang chu, mantih neilou ding ;
Gim, hesoh, lungdonna, kiseikit lou ding,
A tonsot tonsot’a Christa vaihom ding.
Reference: Doh is F. s
Lhum lam gam'a konin,
Thu ahung thang lhunge ;
Hichu Christa lama tah panna thu ahi,
Ahung kitol tol’in ;
Thing lhangin lan asai,
Christa lama dettah a tahpanna thu ahi.
Gal jona dingin, (2)
Pakaiyin kho asam’e,
Athun chonnu hite ;
Gam lo loitau hite,
Christa lama dettah a ;
Tahpanna thu ahi.
Ngaiyuvin O gin chu,
Leiset hot ling soh O ;
Hichu Christa lama tahpanna thu ahi,
Hangtah in tong panun ;
Kiginnan kho sam’un,
Christa lama dettah a tahpanna thu ahi.
Khangdong tha ka pan’ui,
Tunin Jesu angah ;
Hichu Christa lama tahpanna thu ahi,
Athupha phong leute ;
Vannoi mi gam jousea,
Christa lama dettah a tahpanna thu ahi.
Reference: Doh is E♭, sₗ

songs.title: VAN'A LENGPA PONLAP AHUNG LENGLHA TAI

lines: Van’a Lengpa ponlap ahung lenglha tai,
Van Leng sepaite hengah ;
Olmo louvin dom sangu hite tunin,
La i-sah ngei pet’u hin.
Hunguvin, hunguvin,
Christa jal’in mang jongleu hen ;
Khuh sah un Lallukhuh hoi chu,
Thingpel ponlap noi lim’a.
Twipi nong bang melma hung kitol jongle,
Ponlap leh sang jingun lang ;
Alim noiya umun Pakai sepaite,
Thon louva eima jo ding.
Twi le leiset chunga mihem cheng jousen,
Hilsoh un hiche Thupha ;
Hiche thisan ponlap van’a lenglha chu,
Pakai galjo kithanna.
Nopna khovah loupi ni ahung nai tai,
Niseh in ahung nai tai ;
Chuteng Leng anga dougal beisohta ding,
Vannoi Cross in khokhong ding.
Reference: Doh is B♭. mₗ
Gamla naiya kon Christian te,
Hikom a ikikhomui tun;
Jesu thu kihil a sim din,
Van kipa kinep dimset chu.
Eiho hapan loi hin, Amin’a kikhom min,
Lungkhat le thakhat in Amin phongjal leute ;
Pathen le igamsung din pangdet cheh-ute,
Phattheina a eichin jingna dingun taovun.
Akikhomsen la sau hite,
I-Lengpau Christa vahchoi la;
Khangdongin lam amuna ding,
Hinna gam jotna lampi chu.
Pakai natong jing uhite,
Kinepna ineisau ngaiton;
Alungset gingchan jui ute,
Chung a iki khop kah seuvin.
Reference: Doh is C, s

songs.title: PAKAI CHRISTA VANGIN SANTHU NUNG JUI JIN

lines: Pakai Christa vangin danthu nungjuiyin,
Hin kemlou chu Ama vahchoina dingin ;
Kipah le thanom tah in vahchoi cheh un,
Pakai danthu nung juiyin sauvin.
Dingun ! dingun !
Pakai Jesu a dingun athutep juiyun ;
Dingun ! dingun !
Pakai thutep juiyin kadinge kei.
Danthu jui chu imatih in lha ponge,
Lhahchomna le kichatna Aman eihoi ;
Mantih neilou thu chu Ama a ahi,
Pakai danthu juiyin dinguvin.
Athu nungjui ding keima olmo lou ding,
Lhagao Thengin eikou chu ken ngai jing ding ;
Tonsot’in Pakai vahchoiyin ol tange.
Pakai nopna chun um jing tange.
Reference: Doh is B♭, sₗ

songs.title: HUNGUN CHRISTIAN TE LUNGKHAT HIU HITIN

lines: Hungun Christiante lungkhat hiu hitin,
Seiphong leute sochatna Thupha ;
Thinglhang gamsunga mi acheng jouse,
Satan bulpu’vin akum tu’ve.
Hungun Christiante itha gomtou tin,
Sumang dingin idou Satan hat ;
Hungun Christiante tha gomtou hitin,
I thahat pennau Jesu umna.
Mi sangja hijat hinna Thu mulou,
Vetem tauvin akihen nau bul ;
Bulpu ngaiton lang i-nop pailhauvin ;
Gasut lham ute bulpute chu.
Hungun sopite lungthah sem’utin,
Chalsahna din Pakai Jesu gam ;
Kihabol cheh un tantih neilouvin,
Niloupi nia pam chanlou na din.
Reference: Doh is A♭. sₗ
Van chung gamnom emhoi tah a,
Chun vantilten la asai ;
Halleluiyah Hosana tin,
Asamun Leng vahchoi nan ;
Hiche leiset genthei munna konin,
Pakaiyin eipui len ;
Gangtah in ka jon’uve,
Vanchung gamnom emhoi tah chu.
O chu gam ilhun teng le,
Sana lukhuh isan diu ;
Kipah le thanom tah a,
Chu gamnom em’a ilen diu.
Vanchung gamnom emhoi jon chun,
Nitin mi ache jinge ;
Eiho chu gam lhunna ding,
Nikhon eihin naiyuve ;
Jesu heng lam jon ihiuve,
Ama toh leng khom dingin ;
Hiche gama chu tonsot’a,
Ama kivahchoi ta ding.
Chu gam emhoi nom tah a chun,
Mitin din in nom aum ;
Lhandampu tahsan jouse le,
Kouna ngai jouse dingin,
Pakai thupeh hung lhun phat le,
Kipana hung lhung tading ;
Chuteng hi leiset dalha gam,
Nom hoitah chu ijot diu.
Reference: Doh is G. d

songs.title: A MANG KON HUHDOH IN ATHI KON NGAITON

lines: Amangkon huhdoh in, athikon ngaiton,
Chonse khuh a konin ladoh loiyin ;
Chon khelte chu hil’in alhu kaithouvin,
Huhhing Pakai Jesu thu seipeh in.
Amangkon huhdoh in, Athikon ngaiton,
Mi lungset them Jesun huhhing tei ding.
Ama hon angaisah louhel vanguvin,
Aman angah jinge lung neng tah in ;
Avel vel’in dam heochan akou jinge,
Tahsan pouleu ngaidam ding ahi.
Mihemte lungsung setnan alodim tai,
Hijeh chun Pakai leiya ahunge ;
Lungset khut’in athamin asukhangin,
Athisa jong ahinsah kit jitai.
Amangkon huhdoh in nangma kin ahi,
Pakaiyin nangma thahat pen nate ;
Lhagao mang ding mi sangja a um uve,
Huhhingpan alungsetnau thu hil’in.
Reference: Doh is B. sₗ
Christa mi lungset seileu te,
A lungset len,
Leiset mihemte hinna din,
Alungset len.
Ahung kumlhai hi leiset'a,
Apengtai leiset naosen in;
Mihem te jal'in gim thoh in,
Alungset len.
Chapang ho A-anga pomin,
Alungset len,
Aphei chunga pomin vang pen,
Alungset len,
Aching jinge Ama mite,
Agim na ding uva huh in,
Apui touding van gam nom'a,
Alungset len.
Thina ding gui sutlham soh in,
Alungset len,
Gam thum aman vaihomin,
Alungset len,
Along athisan tohpa chu,
Ahitai van chunga Thempu;
Ami te thoh bang thoh in,
Alungset len.
Van'a nopna a ilut man,
Alungset len,
Lungkhat in lhai jing ute,
Alungset len,
Kai jing ute Christa heng'ah,
Kinemin ami lungsetna;
Sau hite hinlai dam sung in,
Alungset len.
Reference: Doh is E♭. d

songs.title: SOCHATNA LE HINNA KHOVAH THU DONG A

lines: Sochatna le hinna khovah thu donga,
Vaipo khat jan’a Jesu henga ahung chun ;
Jesun thudih tah in ana donbut’in,
“Pengthah kit’un” ati.
Napen thah diu ahi,
Napen thah diu ahi ;
Kichen tah a kaseipeh nahi" ati ;
Napen thah diu ahi.
Jesun khuh a kon eihung lhatdoh nau hi,
Athu ngaitouvin mihem chapa chanu ten ;
Hiche Thupha hi moh hisah hih hel’un,
Napen thah diu ahi.
Nangho vangam nom’a lutnom ho chengsen,
Eihuhhingnau Thupha hi kipa lan sauvin ;
Tonsot mangmo hinkemlou nanei nomle,
Napen thah diu ahi.
Na lunga vangam nom chu namu nom le,
Kotpi hoi phunga chun nang na ngah jinguve ;
Chuche gamnom hoi a chu nalut nom le,
Napen thah diu ahi.
Reference: Doh is E♭, d

songs.title: O SOPI NANGMAN VANGAM MUCHI CHU

lines: O sopi nangman vangam muchi chu,
Jingkah seh'a nathe jing hinam?
O sopi nangman vangam muchi chu,
Janthip gei-a nathe jing hinam?
Chang ki at phat chu ahung nai tai,
Chang ki-at chu kichai loi tading,
Nangma changpang chu adim na din,
Pontho tah in tong in nasan ding atam'e.
O sopi nangman vangam muchi chu,
Jan thip gei-a nathe jing hinam?
O sopi nangman vangam muchi chu,
Lungtheng sel'a nathe jing hinam?
O sopi nangman vangam muchi chu,
Lei phalah a nathe jing hinam?
O sopi nangman vangam muchi chu,
Miho henga nathe jing hinam?
Reference: Doh is D. d
Phattheina go hong hungju hen,
Lungsetna eitepna sau ;
Juhsah jing jeng hen niseh in,
Jesun hinjuh lhah sah in.
Phattheina go hong,
Ka ngaiyui phattheina chu ;
Malkhou tah in hinjuhsah in,
Hungju hen ka chunguva.
Go hungjun phattheina go hong,
Lhagao thisa thoukit hen,
Thinglhang le phaicham dam jol’a,
Hung chin in phattheina go.
Phattheina go hong hungju hen,
Pathen hin sollhan tunin ;
Kalung nguisau halsah kit hen,
Nei tepnau guilhun sah in.
Phattheina go hong hungju hen,
Juhsah in tuni tah in ;
Ka setnau jouse sop thengin,
Jesu kakou petchau hin.
Reference: Doh is B♭. sₗ
Kan eihuhhing lou ding,
Kalhin kamai phet jong leng ;
Ka lungdon subei lou ding,
Kumsot chonset beilou ding,
Kan eihuhhing lou ding.
Kei chuna Jesu thita,
Thingpel’a kikhen behta ;
Eingah-e huhhing dingin,
Huhhing jou Ama bou.
Toh-in eihuhhing lou ding,
Iti chonphat jeng jong leng ;
Itobangin hou jong leng,
Ka lung thahsah theilou ding,
Toh in eihuh lou ding.
Ngah leng kei hing lou ding,
Panpi bei mi mangsa kei ;
Lungset’a eikou pet hin,
Ngah leng keima thita ding,
Ngah leng kei hinglou ding.
Christa tahsan hinna,
Pathen Chapa Jesu chu ;
A tohchan ken gingcha leng,
A bantha'n eihuhhing ding,
Christa tahsan hinna.
Reference: Doh is E♭. s
Ka leiset hinkho abei teng,
Ken bang ding tulai ka lasah ;
Pathen inpi sung lim noiya,
Kalut teng kei kipah jing ding.
Kimaitoa muding Amai ken,
Lungset’a eilhat thu sei ding ;
Kimaitoa mu ding Amai ken,
Lungset’a eilhat thu seiding.
Nikhat ka leiset in chimding,
Asot apal kasei thei poi ;
Ahin ka dingin van chunga,
Mun a ume ti ken kahei.
Nikhat chung toni jong mang ding,
Leiset pahhoi jouse mang ding ;
Pakaiyin, “Nabol aphai” tia,
Eikou teng lut’a ol ta ding.
Pakaiyin kot ahon tengle,
Ka lhagao lutjel theina ding,
Ka thaomei devah jinging ting,
Ki gingin ken ngah jing inge.
Reference: Doh is F♭. m
Nitin’in ka tahsane,
Ka lung tha alhom tengle ;
Kalam muthim teng jong le,
Christa a kalung kinem.
Ni tin’in ka tahsane,
Lung dong lou ding itih a ;
I-tih le kahin laisea ;
Christa a kalung kinem.
Ka nop kom le la sange,
Kagim kom le tao vinge ;
Set toh jeng jong leng keima,
Christa a ka lung kinem.
Pathen Lhagaovin keima,
Eisalvah-e nitin’in ;
Aman kei eiching jinge,
Christa a kalung kinem.
Keima kahinlai chansen,
Hi leiset aman kah sen ;
Nopna vangam kalhun man,
Christa a kalung kinem.
Reference: Doh is A♭. m
Na lung hesoh sel’in, min jong anei nai,
Thuh tah-in hasel’in, phatechan sel’in ;
Na changa na umna lung gelin ngaiton,
Jesu jah-a seiyin lung mong tante.
Jesu jah a seiyin, athohsa ahi,
Seisoh in ahenga, nang panpi tei ding ;
Lung mon theina thu chu nalungin ching phan,
Pohgih ngai jang anom, ahenga taovin.
Lungdong hesoh mihem, tamtah aume,
Amaho thu gapen lungmonna thu hi ;
Sel’in nalung hesoh, mi chu kipah hen,
Nalung hesohna chu Jesu heng lhutjon.
Reference: Doh is B♭ d

songs.title: ADANG CHE NUNG A MOLCHUNG A

lines: Adang che nunga mol chunga,
Kelngoi vah mang keiman ;
Hinna lungmonna hong sung lam,
Iti holdoh tang ngem ?
Kei kahi, hinna lam leh thutah,
Keima louvin koima Pa kom alhung theipoi ;
Kei kahi, hinna lam le thutah,
Keima louvin koima Pa kom alhung theipoi.
Kana vahmang lengvai yin kei,
Pathen heng jon louvin ;
“Hilam khu lama” eitiuvin,
Thutah la kahol mon.
Hinna lam le thutah Jesu,
Henge ka chei, tukal ;
Mangthah kit talouhel dingin,
A anga ka lut tai.
Reference: Doh is B♭ m
Nisa vah che phahna chan’a,
Gam jousea Jesun vaihom ding ;
Gam jouse chunga
Leng chang ding,
Ni le lhavah mol mang kahsen.
Chitin namtin pao tintang min,
A vahchoi la sanom cheh ding ;
Chapang sen san’in jong sa ding,
A mintheng vahchoina la chu.
Tan neilouva Ama henga,
Taona vahchoina umjing ding ;
Amin chu thao namtui bang ding,
Namtin vai jousen hou soh ding.
Chuteng leiset min ja cheh ding,
A lengpau chu sang sohkei diu ;
Vantil jong hung kumlha kit ding,
“Amen” tia leiyin kho sam ding.
Reference: Doh is E. d

songs.title: HOICHAN GAM HIJONG LE KEI KICHA LOU DING

lines: Hoichan gam hijongle kei kicha lou ding,
Jesun eilhonpia eipuina channa chu ;
Ama beiya lung kipa thanopna bei,
Jesun eilhonpina a kei kicha lou.
Hoi chan’a hijong le kei kicha lou ding,
Jesun eilhonpia bit keicha kei che ding.
Kei ka chang hilou Jesun eilhonpi nai,
Gol le pai thon jong le Ama kanei nai ;
Lam hahsa lama Aman eipui jongle,
Jesu toh umna chu vahchoina in hi.
Jesun ei lhonpina chan’a kei nom’a,
Imu thei kavel iti thim jeng jong le ;
Lung lhaisel’a ka jingtho ding chu kahei,
Jesu toh umna chan chu innom ahi.
Reference: Doh is D. s

songs.title: HINKHO TWIPI KINONG HUIPI HAT NATOA

lines: Hinkho twipi kinong huipi hat natoa,
Mang soh a kingaito a nalung lhah teng ;
Na phattheina jouse abanchan simmin,
Pakai thilbol cheng chun kinsah in nate.
Na phattheina abanchan simin,
Amin son lang abanchan simin ;
Pakaiyin na bolpeh chengse chu,
Pakai thilbol chengchu kidang san nate.
Pohgih poa lungkham lungdonga na um’em ?
Naput dinga kigotpeh Cross chu gih sam ?
Phattheina sim le chun ginchat lel bei ding,
Sun nisa vah bangin vah jing tan nate.
Mi sumnei, selnei, gamnei navet kom le,
Christan natepsa hao seitheilou ngaiton ;
Ahao choh joulou phattheina chu simin,
Toh phatman nasan ding van’a atam’e.
Hijeh chun gim genthei iti hah jong le,
Lunglha hih in Pathen achungnung pen’e ;
Phattheina simin vantil’in nangah nai,
Nalam lhung keiya nalhonpi diu ahi.
Reference: Doh is E♭. m

songs.title: GEISANG LOU JENUN MI CHONSE HO

lines: Geisang lou jennun michonse ho,
Christa na hinna diu a ume ;
Tunin nakouve, O nem tah in,
“Hinna penge” ati.
Nom hen, nom hen Pakai Christa min,
Ka chonset eisop lheng peh pa chu ;
A kom’a tonsot’a ka chen ding,
Van chunga in thenga.
Jesun na kouve ngaiyin chonsen,
“Hungun chapang ho” hitin ati ;
Hung loiyun chonse lung lengvai te,
Pakai Christa sangin.
Kho pholouvin um hih un mite,
Tunin hin Jesun nang nakouve ;
Hungun mi chonse lungbei olmo,
Na chonset lung khel’in.
Reference: Doh is B♭ sₗ

songs.title: LANGEI TAH KHAT KASA NOM E

lines: La ngeitah khat kasa nome,
Lhatdam kachan’a pat ;
Lhandampu vahchoi la sange,
Lhatdam kachan’a pat.
Lhatdam kachan’a pat (2)
Amin vahchoi jing tange ;
Lhatdam kachan’a pat,
Amin loupi vahchoi jing tange.
In nom hoitah khat kaneiye,
Lhatdam kachan’a pat ;
Tonsot’in cheng jing inge kei,
Lhatdam kachan’a pat.
Lhandampu vahchoi la sange
Lhandam kachan’a pat ;
Tonsot in sa jing inge ken,
Lhatdam kachanna pat.
Reference: Doh is G. s

songs.title: CROSS CHU INJOT NA LAMPIA KANEI TEI DING

lines: Cross chu in jotna lampia kanei tei ding,
Chulou chu lamdang umlou ;
Van khopi hoichu keiman mulou ding,
Ka mansah le Cross lampi chu.
Van in jotna Cross ahi, (2)
Kache pum hin ka lam mu kanome ;
Van in jotna Cross ahi.
Thisan bena lampi chu kaho tei ding,
Eihuhhingpa chenna chu ;
Van chung innom jon’a kakal tou ding,
Lhagao Pathen toh chen na chu.
Vannoi lampi chu kalhadoh tai keiman,
Achung hokit louhel ding ;
Jesun “Hungin” tin ka in ka jon’e,
Kot phunga einga jing na chu.
Reference: Doh is A♭. sₗ

songs.title: KEIMA INNOM VAN KHOPI KA LHUN TENGLE

lines: Keima innom Van khopi kalhun tengle,
Ka pohgih ho Akom'a ken ngading,
Kem theilou Lallukhuh kaki khuh ding ahi,
Ken kipana la-a ka vahchoi ding ahi.
Chung van gamnom keima in chu,
Ka lhun tengle keiman,
Hesoh genthei na ho jouse,
Ken dalha a lung genthei na,
Um louding chu mun'a chun.
Keima innom van khopi kalhun tengleh,
Leiset muthim jingho umkit talou ding,
Vangam vah emhoi chun keima eisalvah in,
Van gam kalhun kahsen eisal vah e.
Keima innom Van khopi ka lhun teng le,
Ka mit a huhhing pa mel ka mu ta ding,
Pakai Ama vah chun keima eisal vah in,
Mangthah louva Ama toh chengkhom ding.
Reference: Doh is C. d
Nalung donsah hih helun,
Pakaiya lung ngaiyun ;
Ama jenga kinem in,
Christa a thi jouse chu,
Van'a ahung pui ding.
Hijeh chun nangho,
Khat le khat hicheng thu hin ;
Kilungmon to cheh un,
Hiche jeh chun nang ho,
Hijeh chun nang ho ;
Kilungmon to cheh uvin, (2)
Hicheng chun.
Nalung donsah hih hel’un,
Christa bou tahsan in ;
Jan’a lungdon na cheng hi,
Jinga nomsah na dinga ;
Aman nang hung pui ding.
Pakai hung nading nikho,
Ngah jingin anai tai ;
Van’a akal ni banga,
Amitheng ten hin tom ding,
Hung kilah loi tading.
Reference: Doh is A♭. sₗ
Ngaiyun Pakai ding bolte jousen,
Hatmo leh thi dingin ;
Pakai phatthei lhah ngah jinguvin,
Eisem pha jing nante.
Pakai thahatna kingai chu,
Athau semthah in tin ;
Alhan leng touvun tin,
Muvanlai bangin leng touvun tin ;
Lhaitou dingu thachol louva,
Chol louva lam jot diu ;
Lhaitou dingu chollou hel’a,
Chol louva che diu.
Tamtah vei theichim le lung thoiyin,
Achunga iphun’ui ;
Huhhingpa hingjing itahsan’ui,
I bol’a kilel dem.
Kipah un ei umpi jing nauve,
Leiset beini geiyin ;
Khodah in hungun lang ma son’un,
Ingai chan eipe ding.
Reference: Doh is A♭. sₗ

songs.title: NISUN VAH A CHUN CHEN NIPI VAH A CHUN

lines: Nisun vah a chun chen, nipi vah a chun,
Jinga pahcha pah le janlai dai lhah in ;
Nitin in masonin dettah in pangun,
Lam tinna Jesu juijin.
Jui un keiman jong kajui-e,
Jui un niti’in jui un ;
Aman napui le na channa,
Juijin Jesu chu alam tinnah.
Sun nisat emlai le, janlai muthimin,
Chamkang lou noulai le chuhlai go lonin ;
Aman nakou ngaiyun asei thun nung un,
Lam tin’ah Jesu jui in.
Nisa vah emlai le thimpi jing a jong,
Khopi hui nunna le lungdon nah a jong ;
Ami ngailut gingchan akhon ni geiyin,
Anung lhaso lou jen in.
Reference: Doh is B♭. sₗ
Jesun kot akiu kiuve,
Thachol ka henga hungun ;
Tin huhhing din nakouve,
Kot chu hong len’in.
Kot chu hong len’in,
Kot chu hong len’in ;
Huhhing jou Ama ahi,
Kot chu hong len’in.
Jesun kot akiu kiuve,
Nang huhnan Ama athin ;
Lhanna kon athoudoh tai,
Kot chu hong len’in.
Jesun kot akiu kiuve,
Don nalung Aheng lama ;
Nalung kipana dim ding,
Kot chu hong len’in.
Jesun kot akiu kiuve,
Huhhingna anaipet hin ;
Ajo le chemang kit khante,
Kot chu hong len in.
Reference: Doh is D♭. sₗ

songs.title: THENNA DING PHAT NEIJIN NA PATHEN HOUVIN

lines: Thenna ding phat neiyin na Pathen houvin,
Amatoh um jingin Athun kivah in ;
Pathen chate ho jong kihou thei pin lang,
Ahatmo te hun lang sumil lou jenin.
Thenna ding phat neiyin athu nit jingin,
Jesu chu guhthim min atamjon houvin ;
Jesu vejing le chun Ama toh bang ding,
Na gol’in amud in a umchan bang thon.
Thenna ding phat neiyin lam kihil sah in,
A ang sunga konin jammang lou jenin ;
Gim hesohna ahi na Pakai juiyin,
Jesu lam kat jingin Athu tahsanin.
Thenna ding phat neiyin nalung olsah in,
Na lungput jouse chun anoiya lut’in ;
Avaihom thun nungin kipuisah jingin,
Ngailut bulpi ahi van’a puilut thei.
Reference: Doh is F. m
Hinkho deilai achom’e,
Thingna pullai abange ;
Changphal kansa abange ki gingun,
Hin nikho akem jinge,
Vangset ni hung lhung inte ;
Thina hunglhung loiyinte ki gingun.
Phat hom’in ki gingun,
Jesun nakou kou laiyu hin ki gingun ;
Setna a umsot leu chun,
Hinna kot hon hom louvin ;
Nalut phat kikhel’in te ki gingun.
Pahcha hoilai pul loiyin,
Khangdong hoilai cheloiyin,
Nang umsot ding nahipoi ki gingun ;
Pathen lhan nakou laiyin ;
Umhih un ngaisah louvin,
Manna lam’a chunnate ki gingun.
Phat akem tul tul jinge,
Thi vaihom ahung naiye ;
Jesu khut’a kikhum’un mangang un ;
Vangsetna ahung lhun’a,
Na lhagao man masangin,
Aloupina chu simun kigingun.
Hilna thu chu ngai phauvin,
Pakai chu tuhdet leu chun,
Van mi jouse kipah ding, kigingun ;
Chonset muthim dalhauvin,
Jesu chu tahsan’un lang,
Van lam jonin tun cheuvin kiging un.
Reference: Doh is E♭. d
Silom twikul mol lim noija,
Pahcha namtui keh chu ;
Iti namtui tam mol noiya,
Saron pah mum hoi chu. (2)
Hibang chun tulai khang chapang,
Hoi keichan apenge ;
Alungu thengsel nemheu chan,
Pathen lam asangui. (2)
Silom tuikul mol lim noija,
Pahcha chu pul teiyin ;
Mol noiya pahcha namtui chu,
Thonmo a mol loi jita. (2)
Mihemte jong chutobang ding,
A hinkho alhin teng ;
Athi ding lung leng olmo ding,
Thon moa la thi tei ding. (2).
Reference: Doh is E♭ m

songs.title: BIBLE A THU UM HI THUPHA CHUNGNUNG PEN

lines: Bible’a thu umhi Thupha chungnung pen,
Athu jouse hinna le sochatna ;
Mi thisa jong thoukit ding tin aseiye,
Lhagao mangsa hindoh kitna ahi.
Bible thu ngaiyun, Bible thun nungun,
Mangun Bible Thupha hinna kidang.
Ngai phauvin Bible gou kemlou chungnung thu,
Lhagao hinna le sochatna ahi ;
Aman jat jong leiset min sim theilou ding,
Hol’in lhagao phattheina kidang hi.
Mi lamvaite dinga Bible meivah pha,
Khangthah dan neilou dinga jong phatna ;
Mi chonse dinga hinna le lung olna,
Teh le khang dinga hibou Thupha pen.
Reference: Doh is B♭, d

songs.title: O NGEI TAH IN SAKIT TEM IN

lines: O ngeitah in sakit tem’in,
Hinna le nopna thu ;
Hi thu chu kei eihil beuvin,
Hinna le nopna thu ;
Hiche Pathen thu hin,
Phatna thu eihil’e.
Thu ngei chungnung thu kidang tah,
Hinna le nopna thu.
Jesun mijouse ahom’e,
Hinna le nopna thu ;
Ngai-jin nalung hongun sangun,
Hinna le nopna thu ;
Man beiyin ahome,
Vanna lut theina din.
Hibang hinna thupha kidang,
Hinna le nopna thu ;
Ka jah man kei kalung monge,
Hinna le nopna thu ;
Jesu bou mi huhhing,
Lungmon konna ahi.
Reference: Doh is G, m

songs.title: SEI IN THUSIM LUI THU CHU

lines: Seiyin thusim lui thu chu,
Mulou van chung gam thu ;
Pakai Jesu Loupi le,
Ami lungset thu chan ;
Seiyin thusim chu ol chan,
Chapang kihil bang chun ;
Keima mi chonse le lung,
Neilou olmo ngai din.
Seijin thusim lui thu, (3)
Jesu milungset thu.
Seiyin thusim lui thu chu,
Kachin jing theina din ;
Mihemte chonset jal’a ;
Jesu leiya pen thu,
Sei-jin hi chu niseh in,
Thupha kidang ahi ;
Lungdon le olmo kom’a,
Kalung monna ahi.
Seiyin thusim lui thu chu,
Lungdon olmo komle ;
Hiche leiset gou homkeu,
Nop le ol jong chutia ;
Hi leiset ka dalhah a,
Van gam nom kalhun man ;
Seijin thusim lui thu chu,
Jesu mi huhhing thu.
Reference: Doh is C. m

songs.title: VANNOI GAMTIN CHONSET MUTHIM IN ALOI

lines: Vannoi gamtin chonset muthimin aloi,
Hinna thun salvah un ;
Lhagao huhhinga um noma atam'e,
Hinna thun salvah un.
Sochatna hinna Thupha vah chun,
Agamtin salvah soh hen ;
Sochatna hinna Thupha vah chun,
Tonsot geiyin salvah hen.
Jet le veiya igam miten eikou-vui,
Hinna thun salvah un ;
Kipah tah le thanom tah in choileu te,
Hinna thun salvah un.
Hinna Thupha mijousen amuthei nan,
Hinna thun salvah un ;
Hinna Thuphan gamtin alosohna din,
Hinna thun salvah un.
Hinna thu lhacha ipan hi chim poute,
Hinna thun salvah un ;
Van’a ivon diu thilpha khol ihiuve,
Hinna thun salvah un.
Reference: Doh is A♭ sₗ
Hungun Pathen ngaite,
Kipah in la sauvin ;
Kipah in la sacheh unlang, (2 vei)
Kikhom’un kimvel’un.(2 vei)
Cheu hite Zion ah,
Zion gam nom chungnung em’a ;
Cheu hite Zion gam noma,
Pathen khopi nomtah a chun.
Pathen hepha louten,
Vahchoi da jeng jong leu ;
Eiho Pathen chate sen vang, (2 vei)
Phongun nalung kipau.(2 vei)
Pathen kihouna a,
Asang jan tha nom’un ;
Vanna khopi hoi ilhun man, (2 vei)
I len mam gam em’a. (2 vei)
Chu a lhi kangsoh ding,
Kipa la isah diu ;
Immanuel cha ihi diu, (2 vei)
Van khopia ilen diu. (2 vei)
Reference: Doh is G. d

songs.title: KA DINGE DETTAH IN GALVON PO KAHI

lines: Ka dinge dettah in galvon po kahi,
Ka ngah jinge Lengpan thu eipeh ding ;
Malam nonge Lengin thu eipeh le,
A kom’a ding ingting Ama jen lenge.
"Ngaiyun ma lam novin" tia gal sam khu,
Anu nungui ven mi kichase ho ;
{Pakaiyin keima einganse tei ding,
Agalvon choi bou kahi jeng vangin.} (2 vei)
Ka ding jinge dettah in galvon choiyin,
Phasa demin chem le thal lum kathoi ;
Gal kisat gin ngah in ka dinge kei,
“Pakai ka ding nai” kati theina dingin.
Von po bou hijong leng chan kanei tei ding,
Loupina kemlou le Lallukhuh hoi ;
Tahsan neiya gal kasat jousea chu,
Pathen anga maipha chang tei ding keima.
Reference: Doh is B♭. sₗ
Ngaiyun Pakai Jesun eikou,
Tunia vaikon ding koi ham ?
Jao a angtai, chang amin tai,
Aga chomkhom ding hoi ham ?
“A chang at chu manpha penge”
Hitin ati Pakaiyin ;
“Keima ka umnai nei sol’in,”
Lhaisel’a ti ding hoi ham ?
Khol gamla che hih jongleu chun,
Holdoh ding amangsa te ;
Mun nate thilha hou sangja,
Hiho chu hinna thu pen ;
Sum tampi ahilou vangin,
Paini jeng cha hi jong le ;
Hiche themcha jong chu Jesun,
Tamtah in sang tei nante.
Thu seiyin themhih jongleu chun,
Solchah Paul seithem bangin ;
Jesu mi lungset sei leuvin,
Ei jal’a athi jeh chun ;
Thupi tan ding kicha louva,
Mi chonse ho adau le,
Chapang ho hin koukhom leu chun,
Pathen’in kipom nante.
Pakai o-gin najah mau le,
Mihem hinkho kemlai hin ;
Na thaset manin ti dauvin ;
“Keima ka-i alou poi”,
Lung lhaiyin Pathen na tongun,
Tong jingun thanom tah in ;
Asei najah mau le tiuvin,
“Pathen keima nei sol’in”.
Reference: Doh is F. d

songs.title: KOI HIJONG LE THUPHA HI AJACHAN IN

lines: Koi hijongle Thupha hi aja chan nan,
Kipana thu hi leiset gam kimvel’a ;
Phongun homjal’un mi umna mun jousea,
“Ahung nom chan hungu hen.”
Koi hijeng jongle ahung nom chan chu,
Thinglhang le phaicham dam’a gasam leuvin ;
Pan vahmang ho inlam’a akouna hi,
“Ahung nom chan hungu hen.”
Ahung nom chan chu hung geisang lou jenun,
Kot kihon lutthei pet cha hin lut loiyun ;
Jesu chu hinna lampi dihtah ahi,
“Ahung nom chan hungu hen.”
Ahung nom chan chu thutepsa aume,
Ahung nom chan chu umjing jeng ding ahi ;
Koi hile anom chan hing jing ding ahi,
“Ahung nom chan hungu hen”.
Reference: Doh is D. s

songs.title: THOUVIN KALUNG NISA SOH TOH KIJUI IN

lines: Thouvin kalung nisa soh toh kijuiyin,
Ka lungin Pathen jeng gel’in ;
Lung lhaisel le lung hal pel’in lhai ponthon,
Meiyin kong hen Pathen Nang ngai.
Sun le jan neilou Van Mithengte jousen,
Pathen thusim asim jingui ;
Nangman jong amaho lasah jeng gel’in,
Na vahchoi na la sangin san.
Pathen tujan kalha nahoi damsel’a,
Hinkho thah neipeh tujinga ;
Hibang chun vangam noma kho vah jingle,
Neilan Nangma gam nom sungah.
Nei ching jingin chonphat le lungnem neipen,
Na lhagao theng chun neipui len ;
Tunia ka chonnau katoh kasei jouseu,
Pathen mitmua lamjang dingin.
Reference: Doh is D. d

songs.title: DANIEL LOI BANGIN DINGUN PATHEN THUN NUNGUN

lines: Daniel loi bangin dingun Pathen thun nungun,
Pahchaute loi lhom ho chun Daniel loi vahchoi-un;
Daniel bangin hangun,
Na changin dingin,
Na hannau chu leiset mi'n,
Heu hen pang det un.
Mihat minthanga kisei vannoi chonsoh ho,
Pathen lama dia pang mihat sangja mangsoh ta.
Gospel ponlap dom sangun Gal jo na dingin,
Satan gal chu no mangun Daniel dingin aovun.
Reference: Doh is B♭, m

songs.title: DAM DUNG LHUNG A JESU NUNG JUI DING KA NOM'E

lines: Dam dung lhunga Jesu nungjui ding ka nome,
Pahcha namtui pahna le twilhum lona a ;
Hoichan hijongle eipuina chana jui jinge,
Anung jui jinge lallukhuh kasan man.
Jui ding, jui ding Jesu nung kajui ding,
Achena chana anung kajui ding ;
Jui ding, jui ding Jesu nung kajui ding,
Aman eipuina channa ken kajui ding.
Dam dung lhunga keiman Jesu nung kajui ding,
Khopi hui nunna le twilhum lonna a chun ;
Ama khut’in eipui le keima kicha lou ding ;
Aman eilhonpi le keima olmo lou ding.
Dam dung hihen lang mol’a kal ding hijong leng,
Ka lhagao Jesu kom’a chu umjing jeng hen ;
Bitkei le damsel chan Aman eipui lhungkei ding,
Ol eipehna ding Pathen inpi nom chu.
Reference: Doh is A♭, sₗ

songs.title: VAN'A PONLAP KHU HUNG VEUVIN HUNG UN SOPI

lines: Van’a ponlap khu hung veuvin hungun Sopite !
Galmi thah sangja ahunge, Gal ijo tei diu !
Kul dalha hih un ka hunge !
Tin Jesun a sam ;
Nang thahat vangin lha ponge,
Neipen Lengpan tha.
Veuvin asangja ahunge, Satan sepaite !
Eima sepaite kicha-in, alungthoi gam tai !
Gal jona ponlap khu veuvin ! ngaiyun sumkon gin !
Pakai mina ijo tei diu, Galte tam jong le.
Gal kisat ahahsat vangin eipanpi tamna,
Igal Lamkai hattah Jesu, I-ham igin diu.
Reference: Doh is D, s

songs.title: NATONG IN KON UTE EIHO PATHEN SOHTE

lines: Na tongin kon’ute eiho Pathen sohte,
I-Pakai nungjuiyin cheu hite na tongin ;
Aman eipeh lungthim thah chu pannu hite,
Ikhut’a itoh thei chan tong cheh uhite.
Tongute … ha tah in,
Na tongun … pon tah in ;
Ngah ute … ki nemin,
Bang poute Pakai hung kah sen.
Na tong cheh uhite agilkel va na ding,
Lhagao dangchah ho dangnou nadin peu hite ;
I loupina dingu Cross thu seileu hite,
“Man beiyin eihuhhingui” tin samleu hite.
Ibonchan cheu hitin na gatong uhite,
Chonset muthim gam chu apumpin mangsoh hen,
Jehovah mintheng loupi chu kilang soh hen,
“Man beiyin eihuhhingui” tin samleu hite.
Pontho tah in pangun Pakai thahat panun,
Toh phatman isan diu Pathen’in eipeh diu ;
Lhatsa mithengte toh vana ichen khom diu,
“Man beiyin eihhuhingui” tin samleu hite.
Reference: Doh is F. m

songs.title: MIHEM CHENNA CHAN'A, GALHANG SAM LEU HITE

lines: Mihem chenna channa ga lhangsam leu hite,
Hungun Christa mite seileute limtah in ;
Mi chonsete henga lungmonna Thupha hi,
Lha monsah ahung tai.
Lha monsah ahung tai, (2 vei)
Pathen’in eipeh-u ;
Eitepnau Lhagao Theng,
Mihem chenna channa ;
Ga lhangsam leu hite,
Lha monsah ahung tai.
Muthim lungdon lengvai, gim le hesoh genthei,
Abonchan achaiyin gamtin asalsoh tai ;
In hoi lul tah bangin nisa so em bangin,
Lha monsah ahung tai.
Leng jouse Leng chungnung, mi damsah Lhagaovin,
Mi chonse te hengah, hinna thu hinpo lhan ;
Hungun huhhingsa te la ngei hi sau hite,
Lha monsah ahung tai.
Lungsetna chungnung thu lan sa choileu hite,
Van chunga cheng ho to kitoh in sau hite !
La ngei hi bang louvin sau hite lim tah in,
Lha monsah ahung tai.
Reference: Doh is C. s
Naiya gamla chang amin tai,
Changvui akoisoh gam tai ;
Naiya gamla a-angsoh tai,
Denna lep a phaicham’a.
Pakai chang at ding hin sol’in,
Na henga ka taonau hi ;
Ngaiyin chang at ding hin sol’in,
Chang at kile get inte.
Jingpi nison hin sol loiyin,
Sun nisat’in hin sol’in ;
Ni lhumkon geiyin hin sol’in,
Gamtin chang at khom dingin.
Man gangun chang akoi jou tai,
Changvui min atkhom loiyun ;
Nilhah tengle in lam jon’a,
Kipah a che ding nahi.
Reference: Doh is A♭. m

songs.title: MAN GANGUN, MAN GANGUN KHOVAH THU SEIPHONG LEN

lines: Man gangun, man gangun khovah thu seiphong len,
Jan muthim gama cheng miho khu gahil un;
Pakai thupeh ahi, Ama Min in kon un,
Gospel thupeh kidang tah Jesu milungsetna,
Nahin nao mangcha in sunlayin na tongun,
Man gangun, man gangun, man gangun.
Man gangun, man gangun hinna thu gahomun,
Pakai awgin hepha louho khu gahil un;
Jing lhaving in lengleuvin Twikhanglen chunga,
Pakai thahat panin amangsa huh doh un;
Nakou kit leuvui chomkhat jong geisang hih un,
Man gangun, man gangun, man gangun.
Man gangun, Thupha chu po-in lhangsam loiyun,
Lhep nan bul'a ahen ganthei lhagao ho khu;
"Lhadoh tei ding" tia Pakai in thu atepsa,
Golvah ankong akithuh tai kou khom loi-un,
Geisang louvin khom un aphat aum tapoi,
Man gangun, man gangun, man gangun.
Reference: Doh is F, s

songs.title: MUN A-ONG NALAIYE KOU KHOM UN

lines: Mun a ong na laiye koukhom’un,
Lengpa golvah ankong um din;
Kou khom’uvin lang a In mi dim hen,
Mivaicha gilkelten neu hen.
Lam lenna le dai pam’a potnun,
Setna lamthim’a umte chu,
Chen lang ngailut le lungset thon lang,
Vahvei ho gapui khom’un
Mun a ong nalaiye kou kit-nun,
Amavang eingaisah lou le;
Kou na ngailouva kilep mang ho,
Koiman kou kitta lou hel ding.
Mun a ong nalaiye kou kit-nun,
Chung’a Pathen thupeh a-hi;
Lung set hongsung’a gapui khom’un,
Huhhingpa lungsetna a chun;
Genthei lengvai le ahao din jong,
Vanna mun a ong nalai-ye;
Koukhom loiyun kot kihon pet hin,
Gunchun hilchen kimvel leuvin.
Reference: Doh is A♭, sₗ
O Pathen salvah soh loiyin,
Vannoi leiset salvah in ;
Alhatpau deitah min’a chu,
Asochat theina dingun.
O Pathen salvah soh loiyin,
Twikhanglen gal’a mite ;
Lungsetna Thupha man beiya,
Hom dinga natepsa chu.
Lhagao thi kon ho salvah in,
Jan muthim’a lamvaite ;
Ahin nikhou alhin kah in,
Salvah in huhhing loiyin.
Athutep loupi le theng chu,
“Cheuvin leiset gamtin ah;
A khonni geiyin ka umpi,
Ka Thupha phongjal leuvin.”
Reference: Doh is G. sₗ

songs.title: PAKAI THAHAT PAN IN HAT UN ATHU GINGCHAN

lines: Pakai thahat panin hat’un athu ging chan,
Athupha theng phongun lhangsam leuvin ;
Galsat lungdonna a jong Aman eikaihoi jing ding,
Pakai mina koi ham eidou thei diu ?
Ding det un thudih a,
Leng thupeh ngaiyun galjo na ding ;
Pakai choi atna dingin athutep hi molso din,
Pakai thahat panin ding det’un.
Pakai thahat panin hat’un athu gingchan,
Gal masanga kon nungjam kit lou ding ;
Ama nakoma ding jing ding nagalsat huding a,
Malam nouvin athahat chu panun.
Pakai thahat pan'un hat un athu gingchan,
Itih channa athutep thon ngailou ;
Aman nakhut jetlam atuh jinge kicha hih-in,
Pakai chu tahsan jingin dingdet’in.
Reference: Doh is G. s
Ngaiyun Pakai Jesun eikouvui tun,
Leiset ga chom khom din ;
Chang at khom ding mi alhom jeh in,
Changvui akoi joutai.
Pakai minin kipah in cheuvin,
Ngailut le khoto thon ;
Man beiya huhhinga nunnom chu,
Vannoiya phong leuvin.
Cheuvin amang ding kon huhdoh un,
Chonset muthim’a kon ;
Aban thahat panin huhhingun,
Chonset bulpu ga lhan.
Kipah tah-in genthei kou khomun,
Lungset ankong um din ;
Ama ho chu hinna changlhah a,
Pakaiyin lamto ding.
Che leuvin nipi lai akeme,
Nilhum man tong loiyun ;
Koiman na atoh thei louna ding,
Jan muthim anai tai.
Reference: Doh is A♭ d
Lunghel lungdon lhamon’ute,
Hin nikho kemlai sung hin ;
Lhagao mang ding ho huh ute,
Hin nikho kemlai sung hin ;
Ama ho kipana ding,
Tongute hinlai sungin ;
Thilpha bolthei cheh ihi,
Hin nikho kemlai sung hin ;
A kem’e ....... hin nikho, (2 vei)
Thilpha bolthei cheh ihi ;
Hin nikho kemlai sung hin ;
Mi thase dinga phat umlou,
Hin nikho kemlai sung hin ;
Namai jing ninou soh bang hen,
Hin nikho kemlai sung hin ;
Vannoi leiset khoisat dim,
Ka le lhiso na adim.
Ule nao lhu phong dingin,
Hin nikho kemlai sung hin ;
Kilungset nan eikan khom’ui,
Hin nikho kemlai sung hin ;
Khat chengin iki dalhauve,
Hin nikho kemlai sung hin ;
Hijong le ithilpha bol,
Vannoi hetna kilang ding ;
Hichun ilungu nem ding,
Hin nikho kemlai sung hin.
Reference: Doh is A, m
Leng sepai ihiuve, thisan’a kilhatsa,
Min khumsa galsatpi dinga ;
Pakai Christa Leng chu ; kichat a um vangin,
Kipah-in la saute ;
Leng sepai Lamkai chungnung chun,
I-lung hahsat jing ding.
Leng sepai ihiuve,
A vahchoi la saute ;
Tahsan nei jing nading bolun,
I-lengpau loupi chu.
Leng sepai ihiuve kipah-in choileuvin,
Cross chunga kithatpa min ngei ;
Achunga kisun chu ; Leng sepai ihiuve,
Hahkam jeng jong leu hen ;
Leng chungnung Jesu choi-at nan,
Hesoh na jong thoh un.
Leng sepai ihiuve, Ama toh pangkhom chu,
Tun Amatoh thoh khom hen lang ;
Pampai hijong leu hen ; a ponlap dom sangun,
Phat lhin ding kon ahi ;
Lallukhuh sanni anaiye,
Leng sepaite dingin.
Reference: Doh is G, sₗ

songs.title: KHUT GOH KEOVA KACHE DING HAM?

lines: Khut goh keova kache ding ham,
Ei Lhatpa lamto dinga ?
Ana nikhat jong tong louva,
Ima lan ding nei louva.
Ka che ding ham khut goh keova,
Eihuhhingpa lamtoa chu ;
Lhagao khat beh keng lou hel’a,
Ka che ding ham khut goh a ?
Thina in eikailut lou ding,
Tua Jesun ei huhhing ta ;
Ka lamto ding bou khut goh a ;
Phamo san kalung kham’e.
Ka sumang tai kum phalai cheng,
Kou la kakou kit thei tapon ;
Hichu ajen nan mangta leng,
A lunggot molso ta ding.
Thina jan chun hinpha le chun,
Lhagao khat huhhing louvin ;
Na huhhingpa loupi tah chu,
Ipin lamto tan natem ?
Reference: Doh is D, s
Na tongun jan anai tai,
Na tongun jingkah in ;
Na tongun daitwi hul man,
Pahcha pah laiyin ;
Na tongun nisa jong leh,
Tongun nilhah daiyin ;
Mite natoh chai phat jan,
Hung lhung ding ahi.
Tongun jan ahung naije,
Tongun sun nisat’in ;
Tongun nidan phat laiyin,
Olna anai tai ;
Tongun mitphet kahchan jong,
Ol go ta di louvin ;
Tongun jan anaitai, min
Tong kit talou ding.
Tongun jan ahung naitai,
Tongun nilhang kaiyin ;
Tongun ni alhum geiyin,
Tantih nei louvin ;
Khovah laisen na tongun,
Na muthei lai chan sen ;
Tongun athim tul tul’e,
Olna anai tai.
Reference: Doh is F, s

songs.title: HINNA GUI JAN LHAN THI DING MI AUM

lines: Hinna gui janlhan thiding mi aum,
Chonset twikhanglen nong laiya umte ;
Koiham tuinonglai pal’a mi huhding ?
Hinna gui janlhan mi gahuh doh loiyin.
Hinna gui janlhan, (2 vei)
Twiya mi mang ding ahi ;
Hinna gui janlhan, (2 vei)
Twiya mi alha lut’e.
Hinna gui janlhan natha le lung thon,
Ngaiyin lhagao mang din nang nakouve ;
Vetan chonset twilen’a thiding mi,
Hinna kong kailhan mi mang ding huhhingin.
Hinna gui janlhan mi mang ding ngaiton,
Chonset twipin chup le homjou lou ding ;
Huipi, gopi kithon hinpha taleu,
Mang teidiu chen nangman ga huhdoh loiyin.
Mi mang ding lah phat kikhel loi tading,
Lhagao tamtah mangthai ding tonsot’a ;
Geisang louvin chen hinna kong kengin,
Hinna gui janlhan mi mang ding huhdoh-in.
Reference: Doh is G, sₗ
Pathen lekha sim jinga,
Asun ajan’a ngaitoa ;
Agunchu athanom pan,
Pathen phatthei peh amui.
Hijeh chun sun le janin,
Lung ngainan nei jingun lang ;
A thulu ching jing jengin,
Phattheina hin kemlou na.
Mi chonse houlimpi lou,
Mi gilou nungjui louva ;
Mi seise te kom dalha,
Mi chun chonset apailhai.
Lui panga thingphung keh chu,
Anan goptih nei talou ;
Hiche thing hinthei bang chun,
Mitheng nop jong kem theilou.
Chonse vang chu tobang lou,
Huiya vai kithe bang ding ;
Pathen thupi tan nileh,
Mi chonse chu pampai ding.
Reference: Doh is G. sₗ

songs.title: TOHGIM LE LUNG JINNA KHEL A

lines: Tohgim le lung jinna khella,
Cholte din in nomtah aum ;
Kikhel tih nei lou innom a,
Koi ham cholnga nomlou ding chu ?
Ngah hat in lung nengin phun louvin,
Ngah hat in lung nengin phun louvin ;
Ngah hat’in lung nengtah in,
Phun louvin.
Pohgih noiya chol jongle chun,
Van phatna in nang ngai jang ding ;
Dah-in ven tonsot anai tai,
Ngah in phun louvin ngah hat’in.
Na lampia ling um jeng jong le,
Pakai lu kimvel ngaiton lang ;
Nalung sudong tajeng jongle,
Nang sanga thengjo asun tai.
Na jong le chun tong jing tangem,
Taona ima sumil louvin ;
Na olna ding ni anai tai,
Ngah hat in phun louvin ngah in.
Reference: Doh is C, s

songs.title: CHEN LANG NAPHAT JOUSEN TONG IN

lines: Chen lang na phat jousen tongin,
Kipa nan Pa deilam bollin;
Hichu Pakai lampi ahi,
Najot lou ding ham ajui-jan.
Hinkho hoilaijin chen tongin,
Seiset japina ging louvin ;
Mihemin apachat louchu,
Pathen pachat louvin geldan.
Chen lang tongin tohphat ahi,
Nalung sung kipa sah in lang ;
Pakaijin na pachat ding chu,
Gellin thanomin na tongin.
Tong jingin chim louvin tongin,
Lhagao mang dingin lei aloi ;
Vannoi gam tina vahlen lang,
Lhagao mangte chu puikhom in.
Kipah-in natoh kipa pin,
Toh gim chu olna nom ahi ;
Ngaiyun jaloi ding Pakai O.
“Ka hunge” ti O chu ngaiphan.
Reference: Doh is E♭ d

songs.title: ANITIN PATHEN CHATE BANG A VAH A ICHEU HINAM

lines: Anitin Pathen chate banga vah a icheu hinam ?
Jan muthim natoh pailha kho hungvah ding ingau hinam ?
Lei lungngai dalhan kho hungvah ding chu ngah jingin,
Lhandampu lungset jal’a hungsoh ding ninou emsel chu.
A mit mua … icheu hinam?
Pathen cha … deite banga ;
Christa thisan lua chu ivon’u
Isop bangu hinam ?
Loupina chang ding khovah chate banga
Icheu hinam ?
Nunnema Pathen chate banga vah a icheu hinam ?
Hi leiset lungdon hesoh genthei muthim jing noiya hin ;
Pakaiyin Ama khel’a tong dingin eidei cheh-uve,
Tonsot hinkemlou chang dingin mi kholkhom loiyu hite.
Vahchoi la saute kipahtah-in khovah chate bangin,
Lhaisel’in Christa dingin mite lah-a na tongu te ;
Chutile leiset miten sochatna thu hinjom cheh diu,
Chua kon Pathen khopi jon’a Christa ijuikhom diu.
Reference: Doh is G. d
Calvary ka ngaiye, Calvary lungsetna
Pakai Cross noiah kei katouve,
Cross noiya lung ol tantih neilou
Nop le olna sochat na ahi.
Chonset muthim noiya genthei tah in athi,
Kagah ven ken katija sa san,
Pathen kelngoi nou kithat ahi,
Kei jal'a Jesu kithat ahi.
Ka miltai lei lungngai lim oldam ka changtai,
Hibang lungsetna vannoi-a bei,
Cross noi-a kachen kei kalung mong,
Calvary michonse kei asoh chai.
Lungset in ka hoitai thisana hing kahi,
Pathen kom'a mun nom kachang tai,
Iti eiki lungset a hitam!
Lungset chungnung chonse kei chunga.
Reference: Doh is G, sₗ
Dingun dingun Jesu din,
Nangho Cross sepaite ;
Aleng ponlap dom sangun,
Mang louhel ding ahi ;
Gal jou-va kon galjou ding,
A sepaite pui ding ;
Gal jouse abei soh-a,
Christa leng chan kahsen.
Dingun dingun Jesu din,
Sumkon gin thun chon’un ;
Gim genthei hahsa thoh-un,
Ani loupi lai hin ;
Tua ading bol’a nang ho,
Gal sim senlou sat cheng ;
Lung nga mun setto na jong,
Thahatna su mangun.
Dingun dingun Jesu din,
Ama thahat pan’un ;
Tahsa khut thahat thon thei,
Nangma tha son dauvin ;
Gospel galvon kivon’un ;
Kiging phan tau jingun;
Toh dingin nakou nauva,
Lhah chomna nei hih-un.
Dingun dingun Jesu din,
Galsat sot talou ding ;
Tunia gal kisat kisei,
Jingle jo la sah ding ;
Gal satna gal joupa chu,
Hinna lukhuh chang ding ;
Loupina Leng chungnung toh,
Tonsot vaihom khom ding.
Reference: Doh is B♭. sₗ
Christian thouvin imut sot dan,
Lhagao mang ding don louvin ;
Pakaiyin thu eipeh laiya,
I mohtou mai mai diu ham ?
Chen lang tongin tun panin,
Amangsa holdoh kit din ;
Chonse muthim’a konin,
Golvahna a hin puiyin.
Huhhingpu ingailut nah em,
Athupeh init nah um ?
Inei jouseu iphalnah um ?
Athua inun lou diu ham ?
Ama chu itahsan nah um ?
Ahil’a ichon nah um ?
Eiho Ama a ihiuve;
Na-natoh in phong cheh un.
Lallukhuh san itup uleh,
Cross nitin in puhite ;
Gunchu tah-in na tongu te,
Phat achom ni anai tai.
Reference: Doh is C, m
Ka lhan Van Lengpa vahchoi-in,
Bohkhup in akho muh'a,
Nahin sah nadam sah Pathen,
Na ngaidam e vahchoi-in.
Vahchoi cheh un (2)
Vahchoi-un Tonsot Leng chu.
Lung donna Pi le Pu te,
Ana khoto a vahchoi-un,
Abang hi-jing chu vahchoi-un,
Phatthei na eipe a chu.
Vahchoi cheh un (2)
Pa-Pathen chu vahchoi-un.
Nu le Pa cha alungset bang,
Eiho hatmo je ahen,
Akhut in eina pom leuve,
Gal a kon eihuhhing-ui.
Vahchoi cheh un (2)
Lungset henlang vahchoi-un.
Vantil neihun a vahchoi nan,
Mujing nahi Amaiso,
Nisa lha sa le namtin mi,
A kuncheh e A-ang ah.
Vahchoi cheh un, (2)
Mi khoto Pathen Theng chu.
Reference: Doh is C. d
Tunin kumlui abeisoh tai,
Kumthah ahung lhung tai ;
Taovu hite Pathen hengah,
I chonset beina din.
Kumlui hitia chemang bang chun,
Akem’e ihinkho ;
Akem jinge aniseh in,
Akem mang loiji tai.
Hijeh chun sopite hungun,
Pathen naiyu hite ;
Ama jenga chu kinemin,
Tonsot hin jingna din.
Hiche kumthah hung lhun bangin,
Thah hen ilungu jong ;
Aga phat apun theina din,
Kihabol’u hite.
Vo Pathen Nang ka tahsan na,
Khang hen aniseh-in ;
Ka kinepnau hin khan sah in,
Det hen thihhat ai-jin.
Reference: Doh is A♭ sₗ

songs.title: VAN MITHENG TE JOUSEN KIPA LA SAUVIN

lines: Van mithengte jousen kipa la sauvin,
Tunin mi mangsa khat ahunge ;
Veuvin ! lung kipah tah in Pathen achei,
Acha A-anga kipom dingin.
Kipa thanom loupi ni nopni,
“Loupi ni” atiuve Vantil ten ;
Van Mithengte jouse akikhom-uvin,
La asauve lung kipah tah in.
Van’a nop la sauvin Van Mitheng jousen,
Tunia chonse khat sochat jal’in ;
Aman ahin dalhan chonset lampi chu,
Ahung tai Apa Pathen henga.
Leiya nop la sauvin Mithengte jousen,
Mijouse hom’un hinna Thupha ;
I mitlhiu jong long hen ikipa man’un,
Tunia chonse khat sochat jal’in.
Reference: Doh is B♭, sₗ

songs.title: LUNGSET NA NAMU HITAM, BAN TOL IN

lines: Lungset na namu hitam, ban tol in,
Nang chang ding jeng ahipoi, ban tol in,
Va le sah in kumlhung in,
Midang mitlhi theh sah-in,
Nabol van'a kiphon man, ban tol in.
Ngailut na thu najatan, ban tol in,
Vacha te lasah bang in, ban tol in,
Ala hi khantou sah in,
Mi lengvai kipa sah in,
Mi tusa na at ahi, ban tol in.
Jesu mi lungset na hi, ban tol in,
Chomkhat bou um ding ihiu, ban tol in,
Tunpi pahcha hoi lai in,
Vacha te lasah lai in,
Khokhal lai le noplai hin, ban tol in.
Nang chang ding jeng gel hih in, ban tol in,
Na sopin angai chu hin, ban tol in,
Nangma chang hin moh ahi,
Christa ding in hingle chun,
Ama toh nachen khom ding, ban tol in.
Reference: Doh is F, d

songs.title: TWIKHANGLEN PANG A INVAH KISONG BANG IN

lines: Twikhanglen panga in vah kisong bangin,
Vah-in muthim lah-a chonsete mu din ;
Na lungkot hongin kithopi hung nante.
Vahsah-in Pathen thu chu, (3 vei)
Na thaomei avah laiyin kitheh ngim in ;
Vahsah-in Pathen thu chu.
Kong sesa bangin mi tamtah aum tai,
Mun tina mihem set thim noiya aum ;
Hil leuvin setto na muntina umho.
Navah emhoi chu lo khukhum lou jenin,
Navah chu mite mu theidin koi sangin ;
Salvah-in jan muthim, phattheina chang ding.
Na hinkho beikah-in Christa din tongin,
Christan nangma “Hungin” tia nakou tengle ;
Hiche leiset mun hi jotkit pon nate.
Reference: Doh is A♭. sₗ

songs.title: JESUN EISOL-UI VAH HOM LE DINGIN

lines: Jesun eisol’ui vah hom le dingin,
Jan muthim’a meivah cha bangin vah-in ;
Hi leiset muthim hi salvah din,
Nangma muna nangman, kei muna ken.
Jesun eisol’ui adinga vah din,
Ivah-u amol tengle Aman ahei ;
Van’a konin eihinve jingui,
Nangma muna nangman, kei muna ken.
Jesun eisol’ui midang salvah din,
Muthimin akhui vannoi leiset mite ;
Achonset hesoh nau sumang din,
Nangma muna nangman, kei muna ken.
Reference: Doh is G, d

songs.title: PAKAI VAHCHOI NAN KEN LAN SANG E

lines: Pakai vahchoi nan ken la sange,
Ka kam le kalung thong ting ;
Eingailut kidang chu vahchoi nan,
Sange avahchoila.
Ka chonset jouse apomang tai,
Amin theng loupi vahchoi la sange ;
Ka chonset jouse apomang tai,
Halleluijah Amin nin.
Ka hunge ka chonset poh pumin,
Aman olna kim eipei ;
Eilhatdoh jeh chun avahchoi la,
Tang louvin ken sange.
Aheng kalhun teng kei bit keiya,
Aman eihon bit keiya ;
Ken hasah cheh ding avahchoi la,
Tonsot geiya sa ding.
Reference: Doh is B♭. mₗ
Ikimu to kit din einem’e,
Leiset hinkho abei teng ;
Thusim lui seiding chun einem’e,
Van gam nom vah jinga chun.
Gamnom vah a chun, (2 vei)
I-Pau chenna gam innom tah a chun ;
Kimuto nau hite, kimuto nau hite,
Galjona lallukhuh isan diu.
Loupia kimuto din ei nem’e,
Hinna thingphung hoi lim’a ;
Eilhatpau vahchoidin einem’e,
Alungsetna eilhat chu.
Loupia kimuto din ei nem’e,
Chunga laltouna kim’a ;
Lhatsa janel avahchoi lasa,
Mitheng lah a lhah ding chu.
Loupia kimuto din einem’e,
Leiset kin kachai tengle ;
Kipah tah-a ikikhut tuh diu,
Tonsot gamnom ema chun.
Reference: Doh is A. sₗ
Ka sopiten neilha tauvin,
Van gam jonin che tange ;
Vannoi leiset’a um laiya,
Ka nga jing van in nom chu.
Ka van in nom ka van in nom,
Tonsot’a hinna nop kem kit louna ;
Neisol tauvin lunglhai sel’in
Nei lha tauvin sopiten.
Van gam kal masa Jesu chun,
Ka umna ding mun asem'e ;
Tun eikouve chua cheng din,
Kipah tah-in che tange.
Chonset dim vannoija hin,
Gim hesoh kachai tai tun ;
Ka Pathen in sem’a cheng ting,
Nop kem louva cheng tange.
Lunghel lou jenun sopite,
Leiya kimu hih jongleu ;
Ni khat van in nom’a thon moa,
Ikimu to kit tei diu.
Reference: Doh is E♭ m

songs.title: O HE TUNI LEISET BEI NI

lines: O he ! tuni leiset beini,
Abange ikikhen hi ;
Pathenin phattheina chamkim,
Pen lang damsel’in chetan.
Ikikhen ahitai tunin,
Nache na damsel chan chen ;
Pathenin kivoppi jing tan,
Lei chibai chaina sangin.
Tunin nangma heng lam jonin,
