Kimupi gang inla vaigei lo in.
Lungsiat tak in ako in a ngak hi,
Ngaipha tiam in akona aw chu;
Lungsiat tak in ako in a ngak hi,
Hepi tak in "ka kiang hung in" ti'n.
Ala ngak zing hi bangdia muang la hem?
La manthaina sawttak himalehle;
A hinna thisan in atat ziak in,
Tatna kidang mi genzaw theilo chu.
A thupiak tepte'n a hepi ngaitua'n,
Gitlona neilo nangma gitlo pua'n;
Ngaidamna bukim kumtuang ah hinna,
A tatna ziak in nangma ahun piai.
Lampi lui hun hawn la lampi dik hi,
Ama Jesu hi akawtkhak ahi;
Belampu ahin ako zing ahi,
Hatlona nei chun thangai tak ahi.
Lalpa dawichuamte'n la,
Kipak la hun sa un;
La minthang chungnungpen tak chu,
Lungthim munkhat pu'n hun sa un;
Lalchutpha kimvel pi'n (2V)
Zion gam zuan i hiu,
Khawpi hawi Zion gam ah;
Zion gam zuan in chia un,
Pathian khawpi melpha ahii.
Lalpa henailote'n,
Pak La sak nial maleu;
Van Lal Cha dawi chuam takte hin,
Van Lal Cha dawi chuam takte hin;
Pak La sa ngei innau (2V)
Zion tangsip a chun,
La Thiangtho sangsawm sa'n;
Van mun lopi ngun leh khamtual ,
Van mun lopi ngun leh khamtual;
Ngun khamtual i tun ma'n (2V)
Zia chun La lem hi ti'ng,
Mitthi zosia hul na;
Immanuel khawpi itun chun,
Immanuel khawpi i tun chun;
Khawpi hawi sumtui luan (2V)
Aw hepina thu genthiam leng,
Nazareth Jesu umdan;
Chuti khawp hiala ei hepi,
Ka thasang in a thi tai.
Aw! hepina a mak taluai,
Ti chu ka la hihen la;
Aw! hepina a mak taluai,
Hukdampa ei hepina.
Lungdawng in huana a pauchap,
Nang leh keima a ding in;
Ama di'n lungdawng ahi puai,
Mi zosia ding in ahii.
Angelte'n ama thamuan di'n,
Khawvel en in a chiau hen;
A lungngaina thamuan ding in,
Van La lopitak asau.
Ka gitlo zosia a pua hen,
Ama a guala ngai in;
Kalvari tangsip a tut tai,
Zia chun khawvel a nuaisiai.
Galzawna van a kithuam in,
A mel lopitak mu'i tiu;
A hepina mak kei a di'n,
Ka kumtuang La hita hen.
Ka lungngaih lunglen chang ni hin,
Ka thilvel hen siatlei gam hi;
Khawvui in tang tin a bawm hen,
Lautha liang lungngai in a vai.
Aw ei pui in Lalpa,
Lungngaih sumpi zing nuai ah hin;
Lei umpi leh aw ka Lalpa,
Kap lai hi hai ta’ng ka.
Aw ka ngai hi Aksi khel gam,
Angel lunggualte a lennau;
Kei lungleng liangvai ka kana,
Lungngaih sumpi zing nuai ah hin.
Aw ka thagau la lungngaina,
Lei genthei gam hi nusia’n la;
Vakhu gual in va leng inla,
Lungmuanna gam khawpi ah khin.
Zia chun lungngaih lunglen kana,
A um nawt puai Kanan gam ah;
Aw  ei Hukdampa ei puikai in,
Thina luigal gam nuam ah chun.
Zion tang leh Aksi minthang,
Lalpa’n kei di’n a siam;
Zia mun chu ka hang tun phet leh,
Kumtuang in vak tang ka.
Tunkal ka ngaklai Zion gam chu,
Thisan zal ah kei ding ah guat chu;
Aw bangtik leh a hem ka tun di,
Hukdampa leh gam ni tum senglo?
Thina lui Jordan gei ahin,
Ka ngak hi Hukdampa;
Aksi khel ah khawpi nuam khin,
Bangtik ka hang tung diam?
Zion chaten gam lopi mun,
Tunkal ka ngakla tau;
Ka lennau gamthip gam ahi,
Nutsia kal ka ngaklau.
Immanuel nang galzo pen,
La gam ka tun phet leh;
Hepina puan minthang sil in,
Kumtuang in chawi hawi ka.
Lalpa hungkit ngei di ahi,
Ki ging zing hitiu e;
Van sang a In minthang sunga,
Pat hung pawt dawk in a;
Ama chu I Lal dikpen pa,
A dawichuamte malzawl piak di'n;
Apa Lalchutpha hung chu'na,
Kiging zing hitiu e.
La kiging zing em mo dawnna dingin?
Meisel tui la nei em mo dawnna di'n?
Sun leh zan bangtik lai in,
Meisel tui tasam lo di'n;
Moneipa hung phat leh meisel vak di'n.
Lei hin hungkit vak di ahii,
Kiging zing hitiu e;
Vaihun hawm ngal ziang di ahi,
Kiging zing hitiu e;
Van mite'n Halleluijah ti'n,
Jesu tatna bukim chawi in;
Aw Lal dawn din la meisel hal,
In hungdi ahi tai.
Mi zosia'n mukim di ahii,
Kiging zing hitiu e;
Pengkul gi hekawm di ihiu,
Kiging zing hitiu e;
Vaihawmna a eihun ko na,
Mihing zosia gamtin apat;
A Lalchutpha ma ding inau,
Kiging zing hitiu e.
Zan khang lai ah belampu,
Bethlehem khul ah giakte chu;
Van lam thilgi’n a hun thawng,
Ngai ding in a tho tau;
Angelte aw hung gi dawk chun,
Thu kidang leh kipak um;
“Namtin zosia hukdam ding in,
Lal thak a piang tai” a tiu,
Van nuai mi kipak hen.
Van Lal Cha va en tiam un,
Bethlehem bawng in sung ah sawn;
A chunnu Mari’n awl cha’n,
Gankuang sung in a sial;
Chung Aksi’n a hun salvak hen,
Gankuang sung ah nausen chu;
Khawsak mipilte’n a hun muu,
A gobawm zosiau hawng in;
Lal chibai a buk tau.
“Zia hi a hi thu kidang,
Namtin chitin suachatna di’n;
A khut leh keng ah kil in,
A nak ah sun in nau;
Hinna tui hing hung luang in a,
Aw Kalvari tang chung ah;
Chun, khawvel ah luangzak intin;
Zawlneite gen lawk gual in,
Lei chung a cham leng hen.
Lal David suan Aksi minthang tak chun,
Bethlehem a salvak tai;
Vakna thu chun tang a hun sam tau e,
Chamna thu leng tahen ti hi ahi.
Chungnung pen ah lian pen tahen
Ti’n la a sau; (2V)
Van ah Angel mipite’n la a sau,
Chamna thu leng hen ti hi lan a sau.
Belampute’n belam a chin lai un,
Lal sawlchak minthang tak chun;
Bethlehem ah Hukdampa hung piang chu,
Va chia unla va en ta un a tiu.
Van ah mipite khi han en tiam un,
Lal Khrista a khen niu chun;
Ding in a hun enzui tau lei lam hi,
Chungnung pen ah lopi tahen a tiu.
Judai gam ah khawpi sangsawm lak in,
A chungnungpen Bethlehem;
Lei mihing leh van mite kikhen ta,
Kichamna di’n Lal thak a pian ziak in.
Malai Israel mipi zosia,
Thim nuai ah saltang in;
Pathian thil hi theina’n a pui,
Tuipi luang a ting tan.
Tuipi luang a ting tan. – (2)
Jesu kiang ah um chu;
Bangma laudi umlo,
Tuipi luang a ting tan.
Gitlona’n ka Thagau them in,
Thepnate hat maleh;
Lalpa’n ngaidam muanna ei piai,
Tuipi luang a ting tan.
Ka lampi launa’n dim maleh,
Jesu tawh ka um chun;
Hepi takin ei kaibat na,
Thep na ei zaw pi’na.
Lal Jesu ka laicha kuan in,
La gamvak hun zuan ka;
Nangma kiang ngei ei pui tung in,
Thepna luipi chawl hen.
Sawmkualeh kua bepcha ahi tau,
A kul in kim in a luttau;
A za tinna gam nuai in amang ta e,
Ngunkham tual kawtkhak a lut ta puai;
Gamnuai ah sahang lak leh thim nuai a chun,
Belampu In nuam chun a lawi ta puai. (2V)
Lalpa zia'n sawmkua leh kua a um,
Dawi khawp mailo di la hi em;
"Zia hi kei a ahi" Belampu'n a tii,
"Ka kiang apat zammang ahi e;
Gamthip lau um nuai a zam mang maleh le,
Belam hawl in gam thip in chia ing ka" (2V)
Tatsate chun a tanpa'u a he puau,
Tui thuktak kan di um leh le;
Lalpa chun thina lui thim akanta hen,
Gamthip ah Belam hamgit ahia'n;
Gamthipa Belam mang kha a mu kit tai,
Damlo panpi neilo panpi dingin (2V)
Lalpa zia thisan te haw pi hi,
Khawi apat pawt ahi tau em?
Amanthaina apat liama pawt ahi,
Belampu'n a hun puikit ta e;
Lalpa la khut liamna te chu belapin,
Linglukhuk in sun leh zan a sun ui (2V)
Tang sang tak leh luiguam thim taka pat,
Leh kawl suangpi kala umte;
A mu in van kawtkhak a pat kiko gi'n,
Kipak un ka Belam ka mu'i ti'n;
Lalchutpha vela Angelte kipak la'n,
"Kipak ta un Lalpa'n a mu kit tai (2V)
Ni minthang hungtung di ei tai,
I ngak Lal Immanuel;
Gamhuai zosia nuaisia ni chu,
Hukdam chate i nawptatnau ni ding.
Zia ni phet chu leh lim in la sang ka,
Lalpa gam siam kumtuang mun nuam,
Chu chang tang ka;
Aw nuamna lawm lawm in a,
Nawp tatna gam ei tai,
Lim tawp di lau lo in leng ka.
Bangtik leh a hi diam Lalpa,
Galzawna ni ka mu ding;
Jordan luigal lam hung kai ah,
Nang a di’n zingsawl gual a ka vak ding?
Gam nitumlo Lal in ei ko,
Khawpi ngunkhamtual lua di’n;
A thisan ah a lei zosia,
Hung pemlut un mun atam ati e.
Aw khawpi thak la melpha e,
Galhat zosia lenna mun;
A galzawnau la thak sak ding,
Tunkim phat a sak ding in a khek tau.

songs.title: Khawi Gam Le Ni Suana Phawt

lines: Khawi gam le ni suana phawt a,
Jesu Lal in vaihawm ina;
Tha thak det man kit masang sia'n,
A gam chu lian deu deu ina.
A kianga pauchap tawp theilo,
Pakna La tawplo chia to in;
Amin gimtui lei leh van ah,
Tu sang in la gimtui diak'na.
Mihing pau chuam zosia te'n le,
A hepina La a suang un;
Nausen hung pauthei bep te'n le,
A min thiangtho pak La a sau.
A pakna La van nuai dim hen,
A min thiang za um pen tahen;
Van mipite'n Amen tiu hen.
Lei mipite'n Amen tiu hen.
Ziatak hin hinna tui a luang,
Kalvari a hung pawt chu;
Mi tamtak hi damna'n a luang,
Kuale a dawn nuamte chu;
Nang Eden natna veitu kha,
Hung inla va dawn vak in;
Chun Kalvari tui chimtak chu,
La lunggila luang ina.
Chun zia tui hi hezing inla,
Midang le va hiatsak in;
Kuale a dawn nuam tapo chu,
Dam ngei ngei inau tinla;
Jesu lopina hung hina,
Van Angel thiangthote khin;
Pak La maktak kiko pi'nau,
I pau Pathian ma akhin.
Tu kipat in kumtuang tiang in,
Zia hinna tui hi a luang;
Thokit chate'n a tui thiangtho,
Kum khawtuang in dawn ta'nau;
Belamno hinna thiangtho in,
Hukdamte kivak in nau;
Eden thillui um talo in,
Hin thak in leng zing ta'nau.
Ka hukdampa'n ei veng in a nai zing,
Lau um banggual le lau nawt ta puang ka;
Thigawpi leh gawpi lak in ei veng,
A khutpek lopi sunga.
A khutpek lopi sung a (2V)
Thil bangkim hung tung leh le ka muang zing;
A khutpek lopi sunga.
A hepina angsung a chun ei pai,
Muanna thute a aw in ei hil tai;
Pathian ngei chun ei ven ziakin ka dam,
A khutpek lopi sunga.
Ka Thagau veng in ei nusia pua'na,
A hepina bangma'n ei khen pua'na;
Ama'n kumkhuan ei veng'na ti ka hiai,
A khutpek lopi sunga.
Lungdawn nite a um,
Kipak nite a um;
Kipak zing'ka ei panpi leu,
Pathian leh Angelte khin.
Angelte lenna gam khin,
Aksi khel gam vak khin;
Ni minthang tun phet leh lut ka,
Pathian leh Angelte gam.
Lalpa ka hatna pen,
Kumtuang puipa Aksi;
Dam in zia gam chu ei tun'na,
Pathian leh Angelte gam.
Van dum khel gama khin,
In minthang kei di'n um;
Go minthang tak le kei di'n um,
Pathian Angelte gam khin.
Ka kuang chawlna mun khi,
Chawm lokal tung tang ka;
Damtakin khawpi hang tung ka,
Pathian Angelte gam khin.

songs.title: Ka Ngak Zing Ui Van Lal

lines: Ka ngak zing ui Van Lal cha,
Lei daum thim nuai ah hin;
Salem vangkhawpi la siam,
Ka thangai ma ma tau.
Khawvel gentheina thim nuai ah hin,
Leng maleng le;
Ei hepi Lal Jesu chu,
Ka ngaih hai thei puang ka.
Van Eden ngunkhamtual nuam chu,
Lungkham dipdap umlona chu;
Aw bangtik ka hang tung diam aw,
La vangkhua Lalna gam,
Vak chul theilo chu.
Ei panpi’n ka Hukdampa,
Gal a hat khawvel ah hin;
Thisan ah la tatsate,
Lungdawng in a kap tau.
Khawvel la len lai a,
La thavaina Kalvari;
Galhat zosia a kim tau,
La gam nuaisia di guan.
Hukdampa khawilam a hem,
Zion tang galmuanna mun;
Gitlo thianna’n la thisan,
Kei haw di’n la luansak.
Gitlo damna kulpi,
La kumtuang van khua leh tui,
Hukdam cha la vang lim a,
Muang ah a lennau chu.
Aw khawvel hi mangthaina,
Chawmlo kal in bei ta’na;
Hukdampa kiko intin,
Lei gam nusia tai tiu;
Ama ngai zosiate’n,
A lopina chang innau,
Hepina tui khanglian bang,
Halleluijah Amen.
Ka lenna gamthip nusia in,
Van Jerusalem in nuam a;
Bangtik leh hang tung di ka hem,
La kumtuang Pialgal gam a.
Aw ka ngai gibang khenlona gam nuam chu,
Hintui luang dam diai;
Hukdam chate’n a dawn ui,
Kumtuang hinna chang in.
Belamno lenna gam lopi,
Ngai in sun naubang ka kap hi;
Aw Thagau Thiangtho hung leng in,
La gam ah ei pui kai in.
Dawngkawt gihawi chu a hawng tau,
A git dan chun ka lung ei len;
Mi thiangthote lenna gam a,
Aw kei le len ka nuam tai
Zia mun ah chun ka Lal dawi um,
A mel nisat lunlai gual in;
A vakna chu a zamvel a,
Kumkhua ah damna ding in.
En tia Hukdampa la Lal chun,
Thing hansedawl in a ngak hi;
Kei le Hukdampa ei ngak in,
Ka hungna lampi hak maleh.
Thepna bangkim zosia in le,
Aw Lalpa ka hiatzingna di’n;
Van Angel lunggual ginumte,
Ka ngai ni hin hung kum sek leu.
En tiam un, hinna lamding saw,
Haw a hak tunlo ka lau hi;
Lalpa van Thagau puilo chun,
Kua a hem hung tung thei ding le?
Bangtik leh a hem ka mu ding,
Ka ngaklai lei genthei um hin;
Nuam ah ka len ding ka thil sek,
Aw la hepina ziak a hin.
Thing hansedawl Khros mak tak chu,
Lungngai tak ah lei tatna chu;
Ka hinna pen thingkung a hi,
Tiin chawi an zing thei le hing.
Lei ah ka nei bang ahem?
Gentheina bep hi  ahii;
Nisin lungzinna'n ei bawm,
Do zawlo di ka lau hi.
Lalpa nang ka hun bel hi,
Pathian chapa hat chungnung;
Nisin ei umpi zing in,
Hatlo ka hattheina di'n.
Hatna thak in ei van in,
Ka thianlo ei silthiang in;
Kei dinga la thawkna hi,
Van gam tun tiang la'n sa'ng ka.
Ka damsung in semthei leng,
Nangma na bep hi sem in;
Nangma di'n kipe zo ka,
Nisin nang kivawp pi'ng ka.
Jesu nunnem ei panpi'n,
La cha hatlo liangvai hin;
Nanglo bel ding ka he puai,
Hat chungnung Halleluijah.
Entia hukdampa i mutau,
Gualpha pen tak i nei tau;
A hung masang in a chanchin,
Zawlneite'n a gen uh kha.
Gualpha pen leh Pathian,
Ei tanpa Jesu ahi.
I thasangin thina mun a,
Jesu chu a chiata hen;
I leibat ei ditpiak zotai,
A hinna a pe zotai.
Jesu thisan a chun,
Pathian tawh i ki cham tau.
Mi ginum hat chungnung ahi,
Chawihawina pe chiat hitiu,
Thiamlo changta thiam i channa'n,
A thisan in ei tan tai.
Mi zosia hung ta un,
Chawihawina Ama pia'i tiu.
Jesu'n vai a hawm hi,
Van chutpha chung a khin;
A lu ah Lallukhuk a keng,
Bul ah mithiangte tawh.
Lopi in hukdamte,
Lal kianga a ding ui;
Dantak leh ei le pang ngei hitiu,
Dantak leh dantak leh;
Dantak leh ei le pang ngei hitiu.
Ni bang vam puan sil in,
Simsenlo a ding ui;
Lopina Lal mawl chawi chiat in,
Chawihawina la a sa'u.
Belamno apak ui,
Amau dingah thi kha;
A thisan lultak ziaka chun,
Lukhuk a khuk chiat ui.
Thagau la hepina'n,
Vangphatna ei pia'n la;
I chung gamnuam taka khin le,
Ka pan theina ding un.
Chang a vakvai in ka hung hi,
Ka lam a thim ma mai;
Vangphatna nangma ka et leh,
Vakna ka hun mu tai.
Aw Jesu Pathian Belamno,
Ka chung ah la phatna;
Leh lei hepina ziak a hin,
Ka ba tam na lawm hi.
Ginglel leh lau in ka hung hi,
La thu bep kinem in;
La thisan luang ka hun et leh,
Lei ngaidam aw ka hiai.
Ka lungthim genthei tak ahin,
Thagau in semthei leh;
La thu meisel in nei tang ting,
Ka phaw leh hatna di'n.
Lalpa van tang lakah la aw,
Hethei di'n ei hilin;
Ka damsung kinepna limna,
Ka kumtuang la nang hin.
Ngaitiam un Pathian hepina,
A lopi ma ma hi;
Mi mangthai sa Pathian cha ah,
Ei hun sak kik tak hi.
Ngai un hepina thuk dan,
Pathian hepina tuipi;
Kalvari a hung luang kha,
Pathian chate hithei na'n;
Cha sak in ei hun ko tai.
Thisan zala ngaidam chang te'n,
Lungsiatna nei hitiu;
A hepina aw hezing di'n,
Ama gamlat puai tiu.
Lopina i chan ding niu chu,
Hung tung vak ziang ta'na;
I Lalpa i mu phat u leh,
Ama mel pu tai tiu.
Malzawlna chu i chan thei na'n,
Thiangtho in um hitiu;
A lopina i chan phat leh,
A mel limtak mu'i tiu.
I Pathian hepina thuk zia,
Zangaihna in a dim a;
Buaina tincheng ei dawn zangkhai,
Mal ei zawl piak zing sek hi.
Hepi Pathian a hi e. (2V)
Thil a hung um a mang kit sek,
Mihing a bei kumte tawh;
A hepina vang a ngai ngai,
Kumtuang in a dang diak puai.
Ei un vangsiatna ah i ngaih,
A hepina latsaktu;
Maleh thavai lungkham buaina,
Kipakna'n a siam zaw tai.
Jesu ka tha hepi pa,
La kianga chun ei pui in;
Thepna ahung nai lai in,
Nang in ei chawi sang inla;
Hukdampa ei pui inla.
Kumtuang mun ei tun inla,
Thepna ah ei hukhing in;
Nang in ka Thagau vawp in.
Ka hukdamna pen la hi,
Ka Thagau tanpa la hi;
Aw Jesu ei nusia kin,
Ei tung ding in ei pui in;
Nangma bep ging thei ding in,
Ka thi hun ni tiang in le;
Ka Lalpa ei pui zing in,
La vangam ei tun sak in.
Nang lo in ka hing thei puai,
Nangma ka bangkim la hi;
Hatlote panpi inla,
Damlo zosia damsak in;
La min a thiang in a fel,
Kei vangphatna bei ka hi;
Gitlona a dim ka hi,
Nang hepi diak na'n la dim.
Ka gitlo liakhu dingin,
La hepina ahun hi;
Tuikhuk pha chu luan sak in,
Zia tui chun eisil thiang in;
Nang tuikhuk pha chu la hi,
Ka dawi khawp ei dawn sak in;
Ka lung sung ah hung put in,
Kumtuang tiang in luang zing in.
Jesu'n a hun ko zing hi,
Chaute haw a ma zuan un;
Hun hukdam ngei ding ahi,
Kawt chu hawng lian un.
A kawt hawng lian un (2V)
Hun hukdam ngei ding ahi;
Kawt chu hawng lian un.
Hukdam ding in a hung hi,
Nang di'n a hinna a piai;
Than apat a thokit tai,
Kawt chu hawng lian un.
Lal Jesu'n a ngak zing hi,
Ama i hawl masang sia'n;
La lungthim kipak ina,
Kawt chu hawng lian un.
Jesu kiang a hung inla,
Hukdamna a nai lai in;
Hukdampa mualkhup ma hin,
Kawt chu hawng lian un.
Zing a thaichi tu in ei hepina chi chu,
An nek lai a sem in nitum tiang inle;
Lak hun di la ngakin lawtin gingcha kawm in,
Lim tak in chia hitiu i buphal keng in.
I buphal keng in, i buphal keng in,
Limtak in chia hitiu i buphal keng in (2V)
Ni vaka chi tu'i tiu lim nuaia le tu in,
Sum zing lau lo a khawvawt le thuak ngap in;
Dantak leh lak hun in i tup kha sem zo in,
Limtakin chia hitiu i buphal keng in.
Lalpa di'n chi tu in chia'nla sem ham ham in,
Lungngai leh buaina hung tung sek maleh le;
I lungngai hai phet leh Lal Jesu in lawp na,
Limtak in chia hitiu i buphal keng in.

songs.title: Ka Kipak Ma Ma I Pa

lines: Ka kipak ma ma I Pa Pathian in,
Bible a ahepi ei hil ziak in;
A lekhabu a thilmak ka mu hi,
Lalpa Jesu ei hepina ahi.
Ka kipak hi Jesu'n ei hepii,
Ei hepi hi; (2V)
Ka kipak hi Jesu'n ei hepii,
Kei natiang ei hepii.
Ama hemil in vakmang ma leng le,
Ka man lai in le ei hepi zing hi;
Ama'n ei hepi'i ti ka hiat phat in,
Ama kiang lama ka kihei kit tai.
Lal chu hawitaka ka mu tak phet leh,
La pakhat bep sa di hita leng chu;
"Lal Jesu hepina a mak ta luai",
Ti hi ka kumtuang la ding chu hi'na.
Ei hepi ziak in ken le ka hepii,
Hepi in ka Thagau ahung tan tai;
Ei hepi ziak in thinga thi ahi,
Lal Jesu'n ei hepi na lawm lawm hi.
Jesu hepi zia mi'n ei dawng leu chu,
Banggual bep in ka gen nasa ta diam;
Ama Thagau leh kei ki lungtuak in,
Lal Jesu hepi zia ei gen sak hi.
Ka hukdampa chu tuak ding in,
Khut ngawn in chia di ka hem?
Nikhat bek ana semlo in,
Bang hem ka piak tak ding leh.
Ka hukdampa chu tuak ding in,
Khut ngawn in chia di ka hem?
Thagau pakhat bek puilo in,
Tuak di Kei tai ka Lalpa.
Thi chu lauvin ka lungngai puai,
Hukdampa'n ei tat ziak in;
Maleh ngawn chang a tuak ding chu,
Ka ngaitua in ka lungngai.
Hun beisate zosia kha aw,
Ko kik thei hita ve leh;
Ko kit in Hukdampa kianga,
Kipak tak in pe ta'ng ka.
Mi thiangthote zosia tho in,
Khua avak lai in sem un;
Thina zan in a hun huam ma'n,
Mangthaite a di'n sem un.
Thina zan chun hun huam taleh,
Thagau khat bek pui lo in;
La hukdampa lopi tak chu,
Bang in la dawn ta diam le.
Pathian in ei hepina a lopi hi,
Mi genthei hing taklo mal ei zawl zing hi;
Gitlo ngaina thiam leh lungmuanna ei piai,
Gitlo zosia zo ding in ei pui thei na.
Tui zosia hin ka gitlo a sil thei puai,
Gan tam tak thisan in ei tan thei diak puai;
Lal Jesu thisan i ki thawi nau ahi,
Gitlo zosia na lo in ei hidam thei.
Khawvel tanpa kianga kumkhaw lopi na,
Lei leh van mi zosia'n pe chiat hi tiu e;
Ama'n ei hidam ziak in ka kipak hi,
Kumkhua in mitin in chawi hawi chiat hitiu.
Tu kipat hin chanchinpha a hung tung tai,
Khawvak pha apawt tai ama i mu tau;
Gamtin apat namtin hung khawm in ti un,
Van Lal hi chawi hawi in kipak ma ma nau.
Nisin in ka ngai hi,
Lalpa dawitak;
La aw zainem bep in,
Lei thamuan thei.
Ka ngai hi aw ka ngai hi,
Nisin in ka ngai hi;
La malzawlna mu ding in,
Ka hun nai hi.
Nisin in ka ngai hi,
Ei umpi'n la;
Setan in ei them in,
Ei zo puana.
Nisin in ka ngai hi,
Kipak ni'n le;
Hin le phachuam pua'na,
La pan lo chun.
Nisin in ka ngai hi,
La dawigual chu;
Ka hi thei zing na di'n,
Ei hil in la.
Nisin in ka ngai hi,
Ka thi phat leh;
Nang bep in lei pui thei,
Van gam a chun.
Kumtuang suangpi aw Khrista,
La angsung in eisel in;
La nak liam sunga pat in,
Thisan leh tui luang dawk khan;
Gitlo thil hi theina'pat,
Ei sil in ei sawp thiang in.
Zia lo hi suan ding bangma,
La dan tin di ka nei puai;
Ka gitlo leibat dit di'n,
Ka theina zosiate hi;
Ei hukdam thei ding bangma,
A um puai nangma lo chu.
Khut ngawn chang in ka hung hi,
La Khross ka hun tu mai hi;
Ngawn chang leh thianglo pum in,
La lungsiatna chu ngai in;
Thianthona lui ka hun zuan,
Hukdampa ei silthiang in.
Thina lui ka galkai in,
Hiatlo gam ka hung tun in;
Nang la Lalchutpha chunga,
Vaihawma ka mu tak leh;
Kumtuang suangpi aw Khrista,
La angsung in eisel in.
Thagau thiangtho hun sawl in la,
Lalpa Jesu min in;
Ka lungthim un cheng zing ta hen,
A thil hi mei gual in.
Penticost ni ahung tun in,
Unaute a panpii;
Chuti'n gitlo sut gual a hia'n,
Mipi ahung Pakai.
Ziaziakchun ana sep theina'n,
Thagau hi ka ni ui;
Ei pawl zilsak ei thamuanna,
Van a tun masang sia'n.
Thil dang zosia mu ma leu hing,
Zia hi i pha maw ui;
Gitlo etsak ei hu dingin,
Thagau bep a phachuam.

songs.title: La Ni Ei Piak Hi A Hung

lines: La ni ei piak hi a hung bei ta,
La thu in khua a thim Lalpa;
Biak hun imut hi thiangtho in la,
Thaw kit phat leh la min pak di'n.
Kochuam ipmulo pawl a um zing,
Lei khen khat a vak zing ziak in;
Chuti'n ven lo lai him a um puai,
Sun leh zan te'n la min a pak.
Khawmual leh thialkal ki zawm zingin,
Thing zang vak in vak a pui zing;
Pauchap hai lo in a zui zing sek,
Pak la gi hi a dai ngai puai.
Nitum lup hun ding ei hil pa hin,
Thanglam unaute akai tho;
Tui fawn ki nawk guala aw te chu,
Chawl lo in van lam a chia to.
A hi ngut hi Lalpa la gam hi,
Lei gam guala mang di ei puai;
Hung det in hung lian deu deu in a,
Thu, mi chunga vak suak vak hen.
Pathian kiang apat chiamang nung,
Tuhin ka hung hi:
Gitlo thuk tak ka haw nungin,
Lalpa ka hung hi.
Ka hung hi, ka hung hi,
Mang nawt lo ding in;
Nangma ah um zing ding in,
Lalpa ka hung hi.
Kumpha tamtak ka mat nung in,
Tuhin ka hung hi;
Kisika mitthi tawl pum in,
Lalpa ka hung hi.
Lalpa gitlo in ka chau hi,
Tuhin ka hung hi;
La lungsiatna ka ngai ta e,
Lalpa ka hung hi.
Ka thagau lungthim chau tak in,
Ka In ka hun zuan;
Hatna leh ginna ei pia'n la,
Lalpa ka hung hi.
Ka Thagau tho in limtak in,
Ka hukdampa pakin la sa'n;
Chawihawina la sa'n ki ko in,
A hepina a thawn ahi.
Aw a hepina a hepina,
A hepina a thawn ahi.
Gitlona a pukta nung hi,
Ei hepina a tuai diak puai;
Mangthai ta sa ei tandawk tai,
A hepina a lopi hi.
Aw a hepina a hepina,
A hepina a lopi hi.
Lei melma leh gawtmun inle,
Ka lampi hibuai maleu le;
Bit takin ka thagau a pui,
A hepina a hat ahi.
Aw a hepina a hepina,
A hepina a hat ahi.
Gospel malam ah kithang pek,
Khawvela gam tin in;
I kikhawp nau le a pung zing,
Ka lungthim lim zing in;
Mi tamtak thina kipat in,
Hung pawt'nau hin chang in;
Hukdampa chawihawi zing ding in,
Kikhawm'nau limtak in.
Jubilee dak sai hitiu e,
Thalek ah gi ding in;
Mi zosia hung kikhawm unla,
Hinna la dawi u kha;
Umna lei siam piak ka dawi hi,
Aw Lalpa ka Pathian;
Kumtuang in nangma pak ing ka,
Khawvel ka damsung in.
Mi thiangtho pakna chiato na,
Pathian kipak sak di'n;
Agit le migilo lak in,
Ki thang na hawi tak in;
Zia hin i Lalpen lopi zia,
Mitin hiatsak in a;
Chun chibai buk in khiangkho'nau,
I Pathian kengbul ah.
Khross a chun thisan go a um,
Khross thiangtho chu ka mui;
Thisan chu Jesu'n ei hiatsak,
Kei a'n malai luang kha.
Aw thisan lopipen chu,
Jesu'n a thawkna chu;
Khross chunga thisan go aluang,
Ginna'n ken ka mu tai.
Khross chu aw Khross giktak mai chu,
Jesu'n kei di'n a pu'i;
Lungngai tak ah athawkna kha,
Kalvari'n a nga tai.
A zang em? khross lultak mai chu,
Khross chu ka han thila;
Ka pawkang thei diam kipan ka,
Lallukhuk chang ding in.
Lallukhuk lopipen tak chu,
Zotu Lallukhuk chu;
Van ah Jesu ka mu phet leh,
Ke'nle la khuk nge'i ka.

songs.title: Hepi Zaw Diak Ka Nuam Lalpa

lines: Hepi zaw diak ka nuam Lalpa Jesu,
Ka duthusam hihen hepi zaw diak;
Zia hi dawn zing ing ka hepi zawk deu deu hi,
Hepi zaw diak aw hepi diak.
Kipak leh thamuanna ka hawl sek kha,
La kiang bep in ka mu'i kipakna kim;
Zia hi hi zing tan ah ka pauchapnate chu,
Hepi zaw diak aw hepi diak.
Hepi lasak piak pa hung hi hen la,
Lungngai gentheite le telsek ing ka;
A gi hawi zing ta'n ah zia la a sak sung un,
Hepi zaw diak aw hepi diak.
Zia'n lungthim ahi nuam hepi zaw diak,
Hi zing theina ka dawn thini tiangin;
Zia hin tawp mai tahen ka pauchapna teu chu,
Hepi zaw diak aw hepi diak.
Lalpa la aw nem in,
Lei ko na chu ka hiai;
La thisan pha'n ka hung thian na'n,
Kalvari a luang khan.
Lalpa ka hung hi,
Nangma bel dingin;
Thiangtho ding in ei sil in,
La thisan pha luang khan.
Hatlo leh gilo in,
La kianga hung maleng;
Nangma ka hatna pen la hi,
Ka gitlo sil thiang in.
Zia lei leh van akhin,
Kinepna leh limna;
Ginna leh lungsiatna bukim,
Di'n Jesu'n ei ko hi.
Pak un thisan pha chu,
Pak un tatna dawi um;
Pak un i Lal Khrist ei tanpa,
I hatna zawk ding in.
Lalpen ma in ding hitiu,
Angelte tawh la sa'i tiu;
Dantak leh (2V)
Luidung nuam tak zui hitiu,
Kumtuang in ama pak in;
Dantak leh (2V)
Lalpen ma in ding hitiu,
Angelte tawh la sa'i tiu;
I Lal lopipen kiang in,
Halleluijah, Halleluijah;
Lalpen ma in ding hitiu,
Sai-un van dak chu sai-un,
Lalpen ma in ding hitiu,
Dantak leh (2V)
Zia chun i lungngai ha'i na,
Zia chun ama pak hitiu;
Dantak leh (2V)
Ka Thagau leiba peta'n,
Lalpen ma in ding in-la;
Dantak leh (2V)
Ama la gopha pe ta'n,
Ama gual hi ding la hi;
Dantak leh (2V)
Gethsemani a khawsa kha,
I hemil ui i hemil ui;
Aw Lalpa ei etsak kik in,
Thawkpi ding in ei panpi in.
Jesu'n "hepa, hepa" a ti'n,
Bang dinga ei nusia la hem?
Chuti lawm lawm thavai thuak in,
Ei uh a di'n a thuak ahi.
Jesu'n "ka dang a chak" a ti'n,
Vat khat bek hi lodi la hem?
Hi du-da in Khross tiang tung in,
Thinglek a khan a thuak ahi.
Jesu dangchak aw hai ding in,
Mihing bep lo chu a pha puai;
Nang uh a khendente haw kha,
Hung un la va dawn sak ta un.

songs.title: Gam Nuam Bu Tamna Ka Tung

lines: Gam nuam bu tamna ka tung tai,
A hausakna zosia kei a;
Thimna vakna'n a chang ta e,
Ka thimna zosia a bei tai.
Aw beaula gam! gam nuam gam vak,
La tang sanga ka din phet leh;
Luigal langkhat lam han en ka,
Kei dinga mun siam na gam chu;
Vak lopitak han thil ing ka,
Ka van in ka kumtuang gam ding.
Ka hukdampa'n ei la dawnna,
A mel kipak um chu mu'ng ka;
A hepi khut chun ei pui'na,
Lei leh van gam gi khellam khin.
Hui gimtui thum tak hang ta'na,
Hinna thing kung chunga kipat;
Zia thing pak chun pul ni nei lo,
Kum khaw hintui luanna gama.
Kipakna hui chim a hang zing,
Van tingtang gi a thum zung zung;
Puan vam minthang sil Angel te'n,
Hukdamna La asa tau e.
Lalpa Jesu Galili ah,
Sa nga man te a ko;
A tawngkam suak dawi um tak chu,
Tu tiang in ka la he zing.
Ei zui in..... Ei zui in,
Ti a ko gual khan ei ko hi;
A tawngkam suak dawi um chu hia'n,
Jesu hi zui ing ka.
Lalpa Jesu hi nei ing ka,
Aw lei la dawi na diam?
Nga mante bep la ko paw e,
Keima le lei ko hi.
Ha kat tak in hun zui ka e,
Tu kipat in Lalpa;
Sual kidak um ei nusia kin,
Thiantho ngaidam ka dawn.
Lalpa la dan ei hil inla,
Sa nga man te gual khan;
Bang gual in len ka sep diam aw,
Galili mi gual khan.
Jesu'n migilo a dawi,
Van  zawtna gam mangte le;
Ama helote kiang in,
Zia lungsiat thu puangzak un.
Ama pak in la sa'n la,
Jesu'n migilo a dawi;
A kona thu hilchian in,
Jesu'n migilo a dawi
Hun zuan in chawldam inla,
Ging in a thu le a phai;
Gilopen le kipak na,
Jesu'n migilo a dawi.
ka lungthim a lung muang tai,
A vaihawmna lau lo di'n;
Ei hepi a ei tanpa'u,
Bangkim in ei lung muan tai.
Jesu'n migilo a dawi,
Ka gitlo sapi'n ei dawi;
Ka gitlo ei silthiang ta,
Van gam tung thei di kei tai.
Belampute'n Belam veng in,
Zan ah agiak khawm lai un;
Angel lopi hung kilang in,
"Lau ki unla ngaitiam un;
Mitin a din chanchinpha leh,
Kipak um ma ma ka hun tun ahi".
Hukdampa ding khat a piang tai,
Nang u di'n David khua ah;
Lal Khrista kha Lal khrista kha,
Ti-in a zuk kiko ta;
Nausen dawi um amin maka,
Lemguatpa, Kumtuang Chamna Lal ahi.
Pathian cha ahi hung piang chu,
Migilo ei tan ding in;
Pathian in ei hepi ziak in,
A chapa chang khat ei piai;
Ama pak in i hung kikhawm,
A min pak in khawvel hi lasa'n dim hen.
Lalpa chu chawihawi un Pathian khat bep chu,
Hukdamna maktak leh i pialgal lampi;
Ei hil tak ziak in ama chu pak hitiu,
Sun ah sum leh zan a mei ding in ei pui.
Angelte haw pak un la aw neisun un,
Van mi zosiate'n ama a pak chiat ui;
A gam lopi tak chu hung lian deu deu na,
A siamsa zosiate'n (2V) Lalpa apak;
Ka thagau nang le pak in.
Thagau mangthai dingte chu a tan zotai,
Migilo di'n thianna lui a luansak tai;
Lei-a atatsate ei hepi ziak in,
Pauchapna ei dawnhu Lalpa chu pak un.
Lalpa chu pak ta un i lungkham lai un,
A lungsiatna thagui in a hun tu tai;
Ginna leh kinepna a zotute tawh,
Hepina gama kituak khawm kit hitiu.
La kumtuang mun ding khawi ahem?
Ti in nang leh kei ei dawng a;
Zia chu bangtin la dawnhu diam,
La kumtuang mun ding khawi ahem?
La kumtuang mun (2V)
La kumtuang mun ding khawi ahem?
A thil bawlsiat teu haisan in,
Jesu a tel ui tam tak in;
Van mun nuam chang ngei ding ahiu,
La kumtuang mun ding khawi ahem?
Van hukdamna lam neu lam hi,
Pumpel in taisan male chin;
Khawitak mun ahem la tun ding,
La kumtuang mun ding khawi ahem?
Tuni pat hung kile kitin,
Jesu Hukdampa ging le chin;
Zia gual ahin dawnhu tan la,
Ka kumtuang mun van gam ahi.
Ka kumtuang mun (2V)
Ka kumtuang mun van gam ahi.
Van malzawl gaw pi hung zu'na,
Hepina thutiam ahi;
Van chung sang ah hukdampa chun,
Halna hun thak sak ina.
Malzawlna gawpi,
Malzawlna gawpi i ngai;
Amal bep tuhin a chak hi,
Gawpi hung zuk ka dawn ui.
Van malzawl gaw pi hung zu'na,
Halna thak hung tung kit'na;
Thingtang leh phaigam zosia hin,
Gawpi chu ahung gi tai.
Van malzawl gaw pi hung zu'na,
Lalpa ka chung un sawl in;
Halna thak ka chan uh phal in,
La thu za um chu puang in.
Van malzawl gaw pi hung zu'na,
Tuni hin hung zu taleh;
Tuhin Pathian ka hun ging ui,
Jesu ka ko tak ziak un.
Khawvel kipak un Lal a hung,
Lei hin a Lal lawp hen;
Lunggil zosia'n mun la awt leh,
Lei leh van in sau hen (2V)
Van leh khawvel ten la sau hen.
Khawvel nawpna'n vai ahawm hi,
Mite'n lasa'n pak un;
Tang leh phai leh luite hinle,
Pak La sa nawn u hen (2V)
Sa nawn u hen kipakna La.
Lungsiat leh thutak in a hawm,
Namte a ding dawk tau;
A felna lopitak mai leh,
A hepina mak chu (2V)
A hepina mak tak mai chu.

songs.title: Ni Vak A Chun Chia In

lines: Ni vak a chun chia in vak lopi a chun,
Zing pakcha gual in leh zan dai kia gual in;
Muang taka chia zing in nisin in zui un,
Khawi ale Jesu zui un.
Zui un ke'nle hun zui ing ka,
Zui un nisin in zui un;
Zui un ahun pui dan gual in,
Khawi ale Lal Jesu zui hitiu.
Ni avak lai tak in thim na a bei sek,
Kipak in lim un la genthei bei tana;
Hukdampa kona chu hia'n hun zui vak un,
Khawi ale Jesu zui un.
Nisa vak hawi lai leh liap hun lai inle,
Thigawpi hat lai leh hat lo lai inle;
Ama hatna ging in ni tawp hun tiang in,
Khawi ale Jesu zui un.
Juda maicham chung a,
Gan thisan luang te chun;
Lungthim hi a thamuan zo puai,
Gitlo hi bei na di'n.
Khrist van Belamno hin,
Ka gitlo cheng a puai;
Khrista kithawi na thisan chun,
Gitlo ahithiang thei.
La ma ah kisik in,
Ka ginna khut phal hi;
La lusip chunga la kawi in,
Ngaidam ka dawn ahi.
Ka ginna'n Khross lam nga'n,
A en la puak gik chu;
Zia gual lawm chun ka gilo maw?
La thuak nasa ta luai.
Chuti chun ka Lalpa,
Chawihawina zosiate;
Nang a hita hen kumtuang in,
La suak ka hung hi e.
Tumlam phaigam apat thu hawitak a hung tung,
Tawmngaina thu tawmngaina, Lal Khrista ding in;
La gihawi tak gual in, tang leh phai a thawng vel,
Tawmngai tak in pang hitiu tu'n Lal Khrista ding in.
Galzo ngei ding in (2V)
I puipau lopi aw chun;
"Malam zuan un" a tii,
Gam chu la pai tai tiu;
Tawmngai tak in pang chiat un,
I Lal Khrista ding in.
Lei chung muntin apat a thawm git chu ngai un,
Tawmngaina thu tawmngaina, Lal Khrista ding in;
Tho un la lau lo in thu dik chu panpi un,
Tawmngai tak in pang hitiu tu'n Lal Khrista ding in.
Tawmngai pawl hun zui un, mihat chu naw ding in,
Tawmngai tak in tawmngai in, Lal Khrista ding in;
Setan leh a pawlte del un la naw zak un,
Tawmngai tak in pang hitiu tu'n Lal Khrista ding in.
Jesu keng a ding in hatna thak chu i nei,
Tawmngai tak in  tawmngai in, Lal Khrista ding in;
Chanchinpha puang hitiu, khawvel gam zosia  hin,
Tawmngai tak in pang hitiu tu'n Lal Khrista ding in.
Jesu zuan in kalkhat bep,
Suan lo di i hiu em?
Hung in Lalpa ma ang ah,
Gitlo ngaidam dawn in.
Kalkhat bep in, (2)
Hung in a ngak hi;
Hung in ngaidam hung dawn in,
Malzawlna chu chang inla;
A zangaina pampai kin,
A thawn in hun pia'n na.
Jesu zuan in kalkhat bep,
Ging le chin hing in la;
Hepi tak in a ngak hi,
Ngaidam di'n a ngak hi.
Jesu zuan in kalkhat bep,
Gitlo apat pawt in;
Bangtin la ngaitua em?
Hun pha bei man ina.
Jesu zuan in kalkhat bep,
Hung inla hung gen in;
"Kipak tak in Hukdampa,
Ka hung kilan hi" ti'n.
Lal Immanuel ka hun pak ui,
Keimau hawina hawl lo in;
Mitin in nangma thu zui hen,
Nangma pak ah kiko in;
Nangma Hukdampa chu pak in,
Van ah pakchak la alem ui;
A pakna la'n vannuai thawng hen,
Lopi tak in um hen, Lalpen Immanuel.
Lal Immanuel, Immanuel (2V)
Lopina chawihawina leh Lalna;
Chitna leh thilhitheina kumtuang in,
Nang a hi hen;
Lal Immanuel, Immanuel (2V)
Aw nang Lalpen te Lalpen,
Immanuel ka pak ui.
Lal Immanuel ka hun pak ui,
Tatsate haw kikhawm in;
Lei ah Lalte'n le chawihawi in,
Lalpa chu khuksak tau hen;
A Lalchutpha lopi vel a,
A ang sung thamuanna a chun;
Pakna La chu dai talo in,
Lopi tak in um hen, Lalpen Immanuel.
Lal Immanuel ka hun pak ui,
Thokit Hukdampa Lal chu;
Nangma melmate nuaisia tu,
Bangkim hithei kumtuang pa;
Thina gitlo gawtmun zotu,
Setan thuneina chu zo in;
La min kumtuang in za um hen,
Lopitak in um hen, Lalpen Immanuel.
La ngainawp um gi chu ka hia'i,
Ka sak theilo La khat ahi;
La dik tak leh gihawi ahi,
Kenle khatvei chu hun sa'ng ka.
Khatvei lim leh kipak takin,
Aw hawi tak in ken le sa'ng ka;
La hawitak chu kenle sa'ng ka,
Jesu kiang van ka tun tak leh.
Ka zinna hi ka zaw phat leh,
Lei gam khel in van tung tang ka;
Lam haksa hi ka zaw tak leh,
Ka hukdampa mel chu mu'ng ka.
Zia hun ding chu ka ngak la hi,
Suangmantam kawt hawnna ni ding;
Bangtik zia hun chu ka tung diam?
Hin tawp lo ah len hun ding chu.
Ka chia hun ding ni tun tak leh,
Zia innuam chu tung ngei ding in;
Pathian khut hat chun ki nga'ng ka,
In nuam tak chu ei tun ina.
Thagau mangte hukdam in,
Vakmangte kha hawl in;
Phatchuam ngai in amau chu,
Lam dik a pui lut in;
Ngilnei tak a na sem in,
Tanpa ko na hil in;
Luai siam zaw ei tai ko in,
"Mun a um hi" tiin.
Mun a um (2V)
Luai siam zaw ei tai ko in,
"Mun a um hi" tiin.
Lungngaina guam apat leh,
Zan thim lak a pat in;
Gam nuam nivak na mun a,
Muanna thiangtho vak a;
Jesu kianga hun pui in,
A ko na hil nawn in;
Luai siam zaw ei tai ko in,
"Mun a um hi" tiin.
Lungthim hepina dim in,
Lalpa min in kuan in;
Hinna leh hukdamna kim,
Khawvel zosia'n gen in;
Khua avak lai in sem in,
Zan hun tung man kha'na;
Luai siam zaw ei tai ko in,
"Mun a um hi" tiin.

songs.title: Tuan A Pi Leh Pu Eden Huan

lines: Tuan a pi leh pu Eden huan sung akhan,
Malzawlna kim chang in a la leng ui;
Pakbang chawi lai a lim lai niu a tawp chun,
Ngai in a ko ui malzawltu Pathian.
A malzawlna leh hausak na'n,
Kiamni nei pua'na;
Thilsiam zosia hin,
Kipak in i chang;
I aw neisun leh i thei tawp un,
Chawi hawi hitiu;
Van Lal Immanuel.
Lo vat leh hal zaw nung in thaichi i ching,
Pak a ga ding in malzawlna i ngak;
Van gawtui leh nisa vak hawi tincheng chu,
A piak hunbi leh bangkim ei guat piak.
Aw Lalpa la malzawlna lopi tak chu,
Ka thai, ka bu-u bangkim chung un alang;
Ka no uh dimlet zing hen, ka damsung un,
La hausakna leh la malzawlna chu.

songs.title: Ka Lal Khrista Thutiam A Chun

lines: Ka lal Khrista thutiam a chun ding det in,
Kum khawtuang in ama chu chawihawi ing ka;
"Chungnungpen akhin lopi pen hen" ti in,
Pathian thutep a chun ding det in.
Ding in Ding in,
Pathian thutep hukhingpa a ding det hitiu;
Ding in, Ding in,
Kei ka ding tai Pathian thutep chunga.
A thutiam pel ngailo a chun ding zing in,
Ginlana huipi lau um hung hang maleh;
Pathian thu hing a chun hum bit in um ka,
Pathian thutep a chun ding det in
A thutiam ka mu ahin ding zing ing ka,
Kei a ding in thianna thisan a pawt tai;
Zalenna ei piak a chun um zing ta'ng ka,
Pathian thutep a chun ding det in
Ka lal Khrista thutiam a chun ding det in,
A hepina'n kumtuang in ei veng ina;
Pathian Thagau chemsau a kiveng zing in,
Pathian thutep a chun ding det in.

songs.title: I Kikhen Nung Khan I Lal Jesu

lines: I kikhen nung khan i Lal Jesu ziak in,
Tuhin mihingte dam in iki muu;
Limtang tak leh thu gual in kikhawm hitiu,
Thavai nung limin kipak hitiu e.
Jesu'n dam taka ei ven chiat ziak hin,
Ama min pak in kikhawm in kipak le'ng;
Mihing mai in ikipak a kim zo puai,
Thagau thiangtho in ei thamuan zing'na.
Vana Lal kiang a kikhawp kinem leu hing,
Kumtuang go pha le mu gaw chiat leu hing;
Pa leh mihiamte mit mu'n fel guai tiu e,
I Lal leh i unau ahi ziak in.
Ziatak khawvel ahin pak pha tadi le'ng,
Zia khin a ga i la mu ding ziak un;
A zuite ziatak hin lungngai maleu le,
Zia khin a kiang a tun un kipak nau.
Van gam ngaitua hin ei kipak sak,
Angel vam te umna;
Zia chun Hukdamte kikhawm in,
Lungngai na a khel tai.
Kikhen umpua'na,
Kikhen ta puai tiu;
Van gam nuama chun,
Kikhen umnawt pua'na.
Van gam ngaitua hin ei kipak sak,
Tanpa vaihawmna chu;
Zia chun Lalpa pakna'n pak La,
Dai ngai nawt ta pua'na.
Van gam ngaitua hin ei kipak sak,
Mi thiangtho te khawpi;
Puan lopi, Lallukhuk khuk in,
Kipakna'n dim tai tiu.
Van gam ngaitua hin ei kipak sak,
I tun khawm na ding chu;
Ngun leh kham kawt zing fang gual in,
Kipak La lem hitiu.
Zia lei ah gualte tawh lim in,
Kikhawm sek maleu hing le;
Himaleh kikhenna a hung tung,
A iki khen kik sek.
Van gam a kikhenna umlo,
"Mangpha" ti talo ding;
Zia gam hawi leh vak tak a chun,
"Mangpha" ti talo ding.
Gual dawitak ten thina luipi,
A kantau kipak a um;
Lei genthei bei phet leh a kiang un,
Kumtuang in um tai tiu.
Zia In hawi tak a chun khenna,
Thugen him umnawt pua'na;
Zia chun muanna limna kipakna,
La chu sa zing tai tiu.
Zia khawpi hawitak chun buai na,
Lungkhamna him um pua'na;
Zia chun kipakna kim tan tin,
Kikhawp na tawp nawt pua'na.
Khawvel ah gualte tawh lim in,
Kikhawm sek maleu hing le;
I van khawpi i tun phat leh,
I mitthi'u thiak hul ta'na.

songs.title: Gam Leh Nam Kal A Lungngaina Hi

lines: Gam leh nam kal a lungngaina hi,
I pau ma ah gimtui in a leng diam?
Chatuan council inziniar te,
Van lampi siam ding in hung pawt un.
Chatuan council vaihawmna chun,
Nam tangsang leh nam mun kuak te;
Siam gual ding in thu chu piak ei tai.
Gam leh nam kal a lungngaina hi,
Kumtuang pialgal mun nuam ei tun pua'na;
Chatuan ginna tha zap kai in,
Van lampi chu siam gual chiat zawi tiu.
Lungngaina tuipi thim chung ahin,
Nam kuang leh gam kuang a chuang diak lovin;
Chatuan hinna kuang a chuang in,
Van khawpi'n hang kilawi chiat zawi tiu.
Damlai tuisuagiat lau um chung a hin,
Ka kuang van Saron phai zuan in a chiai;
Thepna tui kinawk in nisin ei tawk zing,
Saron phai lampi mansua ding in.
Ei pui zing in Lal dawi Jesu,
Ka hungnau lampi hak maleh;
Hung enzui pek ing ka,
Saron phai tung ding in.
Lungkhamna tuipi ka um lai ah hin,
Ka chawl ta e tui kinawk tawvel hin;
Galili tuipi thu la piak gual a khan,
Lalpa ei hung panpilo di maw?
Simthi a han leh sim lam ka puk sek
Malthi a han leh Aw! mallam zuan in;
Kuang chawlna mun ka vai tuipi chung a hin,
Lal Jesu ka chawlna nuam hung hi'n.
Aw Lal Jesu ei hung panpi inla,
Damlai tuisuagiat lau um chung a hin;
Ka kuang van Saron phai chu zuan ngei ding in,
Thepna tuipi lak in ei veng in.
Chia zing ziang hitiu aw Zion chate,
Damlai tuisuagiat lau um chung a hin;
I kuang teu hi zang tak a hek guai tiu e,
Van Saron phai ah kai zo ngei din.
Hun kipak um leh,
Hukdamna ni hin,
Mabak tampi ka nei;
Khrista sep bak sem din,
Lalpa'n kei ei guat tai.
Damlai ni a beima hin,
Sem hat hitiu Lalpa na;
Hun a dang tai hun a dang tai,
Vaihawmna ni a nai tai.
Aw ka damlai hun,
La pammai taluai;
Thawn in liamlo zen in,
Hukdampa melsiatna,
Khu di'n mat ka nuam tai.
Tu tiang hin Lalpa,
Khawvel hin a tawm;
A tawmna siatlei hi,
Thisan ah chawkzaw nung,
Ama Lallukhuk di'n.
Hun a bei deu deu,
Hun a buai deu deu;
Bu tak leh lem sepna'n,
Tuisuagiat a fawn tai,
Lalpa thu dikna di'n.

songs.title: Hun Ni Tha Kumte Haw Hi

lines: Hun ni tha kumte haw hi,
Ngak lo in mual a liam zung zung;
Hung ki nung hei kik pua'na,
Lalpa thupiak gual ngei in.
Aw Lalpa zekim latna hun ti'n,
Kenle matthiam ka nuam;
Ka damlai hun chawmcha te hi,
Lalpa a'n pe tang ka.
Aw ka hun liamta zosia,
Lalpa ka dona hun te kha;
Kokit thei hita ve leh,
Mat ka nuam tai Lalpa a'n.
Hun ni tha kum zosia hi,
Hukdampa kengbul tiang ngei in;
Aw kilawi kim diam ta'nau,
Lalpa thupiak gual ngei in.
Hun ni tha kum zosia hi,
Hukdampa'n a hun phel ni leh;
Bang gual'i mang em hun tin,
Lalpa Pathian a ding in.
Hun ni tha kum zosia hi,
Thawn in hun tam liam sak puai tiu;
I kumtuang hun di ngaitua'n,
Lalpa a di'n mang zawi tiu.

songs.title: Nitum Senglo Lal In Ei Ko

lines: Nitum senglo Lal in ei ko,
Liangvai chate hung ta ve un;
La puakgik puak zosia teu,
"Chawldam sak ing ka aw" a tii.
Aw i leng un chia hitiu,
Hepina Lal ei ko na chun;
Puakgik zosia i ngak tak leh,
Kumtuang chawlna chun chawl tai tiu.
Nitum senglo Lal in ei ko,
Thina lak a hung pawt unla;
Hinna khawpi hun zuan un,
"Chawldam sak ing ka aw" a tii.
Nitum senglo Lal in ei ko,
Van khaw nun nuam limbang bel di'n;
Thina lusun na pel in,
"Chawldam sak ing ka aw" a tii.
A hingut hi kumtuang Lalpa,
La khawpi hawi siam thak a chun;
Gal-do zosia zaw nung leh,
Hung chawl thei di'n ei pui in aw.
Lalpa lungnat suknemna pen,
A hepi puan kivan a hi;
Eima ei hun mutheng lo di'n,
A hepi puan chu sil hitiu.
Lalpa hepi puan i sil tam?
I hepi puan in i tuam nam?
Hepina puan bep longal chu,
Lalpa mittung a um puai.
Lalpa chu a hung kik tak leh,
Chitin namtin lak a pat chun;
Hun hawl in a hepi puansil,
Ama lawpna chu chang ding in.
Van Lal etchim ngailo pen chu,
A hepi puan kivan a hi;
A hepi puan i sil zing nam?
I khu nam hepina puan in.
Zia khawvel ah i um lai un,
Lalpa hepi puan la chiat in;
Zia puan chun kikhutua chiat in,
Gikpuak kidawntua chiat zawi tiu.
Khawvel tuisuagiat lian lau umte chung ah,
Van Zion gam zuan in i chialai uh hin;
Mal thigua "Eurakuilo" chu hung hang in,
Lawng leh mite chu a hung tawk mang zo tai.
I lawngteu a gik taluai tuifawn a sang ngal a,
"Lawng vang siantin mivang damna Lalpa'n atii;
Aw paizang hi tiu thil giksak tamtak te hi,
Van Zion gam chu i tuntheina ding un.
Thigua huaisiat leh tuifawn santak ziak in,
Lawng chu tawvel leh thi lau um in aum;
Kuangmi lungngai lunggel vansang thil ziak in,
A hungtung kumtuang Pa thamuanna aw chu.
Tuihat pani hung kikhawtuana ah chun,
Aw damlai lawng lu te hi a tang zo tai;
Lawng meilam te chu a hung khikek zak in,
Thaphang tak in tui thuk ah a tum pan tai.
Dak inla han entia hinna tang lang khi,
Chi leh kuang sana dangka lopina lem;
Puakgik zosia paitha zang in kai guai tiu,
Aw I damlai lawng teu hi a sezo tai.
Thepna la lutlona di'n pauchap un,
Diabol in ei chang zing hi;
Ama hi do hi ti ung,
Thisan ziak in zo hitiu.
Galvan Galvan lai ti ung,
Chutichun Setan a thal kuang thei zosia;
Sumit hitiu Lalpen chate'n (2V)
Chemsau Kalvari chemsau mang hitiu;
Chutichun Setan a thal kuang thei zosia;
Sumit hitiu.
Setana ngei le vak sawlchak gual in,
A hung kisiam kawm thei hi;
Ama hi ahi i do,
Zo ngei ding in do hitiu.
I bawt hi thisan leh taksa ei puai,
Lalnate, thuneinate;
Van mun a thagau phalo,
Um i do zawk diu ahi.
Jesu Khrista ei tanpa'n a zo tai,
Khrista zaw na ei puipa,
I pau Pathian kiang a chun,
Kipakna thu um ta hen.
Ginna'n thangvan sang ka thil nin,
Tun kal ngakla’n ka ham zia mun chu;
Van khaw nunnuam khenlona chu,
Ngaiin nisinin ka kap.
Lim a um na ding e!
Lalnunnem vangkhaw siam;
Zingsawl Aksi Tanpa Jesu,
Kumtuangin i vak hi tana.
Ginna'n zia gama lut di chun,
Kei hing taklo hi kaki hiat in;
Ka lungngai ni leh ka kani’n.
Ka thamuanna pen ahi.
Jesu Van Lalchutpha bul chun,
Angelte leh Serafimte tawh;
A mithiang tel te haw cheng tawh,
Lal Jesu chawihawi tang kau.
Kana leh mitthi tawl zosia,
Lal Jesu'n ei thekhul piak tan tin;
Kei le van Angelte melpu'n,
Tawplo vankhuan leng tang ka.
Kumtuang pak hawi Immanuel,
Kumtuang pak Immanuel;
Nangma pakna'n pakna La hi,
A hawi in a lopi hi.
Nangma kiang a (2V)
Chawl thei di'n ei pui in aw.
Khawvel buai um thim nuai a hin,
Khawvel buai thim nuai a hin;
Um ka chim tai um ka chim tai,
Hung vak in zingsawl aksi.
Nang la um leh (2V)
Gentheina him a um puai.
Lawnlei pakcha Immanuel,
Lawnlei pak Immanuel;
Hung vak inla ka lungthim hin,
Van Lal lawnlei pak melpha.
Zingdawng sawlno (2V)
Hung vak in lei thim a hin.

songs.title: Ka Thil Chim Thei Ngai Puai

lines: Ka thil chim thei ngai puai,
Buaina sum khel gam nuam;
Van mi lungdawi tual lai lenna.
Aw hukdampa leh tatsate chun,
Van vai ahawm nau;
Thi leh lusun umlo na.
Khawpi Uizo zamvel,
Buaina chupphak lo gam;
Lal Hukdampa siam khawpi chu.
Khawpi chul kik lo leh,
A tatsa zosia leh;
Lal Hukdampa lenna gam chu.
Ka leh buaina gam hi,
Thina khel gamnuam a;
Pel in lunggual tuallai len hun.
khawpi chul kiklo leh,
Tanpa Belamno leh;
Hinna Thinglim gamnuam hawi chu.
Lalpa suangphu Khrista chu phu ei tai,
Pathian lungthim kilatna chu;
Khrista hi i et chun,
Pathian lungthim akilang.
Aw Lalpa suangmantam phu i hiu,
Tang chung ah leh muntin a kiphu in;
Aw lei leh van ki zawp na.
Khrista suangphu thagau chu phu ei tau,
Khrista lungthim kilatna chu;
Thagau hi i lawp in,
Khrista lungthim a hun puang.
Thagau suangphu Kochuam chu phu ei tai,
Kalvari pat mualtin tangtin;
Lal lungawi kum thu hawi,
Zekna dinga phu a hi.
Zia suangphu Lalpa gam chawihawi te chu,
Lalpa gam etnawp pen hi'nau;
Zia khawvel Khrista leh,
Mithiangtho than mual ahin.
Lungngaihna sumpi khel ah khin,
Nang ka hun ko Lalpa,
Malzawlna tam tak a chuai tai,
Khua a hung thim ta ei.
Aw galhat Lalpa ka ngai e,
Nang in ei liakhu'n aw;
Thim gal a hung lian tai,
Nang in ei panpi'n aw.
Siatlei nuaizinmang vangkhua hin,
Hing zo puangka Lalpa;
Thim gal liante'n ei tuamvel tau,
Lalpa ei panpi'n aw.
Nuaizinmang chung Pathian dogal,
A lian hi siatlei hin;
Immanuel gam siam ka ngai,
Thepna gal zaw nung ah.
Nang dogal hat zo chung Pathian,
La gam hung la kik in;
Dogal zo a len ka nuam tai,
Dogal cheng zaw nung ah.

songs.title: Khawvel Buai Umna Khel Lam Ah

lines: Khawvel buai umna khel lam ah khin,
Lalpa'n gam pakhat a guat;
Zia chu a mitelte chenna ding in (2)
Lal lemguat hawi leh thuk chu a hi (2)
I khawsaknau chu van a hi ngal a,
Zia kipat chun Hukdampa i ngak zing
Bangkim a thu'n a um thei ziak in,
I tawmlai taksa hun siam lopi'na.
Lei hin vang ling leh khau a tam a,
Gu leh thang in a dim zo;
Ginna thajap in lengsang chiat hitiu (2)
Lalpa siam vansang nunnuam ah khin (2)
Leng leng lehing chung thangvan ah khin,
Siatlei hi nungtiang sawn in;
Thi leh nat sumzinna khel lam ah khin (2)
Van Lal lung chu su awi ngei hitiu (2)
Chunglam ah khin mit han te zing in,
Hukdampa la ngak hitiu;
Chunglam chunglam chunglam en zing hitiu (2)
Ei puina van ah khawsa i hiu (2)
Ngaitia Pathian hepina thuk zia,
Tuisuagiat thuk sang leh van sanga sang zaw'n;
Eden kawt, sual khak nung kha,
Kap in ahun hawl tau "Aw Adam, Adam" ti'n.
Sual tui kinawk tawmang nung leh,
Sualna piaunel chupmang nung hi,
Van suangmantam mang hawl di'n;
Van Lal miguat a hung tai.
Sualna khukpi sunga kelut ta nung,
Gawtmun huaisia thina than thim chang ta nung;
A chapa changkhat neisun,
Hin neilote hin neina di'n a hun sawl tai.
Lei hansedawl a kilik tanung hi,
A van Lal chutpha pat ahun thilvel ni'n;
Aw a sun ui van mite'n,
Kap in ahun hawl tai "Aw kanau kanau" ti'n.
Aw ei hepina hi a thuk taluai,
Migilo hing hawilo ei hung hawldan hi;
Aw a mutai van Lal chun,
Lawpna sang pen chung in aw lawpna mu tak ti'n.
Khawvel apat pawt in,
Gamnuama pem lut di'n;
Thil thianglo khawilo di'n,
Lalpa'n ei dawi hi.
Hinna hepite leh,
Nipha munuam te chun;
Lei vengpha hen sual laka,
Thianglo genna'n;
Kam thianglo sek kihen.
Van khawpi tualnuam chun,
Thianglo um ta pua'na;
Gitlo leh thianlona,
Umkit ta puana.
Zia khawpi hawi tak chu,
Khawpi thiang chu ahi;
Ki suthiangte bep chun,
Zia chu lua ta'nau.

songs.title: Lalpa La Thutiam Tun Ka Mu

lines: Lalpa la thutiam tun ka mu tai.
Gentheina leh natna buai umte chu;
Tung di him in la genlawk ah,
La thutiam a guitun theina dingin.
Mithiangtho leh,
Van kona changte a dingin;
Khawvel hi umna tak ei puai.
Nat leh genthei leh buai umna te,
Tuhin le tuisuagiat kap leh ham chu;
Khawvel hi a kiling zo hen,
Mi tampi lauin a kithing zo tau.
Ka minin min thu hung gen inau,
Khrista ka hi tin hun panpi in'au;
Ti in thu la genlawk gual man,
Khawvel hi lungngaihnan a dim zotai.
Aw Lalpa, Lalpa chungnung pen pa,
Bangtik taksa tatna um di ahem?
Mithiangtho leh Martar thisan,
Bangtik leia phuba la di la hem?
Khawvel gam hi pawtsan nung takleh,
La lungnatna mel chu hung kilang'na;
Himaleh van kona changte,
Kumtuang hin tawploin leng dial dial nau.
Lalpen sepai hangsan te haw,
Kisiam zovin kigalvan un;
Sual sepai gal lian a nai tai (2)
Do ding in hung pawt dawk un.
Thim lal kuldet phe ding leh,
A sepai hangte do ding in;
Lalpa galvan mang hitiu,
Lalpa'n ma ei pui zing in a.
Jeriko kulpi det maleh,
A sepaite hangsan maleh;
Kul lopi chipna belam ki (2)
Khrista hatna chu a hi.
Thim lal sepai hangsante chun,
Lalpa gam hi la di ei tau;
A mite hatna belam ki (2)
Mang in malam zuan ngen un.
Lalpen sepai hangsante chun,
A gal do a zaw tak uh leh;
Chawihawina sangpen mu ta'nau (2)
Belamno chawihawina chu.
Van Lal chapa thina ding in,
Eden huan thei ahung ga tai;
Pi leh Pu Evi leh Adam,
Hun nek ziak in vannuai a hin;
Sualna chun vai a hun hawm tai,
Aw akhawk ngei e! maw Lalpa.
Puidawk ding in leh tan di'n,
Khawvel sual gik la puak ni hin;
Asun ui lei leh van mi'n,
Aw la thini huaise tak chu;
La chate'n le ka sun ui Lalpa
La thi ni huaise tak mai hi,
Bangtin ka hun bawl diam Lalpa;
Ka en ngam paw e aw Lalpa!
La genthei zia ka mu ni hin;
Ana ta law e! Van Lal cha,
Zia gual lawm a  la thi hi chu.
Aw Lalpa la thi ni hi vang,
Kalvari hinna hun ti'ng kau;
Chitin namtin te a ding in,
Hinna go luandaw na mun chu;
Aw ging leh hethiam thei ding in,
Thagau in mal ei hung zawl in.
I lungthim gamthip tak ua hin,
Cheng nuam Lal tamtak a um;
Ziatak Lal zosiate kianga pat hin,
I kumtuang mun ding chu a um puai.
Aw kapau van a mi,
La min za un hen la;
La gam hung tung hen la,
Ka lungthim gam keu ua hin.
I lungthim gam liantak ua hin,
Sual leh pha a kido tau;
Aw nang ka Lal ding un ka hung guat tau,
Hung cheng in la aw Lalpa dawi tak.
Thimlal thuneina i pel tai,
Khrista chu i Lal ahi;
Melma zosia ei zaw pi ngei in tin,
Limtawp lau loin lengkhawm tai tiu.
Nangma Lalchutpha bela chun,
Aw mite a cheng muang thei;
Ka lungthim gamkeu tak te'u a pat hin,
Aw Lalpa nang Lal in hung chu'n aw.
Thagau vakvaite zosia chu,
Kalvari'n a lengkhawm tau;
Mun dang lungmuanna umlo,
Gensim tang Kalvari lo chu.
Aw ka thagau nang le chian la,
Kalvari thing hansedawl chung a;
La Lalpa saw va en tia,
Lungmuanna thu la gen in a.
Thagau vakvaite zosia chu,
Kalvari'n Hukhingpa tawh;
A lengkhawm tau hin chang in,
Lei gentheina nunglam ngat in.
Sim leh mal hawlvel maleng le,
Mu puangka lungmuanna kim;
Mun dang lungmuanna umlo,
Gensim tang Kalvari lo chu.
Zia chun Hukdampa'n ei la dawn,
Muanna tui ei dawnsak tai;
Mun dang lungmuanna umlo,
Gensim tang Kalvari lo chu.

songs.title: Pathian Gam Chu A Hung Tung

lines: Pathian gam chu a hung tung tai,
A sunga tatsate le a leng zo tau;
Pathian gam chu i khut in a um,
Na vakna gam lopi chu ahi.
Pathian gam ahung tun in,
Lei thimna a bei tai;
A sunga lut kimawi tiu,
Vanlam chawn kit di ahi.
Pathian gam chu a hung tung tai,
A sunga chengte chu van milian ahiu;
Zia lei apat van a han khawsa'n,
Lal Hukdampa lung a su awi tau.
Van gam chu ahung tun tak leh,
Hukdampa Sial gual a sawite zosia khan;
A Lal hukdampau chu he ta'nau,
Sa leh mihiam dogal bei ta'na.
A vangphau Pathian gam cheng te,
Zalenna leh cha hina te chu chang in;
Lal Hukdampa hung kit ni tak leh,
Van sum chunga Lalpa dawn tan'au.
Gam lungsiat um gam hi aw,
A chung a ka kivai;
Hansedawl mun a hi ziak in,
Lal Khrista leh mithiangte'n tha a fam.
Leng dial dial leng dial dial in,
Van mun nuam ah mithiangte;
Limna Zingsawl Tanpa lawi in,
Gam lungsiat um ngai talo in,
A leng dial dial ui.
Gam lungsiat um gam hi aw,
Chung gikna a chang tai;
Hansedawl mun a hi ziak in,
Kana lusunna'n vai a hun hawm tai.
Gam lungsiat um gam hi aw,
Than thim mun a chang tai;
Hansedawl mun a hi ziak in,
Gawtmun meikhu gim a nam zota ei.
Aw ka ngai ka Pa gam siam,
Lungngai umlona mun;
Mithiangtho leh Angel vamte,
Hukdampa tawh a len dial dial nau mun.
I um sung khawvel a,
A hinna Thupha hi;
Chawi in gamtin in leng hitiu,
Sual a pukte kiang in.
La gam thim in a bawm Lalpa,
Lal Jesu Nang hung leng in;
Kokit a puidawk di'n Jesu,
Ei sawl in nang a di'n
Mangthaite'n a Thupha,
Mu tave leu chu maw;
Amau di’n a liangvaina cheng,
Hung thil lo thei pua'nau.
Damlai hun chawmcha hin,
Khrista gam sulian di’n;
Ei chawihawi hen a lopina’n,
Van go hawlkhawm ding in.
Kumtuang hinna khawpi
Hin kiamlo nawp kimna;
Immanuel lim bang belte n,
Chang inau zia mun chu.
Thagau Thiangtho nunnem,
Salvak in lei thim hi;
Sakmel chullo ka Lal liangvai,
Pak ah nga bang leng di n.

songs.title: Khua Hung Vak Di Ei Tai

lines: Khua hung vak di ei tai,
Damna Zingsawl le a suak tai;
Hukdam chate tho tai tiu aw,
Immanuel gam siam zuan di'n.
Aw damna Zingsawl a suak tai,
Lal lopi hung kilatna di;
Chawmlo kal hi tan a,
Kisiam zo in kiging hitiu.
Kisiam zosa'n ngak in,
Hukdampa hung kik vak tan a;
A cha liangvaite hawlkhawm di'n,
Ama la ngakte zosia chu.
Khawvel hi nusia in,
Thangvan sang ah nga bang leng di'n;
Thuang nusia'ng ting siatlei thim hi,
Immanuel gam siam zuan di n.
Aw Lalpa la lemguatte hi,
Mihiam a ding in mak tak a hi;
La lemguatna thuk tak mai,
Kei an mitthi'n a chang sek.
Aw Nang danglam ngailo Lalpa,
La lekha thiangtho ah hin;
La um zia kim ka mu in,
Lalpa ka hun pak ui.
Nang suang chu la hun phu zo ta,
Kei haw a chung ah sa bep ka hiu;
La lemguatna khel bangma,
Kei un hi thei ka nei puau.
La lemguat gual a umte chu,
Nangma'n a kiang un thu la gen sek;
Thamuanna bukim la piai,
Aw Lalpa ei hezing in.
Aigupta gam a Pharo suakte chu,
Pathian in a puidawk tai;
Sun ah sum leh zan ah mei pi'n,
Pui in a veng zing hi.
Aw kei ka zinna Lal vansang a,
Sual leh thepna gamkeu a hin aw;
Lalpa ei pui zing in,
Van lungmuanna khawpi chu ei tun in.
Dogal huaisia tamtak lak a te chun,
Lalpa Pathian in a veng;
A genthei liangvai na cheng un,
Lalpa'n a khawtua zing.
Lalgam Kanan gam zuan a chia te chu,
Sang tam tak a di'n thina;
Sang tamtak a di'n khawpi nuam;
Chawlna mun chu a hi.
Aw eile gamnuam i zawt lai ahin,
Sang tam tak a di'n thina;
Sang tamtak a di'n khawpi nuam,
Chawlna mun chu a hi.

songs.title: Khawvel Ah La Hawi Zosia Hin

lines: Khawvel ah la hawi zosia hin,
A pak seng puau Lalpa;
La hepina thu hi (2V)
La hawi leh aw hawi simsenlo,
Nei te'n zia khawvel apat hin;
La hepina thu hi,
A pak seng puau Lal Immanuel;
Ginna'n a leng dial dial ui,
Kalvari mual lam a;
Khawvel gitlo paw pa,
Halleluijah ti'n a pak ui.
Bangkim bangkim zosia sang a,
Chungnungpen leh sangpen;
Nangma Pathian la hi (2V)
Mualtin tangtin zosia siam leh,
Mihiam siampa Pathian;
La lopi hi Lalpa (2V)
Zia khawvel genthei nuai a hin,
Bukim a um thei puai;
Kim lovin ka hiau va (2V)
A bukim ahung tun phet leh,
Hechian sik sek tang ka;
Lalpa Pathian pak na'n
Pak la kim sa tang ka.
Lalpa bukim ah pak thei di'n,
Ka lungthim hivak in;
La hawi a chawihawi di'n (2V)
Khawvel ahin chamna leh,
Lungmuanna kim ka hawl sek;
Maleh genthei lungzinna'n ei dawn,
Mu leh chan thei him hi'n ka he puai.
Kalvari chamna thu thang,
Mu leh chang tute na vakna;
Mihiam hetphak zaw guallo,
Lei leh van kichamna.
Aw babulon phai zawl a,
Khawvel pum kichamna lim;
Mihiamte lopi zia kilatna,
Jehovah chun a hiatpi thei puai.
Mitin leh tuitin kigawm,
Sakluang changbang a zal na;
Van mun nuam a chitin pautin te,
Kigawm chu van lili'n pak ta'nau.
Saltang Babulon luipi pang a,
Lungngai a kitung te chun;
Aw! Zion ngai in a ting tang teu chu,
A bang tau thing lek a.
Aw Zion Lalpa khawpi hawi,
Chawihawi ka nuam tai;
Mi gam a te hin Lalpa,
Nang pakla kasa thei puau.
Sal-a puite chun Zion la chu,
Sadi'n nisin a phut tau;
Mi gamsunga chun la a sathei puau,
Gam genthei um ahin.
Sualna Babulon khawpi sunga,
Lungngaina saltang ka hi;
Aw! Zion ngai in ka kap nisin in,
Lalpa ei puidawk in.

songs.title: Pathian In Kum Leh Tha Hun

lines: Pathian in kum leh tha hun zosia,
Bukim kei in a siam hi ei a di'n;
Pak in chawihawi tak ahi Lalpa,
Bangkim chung a Pathian.
It la um ngei ei maw?
Tuni kumlui mualliam;
Ngai in kokit nuam maleng le kumlui,
A bei tai nangma hun (2V)
Thil hiphat leh hisiat zosia te,
Pua'n a chia tai I Lalpa kiang a chun;
Thil i hiphat leh i hun zosia te,
Bangti'n a puang ta diam?
Aw kum leh tha leh ni leh hun zosia,
La liam tau maw nunglam ngailo ding in;
La cha, lanau mihiamte kei haw hi,
Bangti'n ka um ding awm?
Aw! ngai in thil leng le nunlui gam hi,
Mual a liam tai thokit thei ta puang ka;
Len gual sui lungtuak ngabang lenlai hun,
La liam ta maw 'NUNLUI'
Babulon khaw lopi chu,
A tawm tai, a tawm tai;
Aw nang khawpi hawi,
Bangdia tawm mai la hem?
Babulon khua Babel chu,
Solomon Lalchutpha leh;
Kum sang gam etsakna,
Lal lemguat la pawi mawi.
Babulon khawpi sawng ni,
A tawm tai, a tawm tai;
Khawvel khawpi hawi,
Bangdia tawm mai la hem?
Damlai Babulon khawpi,
Sualna sal ka tang tai;
Van Zion Khawpi,
Ngai in nisin kakap.
Khawvel Babel mun ahin,
Lal lung suk awi theilo;
Aw ziamun lui hin,
Kumtuang gam ei kawk mui.
Aw kumthak nisuak melpha leh dawi um,
Ka lungthim zanthim hun salvak in;
Nang a'n a thak a umthei ding in,
Lungthim thak chu ei hun pia'n.
La thil siam thing leh lo ten,
Thak hun a nei ui Lalpa;
La misiam te hi,
Bangdia thak theilo ka vem?
Aw kumthak la mel dawi um gual ngei hin,
Nangma'n ei hun pe zawn lungthim thak;
Nanga ding leh Lalpa a ding in,
Lim tak in umthei tang ka;
Kumlui mualliam ta kha kokit thei leng,
Kokit ing ting Hukdampa kianga;
Lim leh kipak tak in pe tang ka,
Aw ka hun melpha cheng tawh.
Lungthim thak lei piak leh aw Hukdampa,
Gitlo lungngai ti hi ngai nep in;
La van khawpi thak chu thil zing in,
Nisin in lim zing tang ka.

songs.title: Khawvel Da Um Nuai A Ka Len

lines: Khawvel da um nuai a ka len sung hin,
Nang lo chu lai na ka nei puai;
Lal Jesu nang hung leng in aw.
Lalpa Lalna gam ka tun phet leh,
Ka Thagau van sang a khin leng in,
Lalna khawpi'n leng tang ka.
Damlai nuai zinmang thunei na nuai hin,
Hinlai lung a zing ngei damlai lung;
Lal Jesu dawi gual hi ding in.
Ei tuam zing da um na leh natna hin,
Pel ka nuam ngei e aw Lalpa;
La min go hi chawihawi ding in.
La min go hi chawi len nuam ma leng le,
Aw damlai hin zia henkawl hin;
Hinlai taksa a su zawng hi.
Zingsawl aksi hukdampa Lal gam siam chu,
Lungngai lungzin genthei zosia um ta puana;
Van khawpi nunnuam tatsate lenna di'n,
Hansedawl thing chunga a siam khawpi chu ahi.
Aw van lili vulna gam sana tual nuam chu,
Hukdampa thisan asiam khawpi tual nuam a,
Mithiangthote a leng zotau;
Lei nung tiang sawn in len ka nuam ta e.
Hukdampa lenna mun khawpi tualnuam chu,
Chul kik lo din Lal nunnem vangkhaw siam ahi;
Keile len ka nuam tai zia gam nuam a chun,
Ka leisiat gentheina cheng pel a chawl hun ding chu.
Van khaw tual nuam Hukdampa mun siam a chun,
Zingsawl melpu'n mithiangtho te a leng zotau;
Keile len ka nuam tai zia gam nuam a chun,
Aw Lalpa ei hung pui in lei gentheina pat hin.
Van khaw nunnuam khenlona khawpi a chun,
Zawlnei martar mithiangtho te kimni tak leh;
Keile leng tang ka zia gam nuam tak a chun,
Ka leisiat gentheina cheng pel a chawl kumtuang di'n.
Lalchutpha chawihawina tin chang ta nung,
Lei hansedawl a kilik tak ziak in;
Lallukhuk leh chutpha nusia'n,
Lal Immanuel a hung hi tai.
Kipak in chawisang hitiu,
Lal Hukdampa hung piang hi;
Halleluijah amin pak hitiu,
Ei a'n damna a hung tun ta-e
Lei Lal Kaisara'n min a zek lai-in,
Mun a um puai Lal lopi pia'n na di'n;
Bawng in tawm a ka Lal liangvai saw,
A chun liang Mari chun a pai tai.
Lal Heroda a lungzin tak ziak in,
Chibai lungngai um leh huaisia chu bukdi'n;
Juda gam mipite a kokhawm,
Maleh lei leh van Lal chu ahi.
Belampute'n chibai a hung buk tau,
Van Angel te'n Lal lopi a hung tha'u;
Thangvan Aksi'n amau ahung pui in,
Mipil ten chibai a hung buk tau.

songs.title: Lal Pian Hun Kipak Um I Tung

lines: Lal pian hun kipak um i tung kit tau,
Lim tak a pak in la’n chawi hitiu;
Thina thim nuai a,
Chute din vakna lopi a tung tai;
Halleluijah pak la'n chawi hitiu.
A min Mak a Lemguattu Lalpa,
Kumtuang Pa Lem Lal Lopi ahi;
A gam in tawp ni him nei puan a,
Lian deu deu zawna kumtuang inle.
Tuhi’n le Bethlehem khaw lam ah chun,
Ginna tha zak in va leng lehing;
Chung liang Mari pai,
Lei leh van Lal liangvai va mui ti ung,
I nei go thil zosia hi piai tiu.
Ginna’n ka han thil ah ka chung vankhua,
Lemna Lal Chapa hung pian ni hin;
Khen na'n la a lem,
A aw hawi thang vel chun khawvel gam leh,
I chung thangvan sang khi a thawng vel.
Ei Tanpa Lal pen thak hung piang pa chu,
A min Lal Khrista Immanuel;
Hosanna chungnung,
Pen ah khin lopi tak in um ta hen,
Lemna thu leng hen khawvel ahin.

songs.title: Lal Pianni Kawl A Liam Nung A Suak

lines: Lal pianni kawl a liam nung a suak dawk kik tai;
Bethlehem ngaihna chulnung, Pakbang a vul kik tai;
Thangvan a aksi’n ma ei pui hen,
Bethlehem mun lam zuan in;
Lal hung piang lawm ding in.
Chungnung pen a (2V)
Pathian lopi zing ta hen;
Amen Amen,
Pathian lopi zing ta hen Amen.
Khristmas ni a hung tun in Bethlehem ka ngai,
Mu ka nuam singkhual vangla Van Lal cha hung piang chu;
A lawpna Angelte aw gi chu,
Ka lungthim in a cham hi;
Ngil ni um ta puan a.
Aw Bethlehem khawpi nang la hawi na e aw;
La sakmin hi van nuai in chuai ni um ta puan a;
La Sung a van Lal cha hung piang chu,
Chun liangthei Mari vawnchawi;
Lal Immanuel chu.
Lal Immanuel lawm ding in Mipilte ahung,
Go thilphate hun chawi in Immanuel ang a;
I Lal Hukdampa ding hung piang chu,
Pakna la ki thang vel hen;
Hallelujah Amen.
Lalpa thigua a hang bek a,
Tui kinawk le a sang tai;
Mangthai thei di ka hi Lalpa,
Aw lei panpina ka ngai hi.
Galili tuipi kinawk,
Thu la piak gual khan;
Damlai tui kinawk hi Lalpa,
Ka manthai ma'n thu hun pia'n.
Thepna thigua hat maleh le,
Tui kinawkte sang maleh;
Nang Hukdampa'n lei umpi zing,
Ti ka hiat in ka tha a muang.
Kei mi genthei ginna tawm hin
Thamuan pa ka hun ko hi;
Damlai thigua leh tui kinawk,
Lau um hin ei panpi in aw.
Van nuai khawtin sakmin tiam in,
Lalpen Kaisara chun;
A chial vel hi namtin chate,
Malai a chang zo tau.
Aw Bethlehem ka ngai na e,
Belampute gam kuan na;
Seraf te'n zaila a awi nau chu,
Ka Lal pianna la hung hii.
A liang na e Van Lal Chapa,
A lupna gan ankuang;
A hung piang hi Mari vawnchawi,
Bawng in tawm tak nuai-a.
Chungnungpen a lopi pen hen,
Van nuai mi zosia di'n;
Lei-a kumkhuan cham leng ta hen,
Chamna Lal a piang tai.
Jesu kalak un hung cheng in,
Zan khawsawt nung inle;
Lim in tai khua ei vakpi in,
La min chawi hawi ding in.

songs.title: Lal Pian Hun Pakcha A Lun Kit

lines: Lal pian hun pakcha a lun kit tai,
Thinlai ip nung lunglen a kai tho hi;
Van nuai mi gen Bethlehem tang chung ah,
Ginna tha’n mi a lengkai ui.
Aw ka Lal nunnem, nang in ei pui zing in,
La chun leh zua kal a;
Senlai naubang la kana mun tual ka ngai.
Ngai a na ngei Bethlehem tang pi,
Kawl nivak hawi kawl in a tum hiai hiai;
Bawng in tawm a ka Lal liangvai tak saw,
A chunnu Mari’n a pai hi.
Bethlehem Aksi a vak kit tai,
Eden than kawtkhak sung a hun salvak,
Hal in tho un Eden khua a vak tai,
I tup gam chu zuan ngen hitiu.
A hawi ngei e Lalna gam thing chu,
Ei di’n Bethlehem tang a hing dii diai;
Malai pi leh pute’n a mu phaklo,
Saron pak chawi in leng hitiu.

songs.title: Hosanna Ti Pek In Aw Halleluijah

lines: Hosanna ti pek in aw Halleluijah Amen,
Lal Khrista a hung piang hi Bethlehem ah chun;
A tawngkam suak hepi thu namtin damna a hi,
Kipak ah kiko in Hosanna tiin.
Aw Bethlehem tang chung ah,
Kumtuang khua a hung vak hi;
Gen kimvel tiam un,
Kua'nle zia hinna vak chu la lawp ah taksang chun,
Thasiat ka leh buaina tuak kit ta pua'n au.
Amak in, a lopi hi kilemna Lalpa chu,
Hepina a luansak hi khawvel gam a hin;
Sual apat i taidaw theina ding u a hi e,
Hepi gam Lal ahi i Lal Jesu chu.
Pa hun tiam a tung ta e ei di'n damna a hi,
Hepina a luang let hi Kalvari ah chun;
A mak dan kua hem gen thei lei lung aw gi te hin,
A hepina gam ah ei puidawk ta'na.
Zion lopina lalpa mangthai ei hawlpa hi,
Van mipite'n it maleu a dalzo puau e;
Bangkim ah bangkim chung ah Lalpe'n tahen Amen,
Ei hepi hi kuama'n a nial thei puau e.

songs.title: Ngaitia Van Lal Chapa Bethlehem Bawng

lines: Ngaitia Van Lal chapa Bethlehem bawng in tawm ah,
Mihing vawnchawiin a hung piang a;
A Lal lopina van Lal chutpha hun nusian,
Ei tan ding in bawng in tawm ah a hung piang a.
Ka pak ui lei leh Van Lal chungnungpen,
Theitawp in la pak la hun sang kau;
Liangvaite le gentheite Lalpa,
Ma'n Bethlehem ah mun hun mulo male chin,
Tuhin vang ka lak un mun a um nang a di'n.
A pianna mun genthei Bethlehem bawng in lo chu,
Ama a din mun dang a um puai;
Alu a nga tai Bethlehem bawng in tawm ah,
Lei lalte leh ama chiten ala dawi puau.
Lal chungnung, mun chungnung penah cheng Lalpa Jesu,
Lei a lalten ala do meleu;
Kei a ding in vang Lal dawi um pen ahung hi,
Liangvaite kipakna ding ah Lal hung piang chu.
Ma'n Eden huan ah hinna lukhuk i matsua kha,
Tuhin Lalpa’n ei hun pe kit tai;
A kamsuak hepina liangvai te ei nempen,
Zingsawl Aksi sang ah vak zaw Lal dawi um hi.
Malai Bethlehem ah khan nang di’n mun a um puai,
Nang mi thiangtho Van Lal pianna di’n;
Tuhin vang chu nang a ding in mun a tam tai,
Jesu ka lungsung ah cheng in munpha chang ta’n.

songs.title: Eden Pak Hawi Chul Nung Pak

lines: Eden pak hawi chul nung pak lun sak kit di'n,
Khawvel Hukdampa a hung piang tai;
Pialgal hin hawi ei chan sak kit theina din;
Lal chungnung pen in mun tawm pen a hung tel.
Pak hitiu ve, Lemna Lal hung piang chu,
A pak la’n lei leh van thawngvel hen;
Zia gual lawm ah ei ding ah Lal dawi um hi,
A piang puai kumtuang in le piang nawt puana.
Malai mi’n le a thilchimlo zia ni hi,
Mu lo in sang tamtak a liam tau;
Lal lungdam kum Hukdamna ni kipak um,
Ei hawm I chan thei ziak un vangpha I hiu.
Tuma tunung van nuai mi minsak lak a,
Hukdampa dang him piang nawt puan’na;
Malai mithiangtho Simeon gual a khan,
Mu leh lawp tapo mi vangpha pen ahiu.
Lei leh van ah sim senglo mipi lak a,
A hawi chungnung pen hi Hukdampa;
Israelte’n a nawl ua a pai sau kha,
Van Lal Kumtuang Go Suangmantam ka chang tai.

songs.title: Khawvel Buaina Khel A I Kumtuang

lines: Khawvel buaina khel a i kumtuang khawpi hawi ah,
Lungngaih kana him a um nawt puai;
I Lalpa'n a siam van Jerusalem thak a,
Zia tak chun lungngaihna sum a zing ngai nawt puai.
Lalpente Lalpen pak in la a sau,
Chibai buk in Angel te'n a biau;
Van khawpi kimvel in aleng ui,
A thiangtho thiangtho ti'n a kiko ko sek ui,
Lung ei len hi van Angelte thazap git in.
Ngunkhamtual suangmantam hawi chitin cheng a zem chu,
A kawtzing ngun leh kham a luan tawh;
Lalchutpha ang ah van mithiangthote haw chu,
Pathian hepi vak lopi'n a um kimvel hi.
A mun hing cham chung a hinna tui a luang del del,
A huang sung tuallai ah hinna thing;
Namtin damna ding chu a chul kit ngai nawt puai,
Gilkial leh dangchak him him le a um ngai puai.
Ngunkhamtual salvak di'n khawnval him a ngai nawt puai,
Vaihawmna Lalchutpha vam chung a;
Pathian Belamno vak a khawnval uh a hi,
Puanvam sil in Belamno chu a pak chiat ui.

songs.title: Gam Thiangtho Ah Lal Hung Piang

lines: Gam thiangtho ah Lal hung piang chu,
Chunglam aksi chun a zuan pek a;
Miching Ama hawltute khan le,
Aksi chu a zui ua,
Ken le zia Aksi vak chu zui pek in,
Lal pianna mun tawm  Bethlehem ei tun na.
Aw Bethlehem tang ka tun masia’n,
Chawllo in chia ing ka;
Sun Aksi vak chun ei pui pek intin,
Mari pai lai Nausen dawi um va mu’ng ka.
Kumtuang Salem kawtkhak lopi,
Chu kei di’n a hun hawng kit ta e;
Manthaina gam ah leng tanung kha,
Van khawpi ei chansak;
Lim in pak hitiu Lal thak a piang tai,
Lei hi kumtuang la hawi in thawngvel tahen.
Lawplo a um diam Lal thak chu,
Van mipite chun a hun khen tau;
Angai in van khua a ngui zo tai,
Kap in lei a thil ui;
Kumtuang aksi chun le a zui peka,
Apian na Bethlehem tang a hun tun tai.
Aw ei uh le va chiai ti un,
Mun lunglen um lam chu zuan hitiu;
Lei ah lalte leh mipite chun,
Ama do maleu le;
Kei vang ka Lal dawi ka lunglai nem pen,
Ka lunngai ni’n le Aman ei umpina.

songs.title: Ngai Tia A Giu A Hawi

lines: Ngai tia a giu a hawi na e,
Ni lopi hung tung lawm in;
Khawvel gitlo thepna chung a,
Cham leng hen ti in la a sau.
Chungnung pen ah lopi ta hen (2)
Tiin a tingtang giu hawi tawh;
‘Lem leng hen’ ti in la a sau.
Malai Aigupta gual a khan,
Jubili a hung tung tai;
Lopi henla chungnung pen a,
Salem thak hun hawngtu chu.
Melhiat phaklo ah mi a hiu,
Tanpa pakla sate chu;
Kumtuang lem Lal lopi pak in,
‘Cham len hen’ ti in la a sau.
A hawi nau e a puan lopiu,
A mel uh ni sang’h vak tawh;
A puan vam lopiu chu sil in,
‘Cham leng hen’ ti in la a sau.
Ei hil tiam un Angelte haw,
Van Lal Immanuel chu;
A Lalchutpha lopi nusia'n,
Gilote ding ah hung hi.
Hung vak kik hen i chung uh hin,
Teptena Zingsawl Aksi;
Chamna leng hen mun tin ah hin,
Tiin la sakpi tai tiu.
Aw pak un Pathian Belamno,
Kalvari ah thi kha;
Nangma leh keima tatna di'n,
A thisan a luang tai.
Thisan in, Thisan in,
Ei tan tai Belamno thisan in;
Ei tan tai, ei tan tai,
Belamno Halleluijah pak un.
Aw Lalpa hepina lopi,
A hausakna kiamlo;
Sang tamtak a pe tai kei le,
Malzawlna chu ei piai.
Halleluijah lopina chu,
Ama'n nei zing ta hen;
Khawvel sual leh kei chu,
Khrista Thisan go chun ei tan.
Lapa’n ei hepina chu,
Van sana tualnuam hun nusia’n;
Gitlo cha ei hung hawl di’n,
A thuak tai Lal Jesu’n.
Lungngaina thing Khros chu,
Kei di’n a pu hen;
Chau in a puk ah,
Kilna thingkhet kei di’n ana taluai,
Aw ka gen thei puai.
Chenna ngailo tual len chu,
Puansan leh lingphek chu khuk in;
Genthei tincheng thuak zo in,
Belamno Lal Jesu’n.
Thil chim theilo Lal Jesu,
Gilote ding ah Khros chu puan;
Kalvari lam zuan ding in,
A chau a hi ka Lal.
Aw kei ding ah thuak zo in,
Kalvari tang thing Khros chung ah;
Ka sual zosia paw zo in,
Ei tan tai Lal Jesu’n.
Ginna tha hi zak in,
Kalvari mual lam va fang le hin;
Ka Lalpa thina mun ah chun,
Ka chenna ding Salem thak va mu’ng ka.
Ka lei lungngaih,
Ka kalai hai tang ka;
Kipakna pak lunna ka thil in.
Kalvari tang chung ah,
Thisan lui lua’ng Hukdampa nak a;
Namtinte silthianna ah chun,
Aw ka thagau nang le kisil in.
Jerusalem thak khi,
A latna tang dang a um paw e;
Thil hitiu Kalvari tang ah,
Zia chun a lang Hukdampa nak ah chun
Aw ka thagau leng in,
Va thil vel in Hukdampa thina;
Nangma ziak ah a thawkna chu,
A thisan luang ah chun kisil in.
Ka Lal Khros chu ka ngaisang pen,
Khawvel sum vang ka ngainep a;
Zia chun namtin chitinte din,
Kipakna bukim a um hi.
Aw ka ngaina ngei,
Hun pak zing tang ka;
Ka Lalpa Khros chu ka hinna pen,
Lungngai chate nang ma zal a,
Ka malam a aw limna'n kawl a eng.
Khawvel hawina leh lopina,
Et in lungngai a khawk diak sek;
Kumkhua ah ka Thagau chawl leh,
Limna ding him ka muzo puai.
Sual huipi leh khawnim kal ah,
Leh gal ma ah ka din chang in;
Ka kulpi leh ka himna pen,
Kalvari thing ka ngaina pen.
Tuisuagiat, van leh khawvel hi,
Belamno thina lopi chu;
Pak in la sau hen kumtuang in,
Hallelui, Halleluijah Amen.
Ka Lal thawkna ka ngaitua in,
Ka lona gual ei puai;
A mai a betna teu leh a vawknau liam chu,
Ka ngaitua ni hin chu ka la'n ka awi.
A na taluai ei tatna chu, (2)
Khawvel Hukdampa chu a luang a chiapi tau;
I Lal nunnem a hi genthei maleh.
Judate chun thiam chang lo in,
Hun guat ta maleu le;
Ke’n vang ka hun ngainai,
Ka Lal nunnem la hi;
Kei haw gitlo ziak in van vawm la chang.
Lei lal thi bawn mi’n a sun ui,
Van Lal thi a sun puau;
Thina’n naubang a awi,
I Lal lungsiat um pa,
Than sung in a zal tau, mi muda in.
A thokit tai i Lalpau chu,
Chawlna gam zuan ding in;
Olive tang chung ah,
Sum in a puito ah,
Chawlna gam a zuan tai i Lalpau chun.
Chawlna gam la zawt ziak in maw,
Khawvel a ngui zo tai;
Hung kile kit mai tan,
Khawvel daum ah hin,
Ei tatna thu gen in tanglam hitiu.
Ka henkawl bul leh hen thikkawl,
Ziak in maw Hukdampa;
Linglukhuk tawh Salem dai ah,
Thisan kai zung zung a pui in;
Thimlal nuaisia ding in,
Thina gin um thuak in a thisak tau.
Aw van Lal ahi, genthei zosia thuakchu,
Israel leh zia khawvel ah;
Vaihawmtute hin he leu chu,
Lopina Lalpa chu;
Thing Khros chung ah kua ahem khenden ding?
Mi thafam chu sausuan sung ah,
Zatam in a awi ui;
Van Lal vang genthei, liangvai in,
Tualthatte kal chun tha a fam;
Kalvari tang chung ah,
A dogalte’n tanglam in a awi ui.
Aw chung van gial, hung so tan la,
Van Lal Cha sun ding in;
Khawtang ngui in ka la lem in,
Tuisuagiat luanthi bang luang leh;
Simlei hung ling tahen,
Van Lal tuai dawng in tha a fam ni hin.
Gitlo kulpi thina khuk thim,
Zo in a tho kit tai;
Thina ziak ah liangvaite chun,
Hinna thak pakbang a lawp ui;
Ginum Tanpa zal in,
Hinna khawpi gam hawi a lua tau e.
Van in tuipi gal ah,
Aw gamla tak ah mang hawl ding in;
Gilo sik ah thi ding in,
Van Lal Cha ngei a hun sawl ui;
Aw mi dang a thei a um puau maw.
Aw kipak tan ka tha nang liangvai,
La manthaina thuk maleh;
Paradise in a hun tun tai,
Aw gamla taka hun hawlpa khan.
Ka sik in a thi hen,
Aw vawkna thawk guallo a thuak hi;
Mi gilo gual ah ngai in,
Mifel a la thawk sak tau a;
Aw a thina chun kei ka hing tai.
Mi lungngai gen le hing,
Aw Jesu kheltha thei a um diam?
Aw hepina ziak bep in,
Khawsa thisan gual ah va hi;
Aw sim leh mal ah hawl vel tiam un.
Thisan go thisan go,
Aw Van Lal Cha ngei thisan go chu;
Sual leh dogal te kal ah,
Hinna khawpi a din ta ei,
Aw Van a chun a thansua ta e.
Kanan phaizawl Sharon pak hawi,
Malai Rom mite’n a thiak uh kha;
Khawtang a ngui hi Sharon a thiak nau chun,
Nu naute liangvai liakhu di nei lo in;
A damnau Sharon pak a thiak ziak un.
Sharon pak hawi a thiak uh kha,
Ama la lungkhamte kiang ah chun;
Lili’n a hung pak a lunggil thim sung un;
A lu chung zawn un Zingsawl in a hung vak,
A vel un kipakna gimtui a zam.
Sharon pak la hawizo nai puai,
Khawvel gamthim ka lennau ah hin;
Sumpi a zing hi la pak hawi lia ding in,
Ni bang hung vak in la mel hung kilang hen,
Zia chun la hawi dan hi hun he ta’n au.
Kanan phaizawl, Sharon pak hawi,
Judai gam ah hung no thak kit in;
Zalen a nuam tau thilsiam zosiate hin,
Ngai in a thil ui lei mi liangvai te hin,
Israel chate’n le la lawp ta’n au.
Sharon pak hawi mu ka nuam ui,
Van lopi ah la hung pak ding chu;
Kilepna thing ah a thiaknau mun ah chun,
La tha hun zak in Zalenna lopi di’n,
Sa leh mihiam kidona hai ta’n a.
Sual kidona'n Van Lal Chapa chun,
Ling lukhuk a khuk ding chu a thil-a;
Lungngai thuak a apauchap khan,
Khawsa thisan guala luang in;
Gethsemani a,
Nung ka le'n a pui Israel te'n.
A lung awi puau, (2V)
Israel te a lung awi puau,
A chung ah suan lam a siam ua;
Mipi'n a dawn ui,
Pilat in a piai khetden ding in.
Israelte'n a Lal a dawi puau,
Kalvari tang chunga a khenden ua;
A chun liangthei nu Mari  chun,
A pak lunlai a thiak u chun;
A lai anai a tiu,
Lalna gam taisan i Lalpau chu.
Zia ni lungngai um thimnuai a chun,
I Lal nunnem thagau a chia ni khan;
Jerusalem Temple sunga,
Puanzak lopi a hung ki thek;
Sim lei hung ling-in,
Mithiangthote thagau a tho tau.
A hun tai sual kidona hai-un,
Khawvel gam hi Lalpa leh Khrista gam;
Gitlo dogal nuaisia Lal-in,
A thisan in a tan zo tai;
Kalvari tanga,
Zia chun kilemna'n Lal mel a tuai.
Kawlva gual in len thiam hileng aw,
Ka Lal thina tang va fang ka tin;
Zia chun ka kitatna va mung ka,
A mel ah thisan kai ning neng chu,
Hepina puan nem in va thiak ka.
Aw Kalvari, aw Kalvari,
La chung ah la Lal kikhai kang kha;
Tho inla a kilna la than la,
A thisan va kha va thiak hul in.
Aw Kidron lui nang le tho inla,
La Lalpa dangchak va dawn sak in;
Zu thuk in a dangchak hai puan ah,
Chian la a muk thiangtho nuai ah sawn;
Dam dii diai in va luan piak in aw.
Kei ei ngai ah dangchak hileh chu,
Kidron tiin ei hun ko ta'n tin;
Tuan ah tang khan va dawn sak tang ka,
Nang hun ngai ah dangchak ahi e;
Chian la thagau tui chu va tul in.
Va chia leng le bang ka va law diam,
I Lalpa dangchak hi hai ding in;
Theina bangma lah ka nei pua hen,
Chia chu chiang katin Kalvari ah;
A thisan va bek va thiak ingka.
Kalvari leh aw Jerusalem,
Ka Lal nunnem hi ei ka pi un;
I gitlo ziak ah liam chang a hi,
Thodawk unla ka la lem hitiu,
Van Belamno tha a fam ni hin.
Ginna’n Kalvari tang chung ah chun,
Gam ngai um leh khaw thiangtho a lang hi;
Mi thiangthote lenna,
Zia khawpi hawi ka tun phat chuleh;
Damsung lungngai leh gimum hin,
Ei chum phak ta puan a.
Ei chum phak puana ti ka hiat in,
Halleluijah tiin Lalpa ka pak;
Ei hung tatdaw ziak in
Gitlo gikpua thiamlo chang ta nung;
Thisan ziak in thiam ei chan sak,
Gamhawi ah leng ding in.
Gam hawi nuam ah ka len phat chu leh,
Khawvel daum hi zuk thil sek ka tin;
Ka vakvai na gam hi,
Zia chun ka mitthi luangta puan a;
Ka Lalpa’n ei umpi intin,
Nunglam ngai nawt puang ka.
Lalpa ngai ah ka hamna gam hi,
Ka thagau in a nutsia zaw phat leh;
Lalpa’n ei pui in tin,
A thazak chung ah ei chuan sak in;
Jordan tui kinawk lau um chu;
Ei len kaipi in ah.

songs.title: Kalvari Tang Chung Ah I  Lalpa

lines: Kalvari tang chung ah i  Lalpa,
Khros chung ah ling lukhuk tawh;
Mipite nuisan ding leh,
Thi ding in a khenden tau.
Aw a thuak gim ngei i Lalpa a bawlnau saw,
A khut a keng a lu en in;
I gitlona ziak in a thisan thiangtho a luang tai,
Lum na ngawi ngawi pa saw.
A thi kuan ah dangchak in a thum,
Dawn ding pe nuam lah umlo;
Melma sim senlo lak sawn,
Dangchak ngawi ngawi in a thii.
"Ka dang a chak" tia a kiko khan,
Zu thuk a han dawn sak ua;
Zu thuk chun subei puana,
Thagau ngai ah chak a hi.
Ka thagau la kitatna nat dan,
Kei chun ka hun hil thei puai;
Chia'n la Kalvari tang ah,
I Lalpa saw dawng mai zaw'n.
Kalvari tang ka ngai,
Ka Hukdampa thina;
Lugu mun himaleh,
Ken vang ka ngaina e;
Ka Lalpa thina mun chu.
Khawvel gitlo ngakna,
Ka Lalpa chung a hi;
Himaleh le Lalpa'n,
Kalvari tang chung in,
Thisan in a ngaidam tai.
A thisan kai nuai ah,
Mari'n ka la a awi;
Aw ka thagau nang le,
Thisan kai nuai ah chun;
Va chian la va kisil in.
Ka thagau ei tatna,
Natdan saw va en tia;
I Lalpa'n a ko hi,
"Ka dang a chak" atii;
Chian la tui va dawn sak in.
Hung nai in Kalvari,
Ka Lalpa thina mun;
Ka ngai a tawp thei puai,
Hung nai in Kalvari;
Ka lungawi theina ding in.
Ka limna pak a chul zotai,
Ka ngai cheng thina'n a pui ta e;
A sulnung khawtang ngui a hin,
Kap in kei ka vakvai hi,
A chiana diu chu ka ngil thei paw e.
Ka ko leh nunglam ei ngat ui,
A aw giu chun mual a khum ta e;
Immanuel gam a zuan ui,
Khawvak gam hawi nuam a chun,
Nunglam ngai nawtlo in a lengzo tau.
Khawvel hin lah ei dawn theilo,
A chung in nisin naubang ka kap;
Salem thak ka Lal khawpi leh,
Lungdawi cheng ka mu masia'n,
Ka kalai sawlbang bang thei mai pua'ng ka.
Ka ma ah Jordan lui a lian,
Lei mi thiam lawng in a kai thei puau;
Thim nuai hin kap in ka ngak hi,
Lal Jesu nang hung nai in,
Van lawng ah Jordan kai ka nuam ta e.
Limna zing aksi Lalpa.
Damna Suangpi Lal Jesu;
Entia mihiam chate hi,
Khawvel kipakna hawl in;
Manthaina lam a zuan ui,
A ma un nang hung ding in.
La mel ah kipakna kim,
Nang ngei nei a muanna chu;
Mitinte hin a la hethiam leu chu,
Kua hem sual nawpna hawl ding,
A manthaina ding bep un.
Thina gu a nat mi gen,
Gitlo gal a hat mi gen;
Himaleh ka Lal Jesu’n,
Liangvai cha ei hawl ziak in;
Linglukhuk leh than thim sung,
Kalvari’n a nuaisia tai.
A thuk dan leh a san dan,
A sau dan a let dan chu;
Lei leh van ah thil zosia,
Gi hawi leh pau tincheng in;
La hepina lopi hi,
Kipak in puangzak tau hen.
Ka lunggil Temple sung ah,
Mun sang pen hi chang lechin;
Chungnung pen ah lopina,
Chungnung pen ah kipakna,
Kei haw a hung hi tan ah,
Zia chun nang ngei chu la hi.
Ka thagau lungngai nawt kin,
La Lalpa'n a hun mu tai;
Lungngaih leh gim um thuak a,
Kap leh ham ah la um hin;
Lei ah leh van chung ah khin,
Hepi'n a hun en zing hi.
Ngaitia Kalvari ah la lungngaih ni khan,
Melma sim senlote a pungkhawm ui;
Kua hem la lungngaihna nem ding?
Van sum ten nangma a bawm ui;
Kalvari a hun liau.
Amen Amen Halleluijah Amen,
Lei leh van ten Amen lem leu;
Tuisuagiat leh khawvel zosia'n,
Hallelui nawn tau hen.
Ngaitia thina nuaisia in a tho kit tai,
Thina sun ah khawpi lim ngailo kha;
Kalvari pak lawp in a leng,
Thawkna sun in zawna a lawm;
Buaina a um nawt puai.
Thina luigal ah aw Salem khawpi chu,
Lalna gam pakcha hawi in a bawm hi;
Zia chun van phaiphuleng lem in,
Zotu Lalpa a chawihawi ui;
Pakna a dai ngai puai.
Ama chu a kiang un a um a,
Amau chule a mite hi ta’nau;
Pathian ngei chun umpi intin,
A mitthi teu chu le la thiak hul ta’na.
Dangchak tapo te kiang in,
Kumkhawtuang hinna tui;
A thawn in la piang ka,
Aw thagau dangchakte chun,
Va dawn tau hen.
Thina  um kik thei nawt ta puan ti’n,
Lungngainate ka leh natnate haw;
Le um kik thei nawt ta puana,
Thil masate zosia kha a bei tau e.
Ngaitia, thil bangkim ka siam thak hi,
