Mipil te'n a hethiam puau,
Kua ziak a dangchak a hem?
Van Kanan ka in nuam,
Khawvel ka khualzinna;
Aigupta a hak taluai,
Ka Lal Jesu ei pui in.

songs.title: A Hun A Chawm Taluai Siatlei

lines: A hun a chawm taluai siatlei ah i limlai niu,
Pakbang a lunlai ni a chulzo tai;
Gibang khenna'n lenkawl ni a suakkit ta e.
Dam tak in unau ngaiumte kikhen mai tai tiu,
I chennau mun zuan in Thagau in ei pui hen;
Lal Jesu'n ei veng zing tahen kumtuang in,
Hing leh dam ah kimu khawm kit ding in.
Hansedawl leisiat ah hin limna a kim thei puai,
Kikhen tai tiu Lal na sem chiat ding in;
Ginna'n Kalvari ah kimu khawm kit nai tiu.
Ki ngaih ziak ah kitho thei lah ihi puau a,
Hun beisa lah ko kit thei ei ta puai;
Kikhenlona khawpi Salem thak i ngai ngei.
Kap ah gibang khenna siatlei gam himaleh le,
Lalpa ni lopi a hung tun phat leh;
Lungngaihna limna chang in naubang nui nai tiu.
Ka khawvel in kiphel tha maleh,
Khawpi hawi leh nuam tak ken ka nei nai;
I Lalpan a siam Zion chate lenna,
Ka kumtuang in ding chu.
Zion chate zalenna ni ding chu anai tai,
La pang na diam aw unau?
Lavaigei leh kumtuang kawt kihawn huam puan la,
La damlai ni Lalpa a din mang in.
Lei lung ngainan hun pui mang khana,
Damsung hun hin ngainat ding atam hi;
I hinnau pakcha hungpak tawbang bep hin,
Lalpa na sem hitiu.
Nitum kuan vai chia phat ahi tai,
Angel leh mithiangtho chia masaten;
Kuangpi leh tingtang lem in ei ngak zing ui,
Van khawpi kituak din.
Lalpa Khrista Lalna gam a chun,
Hausa leh chaga genthei um talo;
Tunkal ka ngaklai Zion chate lenna,
Ka kumtuang in ding chu.
Aw Hukdampa gitlo lungzinna kal ah hin,
Thagau in ei pui inla;
La thisan ah la tatsate sual ah puk in,
Kipakna lui luang lai a chawl hi.
Nawpna luipi luang ta hen,
Khawvel daum ah hin;
Van Lal Cha kei ei Tanpa,
Ka ma hin pak bang hung lun zing in.
Thildang sang in la hawi diak hi ei Hukdampa,
La khutsuak pak ka lawp ui;
Thilsiam sang in la hawi diak hi ei Hukdampa,
La hepina mel ka gen thei puau.
Lei hi Lalpa la thilthawnpiak masa a hi,
Ka simseng puau lei nawpna;
Van mun lopi la malzawlna bukim a hi,
Kalvari tang ah kei lei hun piai.
Dogal a lian khawvel ah hin,
Setan gal chu nisin in a hung lian deu deu;
La Thagau ah lei thuam lo chun,
La min hawi hi Lalpa hun suang ngamlo ka hi.
Malai sawlchakte la thuam gual khan,
La Thagau in ei thuam inla;
Ginna’n la mel hawi ei musak in,
Lim in la min chawihawi ing ka.
Kalvari tang ah Lalpa chun,
Ka gitlo man chu puan daum zosia a thuak;
A lungngaih hiatmil guallo chu,
Sual ziak in aw ei hawn i la hemil zo tau.
Ei ngaidam in aw Lal Jesu,
Kei ding ah la thawknate hun hemil maleng;
Nang longal laina ka nei puai,
Ka ngai ma mai Lalpa la mel ei musak in.
La gam siamlian dingin Lalpa,
La tatsa sual ah tang zosia pui kit ding in;
Dogal lian khuam bang do ding in,
Ka zam ngen sek Immanuel nang ei pui in.
Gam lopi tun ka ngakla tai,
Hung nai in Lal Immanuel;
Ka lautha thangvan sang ah khin,
Nuamsa’n hang leng tan ah.
Aw nang ka lenna gam lungmawl,
La tang chung ah genthei cha albang ka vai ui;
Aw nang gam lopi Lalna pak hawi in a bawm hi,
Nang bep hi la hi ka gam ngaih uh chu.
Ka lautha lei genthei ah hin,
Pak gual in chul tadi maleh;
Nawpna gam thiangtho tun phet leh,
Tuai ni umta puan ah.
Lei pakcha lim lai ni a tuai,
Nungtiang hinkhua ngaih a na ngei;
Lung dang ka nei puai, khawvel ah,
Genthei, naubang ka kap.
Jesu nang in ei hung pui in,
La hepina tuipi ah chun;
Zion khaw gi leh gam thiangtho,
Mu ka nuam ngei Lalpa.

songs.title: Aw Kalvari Tang Saw Ka Han

lines: Aw Kalvari tang saw ka han thil a,
Ka Hukdampa thawkna tang saw;
Mi gensim tang, tang thavai um ah sawn,
Ka thawk sik in a thuak.
Ka kipak ngei Lalpa, ka kipak ngei,
Zia gual lawm ah hepina mak;
Ka gen thiam puai la phatna zosia hi,
Hun pak chim thei pua'ng ka.
Zia gual lawm lawm a hepina mak hi,
Sual tuipi ah tum tanung kha;
Hepina ah lei hung puidaw kik hi,
Nang bep hun zui tang ka.
La thisan in a hawng zalenna gam,
Zia mun chu ei puitung ding in;
La thagau a lei hun thuam kit ahin,
Ka lung a awi ngei e.
Gen chim thei puang ka e la hepina,
Khawvel lopina genlo in;
La hepina thu bep gen tang ka e,
Lalpa ei panpi in.
Hallelujah Amen, Halleluijah.
Amen, Amen, Halleluijah,
Lalpa malzawlna tincheng ei petu,
La min lopi ta hen,

songs.title: Ginnan Ka Han Thil Leh Chung

lines: Ginnan ka han thil leh chung thang
Van khua chu a lang;
Lalpa’n a guat Salem thak ah khin,
Martar leh Angel vamte khi tawh;
Lalchutpha ah khin ei la ngak ui.
Khenlona mun ah ei ngak ui,
Hepi tatsate kimna ah;
Lungngaih genthei thuak ah ham te le,
“Zia chun chawl ta’nau” Lalpa’n a tii.
Kap in gibang khen male hin,
Aw lengual dawite;
Gensim khawpi ngunkhamtual nuam ah,
Khenna thimthu lel a um nawt puau,
Khenlona kawlni la suak tan ah.
Aw khawvel lungngaihna zosia,
A manthai phet leh;
Belamno leh Lalchutpha vam chu,
A mithiangtho te tawh kumtuang in;
Zingsawl Aksi gual in vak ta’nau.
Bangtik hem hukdampa, kumtuang
Mun chu lei tun ding;
Lungngai thimthu lel um talo ah,
Lungngai genthei thuak ah liamsate;
Limna thazak ah lenkhawm phat ding.
Hukdamna dawngkawt a kihawng,
Kalvari tang ah
Lungngai liangvai mun neilote,
Lim ah laitual lenna ding in;
A siamzo tai Van Lal in khi.
Ka hun zuan hi aw ka Lalpa,
La mun siam chu;
Sualna dogal lian maleh le,
Ei kaibat in aw Hukdampa.
Ka thagau Hukdampa thina,
Kalvari tang ah
Sun leh zanin va leng inla,
Zia chun la chenna ding gam nuam;
Thilin la lungngaih lai nem na.
Thil lui zosia mual ah liam in,
A thak kik zo tai
Sual ah pukte hung tho ta un,
Chenna gam nuam a siam ta e;
Nuam ah len dial dial na ding chu.
Immanuel lei leh van thak,
Khawpi nuamah chun
Aw bangtik ahem ka tun di?
Ka ngai ngei aw kumtuang mun nuam,
Lengual ngaih cheng kimna ding chu.

songs.title: Ka Gam Lui Ding Ka Chenna

lines: Ka gam lui ding ka chenna hi,
Aw bangtik leh ka pawtsan diam?
Angel vam haw leh ka Lal mel chu,
Mu kal ka ngaklai.
Aw Jerusalem dai,
Ka Lalpa'n thavai in a ngak;
Hansedawl thing ah a thawk sak ui,
A linglukhuk tawh.
La thawk dan ka gen thiam thei puai,
Sual thawina'n van Lal belamno;
La hung piang mun genthei Bethlehem,
Bawng in tawm sung ah.
Lal Jesu ka thilchim thei puai,
Kalvari lam thil zing ing ka;
Khawvel sual ziak a la lungngaihna,
Ngil gual ahi puai.
Guatsa Lal Immanuel,
Adam suan gitlo ziakin;
Van lopi ngunkhamtual hun nusia’n,
Judai gam Bethlehem a;
Mun a um puai Lal pian na’n,
Bethlehem ah gankuang a chang tai.
Lawm in pak hitiu e ei Tanpa hung piang chu,
Halleluijah ti in pak hi tiu;
Lei chung a cham leng hen nam zosiate kiang a,
Ei a'n damna a hung tun ta e.
Khawvel min a khum lai un,
Belampu te kiang a chun;
Van lopina a hung kilak a,
"Lau ki un la ngai tiamun,
Chanchinpha ka hun tun hi;
Hukdampa a piang ta e" tiin.
Ngailo la hem Hukdampa,
La van khawpi tualnuam chu;
Bang ding ah gankuang ah hung lum mai?
"Kangai e ka van khawpi;
Maleh la gitlo ziak in,
Lei thim ah vakvai ka hii” a tii.
Khawvel lal tam tak pianna,
In lopi insang minthang;
Entia van Lal pianna bawng in saw,
Aw ka tha la Lal a hi;
Chian la hawl tia gankuang a,
"A chun liang Mari’n apai a tiu.

songs.title: Ka Gitlo Ziak In Van Lal

lines: Ka gitlo ziak in Van Lal Cha Thiangtho,
Lei ah a hung a;
Khawvel nam zosia min a ziak lai un,
Bethlehem bawng in sung ah a sial ui;
Ka damna ding in (2)
Namtin a ding in Hukdampa nausen-
In a hung piang tai;
Van mipite chun la a hun lem ui,
“Chungnung pen ah Pathian lopi tahen;”
Tiin a hun sau. (2)
Aw a min Maka Lemguattu Lalpa,
Lem Lal a hung hii;
Chamna thu leng hen khawvel chung ah hin,
Sak lam mipilte’n le a hun zui ui;
A gam tawp puan a. (2)
Khawvel Aigupta gam ah hin,
Damsung hun nuam ah mang ding in;
Kipak leh muanna ka hawl leh,
Lungngaih leh kana mun bep a la hi.
Aw ka pianna gam hin a zil ta puai,
Kipakna, muanna hawl maleng;
Mu thei puang ka a mun ei puai,
Lal Khrista gam a hilo ziak in.
Gam mangthai ding ah lengte hi,
Tatna thisan lopi tak chun;
Van hin i chan theina ding un,
Namtin chitinte di'n kawt a hawng tai.
Aw la gam ah leng thei ding in,
Lalpa la hatna'n ei pui in;
Khawvel kipakna bei zing hi,
Ngai in thil nawt puangka gallian a hi.
Hepina Lalgam zawtna chu,
Aw ka thagau hawl vel inla;
Khawvel hawina'n tho maleh le,
Nunghei kin Lal nunnem kona zuan zawn.

songs.title: Kum Kihei In Hun Leh Ni

lines: (Awkai: number 393 na gual in)
Kum kihei in hun leh ni a hung thak tai,
Lungthim thak tawh hun pha mang hitiu;
Hal tak in hung’un hun leh phat Siamtu hi,
Kipak in chawihawi in A pakla sai tiu.
Chawihawi hitiu vaihawmtu Pathian chu,
A hepina hi la'n chawi hitiu;
Hun leh kum kipak ah mang di’n ei siam hi,
Kumtuang in Lalpa chun lopina chang hen.
Kum lui ah i hun chiasate hemil in,
Tuhin hinna thak ah hing ding in;
I lungngaihna kipakna hung chang ta hen,
Kum thak a Pa Pathian chawihawi zing thei di’n.
Kipak thu gen in i sepga hun chawi in,
Pak hitiu mal zawl tu Pathian chu;
I kipakthu gen Lal pa ang ah tung hen,
I thiamlonau zosia ei ngaidam ta hen.
Kum lui hi kipak in tha’n kum thak zawm in,
Nisin, kum sin ah masawn zing in;
Pa Pathian malzawlna hi dawng zing dingin,
A phatna la'n chawi in a na sem hitiu.

songs.title: Kaplo Thei Ka Hi Puai Aw

lines: Kaplo thei ka hi puai aw ka lungdawite kha,
Lei gentheina mun hi nusia zo in;
Pialgal thangvan sang a kaizo tau a,
Nunghei lo in a chiau.
Ka kap khawvel genthei ah hin,
Siatlei nunlui thimthu lel chang ni hin,
Nunlui mual liamsa ngaih a nai,
Lungngai a khawk,
Siatlei hin sung ah hin.
Tha ka vai ka lungdawite lah nunghei talo,
Ka kana'n khua a sawt taluai Lalpa;
Angelte melpu a lennau gam chu,
Mu ka nuam hi Lalpa.
Zion limtha a bel ui hepi chiasate'n,
Galmuanna tang chung in a lengkhawm ui;
Ka ngakla ngei zia gam lopi mun ah,
Kei le len phat ding chu.
Lei a taksa chawpna ding in,
Chuk leh khal ah na i sep zing a ngai;
A lul zaw thagau chawpna ding ahin,
Lal na sep hi a ngai.
Van Lal na hi,
Hun leh hunlo genlo ah sep ding a hi;
Van hepina,
Kalvari ah hung lang khan ei hil a hi.
Pulpit ah thupha i gen a,
Biakin sung hin thu zawm male hin le;
Mun dang ah zuau thu gen ah i um chun,
Lal na sem hi di hem?
Bible thu thuk takte gen in,
Thiam kisa'n midangte chu dem lehin;
Lal Khrista kingaitawmna zillo in,
Lal na sem hi di hem?
Khrista chanchin pha chu gen in,
Biakin leh mundang ah le pauchap in;
Thutak kingakna ban in um le hing,
Lal na sep chu a hi.
Zan thavai um tak akhan i Lal Jesu chun,
A taksa a hawma A thisan le a hawm;
"Lei hiatzingna dingun zia hi la un" a tii,
Lungngaih mitthi pum in.
Bukna a han siam ua Zion kulpi sung a,
Tinglo ah ngai ham ham gua'n;
Vai pha'n a hawm nuam puau e,
I Lalpau chung ah chun.
Huan lam zuan in achiau dogal chu tuak ding in,
A lawite lungngai in a la vuangzo tau a;
Lalchu ama ngawn in zankhuan a pauchap a,
Lungngaih mitthi pum in.
Rome sepaite sawn lah lungsiatna neilo in,
En tiam un kawt zing ah thisan kai net nut in;
Khawdung leh khawvai ah nung kale'n a pui ua,
I Lal liangvai pa saw.
A hun tawk a lel puau en tiam un Lalpa saw,
Khraws chu a putsak ui Ama thina ding chu;
Kalvari tang lam sawn mipite'n a sawm ui,
Etngam gual a hi puai.
Tang chu a tung tau ah a khai ui thing lek ah,
A nuai ah mipite'n engbawl in a thil ui;
Tui a dawnsak uh chun a lu a hung khun a,
A thagau a tha tai.
Zawlnei genlawk gual in Lal Khrista chu,
A piang Bethlehem ah;
Pak hitiu e khawvel nam tinte hin,
Lalpen Immanuel chu.
Van mipite'n Bethlehem tang chung ah,
A hun thau Lalpa chu;
Chung nung pen ah lopi ta hen,
Lei ah lem leng hen a tiu.
Belampute'n belam a chinlai un,
Lal sawlchak lopi chun;
Bethlehem ah Hukdampa a piang tai,
Chian la va en un a tii.
Van ah Aksi vak lopi tak mai chun,
Saklam mipilte chu;
A pui pek a Bethlehem tang tiang in,
Chun a gobawm a hawng tau.
Zawlneite la genlawk Lal Messia kha,
Kaisar ni lopi ah a hung tung tai,
Lal thak kipak um chu pak un, pak un (2)
Aw Angel vam leh Belampute,
Saklam ah kipan mipilte;
Chung aksi le mi thiangthote'n,
Lim tak in Lal thak pian thu ei hil ui.
Lal leh milian gual in a piang dang em,
Bethlehem bawng in tawm ah a piang hi;
A min Mak a Lal chu pak un, pak un (2)
Van Angelte'n la hawi in a hun thau,
"Lei mite lak a cham leng hen" tiin;
Khrista chamna Lal chu pak un, pak un (2)
Hukdamna dak Lal Jubili aw chun,
Lei leh van zosia a thawngvel tai;
Lal Immanuel chu pak un, pak un (2)

songs.title: Lei kisiem ma chun ‘Thu’ chuh a um,

lines: Joh. 1:1
Doh is D Tune : S.S. 873-T.S. 1
Lei kisiem ma chun ‘Thu’ chuh a um,
Pa Pathien tawh kumkhuo’n a kizawm;
Bangkim abawnin Ama’n A siem,
A siem loh a um puoi khawvel ah.
Zie thusim achun ka deihpen chuh,
‘Thu’ chuh taksa a pieng in a um;
A lop zie mupa’n a zik hi,
‘Lungsiet leh Thutak in a dim hi.
Thildang ahi puoi ‘Thu’ kiti hi,
Krista Isu Amah ngei ahi;
Mihing lungthim sung thu’n apawt hi,
Pathien lungthim alang - Krista ah.
Pathien thiemgaute’n thu a gen ui,
Angelte’n le a kihetsak sek;
A sawl nunungpen pakchawih hitiu,
Pathien-Mihing-A Chapa ngei chuh.

Inpi luna buol zatam

Thup. 4:8
Doh is E8 S.S. 22-T.S. 3
Thiengtho, Thiengtho, Thiengtho!
Pathien Bangkim bawlthei!
Zingkal matakin ka pahchak lau hungto ina,
Thiengtho, Thiengtho, Thiengtho!
Hehpih leh Thilbawlthei!
Pathien-a Mi Thum, Pumkhat a um chuh!
Thiengtho, Thiengtho, Thiengtho!
Mithiengte’n a hun pak;
Lalchutphah ma a khun in sana lukhuk kawihtha’n;
Cherub leh Seraph-te Na ma ah a khun ui,
Umsa, umzing leh hungum ding Lalpa.
Thiengtho, Thiengtho, Thiengtho!
Thimna’n hun lieh mahleh;
Gilote mit in Na lopina mu kimah leu,
Nang mai Thiengtho Na hi, Nang lo adang umlo,
Hatna, hehpih leh thienthona akim.
Thiengtho, Thiengtho, Thiengtho!
Pathien Bangkim bawlthei;
Na siemte’n Na min lei van leh Tuipi-a pak ding,
Thiengtho, Thiengtho, Thiengtho!
Hehpih leh Thilbawlthei!
Pathien-a Mi Thum, Pumkhat-a um chu!
Patea
Lal lung bukimna, kipah ni.
Tuhin I tung kit tau;
Va chieh leu hing Bethlehem daikieng ah.
Van mi zaila sakna.
Aw, nang Bethlehem, ka hun ngaina zen e!
Na tang chunga Puipa Aksi vak chu;
Kap in hun hawl pek ding ka hi,
Ka Lal pienna lei mun siepen chu.
Ngailo a um dem zie mun chu,
Ka Lal sieng A lawihna;
Kaisar lallai nitum kawl eng nuoiah,
Ka Lal naubang kap ie.
Vak en tiem u, Angeltehaw
Na lawppau Lal Isu;
A hung tungtai gimthei chate nawpna,
Pakbang chawian hitiu.

songs.title: Zing in chungleng va’n Pathien a pak ui

lines: Doh is F Tune : S.S. 879
Zing in chungleng va’n Pathien a pak ui,
Pakcha’n le A lopina chuh a phuong ui;
A thilsiem in Amah a chawian ui,
Mihing mai lo chuh sinsak ngai a um puou.
Lei leh van mi’n le chawian hitiu,
Amauhaw sangin I chingzawu hi;
Khawvel chengcheng in sa khawm leule,
Amah chawihatna la sa seng puo’n au.
Nicheng in Na phatna ka mu zing ui,
Sun leh zan, phalbi leh chuklai a um sek;
Hun a thak bangin kipahna I nei,
Kumsawt in Angelte tawh zaila sa’i tiu.
Hetna leh chitna leh thilhih theihna’n,
Mihing chengcheng in Amah pakcha khawm in;
Ei dinga A bawl cheng I gen seng puou,
Kumsawt in A lungsietna gen seng puoi tiu.

songs.title: Aw Pathien! Nang Lalpen na hi

lines: Doh is A Welsh Tune Book
Aw Pathien! Nang Lalpen na hi,
Ka lungthim uh na en;
Bangkim ka gel leh ngaihtuoh hi,
Na hetloh a um puo’i.
Keinei venna’n sun leh zan in,
Mitzung Na tuoh ngei puoi;
Ngaihtuohna thieng ei siemsak in,
Lalpa Isu ziek in.
Na thu thu-a um ka nuom hi,
Na thu hinna ahi;
Zeziekchun ei hun hezing in,
Nangmah mite ka hiu.

songs.title: Nang thu hi hen, Pa! Nang thu hi hen!

lines: Isai 2:3
Doh is F II Alexander 146. - T.S. 5
Nang thu hi hen, Pa! Nang thu hi hen!
Nang Beldangpa; kei atung ka hi;
Na deihbang bang in ei deng inla,
Hun ngak a, kipie’n ka umzing hi.
Nang thu hi hen, Pa! Nang thu hi hen!
Lalpa, tuhin ei enchien inla;
Vuk sanga vamzaw’n tu’n ei sil in,
Na ma a bawk a, ka khun lai hin.
Nang thu hi hen, Pa! Nang thu hi hen!
Liem leh chau in na panpih ka ngen!
Thil hihtheihna cheng Nanga ahi!
Lalpa, ei khawih in, ei hihdam in!
Nang thu hi hen, Pa! Nang thu hi hen!
Ka hatlohna cheng la mang inla;
Na Thagau in ei hihdim inla,
Krista kei a hing zing mi’n muu hen!
By Kamlala
Hinna lenthang kawlni a eng,
Muikhuo thim bang zing ta puona;
Nuoizin sau neu haibang A ngak,
A min chu Lal Immanuel.
A chungnung, A chungnung,
Chungnungpen Lal Minlun;
Zinsau ah kumsawtin,
Chamna tuibang luong ta hen.
A mel tui bangin tawm mahleh,
Sietlei leh thangvana Lalpen;
Nuoi zinmang chan do mahleu le,
Lawibang thanga, vaihawm zing ding.
Sim leh Mala namtin vawnchawih,
Jang semguo leh zaila’n awiin;
“Chungnungpena Lalmang Minlun,”
Ti’n Angel zai awihpih hitiu.
A dahna leh A Lalna um,
Lei Bethlehem leh thangvanah;
Lunggukin paibang kuoh leu hing,
Go thildang him ngai ta puona.
Patea
Lau kiu inla, ngai zaw tiem u mi cheng adi’n,
Chanchin pha kipahum mah mah ka hun tun hi;
Tunin nangu din David khuo ah Hukdampa a pieng,
Lal Krista chu na tiemteh na’ng un’
Gan kuong achun mun lau.
Ka Lal zanchamna mun aw ka ngai na lawm lawm e,
Belampu zuia chieh ka nuom Bethlehem tang chunga
Nausen puona tuom chu aw, dawngin eihilh theileh,
A siem Zion khawpi tuolnuom chu,
Ngailo thei puona.
Maa kipahna pak gimlim a tuoi zo tai,
Mahleh ka Lalpa’n Zion pak hawih ei pe tai;
Gamgaw gam hinle la sau hen “Hossana” tiin,
Khawvel gam cheng chunga kipahna,
Chamna thu leng viel hen.
Tang leh muol, pak tin kipak un van Hossana,
Thiemgau gen bangin Zion dawngkawt a hun hawng;
Van khawpi dingin lungkhamna leh luonthi nulna,
Mahleh ei din phaicham zingtinpak,
Hawih a hung lun kit tai.
Eden tuol ahung hawih kit tai, gal a bei tai,
Kipahna gimlim leh van la hawih a leng viel;
Kipak takin chawian hitiu I Lal liengvai hi,
Ei hehpih bek ziekin eihaw din,
Vankhaw lunlai a chan.

songs.title: Jakob Guol pha leh a Lei sang kha

lines: Zawmpau - T.S. 301
Jakob Guol pha leh a Lei sang kha,
Ka Pathien, ka Bangkim Nang na hi;
Thihna luipi kinawk chung ahin,
Aw, van Lei pha, hung kidawh kit in!
Hung kidawh in, Jordan lui achun,
Thavai lo a ka hung lem kaih na’n;
Aw, van Zingsawl ei hung pui in la,
Thihna luipi lien chung ahin.
Lalpa, van lei a Na kidawh leh,
Na cha gal lau a vakvaite hi;
Muong leh dam in Na van Kanaan chu,
Hung lem kai thei phet ding ka hiu hi.
Ginna Lei, Pielgal kaihna lo chuh,
Lei dang bangmah a um hielpuoi maw!
Zeziek chun aw, Palai Lal Krista,
Gin chawmte lung leh van lei zawm ta’n.
Patea
Lal pien hun pakcha a lun kit tai,
Suihlung ip nung lunghel a kaitho hi;
Van nuoi mi gen Bethlehem tang chung ah,
Ginna thân mi a leng kai ui.
Aw ka Lal nunnem naubang ei pui zelin,
Na chun leh zuo kalah senlai naubang na kahna
Mun tuol ka ngai.
Mubang ka ngai Bethlehem tangpi.
Sunni muolliem din a salhvak singseng;
Bawng In tawma ka Lal gen liengthei chu,
A chun lieng Mari’n a pawm hi.
Bethlehem Aksi a vak kit tai.
Eden than thim dawngkawt a hun salhvak;
Halh in tho un Eden taikhuo a val,
I tup gam chu zuon zel hitiu.
A hawih nau e! Lalna gam tuolthing,
Ei di’n Bethlehem tang a lun sak tai;
Tuona I pi leh puteu muh phak loh,
Saron pak tanin I leng ui.

songs.title: I Pathien in ei pui zel hi

lines: Isai 41:13
Doh is D S.S. 542. - T.S. 8
I Pathien in ei pui zel hi,
Tih ka hetin ka kipak hi;
Bang semin, khawiah um mahleng,
Pathien khut in ei pui zel hi.
Ei pui zel hi! ei pui zel hi!
Amah khut in ei pui zel hi;
A nungzui ginum hih ka nuom,
Amah khut in ei pui zel hi.
Abangkuom leh ka lungkham in,
Abangkuom leh ka kipak hi;
Mun lauh-um leh muonna mun ah,
Pathien khut in ei pui zel hi.
Lalpa, ka khut in hun tu’ng ka,
Phunchiek leh nuok a umlo in;
Ka thilneih phawt ah lungawi ka,
Pathien khut in ei puih ziek in.
Lei a ka nasep ka zawh tieng,
Lungsiet vang’ guolzo ka hih tieng;
Thihna lauh-umna lau puo’ng ka,
Jordan nei puihkaihding ziek in.
Doh is E S.S. 524 - T.S. 9
Lalpa Jeho, Nang ei Puipa,
Gam thiengtho ah ei tun in;
Kei ka hatpuoi, ei Panpihpa,
Na khut thahat in ei tu’n.
Hinna Changthak (2)
Ka ngai hi ei vak zing in (2)
Tuikhuk chîmtak chu hun hawng in,
Damna tui luonsak inla;
Zie gamgaw gam ka kân sung hin,
Nang in ei puizel inla.
Jordan luipi ka kân tieng leh,
Ka thavaihna suhai in;
Ka masawm gam Kanaan achun,
Bit takin ei tun inla.
Chawih-atna la (2)
Kumkhawsawt in sa ta’ng ka (2)
Thangvan khuo lunlaia ngabang lengsa,
Simlei gitloh zanbang thimah a hung;
Van mipi simsen lohte’n gihawih tawh,
Hung tha’n Bethlehem dai la’n a awi ui.
Nunnawpna chung sunni Bethlehem tang chungah
A hung suok ie mitin-a dingin;
Sietlei thangvan mi chengin Amah chawian ding,
A chawihatna zaila lawptakin saitiu.
Suohlam miching leh Belampute chu,
Chamna Lal hung pieng lawmin a hung ui;
Ka lautha nang le hawlin Hukdampa,
Na gitloh ziekin albang A vai hi
Kanaan gam sunni tum ding ka thilin,
A kuol gankuong sungah maw,Hukdampa;
Amah lawm dingin kuomah a hung puou,
Chieh hitiu aw, Amah chawian dingin.
Doh is F S.S. 539 - T.S. 11
Lalpa I kiselnau, Suongpi,
Huihpi nun tieng a I bitnau;
Bangcheng hung mahleh bit hitiu,
Huihpi nun tienga I bitnau.
Gam haksa ale Isu Suongpi ahi!
Gam haksa ah, gam haksa ah;
Gam haksa ale Isu Suongpi ahi,
Huihpi nun tienga I bitnau!
Sun a lim nuom, zan a kulhpi,
Huihpi nun tieng a I bitnau!
Melma’n ei sulau tapuo’n a,
Huihpi nun tienga I bitnau!
Huihpi hat in ei um kimvel,
Huihpi nun tieng a I bitnau!
I bitnau taihsan ngei puoi tiu,

Nicheng’ Isu ka lunggil in ka hehpih deuhdeuh a,

Amah chu keia di’n hawihna lopipen a hung hii,
Nicheng’a ma sang in a hung hawih deuhdeuh zaw ta ie.
Akim le I he puou hi,
Zie luipang apat hin;
Aw, ziechun ama sang in,
Hung hawihzaw deuh deuh ina.
Galkhat a ka et in A lopina chun ei salh hi,
Lili pak hawih leh zingsawl sang inle A vak hawihzawi;
Ka deihnate A hihdim in, A hihhawih deuhdeuh zawi,
Nicheng’ ama sang in a hung hawih deuhdeuh zaw ta ie.
Ka lungthim a hung chauh tiengleh Ama’n ei panpih a,
Ka liengvaih laiin Ama’n A angsung ah ei pawm sek;
Krista, ka gitloh cheng pawpa kha ka hehpih ahi,
Nicheng’a ma sang in a hung hawih deuh deuh zaw ta ie.

songs.title: La’n sa’ng ka thusim maktak chu

lines: Sam 89:1
Doh is E8 S.S. 875. - T.S. 33
La’n sa’ng ka thusim maktak chu,
Krista kei ding a thi chu;
A In nuomtak chu taihsan a,
Kalvari a A thih chu.
La’n sa’ng ka thusim maktak chu,
Krista kei ding a thi chu;
Lopi mithiengte tawh sa’i tiu,
Luigal a I kikhawp tieng.
A beimangsa Isu’n ei mu’i,
Belam taimangsa ei mu’i;
A hehpih khut a ei pawm in,
Amah lam ah ei puita’i.
Ka liemna Isu’n ei hihdam,
Lau leh thingilh a um kha;
Mu theilo in lauhna’n ka dim,
Ei hihveng lauhum apat.
Nicheng’ thim in ei khuh zing hi,
Lam lauhum a ka um in;
Mahleh Lalpa’n ei umpih zing,
A ban thahat in ei pui.
Luipi lien ah ei veng intin,
Tuilien a kan macheng chu;
Bit takin ei pui kai intin,
Ziechun lungdeihte tuok ka.
Upa Kapzinga
Galin dawn leu hing,
Kalvari tang A thihna mun khu;
Khawvel Hukdampa, I Lalpau Isu,
Lungkham leh thavaih na’n Amah abawm,
A chiehna ding chu aw ka thil ngam puoi
Juda mipi leh melmate lakah;
Ka gitloh ziekin, aw ka Lal Isu,
Aw, Na hehpihna,
Lungngaih kinawkin Kalvari ah,
Keihaw nei tantai vakmang gimtheite
Ka gitloh thienna, aw na thisan lul.
Zie Khawvel a hin,
Vakvai gimtheite nei hung hawl tai;
Na angsung mun muong chu ka hungtun ma’n,
Ka hun hawl zel hi, Aw ka Hukdampa.
Zasiama
En un zuo vawnchawih henkawl ei sutpa,
A min Kalvri tang achun;
Thing hansie dawl chungah a khaikang ui,
Kei di’n A thisan lul a luong ie,
Hukdampa nak thiengtho achun,
Thisan leh tui ahung luong dawk;
Ka suihlung in ngilhlo zen hen,
Gilo thienna lui chu.
Ziechun hehpihna damtui thieng a luong.
Hukdampa thihna mun achun;
Sun leh zan in zie chun va leng inla,
Ka thagau na Hukdampa kiengah.
Kuole zie thisan lui a kisil chu,
A gitlouh vuk sanga vam ding;
“Aw na gitloh nin chu silthieng inla,
Hung in aw,’ tin Hukdampa’n ei sam.
Vakmang santa puong ka khawvel ahin,
Ka hehpih ka Lal Hukdampa;
Aw Na thagau thiengtho in ei pui in,
Na mel deihum chu ei muhsak in.
Sam 43:5
Doh is B8 S.S. 230. - T.S. 36
Lungthim kipak chengte,
Hukdampa min ngaite;
Na theihtawp uh suoh un,
A min chawian dingin;
Gamtin, muntin a mi hilh un, (2)
A hehpih lei na bat u chuh.
A Lallukhuk nusie’n,
Lalpuon lopi kawihtha’n;
Hehpih tha’n A hung suk,
Kap leh liem in A thii;
A thawk natzie gen theih ei puoi, (2)
Thihna apat ei hukdam di’n.
Mithite umna mun,
Than thim apat A tho;
Tichun A galte chu,
Lopi takin A zo;
Galhat van ah A kal to ta’i, (2)
Hukdampa’n vanah vai A hawm.
Kin takin hung intin,
Chawmkhat le chawllo in;
I thagau uh pui ding,
Ni tawplo gam achun;
Ziechun A hehpih mel mu’i tiu, (2)
A angsung ah umzing ta’i tiu.

songs.title: A nuom ngei ie Isu muon hih

lines: Doh is A8 E.C. Hymnal 321.
A nuom ngei ie Isu muon hih,
Amah thu bang a pawm hih;
Amah thutiem a kingak hih,
“Lalpa gen dan” hetna tawh.
Isu, Isu, Amah ka muong!
Amah ka hechien deuhdeuh!
Isu, Isu, lulpen Isu!
Zahngaihna di’n Amah muon!
Aw, a nuom hi Isu muon hih,
A thienna thisan muon chuh;
Ginna mawltak a kidieh di’n,
Damna, thienna thisan ah.
Ahi, anuom ngei Isu muon,
Gitloh, kei deih beina di’n;
Hinna, chawlhna, nawpna, muonna,
Isu kawm a lak mai chuh!
Nang ka hun muong a ka kipak,
Isu lul, Hukdampa, Guol;
Ka kawm a Nang na um ka hei,
Tawp chana ei umpih ding.
Ngaite “Hinna lampi ka bawl” A tii,
Khawvel ah hehpih leh nunnuom a;
I len nangun lopina a kawih zo tai.
Aw Angel vam leh Lalchutphah a ngui zo tai,
Pakna kingkang, chawihatna phaiphuleng;
Aw lopnina a chawlzo tau,
Lal nunnem in kalvari ah thuok in a tan tai.
Aw, Pathien cha, hukdampa chun ngaite,
Kalvari leh thing hansiedawl ah;
I gitloh ziekun thuokin, A chawzo tai.
Van leh khawvel haw hin hesuok leu chu;
Hukdampa dangchak leh thavai chu;
Kalvari tang hung naiin, ka lunggil ah.
Aw, ei puiin Thagau zie tang achun,
Pathien Belam No thawmhau tak chun;
“Aw ka cha, ka kawmah hungin” tin ei sam.
Lalpa, Na lam bawlah ei pui inla,
Gamgaw ka mauna gam ngai puong ie;
Na mel enin ziechun lengkhawm chiet tang kau.
Upa Zasiama
Aw khawiah him, Hukdampa chun,
Lungngaih gimtheih A thuok?
A mel deihum tak muh ka nuom,
Hehpih thisan luonna.
Aw na thisan luong chu mu leng,
Ka gitloh nin silthieng intin;
Lungkham lungzinna bei tana,
Aw, na thisan achun.
Ka hun ngai hi Lalpa tuhin,
Ka gitloh silthieng di’n;
Khawvel ahin Nangmah lo chu,
Thienna dang a um puoi.
Ka thihni phat a hungtun tieng,
Hehpih in ei puiin;
Lau puong kating thihna lui chu,
Damin hung kaidawk ka.
Thangngur
Hinna thiengtho siempa a deih puou Zion ah,
Minsiet leh lungkhamna puo chun a matsak ui;
A changthak nete kha dogal a suok zo tau,
A nung a hun zui ui mipi simsenloh hawn,
Juda’n ma a pui a thepthaka matsak guo’n
Tichun a man taua , Thiempu Lal insung ah,
Thimthu a tiemsak ui Linglukhuk khu dingin;
Linglukhuk a ngau ie Lalpa luchung achun,
Khut in a zuk beng un, thisan va zung zungin,
Ka Hukdampa pui ui, Kalvari lam zuonin.
Thing ana sutuoh ui. Kalvari tang chunga,
Kilhna a sekkhawl ui, Ka Lalpa kilhna ding ;
Ka Lal a khai kang ui A mel muol thipthiep in,
A nak ah a sun ui thisan leh tui a pawt,
Zion kulhpi sungah gal vai a hawm khiel ui.
A gensau mah bangin Hukdampan a thuok tai,
A tiemsau mah bangin Hukdampa a thi tai;
Van mithiengthote khun lingpi ling zungzung in,
Lautha a kaitho ui, sietlei a zal sate
Hukdampa puldo di’n khawthieng ah a leng ui.
Na thawkna ngilh tiengleh gitlohna a zing sek,
Mit chu a hun tuom ui, Na vak hawih lieh dingin;
Tuhin hun hawkthan la, Na eng vak singseng in,
Na mela hehpihna mittui vazung zungin,
Ka lunggil gilo ah Lalpa hung leng inla.
Entie Hukdampa chu a pui tau,
A linglukhuk tawh;
Dogal simsen loh te’n masawm,
Kalvari tang tiengin.
Ka gitloh ziekun Na thuok ie,
Na ul thisan bangin a vai;
Na aw nem deihum tak pawt chu,
Ka lunggil in ka ngilh thei puoi.
Ka en ngam puoi ka Lalpa deihtak,
Dogal te’n zep ui;
A thawk natzie ka genthei puoi,
Kei di’n A hin a piei
Thihna huoisie tak A thawk lai khan,
Kuon a panpih em?
“He pa, he pa!” tiin A kiko,
Gausapna thing chungah.
Aw ka thagau, Hukdampa thihna,
Zion ah chieh in;
Ziechun ngaihdamna chu mu’n la,
A thisan apat chun.

songs.title: Ei Hukdampa chawihatna’n la chu sa’i tiu

lines: Sam 95:1
Doh is A S.S. 234. - T.S. 41
Ei Hukdampa chawihatna’n la chu sa’i tiu,
Pa lungsiet I het na’nga A thihzie chu;
A lainatna namtin kieng ah gen hitiu,
I sik gen ding a kumsawt a A hin zie.
Thusim mak chuh genviel hitiu,
Kross chunga A thihzie chu;
Chawihatna, lopina a bawnin chang hen,
Gitloh a I pawt theihna’n A thuok zota’i.
Lungmuonna, kipahna thu A hun puok chu,
Eihaw di’n A nutsieh ziekin pakcha’i tiu;
A thu awite kawm achun A nai zing hi,
Ginumte di’n A hehpih latsak ina.
Thagau kumsawt nawpna di’n van In nuom chu,
Eihaw dinga A siem ziekin pakcha’i tiu;
A hehpihna lopi, gen theihloh mu’i hitiu,
A gam a mithiengte tawh I kikhawp tieng.
Entie, Hukdampa, na Lal chun,
Thing hansie dawlah A hun ngak;
Keile Hukdampa ei ngak-in.
Ka hung hi, lam haksa mahleh.
Thepna lampi tincheng ale,
Ka hun nungheisan loh na din;
Van Angel lungtuok ginum te,
Ka ngaihni hin hung tung sek leu.
En diu hinna ding lampi hi,
Hawh ahak tun loh ka lau ie;
Lalpa, van thagau puih loh chun,
Kuo ahim a hungtung thei ding?
Bangtik leh ka hun mu ding um?
Ka ngaklah lei dahum a hin;
Nuoma ka len diu ka thil sek,
Aw, nangmah hehpihna ziek hin.
Thing hansie dawl Kraws maktak chu,
Lungngai taka ei tatna chu;
“Ka hinna pen thing kung ahi”,
Tiin chawisang zing thei leng aw.
Patea
Ka tha, va chieh inla, Jerusalem dai ah,
Kalvari muol leh, thing leh than leh thisan va en in;
Ziechun um zing inla, mipi chieh dawk mahleu,
Lal phasak phat a luong lak thak;
Than hawm chanin enin.
A na ka sa taluoi! ka hehpih Hukdampa
Thisan loa hukdam thei hileh chu aw. Ka Lalpa
Van khuo nguiin Saron tuoilo ding hiven
Mahleh Isu, Nang din van pi a chim.
Aw ka Lalpa deihtak, Na Lalchutphah enin,
Kei din thuoka mi than awnga van Lal cha na kuol chu;
Ana ka sa taluoi! Ana ka sa taluoi!
Bang ka lawh ta mai die leh aw.
Than suong a khak zo tau.
Vakvai ding ka him,Lalpa khawia um na him?
Kalvari tang chunga thi a Na mel ka muh lai kha;
Tuhin ka lung a dawngka lungkham a khawk diek,
Ka lunggil ah a cham.
Ka man thisan a hi, van Lal a ka hi ie,
Khawvel sum leh sana loa thisan a tat ka hi;
Ka pa In lam ka hei, buoina mei khel gamah,
Zion tang ka gamah.
Lalpa’n ei hehpihna chu.
Van sana khawlai taihsan in;
Gilo chate ei hawl di’n.
A thuok ie, Lal Isu’n.
Lungkhamna thing kraws chu kei din a pua,
Chau in a puk hi!
Kilhna thik khet kei di’n ana taluoi.
Aw ka gen thei puoi.
Chenna khak loh gam tawh chu,
Puon san silh a ling phek chu khun;
Gimtheih tincheng thuok zo in,
Belam No Lal Isu.
Etchim theih loh Lal Isu.
Mi gilo di’n a Kraws chu pun;
Kalvari lam zuon dingin,
A gimthei ie ka Lal.
Aw, kei dinga thuok zo in,
Kalvari tang thing kraws chungah;
Ka gitloh cheng puo kawmin,
Ei tan tai Lal Isu’n.
Doh is C Tune : S.S. 1117
Lawp takin chawian chiet hitiu,
Chamna Lalpa hungpieng chuh;
A Lalchutphah, Ami thiengtho, A Lallukhuk hun nusien,
Eihaw gilo a vaite hukdamna lam ei hun hilh hi,
Pakchau uo, chitin pautin in Lalpen chuh chawian chiet un.
Pakchakna-haita puonna,
Vannuoi tawp tieng geiin le;
Nicheng, kum chengin pahchakna chuh
Hai puona kumsawt in,
Lei leh van beih nungin le
Angel vamte tawh pakchai tiu.
Bawng In tawmah hung piengin,
Gan kuongah hung kuol mah lele;
Amah milien ahi, A gamin tawp tikni nei puona,
Sak Thang, Sim leh Mala um thihna dailim nuoia chu ten;
A Lalna pakchan nicheng, tha cheng, kum cheng pung zel un au.
Eden huona Setan in I Lallukhuk ei chuhthak khah,
Tuhin chuh Lalpa Isu’n A zo a, ei hun pie kit tai;
Zieziekchun nungak tangval, naupang, atek, a khang mitin,
Lalpen te Lalpen pakchan tui kinawk guolin la sau in.
Leia mipi simsen loh leh van Angel simsen loh tawh,
Aw Lalpa, Na hehpihna thukzie, letzie, sauzie, sanzie;
Cha neihsun le hawilo a kei u di’n na hun sawl ziekin,
Ka aw neih cheng u leh hattawp in tuhin ka hun pak chau.
Lianvela
Ginna tha a lengin, kalvari tang lamah va chieh leng,
Ka Lalpa thihna mun achun;
Ka chenna ding Salem thak va mung ie.
Ka lei lungkham kah sawlang bang tang ie,
Nawpna pak lunna gam nuom thil leng.
Kalvari tang chunga thisan lui luong Hukdampa nak ah,
Namtin silthienna mun achun;
Aw ka thagau, ziechun va buol in.
Jerusalem thak khu a kilatna tang dang a um puoi,
Thil hitiu Kalvari tang ah;
Ziechun a lang Hukdampa nak achun.
Aw ka thagau leng in na Hukdampa thihna mun achun,
Nangmah zieka a thawkna chu;
A thisan luong ah va kisil in.
Ka gam lui ding ka chenna hi,
Aw bangtik leh ka pawtsan dem?
Angel vamhaw leh ka Lal mel chu,
Muh kal ka ngaklah.
Aw, Jerusalem dai, ka Lalpa’n,
Thawmhau in a ngak;
Hansie dawl thingah a thawksak ui,
A linglukhuk tawh.
Na thawk dan ka gen thiem thei puoi,
Gitloh thawihnan van Belam No;
Na hung pieng mun nuomlo Bethlehem,
Bawng In tawm nuoi ah.
Lal Isu ka enchim thei puoi,
Kalvari lam hunnga nang ie;
Vannuoi gitloh puoa na thawkna,
Ngilh ding guol ei puoi.
Taivela
Nei hehpih zieka maw Lalpa na thawkna,
Hun en zui ka, Kalvari tang tiengin;
Linglukhuk khu kawma Na mel thisan luong chu,
Ka hun en ngam puoi ana bek ie Lalpa!
Nei hehpihna cheng cheng,
Thu’n vang ka gen seng puoi;
Na min ka pak ding bang hin,
Lalpa, aw ka hun pak thei puoi.
Mipi a enhaw chu laina a um puou,
“Ka dang a chak” tia, A kiko khan;
Ka Lalpa dang chak tulh ding kuomah cha umlo,
A nget loh hiel zuthuk leh thil kha a pieu.
Na khuk bang hi Lalpa, kuo-a a khu um?
A kilawm puoi, Nang dingin linglukhuk;
Na van Lal kraun lul chu khawi taka um a him?
Muhsitna puonsan leh ling phek chu Na khuk?
A thawklai mel en chun ngilh ding guol ei puoi,
Lei leh van Lal nang leh kei ziekin maw;
Lungkhamna thuok kha lo lungkham in A mau a,
Chawian hitiu hehpihna Lal deihum chu.
Luke 2:14
Doh is G S.S. 30. - T.S. 47
Ngai un Angelte lasak,
“Lal thak pieng chuh lopi hen;
Chamna leng hen, lei chungah,
Pathien leh gilo chamna!”
Namtin lawpa kiko in,
Van mite la sakpih un;
Angelte gensa bang khan,
“Krista pieng Bethelhem ah.”
Ngaiun Angelte lasak,
“Lal thak pieng chuh lopi hen.”
Van mite chawihat Krista,
Kumsawt Lalpa Krista chu;
Sawttak nungin A hung pieng,
Nungak thiengtho sung a pat.
Pathien, mihiem mel hun pun,
Chawian un, Pathien mihiem;
Mihiem laka chen a nuom,
Lal Isu Immanuel.
Ngaiun Angelte lasak,
“Lal thak pieng chuh lopi hen.”
Van chamna Lal chawian un,
Felna Nisa chawian un;
Vak leh hinna A hun tun,
A tha nuoiah damna um.
A lopina hun kawihthan,
Kumsawt hinna din A pieng;
Leimi hinkit nan A pieng.
I pienthakna din A pieng,
Ngaiun Angelte lasak,
“Lal thak pieng chu lopi hen.”
Taivela
Zan lungkham um zana,
I Lalpau Isu chun, “Ziehi ka taksa leh,
Ka thisan dawn ding chu,
Nei hetzing nangun” ti’n.
Hukdampa a deih puou,
Zion kulhpi sung ah;
A panpih a um puou,
Thing hansedawl A bel,
“Tho tiemu zie apat,
Hin chieh dawk meng hitiu; Amah chu gilo in,
Sim unau tih zik kha;
Hung tung ding ahi tai”.
Tichun a chieh dawk ui,
Olivet tang lamah; Thiempu lalpente leh,
Sepaih mawlh chaw i lawi chun;
Amah kan in, khen uh.
Enghona lal puon leh,
Linglukhuk mak tak tawh; Kalvari lam zuona,
A chiehpih lai u khan ;
Panpih ding A nei puoi.
Kalvari tangpi khu,
Ni chengin ka thil a; Ka Hukdampa deihtak,
Gilo kala ding khan;
Ka thinlai a lun ie.
Taivela
A lungkhamna mun thil hitiu,
Lalpa a mat nau chu;
Gethsemani huon sung achun,
A ul thisan a luong.
Simon Barjon, na chemzam in,
Dal zolo ding na him?
Ka Hukdampa a chiehpih tau,
Thiempu lal Insung ah.
Linglukhuk le lal puon a pieu,
Mawlh in chibai a pieu;
“Kuo ahim a hun khen gen in,
Ti’n Amah a dawng ui.
Aw ei Tanpa a na taluoi,
Kei dinga Na thawkna!
Giloten le a khu ngei puou,
Na linglukhuk bang hi.
Kamlala
Tuhin Lalpa ka hun mui,
Min dang him sam puong ka;
Nangmah angsung ah cheng ingka,
Hehpihna tuisuohgiet ah.
Ka Lal na hi, hun mung ka ie,
Hun mung ka ie, Ka Lal na hi;
Aw nei hehpih zie ka hetin,
Na thuok ie Kalvari-ah.
Aw na thawkna Kalvari,
Thil ingka khawvelah;
Hehpihna ziekin hun mung ka,
Aw, Na vakzawi ni sang in.
Mipi leh Lal lopite’n,
Musit in kimvel ui;
Nang vang gimtheite Lalpa mai,
Kei di’n Na huntai Lalpa.
Na pienna lei mundawng pen,
Na thihna Kalvari;
Na gimtheihna kei le chang ka,
Nuom hun sangka Nang vang in.
Luke 2:11
Doh is G S.S. 32. - T.S. 50
David lengpa khawpi achun,
Gan In tawmtak a um a;
Ziechun a nun Nausen a siel,
Gankuong zalkhun a mangin;
Chunnu nunnem chu Mari,
A cha chuh Isu Krista.
Van apatin leiah A hung,
Pathien Lalte Lal ahi;
A kingakna gan In tawm hi’n,
A puon luoi gankuong ahi;
Gimthei, chagah liengvai in,
Leiah Hukdampa a um.
A naupan lai hun cheng cheng khan,
Mi a zahin, thu a ngai;
A nu Amah hun dawntei chuh,
A hehpihin, A enkawl;
Kristien naupang cheng cheng le,
Amah bangin um chiet un.
Amah umdan zuih ding ahi,
Ei bang’ nichengin A khang
Neu, hatlo, panpihbei ahi,
Kah leh nuih ei bang A hei;
I lungkham ei thawk pih a,
I kipah ei kipah pih.
A tawpleh I mitun mui tiu,
A hehpih tatna ziekin;
Zie Naupang ching leh ngaihum chuh,
Vana I Lalpau ahi;
A chiehna mun lam zuonin,
A chate A puizel hi.
Gan In tawm, a sika bawngchal,
Dinna mun hita loin;
Van a chun Amah chu mui tiu,
Pathien khut changlam achun;
Puon vam silhte um vela,
Chawihat a A um tieng leh.
Zan thieng thip laitak in,
Vakna a hungtung tai;
Vawnsen a chawi chun nunnem in,
Nau thiengtho ngilnei leh zainem,
Chamna Lal Cha chu,
Chamna Lal Cha chu.
Zan thiengthip laitak in,
Puipa Si-al vak hawih;
Michingte chun hun zuizel in,
Thilpiek thiengtho chu a pieu hi,
Lalpa Krista chu,
Lalpa Krista chu.
Zie zan thip laitak chun,
Si-al minthang vakin;
Van Angelte zaila hawih chun,
Halleluijah, I Lalpen uh,
Lalpa Krista chu,
Lalpa Krista chu.
A Lalna kumsawt gam chu taihsan in,
Alang A vai A lieng eihaw dingin;
Vangkhuo ah muong takin Lalpa A leng ngam puoi,
Zie khawvel ahin chu lawih na ding A hung vai.
A um puoi I Lalpau banga lieng hi,
Tu chan hin le I Hukdampau chu,
Gitloh vangin lungkham, A lieng taluoi aw,
Vakvaih sak puoi tiu.
Maltanga giekmawh vacha bangin maw,
Lungakna mun nei loin maw Isu;
Tuipi dung leh vai ah lieng takin Na vak hi,
Lalpa, ka dah taluoi nei hehpihna ziekin.
Giloa a ngawhpau i Lalpau chu,
Lal Pilat in thiemloh a chansak hi;
Chawnban in a kai ui, kalvari lam zuon in,
Tha a kie tai Isu kalvari tang chung ah.
Suakliana
Jerusalem Zion khawpi chu en tiem u,
Aw mi a tam Belam No lal lenna mun a um puoi;
A lungkhamna, kipahna Kalvari,
Tang a kilang hi.
Aw nam cheng cheng leh,
Chitin pautin hi;

Ka lungkham laiin ei selin,
Ka puokgik laiin;
Kah laiin lungmuonna ka hawl,
Nang mai nei piek theih chu.

songs.title: Ka Hukdampa’n ka ma A huoi

lines: Deut. 8:2
Doh is A8 S.S. 522 - T.S. 72
Ka Hukdampa’n ka ma A huoi,

A hehpihna ka ginglah dem?
Damsunga eipui pa chuh!
Muonna nuom, Pathien lungmuonna,
Amah gin zieka luoh ding,
* Thil bangcheng hungtung mahlele;
Isu’n bangcheng ei hih sak (2)
Ka Hukdampa’n ka ma A huoi,
Kipakin ma ka chawn zel;
Thepna ah ei panpih zela,
Changthak hingin ei vak ie;
Ka lenna gam chu lauhum in,
Ka thagau dangchak mahleh;
* Ka ma’h suongpi a hung luok dawng,
Ngaiin nawpna lui ka mu’i (2)
Ka Hukdampa’n ka ma A huoi,
Aw A hehpihna bukim;
Chawlhna bukim chan thu ei tiem,
Chunggama ka Pa In ah;
Siet theihlohna mun ka tun tieng,

Lal Isu’n ka ma A huoi (2)
Patea
Aw Lalpa David leh a suon aksi chu,
Na dikna gama di’n Nangin nei guot tai;
Ka kipahna tuilien bangin a lien hi,
Thih lui pangah Na min pakin la sa’ng ka.
Aw Lalpa zaila’n Na min chawian ka,
Khawvela Na siemte’n lasau hen:
Lalpa chawihat na’n aw chu suoh un,
Lei chung hi pakna la’n dim ina.
Mihing ka hung hih ma’n le Lalpa Isu’n,
Thisan in man dang ngek loin nei tan tai;
A malin sim sengin gen thei ta leng chu,
Na thilpiek te hi la hawih in phuong ingka.
Aw Lalpa, khawiah em mun nei guotsak chu,?
Daniel bangin kawtcha awngah thil ingka;
Sana khawtuol sungleh a In zephawih chu,
Dahum ale khupdin bekin thil ingka.
Aw Immanuel lei leh van thak siem chu,
A dung leh vailamah va en viel leu hing;
Buoina tincheng thuoka I khensa teu chu,
Van lopina tawh a meluh mu taitiu.
Kamlala
Ginna’n thil thiem leu hing,
Zie khawvel apat hin;
Pak ka nuom Hukdampa,
Na hehpihna deihum.
Kipak lo thei kei puoi (2)
Hukdampa Na nak liem;
Tatna thisan pawtna,
Etin nei tat dan hi, A na ka sa ta luoi.
Na lalna kumsawt gam,
Pelin zie khawvelah;
Ka gimnau Na paw zo,
Sapsietna thing chungah.
Maa pi leh pute.
Mansaksa van pielgal;
Hehpihna thisan vang,
Ken ka na mu kit tai.
Angel vamhaw lenna,
Nitum lohna gam nuom;
Aw Na thisan vangin,
Bang tik leh ka tung dem?
Leiah liengvai mahleng,
Lungsietin ei puiin;
Ka thagau van gam ah,
Nuom takin leng tana.
Na min lopi pakcha’n,
Kipakin lasa’ng ka;
Tuoilo pak Hukdampa,
Na hawih chuom na zen e!
Doh is B8 S.S. 556
Lalpa Isu ei puiin,
Damsung tuilien laka hin;
Ka ma ah tuia kinawk,
Suongpi guk, nga lauhum tam,
Mun hetna Nang apat hung,
Lalpa Isu ei puiin.
Nu’n a cha a thepbih bang,
Tuipi lien na hihhai thei;
Tui kinawkin Na thu awi,
“Haiin, tuilien na tih tieng,”
Lal mak tuichunga thunei,
Lalpa Isu ei puiin!
Luipi pang chuh ka naih tieng,
Tui kinawk lauhum gi leh;
Chawlhna nuom ka tun kuonin,
Na awma ka kingaih tieng;
“Lau ki’n, ka cha ka hun tu’i,
Ti a Na gen ka za dem?

songs.title: Amah umna munthip achun ei sel ina

lines: Sam 27:6
Doh is E8 S.S. 535 - T.S. 75
Amah umna munthip achun ei sel ina,
Khawvel thil ngaihtuoh na puokgik apat in;
A zahngaihna limnuoi ah nuom takin chawl ka,
Zie chun ka Tanpa’n ei veng ina.
Bit takin kei eisel ina,
Lungkhamna, thepna sukbuoi phak lohna munah;
Bit takin kei ei sel ina!
Amah umna munthip achun ei sel ina.
Amah umna munthip achun ei-sel ina,
A lopina pak chu ei muhsak intin;
Amah chun vakna’n puon bangin ei thuom intin,
Aw ka tha a kipak na ding e!
Amah umna munthip a chun ei sel ina,
A hehpihna hai ngeilo, munthip a chun;
Ka Hukdampa tawh kiho in cheng khawm ung kau,
Chunggam nawpna teplawkna ahi.

songs.title: Aw Nang kumsawt Suongpi muon um

lines: Doh is G
Aw Nang kumsawt Suongpi muon um,
Lalpa deihum ka hun muong;
Lam tawnin kei ei veng inla,
Na mel kipahum mu’ng ka.
Ei selin Aw kumsawt Suongpi,
Na mel kipahum mudi’n;
Damsung huiphpi ka thuok tieng leh,
Kumsawt Suongpi ei selin.
Meipi hung zin tieng ei selin,
Nisa hung vakkit masieh;
Ka sep ka zawh ma’n ei vengin,
Khawvel ka taihsan masieh.
Ka khuolzinna ka zawh tieng leh,
Ka thagau chau nang puiin;
Hukdampa mel ka muh masieh,
Zie kumsawt gammnuom achun.
Doh is A8 S.S. 861 - T.S. 76
Ka Hukdampa mu kimah leng,
Ka kawmah Thu a gen zing hi;
Amah ken ka tel apat in,
Lalpa pakun A aw ka he’i.
A aw ka he’i, Hukdampa Aw!
Aw ka lunggil a sukipak;
Ka kawma Thu a gen chengin,
Lalpa pakun A aw ka he’i.
A mel mu thei kimah lengle,
Huihpi lakah A aw ka he’i;
Tui kinawk haidi’n thu A pie’i,
Ni hung langin muonna a um.
Ka kawmah thudik A gen hi,
Muh phakloh, chawlhna nawpna thu;
Muonna hehpihna thu ei hilh,
Chunglam In nuom thu ei hilh hi.
Suih lunghel in ginnan vak thil leu hang,
A lang van gam lopi;
Lei a lungngai chate tuol a lennau,
Belam No leh Hinna Thing pak tanin;
Hehpihte a leng ui,
A lopi ie kipakin la sai tiu.
Aw, thisan lul zaila’n hun chawian ka,
Nei hehpihna lopi;
Kalvaria tatna thisan,
Zaila’n chawian ingka.
Suihlung helin, thil bang cheng gelviel leng,
Kipahna a hung nai;
Hehpihpa thisan zala kipahna,
I vang nei ngei Pathien chate hi din;
Krista’n ei na siem tai,
Kipahna kim nasepna hi ahi.
Ka chantawk a kipahna lopi pen,
Hehpih thiengtho ahi;
Pathien cha leh A nasem hihna tawh,
Ei veng bitin keimah ahin semin;
Aw ka Lalpa deihtak,
Ei mangin aw thagau hukdam dingin.
Suakliana
Aw hehpihna ka gen thiem puoh na’n ka thip thei puoi,
Lei leh van Lalpa lopi leh thiengtho hawih zie,
Hallelujah, I thiem dandan bek un thil hitiu.
Thiengtho, thiengtho, thiengtho,
Thiengtho I Lalpen chu;
Thiengtho thiengtho, thiengtho,
Ei Hukdampa ahi.
Aw hehpihna ka gen seng puoi, aw a za na e,
Khawvel thimna leh lungkham na mei zing mahleh;
A nang diek puoi gawtmun inle aw a vak na e.
Hallelujah, Hallelujah, aw a vak na e,
Zion vak chunga thienthona la hawih a sau;
A pak la tuipi kinawk guolin a hai thei puoi.
Doh is C Welsh Tune Book
Kalvari-a zawhna lopi,
Angel in Amah chawian ding,
Mipite’n le chawian unau,
Khawvel Hukdampa thisan in;
Mi mangthai ding tat in a um,
Kidote kichamna ahi.
Tang dang cheng sangin Kalvari,
A minthang in a lopi zaw’i;
Zie chun hinna tuinak a put,
Leisiet gam chengah a luong viel;
Namtin mihiem hin kitna di’n,
Kumsawta hinna tui hi’na.
Lungngaih leh gitlohna ten ei um ui,
Thihna a puih dingin;
Ginnaa nunglam ka et kit leh,
Ka Hukdampan ei hawl hi.
Nunnuom in ka kipak hi tu hin,
Hukdampa nunnem leh Hehpihna chun;
Ka lautha mang A hukdam tai.
Kipahna tak lunggila ka neih hi,
Isu ei piek ahi;
Leia sanga kipahna lienzaw’n,
Van kipah nan ka dim hi.
Belam No lal lenna tang ka thillin,
Kipah nan ei na muok;
Thihna Jordan gal ka kaih tieng leh,
Van guolvak lopi um ka.
Zie khawvel damlai lungngaih meipi zing nuoi ahin,
Gitlohna leh lungngaihna ten ei tuom velin;
Ka Hukdampa’n ei lungsietna,
Chanchin pha thu ka hun zakin;
Ka lungkhamna cheng cheng,
Nawpna a suok zotai.
Chanchin hawih kei di’n nawpna,
Chanchin pha kei di’n damna;
Lalpa thuthiem lopi pen ahi,
Aw Kei din damna.
Gitloh huihpi leh zinmangin ei um vel mahleu,
Ei Hukdampan A lungsietna kulhpi sungah;
Ka thagau liem puilut intin,
Ka tanpa thutiem dettak chu;
A lungsietna lien chu bang ma’n, a nang zo puoi.
A lungsietna min lopi mai chu kei din a lul,
Kei gilo, liengvai, gimthei hing hawilo cha hih;
Kumsawt pielgal kawt ei hawnsak,
A thisan lul thiengtho tak chun;
Lunggil in ei muhsak in aw, ka Lal Isu.
Doh is A Khasi Tune Book - T.S. 79
Thisan lun, thisan lun,
Kross chunga hung luong chun;
Gitloh a ei tanin,
Thiem ei chansak kittai;
Migilo vawmpen thienna chuh,
Kalvari thisan lun ahi,
Kalvari thisan lun ahi.
Aw thisan, thisan lun,
Thangvan dawngkawt nei hawn;
Van gam nei tun tieng leh,
Ka la tuoilo ding chuh;
“Thisan, thisan, thisan, thisan,”
Ti’n hailo in sa tang kau
Ti’n hailo in sa tang kau.
Aw tang hawih Kalvari,
Mite’n musit mahleu!
Tang dang cheng cheng sangin,
Ken ka ngaina pen hi;
Aw nawpna tang, Aw mun thiengtho,
Pathien Thisan a luonna chuh
Pathien Thisan a luonna chuh.

Imanuel thizam apat,
Thisan lui a luong ie;
* Gilo zie luia kisil chuh,
A gitloh thieng tana. D.S.
Gucha thikuon a damlai khan,

* Amah bangin gilo mahleng,

* Lungsiet tatna chuh ka thupi,

* Ka lei kamthiemlo, dangawk hi,

songs.title: Enin, Luikhuk thuk leh lien chuh

lines: Doh is A8 S.S. 125 - T.S. 81
Enin, Luikhuk thuk leh lien chuh,
Enin, a luong zing hi;

Vuk banga thienna chuh (2)
Lui a chun hungin,

A nuom cheng manbei a hungin,
Gitloh silthieng u-nau.
Lungngai, gima Isu thawkna,
Kalvari kross apat;
Thisan maktak a hung luong dawk,

Zie lui hihdam theihna mak chuh,

songs.title: Ka Tanpa khawi a um na him?

lines: Doh is G Tune S.S. 776
Ka Tanpa khawi a um na him?
Ti’n ka hun hawl viel viel hi;
Kei di’n thil lopi nei guotsak a,
Ka kumsawt van nawpna ding.
Aw, Ka Tanpa lopi pen,
Aw, ka Hukdampa mak pen;
Kei di’n thing hansie dawlah Na hung thuok,
Ka Lal leh tanpa na hi.
Na hehpihna thuk leh let zie,
Kuoman a mu pha ngei puou;
Van mi thiengthote cheng cheng in le,
A thuk zie a mu pha puou.
Sietlei a Na hung lai guol khan,
Tuhin ka hun mu thei puoi;
Mahleh nei hehpihna thu nutsieh,
Ka lunggil ah a cham zing.
Aw, ka thagau chieh zel in la,
Na Tanpa Lal kawm a chun;
A khut changlam akhun va chun la,
Na kumsawt khawpi achun.
Patea
Thagau hung inla, Edena thil lui,
Hung mang intin Na gam nuom thil ingka;
Hun mung ka ting,Na lopina haw chu,
Pakna gi huihchim guolin leng ina.
Immanuel, Na hehpih kulh sungah,
Buoina gal a lien ie hung nai kitin;
Hung kit inla, Nang ka Bitna Na hi,
Na hehpih kulhsungah aw,
Buoina gal a lien ie.
Kipahna leh vangsakna ni lopi,
Na lampi gal muongah ei pui zelin;
Jordan luipi lien chu kinawk vielin,
Kanaan gam hawih luigal chu kai tangka.
Vakhu guolin tha zakin leng thei leng,
Ka damna kalvari tang tung ingting;
Chun, zie mun chu ka pawtsan kittieng leh,
Lalna gam nitum ngeilo zuon ingka.
Aw, ka damlai ni hi abeih tieng leh,
Lawpna khawpi laituol a leng tangka;
Kalvari thihna paka lasate,
Kipahna tuoi theilo in zawm tang ka.
Upa Zasiama
Thagau Thiengtho khuva nunnem,
Hung lengin ka hun ngai ui;
Hun suhalh kitin la mipi chaute,
Muolliem loin hung kit inla.
Aw, ka hun ngai ui Thagau nunnem,
Nang loin mipite a gammang ui;
Puikit inla aw, Zingsawl Aksi Zion,
Nawpna lampi thiengah.
Ngaitie Lalpa Na tatsate.
Kumsawt hinna lam mang ui;
Lei belampute hin a pui thei puou,
Bangti ahi ta dem Lalpa?
Thagau Thiengtho, Nang na um chun,
Khawvel lungkham a nem sek;
Gitlohna leh buoina gal lien mah leh,
Na min pakin zaila sangka.
Isu nunnem hung tau kitin,
Lungkham taka Na thawkna;
Hetsak inla aw Na linglukhuk tawh,
Na thavaihna mak tak cheng tawh.
Pentikost ni bang khan aw Hukdampa,
Hung kit inla namtin chitin te;
Kumkhaw pielgal lam mangin a gim ui,
Puidawk kit inla.
Buoina gam lungzin um sunavak din,
Hung kithuom in, Na theih na lopi’n;
Buoina kang thieng dingin mei kuong bangin,
Thagau hung inla.
Thihna huoisie thuoka na tatsate,
Khawvel pak tana muong denhaw hi;
Nangin puiin, Na kumkhaw gam lalna,
Lam mansak te chu.
Thagau Thiengtho nunnem hungkit inla,
Hukdam ngai ui Na cha taimang te’n;
A kumkhaw hinnau lampi helo a,
Beimang dingte khu.
A ngilh sawt taluou Kraws a Na thawkna,
A lunguh gilo thim salhvakin;
A kipahnau pakcha chu muolsak in,
Na puih theih na’ngin.
Upa Zasiama
Thagau thiengtho meikuong leh meipi a mapui,
Lal Immanuel hung nai kitin;
Sietlei lampi thima ka vaih lai hin,
Hung vak kitin, pielgal Zingsawl,
Aksi vak hawih tak chu.
Aw van Aksi, aw van Aksi vak hawih,
Ka Hukdampa leh ka lal deihum pen Na hi;
Lungkhamna kinawk in dogal hunglien mahleh,
Bitna Lalpa bel ing ie kumsawt in.
Suongmantam dawngkawt hawih lopi hawn a hih tieng,
Sana tuol nuom achun leng tangka;
Gitloh zieka ka lungkhamna cheng hi,
Gam lopi ninnawpna munah;
Pakthing banglun tan a.
Belam No lalna gam nitum ngeilo achun,
Khensa te’n nuoi simlei ngai loin;
Zaila’n Belam No chu a chawian ui,
Hinna thing bak lim nuoiah;
Puon thieng silh in a leng ui.
Ka lenna ding chung thangvan gam ninnuom a chun,
Sietlei hinkhuo sang muol a liem tieng;
Khensa guol ngaih laia va bang buolin,
Ninnawp kiemlo in Lal nunnem;
Chawian in la sang ka.
Doh is C S.S. 11. - T.S. 86
Juda maicham chunga,
Gan thah cheng thisan in;
Lunggil gilo a muonsak puoi,
Gitloh a sawp thieng puoi.
Van Belam No Krista’n,
Gitloh cheng A lamang;
Kithawihna lopi zaw ahi,
Gan thi sanga lul zaw.
Puokgik Na puok mudi’n,
Na luchang deihum chuh;
Lunggil kisik in ka dinga,
Gitloh thupha chawiin.
Puokgik Na puok mudi’n,
Ka thagau in a en;
Hansie dawl thinga Na kikhaih,
Gitloh na puok a he’i.
Upa Chunga
Kalvaria Na hehpihna tui bang a hung liena,
Kei gilo thalek gamgaw mun haksa ah;
Dam dii diei in a hung luonga,
A chunga ginna lawng bawl dan ka thiem thei puoi.
Panpih ding Thagau ka ngai,
Panpih ding Thagau ka ngai ie;
Noah kuong bawl pihpa Thagau ka ngai.
Lalpa, Zion zawtna lampi Thagau panpih loh chun,
Amau chitna mangin kuo a hung thei die?
Lalpa kei chu ka hung thei puoi,
Na chitna leh ka thiemna a kikalh ziekin.
Lalpa, Na khut lopi ngakin gitloh tuipi chungah,
A dawn umlo nausen bangin ka uma;
Na hehpihna a hung tunga,
Ka ginna tawh kiphun kipak in ka um sek.
Ka hukdampa, ka Lal Krista tui bang A hung let tieng,
Ka gimna leh ka buoina chup mang intin;
A hehpihnan ei huk intin,
Amah kawma chawl dingin ei pui lut tana.
Thangngur
I lunggil gilo thim nuoia,
Van hinna chi kituh hi;
Pak ding leh gah ngei dinga,
Enkawl dingin thupiek I hiu;
Hinna Lallukhuk lawh dingin.
Lalpa Isu Thagau hun sawlin,
Nanga dinga pak gimlim hung hithei dingin;
Na Lallukhuk hawihna dingin,
Ka ginnau hih thiengtho in.
I gam nam mawl genthei sungah,
Chang bang damna chanchin pha;
Pak ding leh gah ngei dinga,
Enkawl dinga thupiek I hiu;
Felna Lallukhuk lawh dingin.
Lalpa Thagau lo a hin chu,
Chitna, thiemna leh sanna;
Phatna dan leh felna dan,
Lunggil a hung pak ding ngei chu;
Ei nang gitloh gal a suok thei.
Hehpihnan kawt lien tak a hawng,
Van Lal nasepna dingin;
Tui vatkhat leh thingphel khat,
Thil muhsit um tincheng hawhi;
Van gam go a suohsak theihna’n.
Lalmang Pathien bangcheng bawl thei,
Ka lunggil nin uh hih thiengin;
Na lautha’n naubang ei puiin,
Kah leh mauna gamgaw ahin.
Aw van mei Thagau Thiengtho,
Ginlahna leh lunggil buok;
Buoina lungkham chapona,
Kang thiengin sem zelin.
Israel chate ka gelin,
A phunchiek ui Lalpa chung ah,
Aigupta leh nun lui ngaiin,
Gamgaw ah sang tamtak a thiu.
Khawvel leh nun lui ngailo din;
Thih chanin Lalpa ei puiin;
Hin lui ngaih leh gitlohna chu,
Kumsawt a manthaina ahi.
Lungsiet takin aw Lal Isu,
Hindan thiengtho ei sinsakin;
Ngaiin,Na min theibang ka lo,
Naubang ei sang mengin Lalpa.

songs.title: Gamtin ah Kross thihna lul hi

lines: Doh is G Luther’s Hymn Presby Hymn Book
Gamtin ah Kross thihna lul hi,
Hung thang suok hen, khawk tak ahi;
Kalvari ah khuo hungvak hen,
Gamtin muoltin hun salhvak hen (2)
Lalpa ka Pathien na nasep,
Kawl kimvel tiengin suhalh in;
Na lungsiet zawh theih ngeiloh hi,
Gamtin ah hun hih lang inla (2)
Lampi lauhum ah Lalpa ei puiin,
Thepna lei dogal sang-za tam mahleh;
Kipahna leh lungngaihna ahin le,
Thagau thiengtho ei pui zel inla.
Gamthip dahum taka ka chen lai in,
Lungmuonna Lalpa Isu Nang ngei chun;
Lampi dik leh lungmuonna lama chun,
Aw Lalpa ei na veng zel inla.
Setan thilbawl theihna leh a hatna,
Ei nuoisieh dinga a kipat lai in;
Ding det ingka, Lalpa hatna mangin,
Thagau Thiengtho ei pui zel inla.
Gamla taka vakmang chu kei ka hi,
Ka pa In ka taihsan gamla tak ah;
Tuhin ka hung kit hi aw ka Lalpa,
Ei kaiin, ei na veng zel inla.
Isu nungzui dingin ka kipan tai, (3)
Vaikitlo di’n (2)
Keimai hileng le Isu zui zel ka (3)
Vai kitlo di’n, (2)
Kross chu ka ma ah, khawvel ka nungah (2)
Vaikit lo di’n (2)
Khawvel chu la’n la, Isu kei ei pie’n, (3)
Vaikitlo di’n Amah zui ka.

songs.title: Ka gitloh netna cheng sawpthienna di’n

lines: Doh is F - T.S. 94
Ka gitloh netna cheng sawpthienna di’n,
Kalvari kross ah Isu kikhen den;
Angelte’n a en ui mak a sau hi,
Migilo kei di’n, A kipumpiek na.
Aw hehpihna mak! Aw tatna mantam,
Ka gitloh beihna’n man lopi A pie’i;
Chanchinpha genun, Hukdamna manbei,
Gilo kei di’n hehpihna mak ahi.
Ka gitlohna cheng Isu’n A pawtai,
Ka tatna man kim athawn in A pie’i;
Ka gitlohna cheng kross chungah A puo’i,
Gilo kei di’n hehpihna mak ahi.
Linglukhuk khuksak in a chiehpih ui,
Lungkham ni’n Luguh munlam a tun ui;
Khuo ahungthim a micheng in a muu,
Migilo kei di’n A kipumpiek na.
A luong a siel ui Jospeh than thak ah,
Khetden Lalpa chuh Hukdam di’n A hat;
A hinna A pie’i, kei ka hin theih na’n,
Gilo kei di’n hehpihna mak ahi.
Kamlala
Lungngaihna lummei kalah,
Nga bang ka leng ie;
Kipahna ni eng a tuoi,
Taikhuo val theilo.
Aw nunnawpna ni, mu bang ka ngai,
Ka chungah hung vakin;
Thimna dogal lienin ei nang ie,
Aw, hung vakin, Na kumsawt gam;
Nawpna pielgal ah thuong ei tunin.
Adam than thimsung ahin,
Aw Na eng ngaiin;
Tatna thisan lun zalin,
Nang ka hun sam hi.
Khawvel mauna’n a dim hi,
Nam tin chitin di’n;
Aw Eden ni eng tuoi nung,
Mu bang ka ngai ie,
Lautha khawvel ninnuom ah,
Laituol I len tieng;
Thim lal galhat nuoi zinmang,
Chu nuoisieh tai tiu.
Phat a kidang vaihawmna ni lopi,
Ni chengin ka naih zel;
Thepna leh lungkham buoina hi,
Ka dogal chu a hung lien ie.
Kei maiin ei umsak kin,
Ka kawmah um zelin;
Zion tang hawih ka tun ma chun,
Ka Hukdampa ei pui zelin.
Ka maah thepna luipi ahung lien,
Beihmang ka lau Lalpa;
Zie luipi a tum mangte chu,
Kumsawt gam tungta hiel puona.
Nova damlai a thil umzie bangin,
Leh Sodom khuo bangin;
Amauhaw nawpsak ngaihtuohna’n,
Aw Lalpa a kihei zo tau.
Na lehkhabu thienga zik mah bangin,
Khawvel hi a buoi tai;
Hehpihna a hung dai zo tai,
Buoina leh lungkham na’n a dim.
Khawvel gimtheihna leh lungkhamna hin,
Pa mel ei muhsak in;
Zion chate nawptatna ding,
Ni lopi chu a nai ta ie.
Doh is F S.S. 134. - T.S. 95
Isu kross ei naihsak in,
Tuikhuk lul umna chu;
Namtin di’n damtui manbei,
Kalvari a luong chuh.
Kross achun, Kross achun,
Ka lopina um hen;
Ka thagau kipak taka,
Luigala a chawlh ma’n.
Thagau lau kross kienga um,
Hehpih na’n eimu tai;
Ziechun Zingsawl vaktak chun,
Ka kimvel a salhvak.
Pathien Cha Kross kienga um,
Kross umdan ei hilh in;
Nicheng in ei panpih in,
Kross li’m in eilieh hen.
Kross kiengah ngakzing ingka,
Kinem taksang zingin;
Gamnuom chu ka tun macheng,
Luigal lehlam achun.
Luke 23:13
Doh is B8 S.S. 116. - T.S. 96
Hukdampa Kalvari-ah thi,
Ziechun ka Lal a khenden ui;
Kross-ah kei di’n A thisan luong,
Ka ngaihdamna ziechun A chawi.
Aw Kalvari, Kalvari thim,
Kei di’n Isu thisan luonna;
Aw Kalvari, Kalvari pha,
Hukdampa thii, ziechun kei di’n.
Suongpi khi leh van nim lakah,
Ka Hukdampa khunin, A thii;
Puonzak kithek chun a hihlang,
Van kipahna leh ni tawplo.
Aw Lal Isu, bangtin ahim,
Kei dinga Na hinna nei piek?
Kross pu ding leh lunggim dingin,
Phat lauh umah Kalvari ah.
Aw ka Hukdampa ka hun ngai na e,
Kei di’n lungngaih meipi a zing;
Aw Na mel deihum ka lungngaih ei nem,
Zingsawl Aksi hung vak kit in.
Aw, ka hun ngai hi ei umpih inla,
Na tel loh chun ka Hukdampa;
Ni ka tum zo puoi.
Ka mauna gamgaw leh buoina apat,
Ei nusie ki’n aw Hukdampa;
Aw na hehpihna chun ei tuom vel hi,
Lam lauhum a ka chieh lai hin.
Thihna Jordan lui hung lien mahleh le,
Ei umpih in aw Lal Isu;
Aw Na lampi galmuong sana tuol sung,
Nawpna lasan ei hawh sakin.
Salem kulh sung Hinna thinglim a chun,
Angelte’n ei umpih mahleu;
Aw Nangmah tello chun ka Hukdampa,
Nang ngaiin ni tum zo puong ka.
Khawvel lopina leh a hawihna cheng sangin,
Muh ka nuom ie Lal Krista mel chu;
Zehawtna puon silh in linglukhuk khu mahleh,
A hawih pen ie khawvel lal sang in.
Aw, ka kipahna pen Hukdampa,
Ka thamuonna pen leh ka kipahna Na hi;
Phatna’n hung pak in ka lunggil ah,
Tuoilo ding in kumsawt chan inle.
Hukdampa hehpihna hi kuoa gen thei ding?
Ei hawl in gimtheih tin cheng A thuok;
Bethlehem leh Kalvari tang ah ei hawl a,
Ei pui kit tai hehpihna huong ah.
Lalpa Na hehpihna mel hawih ei muhsak in,
Lungkham liengvai gimthei chate hih;
Zie khawvel siesa nung hi ngaiin tau puong ie,
Aw, Na ang lum ahin ei pawmin.
Hung kit ding ahi lopina tawh meichung ah,
A tatsate ei hung pui khawm di’n;
Lei dahum I pawtsan-na ding ni a nai tai,
Hallelujah ka kipak, Amen.
Upa Chunga
Kalvari hinna thisan lui luong,
Chapsuok menghen khawvel cheng leh gam hi;
Nangmah tatsa lei mihingte,
Thihna hansie kala leng ui.
Lalpa Isu Na lopina leh hehpihna,
Taklang mengin namtin laiah;
Mihing lung gitloh a liem san,
Na min lambang pak zaila sau hen.
Ka gam uh lungngaih buoina kalah,
Kuo a Lalpa, Hukdam dinga kuon ding;
Sim leh Mal a Nangmah minlun,
Panpihtu ding dang a um puoi.
Khawvel gitlohna meipi guol in,
A hung zing ie Lalpa ka lungguk ah;
Hun hal thieng in van mei kuongin,
Nang di’n pak thing bang lun kit ka.
Ka kap Lalpa Na gam lun ngai in,
Kum khawtuong gam leh lung lun Mang lenna;
Bangtik phat leh lungkham mauna,
Pela luonthi dai bang kan ding?
Lungkham buoina dogal a lien ie,
Lungngaih ni hin aw Na eng hung vak dawk hen;
Gal a lien ie Setan gal a lien ie,
Ei veng inla Na gam pello di’n.
Ei taihsan kin, ka Lal Immanuel,
Ka hun ngai pen ie khawvel ahin;
Buoina gal chu hung lien mahleh,
Ka bitna galvenbuk, kulhpi Na hi.
Aw Hukdampa thepna gal lien chun,
“Hun pieng ka ting aw, Gehen gam nuom” a tii;
Ka chieh ngam puoi mi gilo gawtmun chu,
Na gam gal muong Kanaan gam lo chu.
Nawpna pielgal ah leng mahleh chin,
Hun sam zel ingka Hukdampa mel deihum;
A hung lien ie Na gam do gitloh gal,
Kei din chiehna a khak, Nang zo in.
Na vak zam vel lalna gamnuom ah,
Gal a um ta puoi maw lungkham ta puong ka;
Muh ka nuom ie kei le ei pui kai in,
Angel vam leh mithienghaw lenna.

songs.title: Kross-a chun thisan lun a um

lines: Doh is E8 Old Sankey 88
Kross-a chun thisan lun a um,

Thisan chu Isun ei hetsak,

Kross chungah thisan lun aluong,

Kross chu, aw Kross giktak mai chuh,
Isu’n kei din A pu’i;
Lungkham taka A thawkna chuh,
Kalvari-ah A ngai.
A zang em, Kross lul takmai chuh,
Kross chuh ka vak thil a;
Kenle ka pukang zo dei mawh,
Bawl ingka Kraun um chuh.
Lallukhuk lopi pen mai chuh,
Galhat lallukhuk chuh;
Vanah Isu ka muh tieng leh,
Ken le ziechuh khu’ng ka.
Ka mitthitui pawt ta puona,
Hehpih haihloh na ah;
Khawvel apat ei puidawk in,
Nawpna mun ei tunin.

Muonna dang a um puoi nuoi simlei ah,

Pathien hehpihna lopi chu,

A gitloh A ngaidam.

Teh theih ding guol ei puoi!
Kumsawt chanin umzing ina,

Khawvel hun hi a beih tieng leh,

Hukdampa thisan lul apawt,

Nisa’n A mel a selgu a,

A thawknat zie ngaihtuoh ingka,

Ka pumin kipie mai ingka,
Zie mai chu ka theih tawp.
Ka kiengah um zingin Lalpa,
Khawvel thima ka len lai hin;
Nangmah ka phaw leh ka thaumei,
Ka lungthim hun salh vak inla;
Kumkhaw pielgal Na siem chu ei thilsak in.
Aw van Thagau hung lengin,

Nangmah lo chu khawvel ahin.

Midang chu sam puo’ng ka Lalpa,
Nang ei Hehpihpa lo hi chu.
Leiah mipi tamtak a um,
Vana mipi simsen loh tawh;
Ka pauchamna kuo dang kawmah,
Ka tun dem Nangmah kawmlo ah?
Thepna a hat tieng ka hun ngai,
Nuoizin gal a hat a chawl puoi;

“ Ka angsung galmuonna munah,

Na pauchamna ka ngilhdang em,

songs.title: Nanga ka hi, Na aw nem chuh ka zai

lines: Doh is A8 S.S. 607 - T.S. 104
Nanga ka hi, Na aw nem chuh ka zai,

Lalpa, Na kawm lam ei naihsak in,
Kross-a Na thihna achun;
Deihtak, Lalpa Na kawm lam ei naihsak in,
Na-nak thiengtho liemna chu.
Na nasem di’n ei kawihchuom in Lalpa,
Na thilbawl theihna mak chun;
Kinem in ka thagau in en zing hen,
Ka utna Nanga hi hen.
Kipahna thieng hun chawmcha mai ka neih,
Na chutphah maah ka mang;
Khupdina pauchamin Nang ka Pathien,
Guol bangin ka hun ho hi.
Hehpihna thuk ka hetphak loh a um,
Luipi lien chuh ka kan ma’n;
Kipakna sang ka chan nailoh a um,
Muonga, Nanga ka chawlh ma’n.

songs.title: Hukdampa zuon un vaigei lo in

lines: Doh is B8 Redemption Songs 123
Hukdampa zuon un vaigei lo in,

Hukdampa Na kawmah kikhawm kau,

lines: I Pet. 1:19

songs.title: Na gitloh puokgika pawt na nuom em?

lines: I Joh. 1:7
Doh is B8 S.S. 145 - T.S. 109
Na gitloh puokgika pawt na nuom em?
Thisan, hatna um, thisan hatna;
Gitloh chunga guolzo hih na nuom em?
Thisan ah hatna mak a um.
Hatna a..... um, hatna nasep mak,
Belam No thisan ah;
Hatna a.... um, hatna nasep mak,
Belam No....thisan lul achun.
Kideih, lungnat apat pawt na nuom em?
Thisan hatna um, thisan hatna;
Kalvari tuiphul ah thieng di’n hungin,
Thisan ah hatna mak a um.
Vuk sangin hahpin vamzawk na nuom em?
Thisan hatna um, thisan hatna;

Thisan ah hatna mak a um.

Thisan hatna um, thisan hatna;

Isu hehpihna ka het phetin,

Amah ka zuon, kipahna ka mui,

Ka lungkhamna cheng cheng A chiehpih,
Kipakin kei um tang ka;
A kawma kumsawt kipahna chu,

Ni cheng gitlohna’n ei tuom mahleh,

A lopinan ei panpih in tin,
Thepna haw zo ngei ingka.
A hehpihnaa ka chawlh in, Ka Pa’n ei he tai;
A deih bang thil ka bawl chengin,
Vang ei pe zing hi,
Phatchuom ngaihna dan ka hetin,
Kei din vangsakna;
Lungkhama lunghei na vangin,
Hehpihna ka mui.
A chaa ka na um man le; ka Pa’n ei he tai;
Gamgaw haksa a ka um in,

Kei gilo a hih lungkham leh zahhuoi sakpa,
