lines: Hehpihna Kuong chuh a kalto tai,
Isu’n Van lampi chuh A siem tai;
A dogal a-sang-a-za A zo,
Hun pui ina Van chung gam nuomah.
Gam nuoma um dingin (2)
Lam dik lamah hung-un-u-leh-nau,
Gam nuom um dingin (2)
Lam dik lamah hung-un-u-leh-nau.
Zie gam chuh manlo in chang hitiu,
Aman ei lungsiet nasat ziekin;
Bangdi’n em ginglo a I um ding?
Gingin, hung mai tau uo u-leh-nau.
Hehpihna Kuong chuh tuhin chieh leh,
Hung kileh kit puona sam leng le;
Zion gam nuom zuonin chieh tana,
Nang kap ta’n la tuisanglien galah.
Isu’n lainat in A hun sam ie,
Ginglote hawn gingin hun zuon un;
Tichun lungsietna Kuong hum un lau,
Pathien lungsietna gam tunna ding.

songs.title: Hinkhuo phat sung a chawm hi

lines: Doh is E8 S.S. 437 - T.S. 168
Hinkhuo phat sung a chawm hi,
Thingnah pulh zel bang ahi;
Buhphal kankhawm bang ahi, Kisau in!
Ni bei zel hin ei hilh hi;
Thihna hungtung pai ding chuh,
Damlai sunni tum ina, Kisau in!
Kisau in; Kisau in!
Isu Awn A hun sap lai hin, Kisau in!
Gilo a na um zing chun,
Hinna kawt hawn mu puon la,
Nang di’n hun kikhel ina; Kisau in!
Pakcha hawihpen a vuoi pai,
Hat lai, hawih lai a hung bei;
Aw hun sawt na neita puou,
Kisau in!
Thagau thieng hun chiel lai hin,
Mi gilo vakmang ta ki’n;
Manthaina chuh tuok khan lau,
Kisau in!
Phat kintak in a bei zel,
Thihna, vaihawmna anai;
Isu ban chu hun bel un,
Kisau in!
A lulzie chuh ngaihtuoh in,
A phat a kikhelh mahin,
Na thau gawtmun a tun ma’n,
Kisau in!
Gilo, hilhna Aw ngai in,
Lalpa chuh hun pawm inla;
Van mipi kipak unau,
Kisau in!
Thim apat vak ah hung un,
Isun hun na siemphan a;
Van zuon di’n tun kipan un,
Kisau in!

songs.title: Isu’n A kiu, A hun sam

lines: Thup. 3:20
Doh is D8 S.S. 358 - T.S. 170
Isu’n A kiu, A hun sam,
Chaute’n ei hun zuon un ti’n;
Ama’n A hun hukdam thei,
Aw kawt hawng lien un!
Aw kawt hawng lien un,
Aw kawt hawng lien un;
Ama’n A hun hukdam thei,
Aw kawt hawng lien un.
A kiu, hukdam di’n A hung,
Nang di’n A hinna A piei;
Than chungah A guolzo tai,
Aw kawt hawng lien un!
Isu chun, A kiu zing hi,
Na utna cheng Amah pie’n;
Na lung sukipak ina,
Aw kawt hawng lien un!
Isun A kiu hun bei zel,
Hukdamna a naih lai hin
Hukdampa’n A hun pelh ma’n,
Aw kawt hawng lien un.

songs.title: Migilo hungin, A hun sam hi

lines: Sam 55:2
Doh is G S.S. 347 - T.S. 173
Migilo hungin, A hun sam hi,
Isu keng bul ah;
Hungin, lunghei in, na puok chu nga’n,
Isu keng bul ah!
Aw hung nga’n la, hungnga’n la,
Na lunggil gikpuok nga’n la;
Aw hung nga’n la, hung nga’n la,
Isu keng bul ah.
Hungin, gingin na chawlh nang hawlin,
Isu keng bul ah;
Na lungthim gikpuok chu hung nga’n la,
Isu keng bul ah.
Hungin, ginna’n a hun hihdam thei,
Isu keng bul ah;
Aw, na thagau chau chu hun pui in,
Isu keng bul ah!
Hungin, Lalpa pakin mun a um,
Isu keng bul ah;
Na gitloh gikpuok cheng chu nga’n la,
Isu keng bul ah.
Doh is G S.S. 449 - T.S. 183
Kiheiin mimang lungkham leh gimthei,
Ngaiin, Belampu pha’n tu’n A hun sam;
Hukdam ding leh silthien di’n A hun ngak,
Kinin, Amah pawm di’n vaigei ta ki’n.
Aw nemin A hun sam, A hun chiel zing,
Belampu pha hun sapna ngaiin;
Aw nemin A hun sam, A hun chiel zing,
Lungsiet awn “Ei hun zuonun” A tii.
A hun ngak zing hi, bang dia mangthai ding?
Huong apat vakmang gamla mahleh chin;
A hinna thisan in A hun tan tai,
A hehpih mak gen theih ding guol ei puoi!
A thu ngaiin, A lungsiet ngaihtuoh in,
Gilo kimahleh nang gitloh A puo’i;
Ngaihdamna bukim leh kumsawt hinna,
A tatna zalin nang a hun pie tai.
Lamlui ah hungin lam dik ah hungin,
Isu achun lutin, Kawtkhak ahi;
Belampu ahi, Aw nemin hun sam,
Hatlo sa’n hung inla, vakvai ta ki’n.
Rosiem
Ei suonte gitloh mawl ziekin,
Thihna leh lungkhamna haw hi,
Nam tin chungah a leng ui,
Kei chunga le a tun tieng;
Lungkham na’n ka dim sek hi.
Ka ngai ie kumsawt gam,
Ka ngai ie ka Pa gam khu; Thagau in ei puiin,
Hehpihte chawlhna mun chu, ei tun teiin.
Khawvel hinkhuo ka ngaih tuohin,
Lunga mawlin ka lung a zing;
Thapham muol a liem u hin,
Bangkim ka gel kimvel tieng,
Ka lungkhamna a khawk diek.
Hehpih chiehsate ka thilin,
Phamsate ngaiin ka sama;
Nung lam ngailo in leng ui,
Lalchutphah chu kimvel in,
“Hallelujah” ti’n leng ui.
Van khawpi thaka ka tuntieng
Gibang kikhenna bei tan a
Lungdeih cheng kimna munah
Angel vam serafim tawh
Lal lungnem chu awi tang kau.

songs.title: Na phat hih mawkin mangbei ki’n

lines: I Let. 18:21
Ward : S.S. 335
Na phat hih mawkin mangbei ki’n,
Pathien Thu kizak mawh sak ki’n;
Migilo, na lungkhauh sak ki’n,
Tu’n hun awi ngal in.
Bang di’n awi nuom lo?
Bang na uoi-ai em?
Awiin, dam na’n,
Bang di’n awi nuomlo?
Zing khawvak le na mulo thei,
Zan khat mitsin tuok thei na hi;
Suohpih, sanggam, nu-le-pate,
Tu’n hun awi ngal un.
Ama’n A hun lainat ngal in,
Nang Amah bengkhawn loh guo maw;
Na dahna cheng hun nultha’n la,
Tu’n hun awi ngal un.
Pathien hehpihna’n A dim hi,
Kuole Amah kawma nuom chuh;
A tawp chanin A hukdam thei,
Tu’n hun awi tei un.
Thangngur
Kanaan gamthak lam chu zuonin,
Gamthipa khuol ka zin; ziet leh veia tuonglam vaiin;
Mei leh meipi’n kilak in,
Ka maah Nang ni bang vakin.
Aw ei Hukampa naubang ei puiin,
Kanaan gam tun loh ka lau ie;
Lungngaih lummei zing nuoiah,
Kap leh mauin albang ka vai.
Gamthipa lumsuongpi sunga, damtui thieng hung put hen;
Kanaan zuon zaitha chawl dawn ding,
Gamthipa ka chamsung in,
Aigupta lunga ngilhna di’n.
Ka maah zatam a lut tau, Kanaan gam thak a chun;
Bangdin em nungtieng ka ngaih ding ?
Thihna gam thuong nungsieh in,
Hinna vangkhawpi zuon ingka.
Chung si-al in thangvan zawlah, Lalpa a chawian ui;
A gimtheih nau cheng ngilh zo in,
Nunnawpna la thak a sau,
Vabang buol ding chu ka nuom ngei!
Runchawng
Mubang ka ngai ka lal nunnem lenna,
Lautha, Jordan ei pui kai in;
Nitum lohna gam ei tunin.
Aw, mitin nawpna pielgal ninnuom,
Lungsietna zam vel nuoia chun,
Lili pak hawih lunna gamah.
Thepna ngomei chu a hung zam vel ie,
Mithieng te lailenna mun chu;
Tunkal ka ngaklah ngei ie aw !
Pak bang tuoi hen nuoi simlei gimum hi,
Ei hung puiin aw, Lal Isu;
Zan um lohna Na gama chun.
Aw, zemun chu kei le ka tun tieng leh,
Ka umna hi ngai ta puong ie;
Nunnuom in ngabang leng tang ka.
Lienrum
Khawvel Aigupta gam ahin,
Muonna kipahna ka hawla;
Damsung mat zawh guon ka bawla,
Kahna leh lungkhamna mai a hung hii.
Aw, ka pienna hi kumsawt gam ei puoi,
Muonna kipahna hawl mah leng
Mu zo puong ie, a mun ei puoi,
Lal Krista gam ahih loh ziekin.
Gam beimang dinga lenghaw hi,
Ei tatna thisan lun ziekin;
Kumsawta hinna chang dingin,
Namtin chitin a dingin A hawng tai.
Aw zie muna chun leng dingin,
Lalpa, Na hatnan ei puiin,
Khawvel nunnawp beimanna hi,
Ngaiin en nawn puong ie nunlui gam hi.
Hehpihna Lal gam zuon dingin,
Aw ka lautha nang le hawlin;
Khawvel hawihnan hun sam mah leh,
Lili pak Lal nunnem in A hun ngak.
Thangngur
Khawvel in “Sesum leh sana,
A lul,” ti’n a hawl viel ui,
Mahleh a lulnau chun Pielgal a tun zo puoi,
Van hawihnan Pielgal a salhvak
Ziechuh ahi ka gen nuom.
A chanchin gen thiem leng Aw thangvan khu,
A hawih zie gen thiem leng aw ka Lal lenna;
Mitin in suilung in gulh leu,
Van In nuomah hung lawi leu.
Khawvel lopina leh hawihna,
Ni tam tak a liem zo tai;
Mahleh van hawihna chu, khangthak tamtak beih nung
A thakin a hawih deuh deuh hi
Ziechuh ahi gen takpen.
Van In hawih lopi leh sang chu
Kawt chu khuna lut ahi
Aw Kalvari tang leh, Bethlehem bawng In ah
Kuol ding leh Kross A put ding khan
Kuo Lal puon tawh a chieh dem ?
Bangtik leh ka vaihna gam leh
Ka kahna gam hi beiin
Thangvan gam lopi leh hawih gen senloh gam lun
A bukim in a hung tung dem
A ngaiin nau bang ka kap.

songs.title: Aw Pathien! Hinna Thupha chuh nei piei

lines: Doh is G Welsh Tune Book - T.S. 274
Aw Pathien! Hinna Thupha chuh nei piei,
Ka kipak zing tau - Tuhin,
Hallelujah, Amen.
Gamtin, muoltin ah muikhuo thim bang zing,
Hinna Ni A eng - Isu,
Hallelujah, Amen.
Phungguol, namtin chung hun salhvak hen la,
Van Hinna Ni eng-Isu’n,
Hallelujah, Amen.
Doh is D S.S. 1068 - T.S. 174
Gimtheihna leh buoina khel khu,
Aw ka thagau, thil zingin;
Pathien thutiem kilang intin,
Lungsietna ni lopi chuh.
Van Jubili, Van Jubili,
Na ni lopi hung suok hen! (4)
India mite, Negro mite,
Leh nam ngawng dang ten heu hen;
Kalvari a hung kilang kha,
Pathien zawhna lopi chuh.
Chanchin Pha chun, Chanchin Pha chun,
Sim tawp, Mal tawp, hun thawng hen. (4)
Thim nuoi a um gam lien haw ah,
Hukdamna vak tun sakin;
Suohlam apat tumlam chan in,
Khawvak chun zan nawh mang hen.
A tatna chuh, a tatna chuh,
Chang u henla, khuovak hen. (4)
Sunni lopi chuh hung nai hen,
Khawvak lopi hung lang hen;
Kumkhuo tuonga Chanchin Pha chun,
Na min gamtin ah phuong hen.
Gamtin cheng ah, Gamtin cheng ah,
Immanuel gamtin ah. (4)
Gospel lengin, gamtin cheng ah,
Guolzo zelin, hailo in;
Na kumkhuo Lalgam lien tak chuh,
Hung lien hen khangto zel hen.
Khawvel cheng cheng, Khawvel cheng cheng,
Hukdampa, Na gam hi hen. (4)
Thilsiem tincheng - Gan leh lohing,
Pathien guot banga um in;
Pa, Chapa, Thagau Thieng pakin,
Hehpih Pathien chawian leu.
Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Lei chung hi pakna’n dim hen. (4)
V.T. Kappu
Ginnan Kalvari tang chung achun,
Gam ngaihum leh khuo thiengtho a lang ie;
Mi thiengthote lenna,
Zie khawpi chu kei le ka tun tieng,
Damsung buoina leh gimum hin,
Ei chuppha ta puona.
Ei chuppha puona tih ka het in,
‘Hallelujah’, ti’n Lalpa ka pakcha’i;
Ei na tatdawk ziekin;
Gitloh gikpuo leh thiemloh changsa;
Thisan in thiem ei chansak hi,
Gam hawih a leng dingin.
Gam hawih achun keile ka len tieng,
Khawvel gimum hi zuk gal thil ka ting;
Ka vakvaih na gam hi,
Ziechun ka mitthi pawt ta puona,
Ka Lalpan ei umpih intin,
Nunglam ngai ta puong ka.
Lalpa ngaia ka mauna gam hi,
Ka thagau in a pawtsan zawh tieng leh;
Lalpa’n ei pui intin,
A thazak chungah ei chuonsak in,
Jordan tui kinawk lauhum chu;
Ei lenkaih pih tana.
Zalawma
Van gam lopi tak chanchin,
Kuo ahim a genthei ding ?
Lungkhamna lei gimuma I len lai hin ?
Hukdampa Isu Krista’n sinsak a hehpih kawmah,
Van gam lopi zie chu a na hetsak tai
Aw van gam hawih leh nuom tak chu,
Len guol kima kikhen lohna gam ahi;
Hehpihna gam hawih zam vel,
Lopina vak hawih zam vel,
Keile tung ka, zie gam hawih leh nuomtak chu,
Zie khawpi vak hawih tak chu,
A min Jerusalem thak;
A khuo umna bang chu suongmantam ahi,
Mi gen minthang sana leh dangka a zephawih ahi;
A umna tuikawk suonga zephawih ahi.
Zie khawpi nuom tak achun,
Nisa vak a ngai ta puoi;
Tha leh aksi vak haw le ngai ta puona;
Lalpa chu a vak hin tin, Ho In le um ta puona;
Lalpa Isu mu’n Amah chu ho tai tiu.
A hehpihna leh phatna,
Chu chawian in la sai tiu;
Lungkhamna leh gitloh kihdak-umna haw,
Kidona um ta puon tin In hawih lopi kawtkhak ah;
Lalpa hehpihte mai chu lut thei unau.
Zamgen
Sietlei hingmi zatam suilung damna dingin,
Min lun Chung Pathien in vawn tuoidawng ei chawihsak;
Tuni hin ken le ka pawm hi ka etchim loh,
Chung Pathien in veng hen A vanglim nuoi ahin.
U leh nau in kipakin ei lawppih chiet un,
Kipahna chul theilo go thil bang ei piek hi;
Paktil bangin chawi hitiu nausen deihum hi,
A dam kumkhuo sawt hen a vanglim nuoi ahin.
A chun leh zuo’n kumsawta ka lungtup pen uh,
Thimthu leh laigilah siktui in um mahleh;
Chung Pathien venna leh thahatna zalzo in,
Anglai a pawmin vawnsen sakmel I mu tai.
Lawp chim puong ie vawnsen tuoi til dawng lai cha hi,
Chung Pathien leh a chun leh zuo suihlung tuok di’n;
Chang bang damin laituol nga bangin leng hen la,
Suihlung pilin a hinkhuo gui bangin sau hen.
Malsawmna lien, vangphatna lien thilthawnpiek hi,
Nausen deihum laigila pieng vawntuoidawng hi,
Gentheia alang vailo dingin sietlei ah,
Chung Pathien in khawtuoh zing ta hen la, Amen

songs.title: Ka hehpih, Ka hehpih, ka hehpih Lalpa

lines: Doh is E8
Ka hehpih, Ka hehpih, ka hehpih Lalpa,
Ka Hukdampa, Pathien, ka hun hehpih hi;
Nang ka hun hehpih hi, ziechuh Nang Na he’i,
Ka hun hehpih zie chuh, ka sep in phuong ding.
Ka kipak, ka kipak, aw, a gen a nuom,
Kipahna tuoi thei lo, tangsip ah ka ding;
Ka go chuh ka gal thil, ziechun um ka nuom,
Isu leh Angel leh, it leh ngaih cheng tawh.
Nang kawma um a nuom, Hukdampa Isu,
Ka hinna, Hukdamna, Kipahna, chawlhna;
Na min ka thupi, na hehpihna ka la,
Na hehpihna’n ka lung, ka lei hihdim hen.
Hukdampa bang kuo a? Salem Lal ahi,
Maitai in ei hehpih; la ei saksak hi;
Chawian ka, chawian ka, aw ngeih, thieng takin,
Kipahna lui luongin, katha a hih lawp.
Lienrum
Chung Pathien vangsakna go thil
Vawnsen deihum kei di’n tuoilo pak
Muh loh laigil a damtui bang vung
Vawnsen pallai kei di’n a hung vul
Pak bang chawi ka, kei ngaih ding dieng
Chang bang damin suihlung pil hen
Sakmel eta pawm chim loh vawnsen
Laigil vangsakna go thilpha
Tuona chung Pathien thimthu tiemsa
Kei din vawn dawng a hung pak san sel
Sakmel deihum tuoisen chul mawh hen.
Chung Pathien vang gobang channa,
Vawnsen pallai zatam suihlung nem pen
Zuo chung Pathien, Na banzal nuoiah,
Ka hun piei damsung Nang nasem ding.

songs.title: Aw Pathien Na Min Lien Hen

lines: Khaikhawmang
Doh is D Tune S.S 380
Thilsiem chung Pathien Min zanglawi bang thang hen,
Simlei nam tinin zailan chawi-an hen la
Aw Lalpa, Na thilsiem te hi vang hun pie’n
Na ma ah ka hun lan ui.
Thilsiem chung Pathien zaitha hat vangin
Thaithak sakmel kipahum I mu tau ie
Chawian un Lalpa a lien a neute haw
Aw Pathien, Na min lien hen.
A lien a neu lungtuok na Thilsiem Pathien
Thang hen la, lien hen, Na min kawl kimvel ah
Enkawl in, Aw chung Pathien, Na thilsiem te,
Sing zatam guo bang hinna’n.
Zaila leh thimthu’n chawian un, Lal Minlun,
A thilsiem haw gen vielun, kawl kimvel ah;
Van nuoi mi zatam guo bang I hinna di’n,
Chawian un, Lalpa Pathien.
Rev. K. Thuomngel
Lalpa chu chawian hitiu,
A lungsietna I muh u hin;
Thilsiem chengin,
Amah chawihatna la sau hen la,
Ei khawtuohna a let ziekin.
Lungsietna thilpiek, thaithak kipah um,
Kipahna la sa’n lawm hitiu;
Aman guoh zu, nisa, khawlum leh khaw vawt,
Thaichi gahna dinga ei piek ziekin;
Chawih-atin um hen, chawih-atin um hen, um hen.
Chawih-atin um hen, Amen.
Thaichi chu I va tuh a,
Hih theih dang bangmah I nei puoi;
Mah leh Lalpa
Hatna a etkawla umin tun,
Thaithak kipahum I mu tau.
Mel muh loh ginna mita
Ena sawttak hai bang I ngak;
Lalpa lungsietna vanga-
Etkawla um in tun,
Thaithak sakmel I mu tau ie.
Lalpa, ka hun chawian ui,
Na lungsietna ka muh u hin;
Ka pawihmawh chenguh Nangin,
Nei ngaihtuoh sak zela,
Chawih-atin um zing ta’n, Amen.
Sawngkhawkhai
Chung Pathien sam suihin tuona pi leh pute,
A kigawm ui sietlei luoh ding, vawnchawi di’n;
Chung Pathien lai tanna thimthu gui bang zawtin
Sietlei chungah vawn zatam chibang a hun theh ui
Aw Lalpa, ka ngetnau ngaiin
Zie thutiem hi Nang hun zawmin
Tu-a lungsietna gui khau bang zawp hi
Chin leh tuoi leh guol lungtuok ten
Chung Pathien leh lei mite angah
Ka hetpih chiet ui
Lalpa, Na dan thienga chawnban hun zawmte hin
Zuomang min siel thimthu duh ai bang samin
Damlai kawlni a liem man pallai lo bang chul leh
Thimthu tiemah kumsawt in kigawm det uh hen
Tuon leh tanga pi pu lung mawlte dungsun in,
Pai tin chawia ki lungsietna tawplo di’n
Chung Pathien samsuih thutiem lam bang pel loin
Phunglai chawi thiem pai kuoh di’n Aw Lalpa vang hun pie’n.

songs.title: Chanchin Pha phuongzak un, mihiem umna chengah

lines: Doh is C S.S. 198
Chanchin Pha phuongzak un, mihiem umna chengah,
Mi lunggil sung lungkhamna a umna cheng ah;
Kristien chengin thu kipahum phuongzak uhen,
Lungmuonpa A hung tung!
Lungmuonpa A hung tung (2)
Van apat Thagau Thieng, Pa tiem chuh piek ei tai;
Chanchin Pha phuongzak un, mihiem umna cheng ah,
Lungmuonpa A hung tung!
Zan sawt chuh a bei tai, taikhuo a hung vak tai,
Lungkhamna leh thil lauhum cheng chuh a bei tai;
Tang hawihtak apata, kawl ni no suok bangin,
Lungmuonpa A hung tung!
Lalpente Lalpen chun, sukdamna chuh nei in,
Thagau saltangte cheng, pawtna thu A hun puoi;
Gitloh suoka pawt ten, zawhna la hun sa’n au,
Lungmuonpa A hung tung!
I lungthim gil ahin, Hehpihna thu lien hen,
Kumsawt lam mansakte, ma I puih theih na’ng un;
Khawvel gitloh thimah, eihaw ei hihvak di’n,
Lungmuonpa A hung tung.
Leisiet gam kimvel ah, zie thu hi kithang hen,
Van mi thiengte guola lei mite umna di’n;
Hehpih tawp neilo la, haih ni um ta puona,
Lungmuonpa A hung tung!

songs.title: Greenland vuk gam apat leh, India gam apatin

lines: Doh is F S.S. 1070 - T.S. 185
Greenland vuk gam apat leh, India gam apatin,
Africa gam haksa leh, gam dang tamtak apat;
Luilien panga chengte, leh tang leh phai a miten,
Gitloh hatkawl apat a, Hukdawk di’n ei sam ui.
Silon tuikuol nuom chungah, huihchim pha a hung nung,
Etna mun cheng a hawih a, mihing mai a gilo;
Pathien thilpiek simsen loh, changin a um ngal un,
Mahleh Pathien helo ten Thing, Suong bul a ho ui.
Eihaw chunglam chitna a Thagau hihvak sate’n,
Vakna pie lo ding I him, thim laka chengte chuh?
Hukdamna! Aw hukdamna, kiko pih zel unla,
Lei gam tawpa chengte’n le, Messia min a het na’n.
Huih nungin A thu tawk un, tui luong inle tawk un,
Tuisuohgiet lien tak banga, gamtin a luoh suok ma’n;
Belam No gilote ding-a thi chuh hungtun ma’n,
Tanpa, Lalpen, leh Siempa, Panpih in na pang un.
Doh is A8 Redemption sons 233 - T.S. 194
Na kuong tawl phatloh ziekin,
Kuong chawlhna mun nuom apat,
Tuilien in awl awlin a hun tawk zel hi;
A thukna lai lam zuonin,
Tuipi lien leh lauhum ah,
Tuilien in awl awl in a hun tawk zel hi.
A hun tawk gamla deuh deuh hi,
Tuipi lien leh lauhum ah;
Pathien lungsietna, bitna huongsung apatin,
Manthaina mun lam zuonin,
Tuilien in awl awlin ahun tawk zel hi.
Gam nuom lama thilvak chun,
Um ding dan a hun hilh zing,
Tuilien in awl awlin a huntawk zel hi;
Kuongchawlhna mun apatin,
Na kuong tawk mang pai khana,
Tuilien in awl awl in a hun tawk zel hi.
Gam nuom apata Aw chun,
A hun sapnau chuh ngaiin,
Tuilien in awl awl in a hun tawk zel hi;
Khai, suohpih, a Awu ngaiin,
A phat a kikhelh mahin,
Tuilien in awl awl in a hun tawk zel hi.
Isu neih hinna nuom,
Kipahna thuguk chu;
Ka thagau muonna ei pie’i,
Isu neih chauh kipahna.
Isu neih chitna bulpi,
Isu neih hauhna bukim;
Isu neih chu vannuoi tawh kikhenna.
Isu neih hinna nuom,
Mihau hawn neizo lo;
Miching hawn a hethiem puou,
Kuo zieka dangchak ahim?
Van Kanaan ka In ding,
Khawvel ka khuolzinna;
Aigupta a hak taluo’i,
Ka Lal Isu ei puiin.
Ken Isu kanei hi,
Genviel leng vannuoi ah;
Taksanna’n ka muchien tai,
A thihna mel Kross bul ah.
Lal na semtu te a kiting puou,
Lalgam panpih ding I um puou maw?
Kumsawt gawtmun lam chu zuonin,
Thagau simsen loh a beimang zing ui.
Aw Krista a ding a pasalphate,
Simsen loh te a man zing lai un;
Mangthai dingte I puihloh chun,
Lalpa kawmah bang I gen dem ?
A thisan mawh I khut ah na ngen in a.
Lal nasemtu te a tawm taluou,
Panpihtu ding guol a ngai nau e
Panpihtu ding I um puou maw ?
I Lalpau bangziek a gimthei a him ?
Lal nasemtu te a tawm taluou,
Lalpa Isun nangle a hun sam,
Khawvel kipahna bei pai ding
Hun taihsan in Lalpa dingin sem in
Lal na semte panpih a ngai ui
I thil neihteu khawi ah a um tam ?
Lalpa gama dingin piei tiu,
A hun tawk nai puoi, a huntawk nai puoi.

songs.title: Chanchin Pha dakte a giu, Gamtin leh tuipi chungah

lines: Doh is F S.S. 356
Chanchin Pha dakte a giu, Gamtin leh tuipi chungah;
Hukdamna manbei kipah um, Nang leh kei ei hun tun ui;
Pathien khawvel hehpih, A Chapa neihsun A piei;
Amah gingcha taphawtte chun,
Kumsawt hinna changun au.
Chanchin pha dak a giu,
Gamtin leh tuipi chung ah;
Chanchin pha’n a hun tun,
Nang leh kei di’n vangsak na.
Chanchin Pha dakin ei chiel, Mitin guolvakna di’n;
Chielna ngaihsak loin um ki’n, Hehpih sapna chu niel ki’n;
“Hinna Changthak Ka hi, Thagau a gilkiel te An;
Na gitloh sandup bang mahleh,
Vuk bangin hung vam ina”!
Chanchin Pha dak vau lawkna, Nichengin a hung gi zel;
A vaigei taphawtte dinga, Thihna lauhum hung tung ding;
“Na hinna di’n taidawk in, Phaicham ale kichawl ki’n”
Na nunglam nga kit hiel kinla,
Kumsawt gawtna thuok kha’n la.
Chanchin Pha dak kipahum, Gamtin, muntin, a thawng hi;
Ngaihdamnabukim thuchuhpuo’n, KhetdenHukdampaziekchun;
“Chanchin Pha kipahum, Micheng dingin ka hun puoi;
Nanguh di’n Hukdampa a pieng,
Krista Lal, Lalpen chuh.”
Doh is B8 III Alexander 327 - T.S. 186
Na thil lopite gen ahi,
Zion I Pathien khawpi;
A thu suksiet kit theihloh pa’n,
A hun siem Amah chenna’n;
Kumsawt Suongpi a kinga chuh,
Bangin a hun sulawk dem?
* Hukdamna banga ki umin,
Na galte lau ta puon la (2)
Lalpa Zion khawpi achun,
Lungsieta nei telsak chun;
Khawvel in ei musit mahleh,
Na min mai suong zing ingka,
Khawvel kipah na abei zel,
Alopi leh hawihna tawh.
* Zion chate mai ngal lo chun,
Kipahna pha a nei puou (2)
Enin, kumsawt hehpihna ’pat,
Tuihing luite hung pawtin;
Na chate cheng cheng a vaka,
A taksap lauh nau cheng bei;
Ziebang lui chuh a luon sungin,
Kuo a dangchaka chau ding?
* Kumkhuo’n lungsietna hai puo’n a,
Lalpa a piepa guolin (2)
Amun kimvel cheng cheng achun,
Lopina leh bitna di’n;
Mei leh meipi a kilang ui,
Lalpa anai tih hetna’n;
Nicheng Manna a mau Piepa,
A sapna hawu Ngaithapa.
* Hossana! Chawihatna la chuh,
A Lalchutphah tungto hen (2)
K. Siema 1977
Solomon leh Nehemia Puitu
Ka lam u-ah Nangmah hung pangin
Ho-In zawhin a um taa,
Jerusalem Temple guol khan luohin
Thagau Thiengtho in hun luoh in
Na min thieng lopina ding leh
Hatlo te hat thakna dingin
Vangpiek na’n hun thuomin, Lalpa
Na Ho-In thieng sunga hung lut a
A gitloh nau thupha hung chawia
Nangmah masang a hung khunte
Kalvari thisan zalin ngaidam in.
Na chanchin Pha thu gentute leh
Na Ho-In sunga nasemtu te
Panpihtu nai zing ka Lalpa
Panpih in Thagau Thiengtho in thuomin
Khawvel mite thuneihna ding leh
Nang helote vaihawmna dingin
Aw Lalpa, Nangin phal ki’n la
Vengtu dingin Cherub ka ngen Lalpa.

songs.title: Sapchuom kingakna khat mai, Lal Isu Krista chuh

lines: III Alexander 241 - T.S. 188
Sapchuom kingakna khat mai, Lal Isu Krista chuh;
Lalpa thilsiem thak ahi A thu leh Thagau in,
Van apat hung kumsuk in, A mo di’n a hung hawl,
A thisan ngeiin a chaw’i, Sapchuomte hinna di’n.
Namtin laka teldawk te, Krista a kipum khat,
Hukdamna khat, pienna khat, Lalpa khat, Ginna khat;
Min khat manga limbawl in, Ankuong khat u khawmin,
Kinepna khat mai neia, Hehpihna piek I hiu.
Gim theih leh buoina lak a nicheng galdo na ah,
Kumsawt muonna bukim chuh thuokhat taka ngakin;
A vangsakna bukim chuh a mita mu dingin,
Sapchuom vangsakna lopi, Kumsawt chawlhna chang di’n.
Lei chunga a um inle, Pathien Mi-thum pumkhat,
Lei a a tatsate cheng, Muhtheih loh a kizawm;
Aw thiengtho leh nuomsa te, Lalpa ei vangsak in,
Kingainiem leh nunnem a, Nang tawh kivawp zing di’n.
Sam 71:4
Doh is F S.S. 1119 - T.S. 187
Krista Sapchuom di’n I ding,
Lunggil a kizawm in;
Muk a pak thu gen di’n,
I khut hatlo huh di’n;
I keng mangthai hawl di’n,
Krista, Sapchuom di’n.
Krista Sapchuom di’n I ding,
Lunggil a kizawm in;
Tu apat I hinnau I pieu,
Krista, Sapchuom di’n.
Krista Sapchuom di’n I ngen,
Ni chenga sem zelin;
Gunchuh leh hangsan in,
Na chuh sem zel dingin;
I thuthun tudet in,
Krista, Sapchuom di’n.
Krista Sapchuom di’n la sa’n,
Kipak a chawian in;
Ei suohchak sak ziekin,
Zawhna ei tiem ziekin;
I thupiu hizing hen,
Krista, Sapchuom di’n.

songs.title: “Krista leh Sapchuom di’n” Aw suoh hitiu,

lines: Doh is D S.S. 1096 - T.S. 195
“Krista leh Sapchuom di’n” Aw suoh hitiu,
I Lalpen uh deihum min chuh chawian hitiu;
Lawptak in hat tawpin A na sem hitiu,
Dikna lalgam a di’n theihtawp suoh hitiu.
Tanpa deihum, Krista di’n,
Hukdampa, Krista di’n;
Thisan a A chawk, Sapchuom di’n,
Lalpa hatna ei pie’n.
“Krista leh Sapchuom di’n” paucham hitiu,
A puonlap zui hitiu, nicheng a Kross chuh pu’n;
Thagau Thieng hatna ah kipumpiek hitiu,
Damsung chenga ginuma A na semin.
“Krista leh Sapchuom di’n” paucham hitiu,
Phat leh theihna leh I sumuh Hukdampa di’n;
I neih pha penuh Amah dingin piei tiu,
Lunggil hehpihna tuoi thei ngeilo pumin.
“Krista leh Sapchuom di’n” paihvek hitiu,
Mihinna, lauhna, chapona, Amah ziekin;
I lungtup in I damsung hun hihnuom hen,
Kipakin ei sapna achun chieh hitiu.

songs.title: Aw I bawnun pang hitiu, lunggil leh theihtawp in

lines: Doh is B8 S.S. 1109 - T.S. 189
Aw I bawnun pang hitiu, lunggil leh theihtawp in,
I Lalpau nasem in, A nasepa kipak in;
Kipahman sa’n ma’n sep ding ahi tih hezing in,
Pa deihbang leh A thu a semin, kipak hitiu.
Krista, Sapchuom di’n,
Lalpa, bangcheng ka pie’u;
Krista, Sapchuom di’n,
Theihtawp in pang ung kau!
Aw I bawnun pang hitiu, Krista Lalgam ke’k di’n,
Muntin hawla, gitloh apat thagau hukdam di’n
Khawvel gam tina Chanchin Pha thu phuongzak dingin,
Chitin, zat tinin Chanchin Pha a zak masieh un.
Aw I bawnun pang hitiu, Krista Sapchuom phut di’n,
A nasep ah ginum in, I bangcheng Amah pie’n;
A dan tincheng zawp a, a chawndan haw ngaisang in,
Chun, Krista batna a khanglien in, hinkhuo beihma’n.

songs.title: Ka mawhna puokgik leh lei dahum hi

lines: Thup. 22:17
Doh is E8 III Alexander 265
Ka mawhna puokgik leh lei dahum hi,
Thangvan ka et leh ziechun lut ka nuom;
Van In nuom achun gitlohna umlo,
Hungin ti a ei sapna Aw ka za’i.
Zie gam thiengtho leh lopi tak achun,
Migilo ka hi ka ding ngam na dem;
Zie Lalchutphah vam lopi ma achun,
Mahleh va naih di’n khutin ei sam hi.
Nicheng in Van lampi chuh ka ngaihtuoh,
Mahleh gitlohna’n nicheng in ei zui;
Ka nakhang in thu kipahum ka za’i,
“Kisik in, haiin hing inla” ei tii.
Ka zak hi Lalpa Isu Aw ahi,
A khut in ei ban hi ei pui dingin;
A thisan in, gitloh cheng a khuhmang,
Lalchutphah maah dembei in ei kawih.
Kitupna Lalpa, kei di’n dawngin la,
Na titna zalin kipahman keia;
Linglukhuk Na khu’i keima’n Lallukhuk,
Na thihna kei di’n hinna a hung hii.
Ka hun bat Lalpa hun din zo puo’ng ka,
Mahleh lunggil in a theih chan pie hen;
Ka pumin ka kipie’i ka lungthim tawh,
Nei ngaihdamna chuh ka hengilh thei puoi.

songs.title: Timai hih ka hi panpih bei

lines: Joh 4:37
Doh is F S.S. 489 - T.S. 196
Timai hih ka hi panpih bei,
Mahleh Na thisan kei din luong;
Na kawma hung di’n nei sama,
Aw Pathien Belam No, ka hung.
Timai hih ka hi, nei pawmin,
Nen cheng theinna di’n ka hung hi;
Na thisan ah gitloh thieng ding,
Aw Pathien Belam No, ka hung.
Timai hih ka hi, nei pawmin,
Nei ngaihdam a nei silthien di’n;
Na thutiem chuh ka gin ziekin,
Aw Pathien Belam No, ka hung.
Timai hih ka hi, Na hehpih -
Na’n gitlohna cheng a hihmang;
Tun Nangmah a mai hi dingin,
Aw Pathien Belam No, ka hung.

songs.title: Van dak tum-un! tuni’n kipahna a um

lines: Luke 15:10
Doh is B8 S.S. 650
Van dak tum-un! tuni’n kipahna a um,
Mikhat gitloh apat a hung kit;
En in! Pa’n lampi-ah ana lamtuoh hi,
A Cha gimthei, vakmang a na lawp.
Lopi! Lopi! Angelte la sak!
Lopi takin kingkang ngeih tumin;
Tatsate’n la a sau, tuipi luong bangin,
Suohchakna thu lopi la’n a sau.
Van dak tum-un! tuni’n kipahna a um,
Vakmang chu tu’n lawp kit ahi tai;
Gitlohna lampi apat hukdam ei tai;
Tatdawk leh piengthak ahung hitai.
Van dak tum-un! tuni’n guolvakna bawlun,
Angelte’n zawh la kipah um sau;
Thu kipah um gen unla, gen sawn zel un,
Thagau lul tak a pienthak ziekin.

songs.title: Vaihawm khat Isu kawmah zanin a hung

lines: Joh. 3:3
Doh is E8 S.S. 366 - T.S. 190
Vaihawm khat Isu kawmah zanin a hung,
Hukdamna lampi leh vak thu dawng dingin;
Lalpa’n thudik leh chientak in a dawng hi,
“Na pienthak ding ahi.”
“Na pienthak ding ahi,
Na pienthak ding ahi!
Ken tihtak taka nang ka hun hilh ahi,
Na pienthak ding ahi.”
Nanghaw mihiem chate, A thu ngaihsak un,
Lalpa Isun guntak maia A gen chuh;
Zie thu hi nangun mawk maiin um sak kiu,
“Na pienthak ding ahi”.
Nanghaw zie chawlhna lopi a lut nuomte,
Tatsate tawh kipahna la sak nuomte;
Kum khawsawt a hinna neih na nawp uchun,
“Na pienthak ding ahi”.
Lunggil a na muh nuom, vana deihtak te’n,
Kawtkhak hawihtak bulah a hun na ngak ui;
Zie la go tak thugen hi ngaitha zingun,
“Na pienthak ding ahi”.

songs.title: Ka hinna ah kithenna maktak ahung um

lines: Doh is A III Alexander 378 - T.S. 191
Ka hinna ah kithenna maktak ahung um,
Ka lunga Isu hung apat!
Hun sawttak a ka hawl, lungthim ah vak ka nei,
Ka lunga Isu hung apat!
Ka lunga Isu hung apat,
Ka lunga Isu hung apat!
Ka lunggil kipahna tuipi luonggi a bang,
Ka lunga Isu hung apat!
Ka vakmangna leh chieh khelhna ka haihsan tai,
Ka lunga Isu hung apat!
Ka gitlohna tamtak chuh sawpthien ahi tai,
Ka lunga Isu hung apat.
Taksanna det leh zuou ngeilo chu ka nei tai,
Ka lunga Isu hung apat;
Ginlahna meipi thimin ka lam khuh lo ding,
Ka lunga Isu hung apat!
Thihna luiguom ah tun kei di’n vakna a um,
Ka lunga Isu hung apat;
Chunglam a Khawpi kulh kawtkhakte ka mu thei,
Ka lunga Isu hung apat.
Khawpi achun cheng di’n chieh ingka tih ka he’i,
Ka lunga Isu hung apat;
Malam zuonin kipak takin ka chieh zel hi,
Ka lunga Isu hung apat.
Laibata
Lungguol takin Lalpa, ka lennau tang chungah
Kalvari tui hing ka dawnpih teu kha
Chawmlo kalin lenna tang dang ding ahi.
Aw na chieh nang tuonglam sau mahleh lau loin
Galhat Lalpa’n na ma pui ina
Dam takin guol ngaih chiehin
Lalpa vangsak in.
Aw na chieh lai ni chun Kraws chu bangmah lele
Lalpa Thagau Thiengtho in hun pui ina
Lungkhamna meipi leh gallien tawng zelin
Leia len-guol khen cheng Zion tang hawih chungah
Ginnan I lengkhawm ui lung kipakin
Hinna Thing leh ka Lalpa tha lim nuoiah.

songs.title: Lalpa pakcha’n Hossana ti’n kiko un

lines: Doh is B8 S.S. 215 - T.S. 302
Lalpa pakcha’n Hossana ti’n kiko un,
Lawp takin Lalpa pak un;
Lunggil kipaka Lalchutphah tun dingin,
Amin thiengtho let sakun.
A puonlap vannuoi a masawn zelin,
A hehpihna muonga chieh zelin;
A Pathien na I chung ah hung eng ina,
A khutin ei pui zel intin, Tu leh kumsawt in.
Chawllo a chieh zelin, I chunga puonlap kipei tawh,
Chawllo a chieh zelin, lawpna la chuh sa kawm zelin;
Chawllo a chieh zelin, mei leh meipi’n I mau a pui hi,
Chunglam a I kumsawt In lopi tung di’n.
Lalpa pakun, Amah kumsawt vaihawm pa,
Chungnung pen ah lopi hen;
Amin chuh pakcha’n A lungsiet na ziekin,
Chung Van lapi sakpih un.
Masawn zelin lung kiguol a chieh in,
Isu nungzuite laka chieh in;
Chawlhna In nuom lunggil lawpin zuon hitiu,
A nunnuom te’n Hukdampa a pahchak nau mun ah.
Isai 26:4
Doh is A8 S.S. 237 (2nd Tune) - T.S. 198
Kumsawt suongpi kei di’n khi,
Nangmah achun ei selin;
Na nak liem akipat a,
Thisan leh tui luongdawk chun;
Gitloh thil bawltheihna ’pat,
Silthieng in, ei hukdam in.
Ka khut nasepte haw hin,
Na dan thil nget tak zo lo;
Phatchuomngaih na tawp loin,
Ka mitthi luong zing mahleh,
Ziehin gitloh khuh theilo,
Nangmai in nei hukdam thei.
Khutngawn maia hun zuonin,
Na Kross chuh ka tu mai hi;
Ngawnchang, nei khuh di’n ka hung,
Panpih bei, nei lungsiet di’n;
Gilo, ken lui ka hun zuon;
Ei silthieng in, ka dam na’n.
Thi a, ka mit ka sin tieng,
Hetloh gam ka hung tun tieng;
Nang Na Lalchutphah chung a,
Vaihawma ka hun muh tieng;
Kumsawt Suongpi, kei di’n khi,
Nangmah achun ei selin.
Thangngur
A bei huoi huoi ie I damlai niuhaw hi
I kipahnau muol a liem kit sek
Vaihkit gawleu a kilawm puoi
Ngai in thil mah leng le.
Lungdeih len-guol ngaihte kikhen tadih mah leng
Lawp leh nuomin lungguol takin;
Damlai lam suk leh to ahin
I Lalpau na chu sem hitiu.
Zan thim nuoi leh sun lunghelna ahin le,
Lei gim theihna hin ei chawkbuoi sek;
I lungkham nau kipah suok hen,
A kaplai hai hitiu.
Lalpa, ei kai in Aw len-guol deih cheng tawh
Na lenna zaila tawh zuon thei din
Kikhen na him lau ta puong kau
Lungkham buoina khelah.
Mitthi thieka kikhenna a lau ta puou
Aksi khel gam nuoma lengte khun
Zaila a sau gihawih cheng tawh
Lopina gam nuomah.
Math. 11:28
Doh is A8 S.S. 471 - T.S. 229
Pathien apat in ka vakvai,
Tun In ka hun zuon;
Gitlohna lam saupi ka hawh,
Lalpa, In ka zuon.
In ka zuon, In ka zuon,
Vakmang ta lo di’n;
Lungsiet vang Nanga hing ka,
Lalpa, In ka zuon.
Kum pha tmtak mawkin ka mang,
Tun In ka hun zuon;
Kisik in ka mitthi pumin,
Lalpa, In ka zuon.
Gitloh suoka um ka khawptai,
Tun In ka hun zuon;
Ka ging, ka muong Na hehpihna,
Lalpa, In ka zuon.
Ka thagau leh lunggil a chau,
Tun In ka hun zuon;
Hatna, kinepna a hung thak,
Lalpa, In ka zuon.
A hehpihna zieka ninnuom a kikhawmte,
Ka hung kikhen zak u hin Hukdampa;
Nau bang ei nem ding sietlei ah um lo,
Minlun Isu’n nau bangin ei nemin.
Aw Lal Isu ka lung-u-ah chengin,
Nei umpih in lunghel liengvai chate;
Na melah lungmuonna a um,
Ka hun ngai zing zieng ui.
Sietlei hi chu kapa kikhenna mun ahi,
Aw Lal Isu Na hehpihna vanga;
Na kumsawt gama tui bang kigawp tieng,
Kikhen kit ta puong kau Nang hun gingte.
Lunghel khuom bang do in Lal Isu ka hun sam,
Nga bang hung lengin ka lungthim u-ah;
Zingsawl Aksi sangin Na vak hawih zawi,
Na mel muonna leh kipahna’n a dim.
I Joh. 1:7
Doh is A8 S.S. 629
Hukdampa lul hun chawian ka,
Nangmah a mai chuh ka hi;
Thienna thisan hungtun ziekin,
Belam No chuh lopi hen!
Lopi, Isu’n ei hukdam hi,
Amin thieng chuh lopi hen;
Thienna, thisan hungtun ziekin,
Hallelujah Belâm No!
Chawlhna bukim chuh chang dingin,
Lunggil in sawttak ka hawl;
Mahleh ka hawldan chuh nusie’n,
Gin ziek maiin ka mu tai.
Mitphet kal tinin ka ging hi,
Thisan lul tak hung luong chuh;
Zie tuikhuk achun ka chawl hi,
Hukdampa pang chuh belin.
Na nasem di’n kikawih chuomin,
Nanga di’n hingin thing ka;
Hukdamna bukim leh manbei,
Kipak takin gen ingka.

songs.title: Luiguom thuk-thim leh zanthim takmai achun

lines: Isai 49:15
Doh is A8 III Alexander 118 - T.S. 199
Luiguom thuk-thim leh zanthim takmai achun,
Gitloh thukpen apat ka tha hung kitin;
“Kumkhaw hinna vak lam hi hun zuon inla,
Hun hengilh ngei puong ie” Lal Isu’n Atii.
“Hun hengilh ngei puong ie” (na) damsungin,
Khut in hun tuzing (ing) ka;
Ka thupiek haw (hi) sungilh ki’n,
Hun hengilh (ngei) puong ie, damsung in,
Na Hukdampa ka hi, hun veng zel ing ka.
Khawvel thimna leh meipi’n ei khuh laiin,
A hehpihna leh lainatna ka hengilh;
Tuhin Kalvari a hehpihna ka he’i,
Amah lochuh muonna dang a um puoh ie.
Kinem mah mah in Lalpa ka hun zuon hi,
Nang chawihatna lasa’n na kawm ka hun zuon;
Leisiet apat Van Lal Cha hizaw dingin,
Isu’n eisam zing hi, A Van In akhun.
Van mun lopi Sana khawpi enzing in,
Lungzin lungdawnna hungtung zing mahlele;
Vangphatna go leh chawlhdamna chuh mu’n la,
Na kumsawt mun lam chuh enzing zieng maiin.
Pautinkhup
Hun a chawm taluo ie simlei nunnawpna,
Pak bang tuoiin sangmuol a liem zel hi;
Gi bang khenna’n lenkawl ah chung sunni a suok.
Chang bang damin guol ngaihte, Gi bang ki khen tai tiu;
Lautha puiha I gam leh vangkhuo zuon dingin,
Lal Isu’n nau bang ei pui hen lamtawn in,
Chang bang dama dawn bang kituok kit di’n.
Hansiedawl sietlei ah nunnawp peh bang kim theilo,
Gi bang kikhen tai tiu Lal na sem di’n.
Ginnan Kalvari-ah dawn bang kituok khawm di’n.
Sietlei hi guol ngaih chang bang kikhenna himah leh,
Hai bang I ngak ni lopi hung tung ding,
Tieng chuleh nau bang kahna nunnawpna suok ding.
Gi bang khenlohna ding thimthu la ki lel theilo,
Hun muol liemsa la sap kit theih hilo,
Gi bang khenlohna Salem thak mu bang I ngai.
Guol lung tuok sam gibang khenna nuoi simlei ah,
Lengin va bang na buol mahleng le;
Sam gibang khenna din lenkawl ah ni a suok,
Guol ngaih khenna’n thimthu, “Dam takin”
Tih sawlang bang theilo.
Chang bang damin sang muolpi liem mai tan,
Chung Pathien venna zal zo zelin;
Lungtup na gam ninnuom I tun tieng,
Lunglen thimthu khau bang sut lohna.
Thangvan gam ninnuom ah;
“Dam takin” tih sawlang bang tana.
Sietlei gamdai hi gibang kikhenna dinga,
Zuo chung Pathien in tawngsie A lawh;
Mahleh gibang khenlohna thangvan gam nuomah
Nga banga I len tieng “Dam takin,”
Tih sawlang bang tana.
Tuhin luonthi nulin gibang kikhen mah leng,
Chung Pathien vanga chang bang damin;
Dan leh gi bang kikhen lohna thangvan gamah,
Luonthi nula sam gibang kikhen-
Te tui bang kigawm ding.
V.T. Kappu
Gal in dawn leng thangvan khawpi,
Khen lohna gam ngo bang a lang;
Gibang khenni a hung tun in,
Khen lohna gam ka ngai.
A chawm ngei ie lei nunnawpna,
Pak bangin a tuoi kit tai;
Kikhen lo thei I hi puou maw,
Lenna mun a dan ziekin ?
Mu bang ka ngai khen lohna gam,
Nun nuom sawl bang I hei na ding;
Bang tik leh thuongte I tung dem?
Khenlohna vangkhuo lun.
Gimtheih thuoka I kikhen hin,
Bangtik tui bang I kigawm dem?
Nuoi simlei thuong nung I sieh tieng
Luon tui bang kigawm ding
Khen lohna vang khawpi ka ngai,
Simlei a gi bang kikhen ni’n;
Lungkham sawlang ban na’ng um lo,
Simlei gimum ahin.
I kikhen a I kah lai hin,
Thangvan gam nuom galin dawn leng;
Kikhen a um loh ka het in,
Tunkal ngakla’n ka kap.
Saihnuna
Kap lo thei ka hi puoi, Aw ka lungdeihte kha,
Nungtieng lam sul bang a hei kit ta puou;
Pielgal van sang saulun a kai zo tau,
Nungsul hei talo in.
Ka kap khawvel gam zau ahin,
Buolna gam tawha suihlung hel ni hin;
Malai nung tieng ngaiin ka mau,
Atho kit sek ngaihlai ni haw cheng khah
Suihlung ahel lunglai nemte sul bang heilo,
Nau bang kahna a sauta luoi Lalpa;
A lennau leh a meluh muh ka nuom,
Angel dungsun a hiu.
Zion lim thing bang bel hehpih lungdeihte tawh,
Galmuonna tang chunga lengin zai awi
Ka ngaklah ie zie gam hawih achun Aw
Laituol lengkhawm ung kau
Doh is B flat
Guol deih samgi bang khenna di’n,
Phat leh ni a nai tai;
Kipak nunnuom alen lai ni,
Malai suok ding ei tai.
Na chieh na’ng tuong lam sau mahleh,
Lalpa’n hun veng ina;
Na vang khawpi na tun tieng leh,
Ei hun hezing in Aw.
Lung guola ni chenga lenna,
Buolna sau lun sungah;
Na sakmin gen hai thei puong kau,
Hun sawt tak nung inle.
Damtak in Aw, mangpha, mangpha,
I kituok kit masieh;
Chung Pathien in hun veng ina,
Damtak in Aw, mangpha.

songs.title: I velah buh lakding tamtak a min ta ie

lines: Doh is E8 Golden Bells 92
I velah buh lakding tamtak a min ta ie,
Amauhaw at dingin chieh in;
Lalpan hun huh ina, Na hatna suong loin,
Lalpa hatna chuh suong zel inla;
Na chi theh kek ina, Lalpan hun huh ina,
Kumsawt gam na tunpih theihna di’n,
Na hatlai in semin, Lalpa hatna suong in.
Nasep loh ziekin tamtak chuh a bei mang ui,
Lalpa hehpihte a bei zel;
Amau panpih dingin na chieh dem?
Panpih ding a ngai ui. A beihmang zawh kal un;
Chieh in, chieh in, semin, Amau di’n ni a kiem,
Thagau simsen loh beimang ding chuh;
Hehpih lo hiel na him? Khat mai bek hun puiin.
Khawdak in, enviel in, tatna helo tehi,
Lalpa’n A tatdawk a he puou;
Muong takin a um ui,
A pui dingin kuomah a um puou;
Hukdampa a he puou,
Amau haw pui dingin, Lalpa’n a hun deih hi;
Bangtik leh Isu anga kunin, A Tanpau ahih he’n,
A Lalna min pakin?
Lienkhawpau
Hun kipah um leh Hukdamna ni hin,
Maban tamtak ka nei,
Krista sep ban sem di’n;
Lalpa’n kei ei guot tai.
Damlai ni a beih ma hin,
Semhat hitiu Lalpa na;
Hun a dang tai, (2)
Vaihawmna ni a naitai.
Aw ka damlai hun na pammaih ta luoi;
Thawnin liemlo zen in,
Hukdampa melsietna;
Khuh di’n mat ka nuom tai,
Tutieng hin Lalpa khawvelah a tawm,
A tawmna sietlei hi;
Thisana chawksa nung,
Amah Lallukhuk di’n.
Hun a bei deuh deuh, Hun a buoi deuh deuh,
Buh tak leh lem sep na’n;
Tui suohgiet a fawn tai,
Lalpa thudik na di’n.
Thihna thim nuoi a um in,
Thagau sangtam amang zing;
Hukdampana Aw, Hukdamna helo in,
Hinna lampi mansakin, Thingbul suongbul aho ui,
Ei haw guola tatdawk sa ahiu.
Hukdamna Chanchinpha,
Gamtina phuongzak dingin;
Lalpa’n tuhin ahun sam,
A hun sam ahun sam zing,
Hukdamna huongah lun puilut un.
Lalpa’n A hun hehpih a,
Nanga dingin a hung thuok;
Na gitloh leibat haw ahun ditsak,
Gamthima Lalpa hehpih Thagau sang tam amang zing,
Amau pui ding kuomah aum puoi.
Amauhaw chu pui dingin,
Suohpih bang dinga nang muong ?
Hun a chawma ni a liem zing ngala,
Na leibat na dit loh leh Lal kawmah bang na gen die ?
Tu hi Hukdam theih na ni ahi.
Lalpa kei ka um hila,
Na hehpih te pui dingin;
Na deih bang taka nei mat di’n ka nuom,
Nang a ding in hing ka ting nanga ding mah in thing ka,
Ka theihna ka pum in ei mang in.

songs.title: Kristien tho un ip ta kiu

lines: Luke 14:23
Doh is C S.S. 148 - T.S. 206
Kristien tho un ip ta kiu,
Kapte I chawlhsan mai dem?
Lalpan thu ei piek lai hin,
Mawk chut mai mai ding I him?
Chieh un, sem un, tun pan un,
Chieh un hawl un beimangte;
Gitloh thim laka chengte,
Hinna An um di’n sam un!
Hukdampa I lungsiet um?
A thupiek I zui ding um?
I neih cheng I piephal dem?
Ei sapna awn I nung dem?
I gin ding bangun I gingum?
Ei hilh bangin I um um?
Amah mai a I hiu em?
Ginna nasep in phuong hen.
Kross I put dinguh a um,
Lallukhuk neih I guot chun;
Thanuom takin pang hitiu,
Phat a chawm, ni a tawm tai.
Aw kalvari tang khu ka vak thil a,
Ka hukdampa thihna tang chu;
Mi tizat tang, tang thavaih um a chun,
Ka thuok sikin A thuok.
Ka kipak ie Lalpa, ka kipak ie,
Zie bang lawma hehpihna mak;
Ka genthiem puoi na phatna zozai hi,
Hun pak chim thei puo’ng ka.
Zie bang lawm lawma hehpihna mak hi,
Suol tuipi a tummang sa nung;.
Na hehpih na’n nei hung puidawk ta a,
Nang chauh hun zui tang ka.
Na thisan in na hawng zalenna gam,
Zie mun chuh ei puitung ding in;
Na Thagau a nei hung panpih ziekin,
Ka lung a awi ngei ie,
Gen chim thei hiel puo’ng ka, na hehpihna,
Khawvel lopina genlo in;
Na hehpihna thu mai hi gen tang ka.
Lalpa ei panpih in.
Hallelujah amen, Halleluijah.
Amen....Amen Halleluijah;
Lalpa vangsakna tincheng eipie pa
Na min lopi zing hen.
Ka umna lei In hi mang mahleh,
Khuta sak loh kumsawt In ka nei;
Zie In chu ngaiin ka galdawt ka tung thei puoi,
Ka taksa sietlei In hin ei nang.
Gam ka nei gam lopi,
Hukdampa’n kei dinga A bawlsa;
Sietlei ah kumsawt chenna ding mun ka nei puoi,
Gam hawih zaw diek vana tih loh chu.
Ka umna lei ka mauna gam hi,
Aw, bangtikleh ka pawt san ta dem ?
Lungsietna Lal pakcha’n Amah chawian dingin,
Ka taksa sietlei In hin ei nang;.
Muonna leh chawlhdamna ka hawla,
Zie leisiet chung ahin a um puoi;
Ginna’n gam thiengtho ka galdawt ka tung thei puoi,
Ka taksa sietlei In hin ei nang,
Abraham mah bangin tuhin chu,
Ginnan gamtiem lam chu ka zuon hi;
Mi thiengthote le gam nuom chu chang chiet dingin,
Ka taksa sietlei In hin ei nang.
Kamlala
Lungmuonna kim kipahna kim
Hehpihna vak ka Lal melah
Pulthuok a nem thuok laia nem
Vakvaite din In nuom.
A umna mun cheng van ahi
A keng bula um hi a nuom
Lungkhamna leh thim nuoia chau
Nuomin a chawlhsak sek.
Suihlung ahel ka sa lei ah,
Mahleh hehpihna Lal vangin;
Ka lautha lungdeihte haw tawh,
Nunnuom in leng tan au.
Aw, I mi ngaihteu chieh ka mui,
Hehpihna vakah a leng ui;
A mau a mihiem hin beita,
Angelte dungsun in,
Ka hun ngai Aw, kipahna pen,
Na thawkna chun kah lai a nem;
Ka lenna gamgaw gam ahi,
Hun khen ding ka ngam puoi.

songs.title: Muot Thei A Tuh A Um !

lines: Khuonga
Muot theia tuh a um,
Muot theilo lo a tho di’n;
Limbawl loha tuh in I um,
Lopi taka kaihthawh dingin. (2)
Hatlo a tuh a um,
Thilhih theia tho di’n;
Taksaa tuhin I um ui,
Thagau a thodawk kit ding in (2)
Lei taksa a chuoma,
Van taksa a chuom hi,
Lei lopina a danglama;
Thagau lopina a dang hi, (2)
Lalpa chu Aw gi tawh,
Vansawlchak lopi tawh;
Pengkun in ei hun sam intin,
Lalpa kawma chun chawl dingin. (2)
Thihna um ta puon tin,
Kahna um ta puona;
Thihna gun eizo ta puona;
Melma nunung I nuoisieh tau. (2)
Matt. 21:8
Doh is A8 S.S. 756 - T.S. 209
Ngaiun, Lalpa’n hangsan leh thudik;
Buh lakhawm di’n a sam;
Buh a min tai, lak ding phat ngakin,
Nasemte a tawm ui.
Lalpa minin kuonun gunchuh leh,
Hehpih leh zaidam in;
Hukdamna manbei thu kipahum,
Khawvel ah phuongzak un.
Chieh unla, mangthaite hukdawk un,
Gitloh, thim nuoi apat;
Panpih un hukdam hung hiding in,
Thempa hatkwl tan un.
Gimtheite lawp takin va hilh un,
Hinna an um dingin;
Amah, kumsawt Hinna changthak chun,
Amau na lawp ina.
Chieh un, sem un, nitum ding ei tai,
Khawvel bei pai ina;
Phat haksa chuh hung tung pai ina,
Na sem thei ta puoi tiu.

songs.title: Buh lakphat ahi sep ding atam hi,

lines: Matt. 3:7
Doh is B8 S.S. 754
Buh lakphat ahi sep ding atam hi,
Buh a min tai, nasem mi a tawm ui;
Lalpa’n ginuma sem di’n mi a sam,
A hun sapna chuh ngaihsak in.
Sem hitiu, sem hitiu,
Kipahman chuh en kawmin;
Lalpa’n hatna thak ei piek ding thu A gen,
Nisa a tum man sem hitiu.
Buh-In ah buhvui pha hun lakhawm un,
Lunggil zangtaka kipahna la sa’n;
Zan hungtun man theihtawp in sem hitiu,
Thimna’n sun khawvak a suon man.
Buh atte’n kipahman tampi mun au,
A phat chuh sawtin, nasep hak mahleh;
A mitel te’n Lalpa kipahpih ding,
Lungkhamna dahum nawhmang in.
En un, chung gama um van In nuom chuh,
Theihtawp a panga, semgim te’n luoh ding;
Lalpa hehpihna Aw chun sam intin,
Kumsawt ni tawplo luoh tan au.

songs.title: Na Lung A Awi Kei Nam ?

lines: Mihiemte hinna hi banga hia ahim ?
Meipi chawmcha hung kilanga mangkit bang hi ahi;
Simlei pakcha hawih lunlai atuoi bangin,
Mihiem phatlai paklun zamuol a liem paisek hi.
Aw, na khawvel hinna a beih tieng,
Bang lampi ahim, na hawh ding?
Na kumsawt mun ding na gel tieng leh,
Na lung a awi kei nam?
Hun leh tui luong laiin kuomah angak ngei puoi,
Mitphet kalsungle chawllo in zamuol aliem zing ui;
Khawvel ahin aum den ding a um puoi,
Khuolzin nichuong phet I hiu I leisiet hin khuo hi.
Na vanglai leh phatlai nihaw a vak sung hin.
Krista haw’n khawvel pakhawih chenin muong mahleh chunle
Aw thihna luiguom thim nahawh tieng chu leh,
Krista lo a muongtaka chiehpai ni kinem maw?
Pak zel unau lei nawpna haw su hawih dingin,
Kumsawt hinna lampi mansak theih na din ei themsek
Zui in pet mangsan ta leng I van lampiu,
Tuoikit untin I chan uh lungkham kah leh mauna.
Sietlei ah kipahna nawpna, hawl mahleu hing,
Lunggil leh ngaihtuohna mangin na theihna haw cheng tawh;
Bangtik kipahna tawplo na mu thei dem?
Mu ngei puonla Kalvari tuichim na tun ma chun.

songs.title: Galkap banga chieh in! Kristien sepaihte

lines: Deut. 31:6
Doh is A8 S.S. 706 - T.S. 210
Galkap banga chieh in! Kristien sepaihte,
I maua na chiehsa, Isu chuh en in;
Krista I Lalpen un, galdo di’n ei pui,
Kidona phuol achun; a puonlap a phe’i.
Galkap banga chieh in Kristien sepaihte,
I maua na chieh sa, Isu chuh enin.
Isu min I sap tieng, Setan gal a zam,
Pangun, Kristien sepaih, galzo zel dingin;
I pahchaknau Aw gin, gawtmun hihling ding,
Suohpihte kiko un, ngeih takin lasau.
Sepaih tamtak bangin, Pathien Sapchuom um,
Suohpihte mithieng haw, nungzui I hiu ui;
I kikhen zak puou hi, pumkhat I hiu ui,
I tup, I Thugin leh Hehpihna kibang.
Lalna a hung bei thei, Lalgam a tuoi thei,
Mahleh Isu Sapchuom, um zing ding ahi;
Gawtmun kulh kawtkhak te’n, Sapchuom zo ngei lo,
Krista thutiem I nei; zie chuh thawn ngeilo.
Mipite, pang zelun, kei u lawi hung hiu,
Lopi, chawihat zahna, Lal Krista chang hen;
La ei hung sakpih un, galzawhna la chuh,
Mihing leh Angel te’n, kumsawt in san au.
Pautinkhup
Aw, Lalpa, naupangte’n ka hun chiel ui,
Na mel deihum leh Na pau kamsuok thum tak
Het ka nuom muh ka nuom ui.
Aw, nang ka Lal leh ka Tanpau, ka Puipau Na hi,
Ka kikhawpnau leh thilpiek,
Nang di’n lopina hi hen, kei u din vangsakna
Van chana kipahna di’n.
Malai khan naupan neuhaw Na lawpa,
“Ka kawmah hun pui un, gai, kiu in” Na tii,
Naupang kipahna a kim.
Puipa di’n Thagau Thiengtho, hung lengin,
Naupang neucha cha kikhawmhaw ma hung puiin,
Lal nasep khawk dan hilh in.
Ei ngaidam in Aw, Lalpa ei ngaidam in,
Ka hihding helo in, sawttak ka na chui,
Ka lawpna maidi’n, ka hun bel Lalpa,
Ei ngaidam in, Lalpa ei ngaidam in.
Kei mah ziekin thagau simsen loh,
A mangthai tau kumsawt thim nuoi ahin;
Na masang ah bang ka genta dem?
Ei ngaidam in, Lalpa ei ngaidam in.
Na hukdamna athawn in ka na nei tai,
Na malsawmna simsen loh in nei vuk sek,
Mahleh kei mai dingin ka na mangzo,
Ei ngaidam in, Lalpa ei ngaidam in.
Na lawpna pen Lalpa thagau mang hukdam,
Na na khawkpen khawvela chanchinpha gen;
Mahleh kuo mah ka hun pui puoh ngala,
Ei ngaidam in, Lalpa ei ngaidam in.
Na sapna hi kihetloh sak thei kei puoi,
Nangin neisawl thagau mang hukdam ding in,
Na thagau thiengtho in ei pui zel in,
Na gam adi’n ka hung ki piei Lalpa.

songs.title: Nang Lam Ka Hun Nga Tai

lines: Zie khawvela lawp leh muonga ka chut laiin,
Kalvari hehpihna thisan zalin,
Ka lunggil ah a hungtung ta ie,
Manthaina gam a leng ei tatna a hung hii.
Aw nangmah lam ka hun nga tai Lalpa,
Bangmah dang ka deih puoi khawvel ahin,
Ka Lal leh Hukdampa di’n ka hun pawm tai
Kalvari’ah nei tatna thisan zalin.
Sawttak ka Lalpa chu vakmang san mahleng le,
Bang ti a gitloh nen kai hi mahleng;
A hehpihna Aw nem chun ei sam,
Ka lungsung ah thamuonna bei theilo ei piei.
Ka Aw leh nei thilthawn piekte haw hi Lalpa,
Hun pha leh kipahum nei piek haw hi;
Na pahchaknan ka na mang ngei puoi,
Tuhin vang chu ka hun mang pan ta ie Lalpa.
Aw ka hun lui beita cheng kha samkit thei leng,
Ka ngaina e Aw ka Lalpa pakna’n;
Thih chana ei hung hehpihtu hi,
Ka hengilh sawt taluoi Lalpa ei ngaidam in.

songs.title: Ding un! Ding un, Isu di’n!

lines: Doh is B8 S.S. 680 - T.S. 212
Ding un! Ding un, Isu di’n!
Nanghaw Kross sepaihte;
A Lal puonlap dawmsang un,
Mang ngeilo ding ahi;
Galzo a, zo zel dingin,
A sepaih puihuoi ding;
Melma nuoisieh ahih a,
Krista leng A chan nan.
Ding un! Ding un, Isu di’n,
Pengkun sapna ngaiun;
Kidona phuolah pang un,
A ni lopi a hin;
Nanghaw, Amah nasemte’n,
Gal simsen loh do in;
Lauhum na-ah hangsan un,
Hat takin do zel un.
Ding un! Ding un! Isu di’n!
Amah hatna muong un;
Na sapum ban thahatnau,
Senin do zo puon lau;
Gospel galvan chu lauin,
Paucham un la, do un;
Lauh umna na tuok tieng leh,
Chau in puk ngei puon lau.
Ding un! Ding un! Isu di’n!
Kido sawtta puona;
Tuhin kido thawm I zai,
Dan leh galzawhna la
Kuole guolzo te cheng chun,
Hinna lukhuk chang ding;
Lopina Lalpen chu tawh,
Kumsawta vaihawm ding.
Lalpa chieh dinga nei sawl na ta phawt achun,
Tangsangpen leh tuipi kinawk kal himahleh;
Na thu leh Kraws vaka nei thuom phawt chun,
Na hehpihna thu hi gen zel ingka
Chieh in sempan ngalin nite bei mang zing,
Kalvari tatna mak henailo te kawmah;
Na tawhna ta phawt chu na gam hizel ina,
Hattak leh hangtak in umphawt mai in.
Setan gallien chu lau loin nawh pai zelin,
Tawpchana na kawma umdi’n thu ka hun tiem;
Thu ka hun pie hila bangmah lau ki’n,
Hattak leh hang takin um phawt mai in.
Ka hukdamna Zion tang achun hun puiin,
Amau dingin mun nuom leh chawlhna ka guonggalh;
Hattak leh hangtakin va gen zelin,
Na kipahman Lallukhuk hawih ina.
Redemption Songs 92
Key G
Samari lam khawm lui ah, Thu kipahum gen a hi;
Thagau dangchaknu kawmah, Sawt lamin;
Vak mulo sawt tak um, Chun vakna lopi a mui;
Lui chu hawn a hihtak ziekin, Sawt lamin.
Lui a um hi, hawn a hi tai, Sawt lamin, Sawt lamin;
Zie lui luong chu namtin damna ding ahi,
Sawt apat zie lui achun Thiemgaute leh mithieng te’n;
Damna lui luong chu a na muu, Sawt lamin.
Galhat miphakpa kawmah, Saltang numei naupang chun,
Thusim mawltak chu a gen, Sawt lamin;
A ki diehna ding lui mai chun hihdam theihna a nei;
Ginnan a damtai tui achun, Sawt lamin.
Mipi laka numei khat, pau lo thip kei a um in;
Khunin, a puon mawng a tham, Sawt lamin,
A thildeih chu a mu tai, A thagau hukdamna tawh,
Luikhuk hawnsa a um achun, Sawt lamin.
Mitilgehpa lehkha sim Philip in a hilhchiena,
Lui achun a Baptis tai, Sawt lamin;
Sunggila Pathien nasep pawlama tiemtehna din,
Lui achun bawlin a um tai, Sawt lamin.
Joh. 2:5
Doh is F S.S. 1102 - T.S. 214
Tumlam phaicham apat,
Hetsakna la a hung;
Ginumna, ginumna, ginumna, Krista di’n,
A la gi thang zel chuh;
Muol tinin a sak pih,
Zie ginumna, Krista dinga ginumna thu chuh.
“Zo zel din kuon un!” (2)
I lamkai pauin A tii;
A thupiek awi hitiu,
Gam la pai zieng hitiu;
Krista din I ginum nau, I ginum nau ziekin!
Mi hangsan te’n ngai un,
Sietlei kimvela thang;
Ginumna, ginumna, ginumna Krista din!
Tho un pang ngam dingin;
Hilhna thudik phuong un,
Zie ginumna, Krista dinga ginumna thu chuh!
Lawi muon um hun zawm un,
Setan gal nuoisieh din;
Krista dinga ginumna, ginumna ziekin!
Setan puonlap zak na’h;
Gospel phuong zak hitiu,
Zie ginumna, Krista dinga ginumna thu hi!
Khanglai’ hatna I ngau,
Tu’n Isu kengbul ah;
Krista dinga ginumna, ginumna ziekin!
Gospel phuongzak hitiu,
Khawvel gam tin chengah;
Zie ginumna, Krista dinga ginumna thu chuh.

songs.title: Kanaan lam I zuon puonlap chawia lasa’n

lines: Doh is F S.S. 694 - T.S. 213
Kanaan lam I zuon puonlap chawia lasa’n,
Gitloh do di’n sepaiha kipie I hiu;
Mahleh gal muna I kikhenzak lohna’n,
“Lalpa lama pang kuo?” ti’n I ki dawng ui.
Aw, I lakah kuo ahim thudika muon um,
Thutak panpih a ding Lalpa lama pang?
Aw, I lakah kuo ahim thudik a muon um?
Thutak panpih a ding, Lalpa lama pang?
Chemzam leh galvanhaw a te zawl zawl thei,
Setan vak Angel bang a kilat ziekin;
Mahleh lunggil ginum lohna a um thei,
Mukin, “Lalpa lamah ka pang” ti mahleh.
Vaihawmna nuoia um nalai I um um?
Pathien zahngaihna, ngaihdamna he nailo;
Lunggil khauh kingainiem in, A kawm zuonin,
A hun ngak hi, kinin, A lamah pangin.
Lungkham, natna leh bawlsietna khawksa ki’n,
Lungkham nawp la suok pai ding ahih ziekin;
I puipa muonum chuh zuiin A Kross pu’n,
Guolzo a kiko ding “Lalpa lam’ pang” ti’n.
Johan 14:2,3
Chung van gamah ka In guotsa um,
Ana ngaihtuoh di’n Lalpa chieh ta;
Hukdamna gam nuom achun,
Hukdamsa hehpihte tawh,
Lawi khawma chawihat la sa zing ta ding.
Kum a sawt um ngeilo,
Kipahna gam achun;
Gim genthei um talo,
Zie mun achun va cheng ding i hiu.
Kei dingin Hukdampa hungthi ta,
Ka thagau hukdam na ding ziekin,
Gitloh a dim sietlei ah,
Kei apata peldawk di’n,
Van gam nuom hawihtak a cheng zing dingin.
Phat tampi chieh zing ding Aw Lalpa,
Keimah nei vawp zing ie tih ka he’n;
Mang lo hielin I Lalpa’n,
I chenkhawmna diu lim ah,
Etnawp etdah umlo chamna leng ta.
Chung van gam sana khawpi a chun,
Kah leh mau, gim theihna um ta lo;
Nunnawp zaila sa zing ding,
Chawl-le-nan beisuok ta ding,
Nunnuom zing ding chung gam In nuom a chun.

songs.title: Kristien, kiveng zingin, lauhum a nai!

lines: Eph. 4:1
Doh is G S.S. 617
Kristien, kiveng zingin, lauhum a nai!
Na zinna ah lau leh linga chieh in;
Thang leh thepnan a hun um kimvel hi,
Gitlohna a lut di’n thepin na um,
Kristien, kiveng zingin, (3) lauh um a nai.
Kristien, kipak zingin huihpi lakah,
Van chu nimin, lauhum in lang mahleh;
Van nim leh huihpi hung bei pai tana,
Hukdampa kawmah kumkhuon chawl tan la,
Kristien kipak zingin, (3) lauh um a le.
Kristien paucham zingin na pukloh na’n,
Na hukdampa sapding hengilh ki’n la;
Thepna leh buoina haw zongei inla,
Pauchamna galthuom a na kithuom chun,
Kristien kiveng zingin, (3) na puk loh na’n.
Kristien, kinem zingin, lungkham leh nat,
Van chawlhna na chan tieng leh bei tana;
Na kipahman vaihawmpa gen zan la,
“Na Lalpa kipahna ah lutin” ti’n,
Kristien, kinem zingin, (3) chawlhna mu’n la.

songs.title: Kisau kido di’n! dogal a nai tai

lines: Thup. 2:10
Doh is B8 S.S. 703
Kisau kido di’n! dogal a nai tai,
Puonlap dawmsang un, Lalpa di’n;
Kigalvan un, dettak in ding chiet un!
A thu thiengtho chuh mangin, pang un!
Tho un, sepaih! Lal puonlap nuoi achun,
Kisau unla, A thu gensawn un;
Malam zuon un! Hossana! ti’n sam un,
Krista chuh sepaih puipa ahi.
I galteu tuok di’n malam I zuon zel,
Panmun I het chun zo hitiu;
Phaw leh puonlap thieng taka vawp zingin,
Thudik a pangte, puk ngei puoi tiu.
Aw micheng Pathien, ka sapnau ngaiin,
Na zahngaih na’n ei panpih in;
Galzawh ahih a kidona beih tieng,
Na ma achun Lallukhuk khung kau.
Damlai tuipi-ah ka thagau a vakvai,
Gitloh gikpuo gimthei tak in;
“Ei hun zuonin” ti a sapna aw nem chu zan,
Lawngchawlhna mun chu ka tung tai.
Lawngchawlhna achun ka thagau a chawl tai,
Tui-pi ah vaikit puong ka,
Huihpi te nungin, tuipi kinawk mahleh,
Isu-a chun ka bit zing hi.
Lungsieta ei hukdampa kawmah ki pie’n;
A thu chu gingin ka um hi;
Gitloh kawlbuh a kiei chawlhmun ka tungtai,
Lawngchawlhna chu Lalpa ahi.
Lalpa, nei hihdam apat ka la deihpen,
Isu chanchin hawih hi ahi;
A nuom taphawt te d’in Hukdampa ahi,
Lawngchawlhna a chawl nuomte din,
Hungin, Hukdampa kawmah, A hun ngak hi,
Ama’n hun na hukdam ina;
Lawngchawlhna ah na thagau hun pui inla,
“Ka nawpna pen ka tung tai” ti’n.
Thagau satang leh gitloh gik puo a,
Lungkham liengvai taka ka um lai in;
Kalvari thing hansedawl kraws ah chun,
Ka Lalpa’n zawhna ei pie tai.
Aw Kraws, Aw kraws,
Aw Kraws, kei gilo thiemchan na;
Aw Kraws, Aw Kraws,
Aw Kraws kei ei chawi sang tu.
Kei migilo buok thilhih theih neilo,
Phat kana guot zing theihna ma suonin;
Lungkham taka thavai himah lengle,
Ka Lalpa’n zawhna ei pie tai.
Kei migilo mangsa kikhenden in,
Keimah a hin Lal Krista a hing tai;
Khawvel in ei subuoi thei ta puona,
Ka Lalpa’n zawh na ei pie tai.
Damsung in lungkham buoina tung mahleh,
Lau puongka Lal Krista ka phaw ahi;
Nicheng Amah pahchak nan la sang ka,
Ka Lalpan ei zawh sak ziekin.
Mi kuole tuia leh Thagau a,
Piengthak lo chu (2)
Pathien gam mi hitak ahi puo,
Lalpa Isu’n a ti a.
Kuole Amah ging chun,
Kumsawt hinna nei ding;
Kuole a mah ging chun,
Kumsawt hinna kumsawt hin nei un au.
Kuole lei lehna a khut nga a,
Nunglam en chu (2)
Pathien gam mi hitak ahi puoi,
Lalpa Isu’n a ti a.
Kuole nicheng amah kraws pu a,
Ei zui lo chu (2)
Pathien gam mi hitak ahi puoi,
Lalpa Isu’n a ti a.
Nicheng Lalpa hun zui zel ing ka;
Gimum mahleh (2)
Thagau Thiengtho in ei pui zelin;
Na gam ka tun masieh in.
Kuole amah zui chun,
Kumsawt chawlhna chang ding;
Lopina vak achun kumsawt nawpna,
Tawp lo chu chang unau.
Lalpa Isu hehpihna chun,
Mangthai chate ei hun sam hi;
Kei di’n a thisan lul a luong tai
Mangthai chate ei hukdamna dingin.
Aw athukin a sang na e,
Gilote kala khaikang ui;
Bang ati a him van Lal Chapa,
Kei migilo dinga a hung thih.?
Gilo pen le ei hukdam tai,
Liengvai gammang haw cheng a di’n;
Gilo mun thim pen le a hih thieng,
Aw a deih chengchengte haw hung tau uo.
Migilo chate tatna di’n,
Bang a tia Lal lopi pen;
Gan an kuong leh thing Kraws khelah maw.
Aw a thukin Aw a sang ngei ie maw?
Namtin chitin te hung tau uo,
Thamuonna leh lawpna pen chu;
I Lal Isun ei hun piekit tai,
A gam hawih nuom ah ei puilut ina.

songs.title: Ka lawite! en tiem u hetna

lines: Thup. 2:25
Doh is D S.S. 669
Ka lawite! en tiem u hetna,
Van a khun a um;
Ei panpih ding a lang ta ie,
Zawhna ding a nai.
“Na pang un la hung ding ka hi”
Lal Isu’n A tii;
Van lamah dawnna pieu un la,
“Nang ziek’ Pang kau” tiin.
En tiem u, dogal a hung ui,
Setan puih huoi in;
I velah mi hangsan puk ui,
I zolo vang ui!
En un puonlap lopi aphei!
Pengkun gi ngaiun!
I puipau min in zo hitiu,
Dogal tincheng chuh.
Gal lauhum sawtpi do mahleng,
Panpih ding anai;
Pangun, I Puipau A hung hi,
Lawite, kipak un.
Ka Lalpa hehpih thutiem chun,
Lei mi lungkham leh chaute kawm ah;
Nawpna leh muonna piek a tiem,
Hun zuon kinin a vaigeih man.
Aw hinna neilo mihing chate haw,
Muonna deiha mu dieklo te;
Lungngaihna than thimin ei nan ma hin,
Zuon kin hitiu hinna Lal Krista chu.
Lalpa hehpih, gingchate haw.
Amah hinna tuikhuk hengilh in;
Tui ting theilo tuikhuk I cho,
I thagau dangchak pha diek lo.
Khawvel lopi leh sannate,
Hawlin khawvel ah ka na vak sek;
Mahleh ei pie thei puoi muonna,
Hukdampa Aw na telloh chun.
Tuhin muonna tak ka nei tai,
Ka hukdampa ei piek muonna chu;
Khawvel ah umlo muonna chuh,
Kumsawt chana kei a ding chu.
Josh. 5;15
Doh is C S.S. 689
Sapna aw gi ngai un,
“Tuni’n kuo kuon ding?
Ka nasepna hawla,
Niel loa pang ding?
Kuo a gal matawnga,
Ka puonlap dawm ding?
Pathien leh A thutak,
Panpih a do ding?
Isu’n puonlap nuoi ah, sepaih ma A huoi;
Galzo hiting, dikna’n khawvel luoh suok ding.
Pathien hatna muongin,
Gal zawh macheng in;
Setan lawi chu do-in,
Kigalvan hitiu;
Thienthona leh thutak,
Panpih a do in;
Pathien dinga do di’n,
Pang khawm chiet I hiu.
Ngai un, a thawmgiu chuh,
Lasa’n chieh zel ui;
I Puipa, I Lalpau,
Chu lopi henla;
Gamla leh naia te,
Lungtup kibang in;
Galdo di’n a kuon ui,
A aw giu ngai un!
Krista sepaihte haw,
Kigal ging zing unla;
* Pathien hatna suongin ding un,
A kumawt cha zalin (3)
Lalpa vang a hatin,
A hih theihna muongun;
* Kuole Isu hatna muong chuh,
Zinmang sangin a hat. (3)
Mun cheng veng phau unla,
Thagau chau lo hielin;
* Hehpih leh thilbawl theihna chun,
Khawvel pumpi zo un. (3)
Buoina hungum mahleh,
Na zawh vek tieng uleh;
* Krista vangin nuom un natin,
Tawp chanin ding un lau. (3)
Hatna leh lawpna chun,
Do unla, pang zel un;
* Thim thilhih theihna haw cheng chuh,
Na zawh niu tung ina. (3)

songs.title: Dettak in ding un, khawvel buoina ah

lines: Sam 62:2
Doh is E8 S.S. 685
Dettak in ding un, khawvel buoina ah,
Huihpi nungin, tuikinawk sang mahleh;
Zie Suongpi hin hatna, hinna ei piei,
Gitlohna a hung naih tieng.
Suongpi chunga dingin! dettak in ding hitiu!
Krista Suongpi chung ngeiah;
I do ham ham chun bittak in ding hitiu,
Lalchutphah vel mipi lakah.
Thudik ah dingdet un, lunggil thieng pu’n,
Lunggil dik, hangsan leh ginna hatin;
Zie Suongpi mai hin zawhna ei piena,
Khawvel gitlohna lakah.
Thudik ah dingdet un, nang di’n phapen,
Ahun sawt mahleh, hung tung tei ina;
Suongpi hin chawlhna, muonna ei piena,
Damsung huihpi a beih tieng.
Ka hukdampa vakmang sanin,
Sawttak ka cham khawvel ahin;
Khawvel hawihna haw hi,
Kum sawt a ting zo puoi;
Hehpihna’n ei pui zing.
Gam tiem zuon zel dingin.
Aw a mak na e; ei hehpihna, kei di’n ahi a thawkna chu;
Hungun chawian hitiu, khawvel hukdampa chu;
Amah chawihat loh chu, nawpna dang a um puoi.
Khawvel hawihna ka hawl seka,
Luoh loh ding gam genthei ahin;
Ka lunglai ei nem ding,
A um puoi khawvel ah;
Hehpihnan ei sam hi,
“Hung kihei in” ei tii.
Tuhin ka hungkit Hukdampa,
Na ang sung muonna chang dingin;
Nangin na chate,
Pauchamna na ngaitha sek,
Ka lunggil ah kumsawt,
Hinna lultak nei piei.
Zie khawvel ahin gingtu a tam ngei ie,
Mahleh gingtu hindan thiem a tawm ngei ie;
Mahleh puokgik puo leh hin chawllo te di’n,
Hindan thiem ei sinsaktu Isu ahi.
Hindan ka thiem ta ie (2)
Ei sinsaktu Lal Isu Amah ngei ahi;
Lung awih zel ka chi’ng tai(2)
Lung-awihna ei sinsak tu Isu ahi.
Sum leh pai hauhsakna duh amna haw hin,
Hun tawk a nei puoh ie lung-awih tawk a hak,
Gimtheih chatgah hile Isu tello chun,
Thuok thiem dan a um puoi, lung-awih tawk a hak.
Chatgah dan ka thiem tai, hauhsak dan ka thiem tai,
Tai leh vah, gilkiel a umdan ka thiem tai;
Ei hehpihpa Lalpa ka bangkim ahi,
Ei suhatpa achun bangkim ka bawl thei.
Krista hehpihna’ pat ei khen thei um lo,
Lauhna leh lungkhamna gimtheih na haw hin;
Kipah leh lungmuonna’h ei puitu ahi,
Ei suhatpa achun bangkim ka bawl thei.

songs.title: Muonna lui banga ka lampi a luong in

lines: Doh is D8 S.S. 901 - T.S. 231
Muonna lui banga ka lampi a luong in,
Lungkhamna tui bang kinawk in;
Bang cheng um mahleh ziehi he di’n nei hilh,
Aphai, aphai, ka thagau ding in.
Aphai, ka thagau di’n,
Aphai, aphai, ka thagau dingin.
Setan thepna leh patepna hung mahleh,
Hetchetna pha hi vawpzing ka;
Krista’n panpih ka ngaih zie A hezing hi,
Ka thagau di’n A thisan A piei.
Ka gitloh-zie ngaihtuoh hi a nuom ka sai,
Ka gitlohna cheng a bawnin;
A Kross-ah a bawnin khetden vek ei tai,
Ka thagau, lawpin, Lalpa pakin.
Tun chuh keia din hin Krista hi ta hen,
Jordan tuipi kinawk mahleh;
Thihna leh hinna ale khawksa puong ka,
Ka thagau Na lungmuon ding ziek in.
Mahleh Lalpa, Na hung phat ding ka ngak ui,
Ka lungtup uh van tun ahi;
Aw, Angel Awgi leh ka Lalpa Aw chuh,
Kinep leh chawlhna nuom, ka tha di’n.
Vak thil tiem u lei hinkhuo hi,
Mihing cheng leh ganhing cheng hi;
Gitloh galina man zo tai,
Lei hi manthai na gam ahi;
Ni nuoia thil um cheng cheng hih,
Bangmah lo mai ana hih ie.
Aw Lal Isu panglo in khawvel cheng hi,
Bangmah lo mai ana hi ie.
Khawvel hauhsakna leh nawpna,
A lopi leh hawihna chenghin;
Thamuonna ahun tun thei puoi,
Zie lei hansie dawl nuoi ahin;
Thaklah ding him aum puoh ie,
Bangmah lo mai ana hiu ie.
Khawvela hatna cheng cheng hi,
Vanglai ni leh vullai nite;
Chawm lokala tuoi ding ahiu,
A nawpnau pumin a mang zing;
Khawvela nawpna cheng cheng hi,
Bangmah lo mai ana hiu ie.
Genthei liengvai chate chengin,
Ka ngai ui nawpna leh muonna;
Pathien Chapa Lal Isu chauh,
Mangthaite di’n hinna ahi;
A kawm ah nangle hung leh chin,
Kumsawt hinna chu chang inla.

songs.title: Muonna kim na deih a, ginna hat na nawp leh

lines: Worship in Songs 153 - T.S. 216
Muonna kim na deih a, ginna hat na nawp leh,
Aw, na lungthim chengin na ngenin;
Mahleh chawlhdamna leh kipahna mu puon la,
Na bangkim Amah na piek macheng.
Aw, na bangkim Lalpa kawmah na pie tam?
Thagau in a hun pui thei nam?
Na sapum, na thagau, na bangkim na piek chun,
Kipahna, chawlhdamna nei inla.
Kipak leh lungdam in Lalpa tawh kitawn in,
Amah thu vaka chieh na nuom em?
A deih bang thil bawlin gitlohna thihsan in,
Na bangkim Amah kawmah pie’n la.
Aw, I he thei ngei puou, Lalpa’n ei piek thilte,
Vangsakna A kawma nget ding le;
I sapum, I thagau Ama’n A neih ma cheng,
I bangkim Amah I piek macheng.
Hehpihna ei piekin ei kipahsak intin,
Kuoman genthei in, gen seng, lo ding;
I bangkim pie leu hing Aman ei umpih ding,
Kipahna, chawlhdamna mu tai tiu.
Lal Isu hehpihna chun ei uh gilo a beimang,
Ei hung tatdawk ziekin a lopi na e;
Kumsawt hinna lultak chuh thimnuoi a mite kawmah,
Genzak dingin kuote a chiehdawk ding?
Gamtin mun tin a mite kawmah,
Na hukdamna thu kuo a kiko pih ding?
Kei chieh dawk ing ka Lalpa na hukdamna puong zak di’n,
Na thagau thiengtho in ei puizel in.
Semzel ingka Lalpa di’n sepgim chuh chawlhna ahi
Lallukhuk lopi I chan theih na dingun;
Ma a mihangsan tamtak chiehsate kha hezingin,
Lau loin hangtakin semzel hitiu.
Dai gam leh Arakan gam Tidim biel leh Matupi,
Fang suoka salhvak dingin Lalpa’n ei sam;
Aw Suohpih Lalpa chielna ngilh in kihet mawh sak kin,
Nang leh kei hi mawhpuotu I hiu ui.
Thagau mangthai khatmai bek ka hukdawk theihna dingun,
Na thagau thiengtho chemzam in ei thuom in,
Thim leh gimtheihna nuoi a puidawka salhvak dingin,
Kei uh KHANGLAI TE hi ei hun mangin.
Lalpa Aw-gi chu ngaitiem u,
Leisiet a mite’n;
A hungna ding ni anai tai,
I sepgah kimlo.
Hungtei dingin (2)
Van thamzawl mei chung ah;
Lopi takin hung kipuong ina.
Aman atel chuomte a puih,
Toh ni tieng chu leh;
A nutsiehte haw cheng vang chu’n,
Gimtheih thuok tan au.
Gawtmun meidil aumte chun,
Kum sang sawm-sang za;
Lunggimtheihna thuok kumkhuo ding,
Hin ding guo mah leu;
Van goluoh ding chengte vang chu,
Vak sing seng un au;
Pa lungkim na um theilo ding,
I sepgah kimlo.

songs.title: Hebrai mi sal khupdinpa kha na mu’m?

lines: Doh is E S.S. 167 - T.S. 230
Hebrai mi sal khupdinpa kha na mu’m?
Zing, sun leh zana paucham kha?
A indan ah Zion a hezing a,
Gamla saltang himahleh.
Jerusalem lam ngan tukvan na hawng em?
Ziehin saltang bangin “chawmkhat” um mah leng;
Lalpen lopi taka thuoma hung ding chuh,
Nicheng in na ngakzing em?
Meipi-a paihlut ding chuh lau kiu in,
Sakei-baknei kula khiek le;
Daniel Pathien in hun hukdawk ina,
Angelte hun sawl in tin.
Pathien hing chate haw hangsan unla,
Na suohchak lau kipakin sau;
Zion tangpi lam chuh nga chiet unla,
Lalpen hung chuh tuok dingin.

songs.title: Muon! muonna kim! Khawvel gitloh thim ah

lines: Isai 26:3
Doh is C S.S. 726
Muon! muonna kim! Khawvel gitloh thim ah,
Isu thisan in lunggil a muon sak.
Muon! Muonna kim! sep khawknan ei phak tieng,
Isu deih bang bawl chawlhdam na ahi.
Muon! Muonna kim! lungkham kinawk mahleh,
Isu angsung bel leng hai pai ina.
Muon! Muonna kim! I ngaihte gamlat tieng,
Isu vennan amau tawh I bit ui.
Muon! Muonna kim! tunung ding I he puou,
Isu I heu, Lalchutphah chunga chu.
Muon! Muonna kim! thihna hung tung mahleh,
Isu thihna leh a hatna’n A zo.
Ahun tai lei dogal bei pai tana,
Isun van muonna kim chang di’n ei sam.

songs.title: Lal Isu, ka hun hehpih keia Na hi!

lines: I Pet. 1:8
Doh is F S.S. 659 - T.S. 218
Lal Isu, ka hun hehpih keia Na hi!
Nang vangin gitloh guolnuom cheng nusieng ka;
Ka Tanpa lopi ka Hukdampa Na hi,
Ka Lal Isu, tuhin ka hun hehpih hi!
Nei hehpih masak ziekin ka hun hehpih,
Ngaihdam ka hih nan Kalvari ah Na thii;
Lung lukhuk Na khuk ziekin ka hun hehpih,
Ka Lal Isu, tuhin ka hun hehpih hi.
Damsung leh thih chan inle hun hehpih ka,
Hatna nei piek sung chengin hun chawian ka;
Ka thih ding kuon chan inle ziehih gen ka,
Ka Lal Isu tuhin kahun hehpih hi.
Umna lopi leh nawp tawplohna munah,
Van In vak achun hun chawian zing ingka;
Lallukhuk zephawih khu kawmin lasang ka,
Ka Lal Isu tuhin ka hun hehpih hi.

songs.title: Aw kipah ni, ka huntel ni

lines: Thuch. 16:20
Doh is G S.S. 866 - T.S. 219
Aw kipah ni, ka huntel ni,
Nang ka Hukdampa, ka Pathien;
Ka lunggil nuomsa’n kipak hen,
A kipahna chuh gen viel hen.
Kipah ni (2) Ka gitloh a silthien ni chuh,
Kiven leh paucham dan ei hilh;
Nicheng a kipak zing dingin,
Kipah ni (2) Ka gitloh a silthien ni chuh.
Tatna lopi chuh zawh eitai,
Kei Lalpa a, Amah kei a;
Aman ei kai, ka zuizel tai,
Aw nema A gen zawp dingin.
Ka lung liengvai, tun chawldam in,
Ziehi chawlhna nuom chuh ahi;
Na Lalpa nusieh ngei ki’n la,
A kawma thupha tin changin.
Ka kitiemna vanah A zai,
Kitiemna nicheng in zana;
Ka hinkhuo hi a hungbeih a,
Thih ding thutiem ka chan gei in.

songs.title: Aw, Krista hun hehpih-zawk diek ka nuom

lines: Doh is A8 S.S. 632 - T.S. 228
Aw, Krista hun hehpih-zawk diek ka nuom,
Khupdin a ka pauchamna hih ngai in;
Zie ka nget pen ahi, Krista hehpih zawk diek,
Hehpih zaw diek Hehpih zaw diek.
Lei nawpna, muonna chawlh na ka na hawl,

songs.title: Pathien Cha chuh ka hita ie

lines: Zawmpau
Pathien Cha chuh ka hita ie,
A cha minsel pen chuh ka hi;
Ka lung lauhna a um hiel puoi,
Ka lungkhamna le a um puoi.
Lalpa Thagau panpih zala,
Thihna dawngkawt ka kan tieng leh;
Ka Pa’n naubang ei-sang tan tin,
Dan muolpi khup viei viei tang ka.
Thihna dawngkawt lauhum tak chuh,
Lalpen sepaih hangsan haw chun;
Khandaih hiemtuok meikuong bang chun,
Gitva bang ei heu zel una.
Thihna dawngkawt kihawn tieng leh,

Thagau thiengtho Lamkai pen chun,

Ka lungtup leh ka lunggulh cheng,

Lalpa, nei ngaihtuoh hi!
Lalpa, nei ngaihtuoh hi,
Lalpa, nei ngaihtuoh hi;

Lalpa, nei ngaihtuoh hi!

Paucham phat.... deihum.........!

songs.title: Paucham leh pakna phat a nuom

Bible in ei hilh hi;

Buoina huihpi I thuok u hi,
