Van In vaka naupang ngaihum haw’n,
Midangte “Hungin” ti’n a sam ui;
Ni banga vak, dai banga chim in,
A nuteu ngakin a en zing ui.
Hukdampa Isu Zingsawl Aksi’n,
Gamla taka vakmangte a hawl;
Isu sapna kipahum ngai un,
“Bang dinga vak vai” gilo hungin.

songs.title: Hun kipei in ei pui zela

lines: Doh is A E.C. Hymnal 295
Hun kipei in ei pui zela,
Nite a beih zel lai hin;
Zie lei hi nusie pai tai tiu,
Van In achun cheng dingin.
Hun kipei in ei pui, ei pui zela,
Hun kipei in ei pui, ei pui zela;
Gam lopi chuh zuonin I chieh zel ui,
Hun kipei in ei pui, ei pui zel hi.
Damsung lamsuk lamto hawh in,
Kumhaw chuh I mang bei zel
Dahna, kipahna tuok zelin,
Lungkham ni, kipah ni le.
Lam dika ei pui zel dingin,
Lalpa gingcha zing hitiu;
Gitlohna lampi thim ale,
I petmang ngeiloh na di’n.

songs.title: Thangvan sunni vakin ka lam a salh

lines: Doh is G C.S.S. 103
Thangvan sunni vakin ka lam a salh,
Dam-leh-guom hawh a ka zinna ah;
Isu’n ei tiem, ei nutsieh ngeiloh ding,
Pathien thutiem chuh a zuou ngei puoi.
Thangvan sunni vak (2)
Pathien lopina’n ka tha ahih dim;
Hallelujah! kipahna’n ka dim,
Pahchak la ka sai Isu kei a.
Ka chiehna kimvel thimna’n tuom mah leh,
Ka hukdampa mel a lieh thei puo’i;
Amah Vak ahi, thimna a um thei puoi,
Ei kitawnpih ina lamtawn in.
Thangvan In zuon in ni chengin ka chieh,
Lamtawn in A pahchak la ka sa’i;
A vak in ei salh, kipak in ka chieh,
Thangvan Sunni Vak Isu kei a.

songs.title: I lampiu ah I kipahna din la sai tiu

lines: Doh is F S.S. 832 - T.S. 253
I lampiu ah I kipahna din la sai tiu,
Chawmlo kalin van In tung hitiu;
Zan hung bei in tin kumsawt khuo hungvak ta’n a,
Chawmlo kalin van In tung hitiu.
Chawmlo kal sungin, chawmlo kalsung in,
Tui kinawk galkai hiting;
Buoina huihpi hat a beih tieng kituok hitiu,
Chawmlo kalin van In tung hitiu.
I khutun na sem hitiu I theihtawp suoh in,
Chawmlo kalin Van In tung hitiu;
Pathien lungsietna’n ei hihhat thak zel intin,
Chawmlo kalin van In tung hitiu.
Lampi siem zang hitiu, kengkham chaute hawh di’n,
Chawmlo kalin van In tung hitiu;
Hehpih lunggil pun, thupha chuh gen viel hitiu,
Chawmlo kal in van In tung hitiu.
Buoina cheng khelah kumsawt chawlhna nuom a-um,
Chawmlo kalin van in tung hitiu;
Khawpi vak hawih achun mitthi cheng hul ta’n a,
Chawmlo kalin van In tung hitiu.

songs.title: Leiah guolte tawh phat chawmcha sung

lines: Isai 35:10
Doh is B8 S.S. 961
Leiah guolte tawh phat chawmcha sung,
Kipak in I kikhawm;
Mahleh, I kikhen ding phat gelin,
Lungkhamna a hung tung.
Van ah kikhen um ta puo’n a,
Kikhen um ta puo’n a;
Kipahna gam nuomtak achun,
Kikhen um ta puo’n a.
I ngaihteu thihna lui gal kaite,
Muh kit ding I kinem;
I leisiet sepgim nau a beih tieng,
Amau tawh um tai tiu.
Kikhenna thu kigen ta puo’n a,
Chung lam In hawih achun;
Nawpna, lungmuonna, kipahna la,
Kumsawt in sa tai tiu.

songs.title: Nisa hung tum pai tan tin

lines: I Thes. 4:17
Doh is E8 S.S. 939
Nisa hung tum pai tan tin,
I nasep I zawh tieng leh;
I lunggim nau cheng hung bei ta’na,
Mahleh Lei leh Van Lalpa’n;
Ei uh ei hungpui intin,
Zion tangah kituok khawm hitiu.
Zie chun kituok hitiu,
Zie chun kituok khawm hitiu;
Hukdampa batna nei in
Zie gam vak leh hawih achun;
Zie chun kituok hitiu,
Ziechun kituok khawm hitiu;
A lopina chang tai tiu.
Luiguom a thimnuoi achun,
Huihhat nun git chuh lau in;
Thimna leh huih pin ei um kimvel,
Mahleh gamvak nuom achun;
Lalpan ei puitung intin,
Leichung huihpi nunna khel achun.
I mitthiu chuh luong henla,
I lung lauhna’n dim mahleh;
Leichung nite buoina’n dim mahleh,
I Lalpau chuh hung intin,
A In a eipui ding in,
Zie chun lungkhamna um ta puo’n a.
Eph. 3:8
Aw Lalpa ka Pathien,
Chi tin nam tin chungah;
Na lungsietna, vangsakna leh vangphat
Na’n phungbang Na vuk hi.
Ka kipak mah mah ui,
Na vangsakna chungah;
Na Sapchuomte leh na nasemte hin,
Na min pak bang chawi kau.
Pakchawih un chawihawih un,
Nungak, tangvalte haw;
Nupi, upa, atek-akhang tenle,
Pathien chawian hitiu.
Lalpa paktil bangin,
Chawi chimlo hiel dingin;
I Aw teu leh I lungthim cheng cheng teu,
Amah pie chiet hitiu.
Tichun I sepnau leh,
I thilpiek sunteu chuh;
I pau Pathien kawmah go thilpha chuh,
I khawl uh hi zaw’n a.
Doh is A8 Rev. K. Thuomngell
Lal Isu A thawhkit nungin,
Tiberia dila nga mante;
A sinsakte kawmah A kilak a,
Zing annek zawh in Peter chuh;
Zie thu pawimawh hi A dawng tai.
Simon Jona chapa, nang zie haw sangin,
Kei nei hehpih zawm? (2)
Simon Jona chapa zie haw sangin,
Nei hehpih zaw’m? ti’n A dawnga.
Simon Peter chun a dawnga,
“Ka hun hehpih hi tih Na he’i (2)
Aw Lalpa bang cheng Na he a,
Ka hun hehpih tih na he’i” ti’n.
Lalpa’n Simon Peter kawmah,
“Ka Belam note vak inla;
Ka Belamte enkawl in nekding pie’n,
Na naupan lai bang ta puo’n tin,
Nang thu lo a puih hita’n la.”
Ei le Lalpa’n Peter guol in,
Amah hehph pen di’n ei deih;
I thilneih I sum-leh-pai bang cheng leh,
I lunggil I hatnau chengin,
Amah I hehpih zaw nau em?
“Aw Lalpa ka hun hehpih hi,
Khawvel lopina cheng sangin;
Na nasem di’n kipieng ka ting,
Nanga ding maiin hing ta’ng ka;
Nei hehpih ziekin kei di’n Na thi a,
Beimang sa’n hinna ka mu tai;
Zieziek chun ka damsung chengin
Bang cheng sangin hun hehpih ka;
Na Belamte enkawl ing ting,
Ka hatna leh ka talent cheng;
Nang di’n pie’ng ka,”
I ti ngam dem?
I Peter 1:5
Doh is A8 S.S. 916
Kum tawmcha I nei tai,
Buoina phat chawmcha tawh;
Dahna phat chawmcha mai I nei,
Paucham phat tawmcha tawh.
Thil hihkhelh lungzinna,
Phat chawmcha sung hina;
Lei nawpna phat chawmcha I nei,
Kikhen phat chawmcha tawh.
Kumsawt chawlhna munah,
Kumkhuon umkhawm tai tiu;
Kumsawt ni lopi vak ta’n a,
Kumsawt la sa tai tiu.
Doh is G S.S. 974
Aw In nuoma kituok khawmte,
Kikhen kit ta puon tiu;
Ziechun mitin kituok hitiu,
Kikhen kit talo di’n.
Kikhen kit ta puoi tiu,
Van khela zie gam nuom achun;
Kikhen kit ta puoi tiu.
Sepgim leh buoina khela khun,
Kikhen kit ta puoi tiu;
Lei ah kapin kikhen mahleng,
Vanah kikhen umlo.
Tatsate laka I tel tieng,
Kikhen kit ta puoi tiu;
Kumsawt in chawihat la sai tiu,
Kikhen kit ta puoi tiu.
Luigal gam hawih muonna munah,
Kikhen kit ta puoi tiu;
Krista tawh kumkhuon cheng tai tiu,
Kikhen kitta ta lo di’n.

songs.title: A hung tieng leh, A hung tieng leh

lines: Doh is E S.S. 1140 - T.S. 262
A hung tieng leh, A hung tieng leh,
Suongmantam lakhawm di’n;
A suongmantam lul haw cheng chuh,
A hehpihte chuh.
Zingkal aksite bangin,
A Lallukhuk zemin;
Hawihna suohin vak unau,
A Lallukhuk zem di’n.
Lakhawm ina, lakhawm ina,
A gama um dingin;
A thiengtho cheng, avak cheng cheng,
A hehpihte chuh.
Naupang neute, naupang neute,
A Tanpa hehpihte;
Suongmantam lul haw chuh ahiu,
A hehpihte chuh.
Luke 9:47
Doh is B8 Redemption Songs 657
Naupangte din guolpha a um,
I chung thangvan akhun;
Danglam ngeilo Guol pha chuh,
A hehpih dai ngeilo;
Amah chu leisiet guolte,
Kidang zel bang ei puoi;
Zie guol hin A put min lul,
Hi pu tak mawng ahi.
Naupangte din kichawlhdamna,
Chung thangvan ah a um;
Pathien hehpih naupang te’n,
“He pa” ti’n a sam ui;
Buoina cheng apat chawlhna,
Gitloh, lauhna beita;
Ziechun Kristien naupangte,
Kumsawt in chawl ta’n au.
Naupangte din In a um hi,
I chung thangvan akhun;
Ziechun, muonna Isun vai A hawm,
Kipah, muonna In ah;
Van In bang lei ah umlo,
Tehpih ding le um lo;
Micheng chu a kipak ui,
Mun nuomzaw dang umlo.
Naupangte din lukhuk a um,
I chung thangvan akhun;
Kuole Isu lam en chun,
Dantak leh hun khu’n au;
Lallukhuk vam lopi chu,
A deihguol bawlte leh;
Leia A min hehpihte,
Cheng chu Aman pie’n a.
Naupangte lasak ding a um,
I chung thangvan akhun;
Kisa zing zing mahlele,
Chul thei ngei talo ding;
Angelte nasan inle,
A sak ngei loh uh la;
Hukdampa’n helo mahleu,
Lal bangin a ho ui.
Naupangte din puon lopi um,
I chung thangvan akhun;
Kingkang gihawih pen a um,
Zawhna tumbak a um;
A bawnin chunglam ah um,
Krista mai a muh ding;
Hungun, naupang deihum te,
Ziehaw chu chang dingin.

songs.title: Naupang neu haw hukdamna lopi gente hi thei ui

lines: Doh is D S.S. 1132 - T.S. 256
Naupang neu haw hukdamna lopi gente hi thei ui,
I Tanpau leh Kross A put chuh a genviel thei ui;
Gamla taka umte chuh lungmuonna neihsak dingin,
A Pathienni thilpiek un Bible a thak thei ui.
Naupang neu haw Hukdampa hehpihna kipah-
Um gente ahi thei ui;
Naupang neuhaw’n Pathien thu genin mi tamtak
Van In chuh a hilh thei ui.
Naupang neuhaw’n Lalpa nasep ah hihding a nei ui,
Lungkhamna leh buoina meipi a hihmang thei ui;
Lunggil ngui leh hatlo lungkhama taute kawm achun,
Ni vak hawihtak guolin thu nemtak a gen thei ui.
Hukdampa thutiem achun naupante hetzing a hiu,
Hehpih tatna vangsakna chu le a chang thei ui;
Amau haw chuh zainem takin a veng zinga, vana,
A vansawlchak-teuin Pa mel a mu zing sek ui.
Mark 10:14
Doh is E S.S. 1149 - T.S. 258
Isu zaidam leh nunnem,
Naupangte ei enkawl in;
Ka ngawlnau ei ngaidam in,
Na kawm lam ei zawt sakin.
Na kawma puih ka hihding,
Lalpa deihtak, zadah ki’n;
Na hehpihna gam achun,
Naupangte umna Na piei.
Ka en Pathien Belam No,
Ka tatzuih dinguh na hi;
Zaidam leh nunnem Na hi,
Khatvei naupang na hung hii.
Nangmah bang a um dingin,
Thu awih theihna ei pien la;
Lungsiet thei, nunnem Na hi,
Hehpih lunggil ei hun pie’n.
Isu Belam No nunnem,
Na hehpih khutah ka um;
Nang tawbang in ei siemin,
Ka lunggil sungah chengin.
I Joh. 4:19
Doh is e8 S.S. 1155
Isu’n ei hehpih ka he’i,
Bible-in ei hilh ziekin;
Naupang Amah a ahiu,
A hat puou, A mah a hat.
Isu’n ei hehpih (3)
Bible-in ei hilh hi!
Isun ei umpih, A thii,
Van kawtkhak chuh hawng dingin;
Ka gitloh sawp thieng in a,
A naupang te’n zuon u hen.
Isun ei umpih ina,
Lamtawn ah ei pui intin;
Ka hehpih chun ka thih tieng,
Van In ah ei pui ina.

songs.title: I Hukdampau nungsul chuh zui zel dingin

lines: Doh is D8 S.S. 1158
I Hukdampau nungsul chuh zui zel dingin,
I Hukdampau leh Lalpen chuh zuiin;
I hindan leh Amah umdan pha la leng,
Kipak leh lawptak in la chu sai tiu.
Hukdampa nungsul zuia chieh chuh a hawih na e,
Vak achun chieh in, vak achun chieh in;
Hukdampa nungsul zuia chieh chuh ahawih na e,
Lamdik ah ei pui.
Amah ei Puipa kawm nai achun chieh in,
Chiehmang dinga thepa I um lai un;
Ei panpih ding A ban thahat a kinga’n,
Kipakin ni cheng in chawian hitiu.
Ginnan I hukdam pau nungsul chuh zuiin,
I Puipa ei puihna chuh zui zelin;
Lalpen chu “A hawihna a” I muh tiengleh,
Kipak takin A kawm ah um tai tiu.
Doh is C Redemption Songs 683
Salem khuo a nute’n,
A chateu Isu kawma;
A puih lai un sinsakte chun,
Amau chu ana hawu;
Mahleh a taih mau in Isu’n,
A na mu a, Aw nem takin;
“Naupangte ka kawma-
Hung ding phal un” tin.
“Amau kipahpih in,
Ka angsungah pawm ingka;
Nawhmang kiuin, zehaw ding hin,
A Belampuu hi’ng ka;
A lunggil teu ei piek u chun,
Ka kawmah lopi’n um un au;
Naupangte Ka kawmah,
Hung ding phal un,” ti’n.
Naupangte na lawp di’n,
Hukampa a zainem hi;
Mahleh A min he kha nailo,
Sang tamtak a um ui;
Bible a sim kha ngei puoi hi,
Hukdampa thugen za dingin,
“Naupangte ka kawma hung ding phal un tin.”
Namtin, chitin laka,
Pathien thu awilote hin;
Na thu awi mengu hen,
A milim teu paihmang u hen;
A lunggil uh salhvak inla,
Hehpih Pathien na hih hilh in,
Naupangte Na kawm lam zawt dan sinsak in.
Doh is A K.H. 412 - T.S. 259
Isu’n naupangte A hehpih,
Lunggil hehpihnan A dim;
Sun leh zanin A veng zinga,
A Lalchutphah a patin.
Isu’n ei hehpih hi ka hei,
Amah a maicha ka hi a;
Isu’n ei hehpih ka kipak,
Ama’n ei tatdawk ka hi.
Ka kipahna ziek nei dawt leh,
Krista kei dinga thi chuh;
Chun Bible inle ei hilh hi,
“Naupangte, hungun” a ti.
Isu’n naupang ngetna A za’i,
A Lalchutphah apatin;
Hungun Amah chawian hitiu,
Van-gam phaiphuleng haw tawh.

songs.title: Tangsang apatin luicha a hung luong

lines: Prov. 21:11
Doh is G S.S. 701
Tangsang apatin luicha a hung luong,
A luong zela, a luong zela;
Nisagang kawmah la ngaihnawp um sa’n,
A luong aluong zel hi.
Luicha a luong, gi kawm zelin,
Tuilien zuonin a luong;
Luicha a luong, gi kawm zelin,
Thienthona la chuh san.
Khal nisa thuok hampa haw hih hingin,
Hihhalh thakin, Hihhalh thakin;
Vacha haw leh pakcha haw dawn ding pie’n,
A sukipak zel hi.
Lien deuh deuhin malam na zuon zela,
Gi hieu hieu in, Gi hieu hieu in;
Na chiehna chenga vangsakna thu puo’n,
Gi kawmin luong zelin.
Ei haw naupangte le luicha bangin,
La sa zelin, la sa zelin;
Lung thieng pu’n, mi lungsiet leh panpih in,
Lasa’n chieh zel hitiu.

songs.title: Min khat ka ngaih nawp chuh a um

lines: Sam 5:11
Doh is A8
Min khat ka ngaih nawp chuh a um,
La a sak ka nuom hi;
Zie min chun ei sukipak hi,
Lei chunga min hawihpen.
Aw, Isu, ka hehpih (3)
Ei hehpih masak ziek.
Hukdampa hehpihna ei hilh,
Suohchak na’ng a thi chu;
A thisan lul chuh ei hetsak,
Migilo thienna chuh.
Nicheng in ei hetsak zing hi,
Ka Pa hehpihna chuh;
Lampi thimah chieh mahleng le,
Ka lampi A salhvak.
A hehpih lunggil ei hetsak,
Dahna pen ei nem chuh;
Ka lungkhamna ei thawkpih hi,
Mi dang hih theihloh chuh.
Doh is B S.S. 1053
Lovat leh hal zawh nungin!
Chi pha chuh I tuh ui;
Mahleh Pathien khut hat chun,
Tui buokin a khansak;
Phalbi’n vuk a kieksak a,
Lumna’n a hihkhang a;
Huihchim, nivak A piei,
Hinna dingin guoh tui tawh.
Thilpha I neih cheng cheng,
Chunglam apat ahi;
Ei hehpihna ziekin Lalpa,
Chuh pakcha tiu.
Nai leh gamla a thil cheng,
Siempa Amah ahi;
Pakcha hawihna A pie a,
Aksi vakna a piei;
Huih leh tuiin A thu awi,
Vacha haw le A vak;
Ei uh A chate vang hi,
Nicheng an ei pien a.
Na thilsiem haw cheng ziek hin,
Lalpa, ka hun pakchau;
Buhtuh phat leh buh-at phat,
Damna nei piek ziek hin;
Nei hehpihna zieka thil,
Ka hun piekuh pawmin;
Na thil deihpen ka lunguh,
Na kawmah ka hun pieu.

songs.title: Kumsul vei ta ka nun lui leh hun pha

lines: Kumsul vei ta ka nun lui leh hun pha,
Malai suok ding nei ta maw?
Bangkim gel khawmin,
Suihlung na suhel ngei!
Ka ngilh lah, ka ngilh lah,
Aw, hun leh kumlui muolliem;
Na sungah chitin namtin ka lengkhawm ui,
Chang bang dama kawp bang kim lai kha.
Nunnuom kawlni a kiem, Aw mi zapi,
Nunnuom pak hawih a tuoi tai;
Namtin hin hun chieh nung,
Ngaiin I thil zing ui.
Thei mai leng chuh ninnuom kawlni tu’ng ka,
Zamuolpi a liem mai tai;
Nunlui ngaiin ka mau,
Nunnuom a ka lennau.
Kum lui zamuol liem nung sapkit theih loh,
Guoldeih gibang khensate;
A hinkhuou buting in,
Hun in a liempih tai.

songs.title: I ngak kumthak kipahum a hung tung

lines: I ngak kumthak kipahum a hung tung,
Kipakin zaila sai tiu;
Hun lui ngaih beita hen,
I malam thil hitiu.
Pakchawih na’n ka hun lawp,
Nang hun leh kum thak hung suok;
Lei mite din na pakhawih cheng suoh mai ta’n,
Kum lui beimang sa ngaita puong kau.
Vangphatna kum tamtak beih nung inle,
Isu hehpihna I chang;
Namtin din hun hawihtak,
Lenkawl ni a suok tai.
Lungngai, lusun chate’n puol do mahleng,
Kumthak mel I muh u hin;
Khangthak guol hung piengin,
Bangkim hungthak ta hen.
Chung Pathien vangsakna libang ating,
Hun leh ni lenkawl hung eng;
Vannuoi mi kipak in,
Lambang in pakchai tiu.
Children’s Hymn 14 - T.S. 260
Pathien lehkha ka ging chai,
Isu thutak agen hi;
Van zawtna lampi pen ahi,
Vanah I kal thei ui.
Aw Bible! Aw Bible!
Ka hun ngai, ka hun thalah;
Aw Bible! Aw Bible!
Pathien lehkhabu hi.
Pathien lungthim thuk umdan,
Gitloh leh mihiem umdan;
I damnau le a gen chiena,
Thu lulpen ahi ie.
Isu, Bible a pha ie,
Pathien thilpiek chuh ahi;
Thih a thawhkitna thu a gen,
Hinna thu chuh ahi.
Zana thaumei vak guolin,
Na thu’n lungthim a salhvak;
Go phapen sangin a lul zawi,
Lunggil in vawp ingka.

songs.title: Tuni’n Pathien ni a hung tung

lines: Matt. 12:8
Doh is F Tune : S.S. 302
Tuni’n Pathien ni a hung tung,
Amah chawian din I kikhawm;
Zinga tho in Amah I ho,
Lawp takin kipahna zie hen.
I gitlohnau thupha chawiin,
Eihaw’n thu gilo I zawp sek;
Amah lungsiet zie ngaihtuoh in,
Ei hawih ziek hin mak I sau ui.
Ni gup sungin na I sem thei,
Pathien ni’n sep loh ding ahi;
Aman A phatna’n ei vuk zel,
Zie ziekchun Chawlhni A umsak.
I lunggil un thu mai mai haw,
Van lam thu lochuh ngai ki hen;
Pathien thiengtho A lopi zie,
Ngaihtuoh zaw hen a pawm tak ahi.
Isu guola thilpha bawlin,
Amah guola thu gen theihna’n;
Thagau Thieng, Lalpa, ka ngen ui,
Van chawlhna a ei pui dingin.

songs.title: Chawlhni Lalpa ei hun ngai tha’n

lines: Doh is B8 S.S. 274 - T.S. 263
Chawlhni Lalpa ei hun ngai tha’n,
Na In ah ka leng ui Na ni’n;
Gamgaw apata la hung gi,
Thilpiek gimlim bangin pawmin.
Lei chawlhni hi bawn ka lawp ui,
Vanah chawlhna nuomzaw a um;
Ka sepgimnau hi a beih tieng,
Kipak leh lawpin chawl ta’ng kau.
Buoina, lungkhamna bei ta’n a,
Gitloh, gawtmun um ta puo’n a;
Lungkham leh tauna bei ta’n a,
Kumsawt in chawihat la sai tiu.

Rev. F.W. Savidge
I Pathien hehpihna thuk zie,

songs.title: I kimuh tuoh kit mau cheng

lines: Doh is D8 S.S. 298 - T.S. 265
I kimuh, I kituok kit mau cheng!
Pathien in hun veng zing henla;
A huongsung ah hun veng bit hen,
I kimuh, I kituok kit mau cheng!
I kimuh tuoh kit mau cheng,
Lalpa Isu kengbul ah;
Pathien in hun veng hen,
I kimuh, I kituok kit mau cheng!
Pathien in hun umpih zing henla,
A thalim nuoiah hun sel henla;
Nicheng in nekding hun pie hen,
I kimuh, I kituok kit mau cheng.
I kimuh, I kituok kit mau cheng,
Damsung buoina na tuok tieng leh;
A hehpih khutin hun tu hen,
I kimuh, I kituok kit mau cheng.
I kimuh, I kituok kit mau cheng,

songs.title: I kikhen u khah Lal Isu’n ei vengin

lines: Sam 14:6
Doh is E8 K.H. 434
Tune : S.S. 798
I kikhen u khah Lal Isu’n ei vengin,
Tuhin hing le-damin I kimuu hi;
Kipak tak leh lungguol in kikhawm hitiu,
Thawmhaute chuh nuom takin um hitiu.
Isun dama ei, na ven gel ziekin,
A min pakchawi an kikhawmin lasa’i tiu;
Mihing mai kipahna chuh akim zo puoi,
Van Thagau Thiengin ei lungmuon zing hen.
Van a Lal kawma kikhawp ding lungtup in,
Kumsawt a go thilpha chuh muh guoi tiu;
Pa leh mihingte muh in phat chuh guoi tiu,
I Lal leh I suohpih a hih ziekun.
Zie khawvel ahin A na sem tadih leng,
Van gamah aman chuh mu ding I hiu;
Khawvel dahumna hi thuok tadih mah leng,
A van gam nuom achun kipak nai tiu.
Matt. 11:30
Doh is F S.S. 506 - T.S. 279
Hehpihna gui zawmin,
Lungkhata ding guolin;

Lungtupna leh ngaihtuohna chun,
Siktui bang luong gawm ding.
Lungngai liengvai um leng,

Lalpa minin kilungsiet leng,
Thagau vangphatna din.
Tuhin kikhen mahleng,

songs.title: Pathien in hun veng ina tawp chanin

lines: Doh is D8 S.S. 517
Pathien in hun veng ina, laukiu in,
Nisa leh liepa hun Vengpa ahi;
Nunnem in Amah ate A veng hi,
Ngawna vakvai din hun nusie puo’n a.
Pathien in hun veng ina tawp chanin,
Pa, Tanpa leh Guol pha pen chuh ahi;
Isun na sap chengin hun dawng ina,
Aman hun veng ina Amah gingin.
Pathien in hun veng ina nitum in,
Na kalsuon vengin, hun pui zel ina;
Na Belampu, nang hun chingpa ahi,
A chate tui luonna munah A pui.
Pathien in hun veng ina, damsung in,
Mi piek theihloh vangsakna hun pie’n a;

A tawp leh A gamah hun pui ina.

songs.title: Lopi taka hun tuok ka kinem

Lungkham, buoina a thuok un,
Nangin thuokpih zelin
A damlai niu hung tumin,

Na In ah pui inla.

songs.title: Pathien in atung in kichen hi A siem

lines: Doh is B8 K.H. 437 Tune : S.S. 650
Pathien in atung in kichen hi A siem,
Inkuon bul thiengtho umkhawm dingin;
Kipanpih, kizah a, ginum gel gel din,
Hin kithengin a bukim na’ng un.
Lawp takin kipahpih chiet hitiu,
I suohpihteu kichenna thu hi;
Zien I hetpih u hih Lalpa’n zawm det hen,
Thihna lo chun kuoma’n khen kihen.
A det zie chuh genin, Lal Isu’n A tii,
“A nu leh pa hun nusieu un tin;
Chawnbana kiluoi in, pumkhat hung hi’n au,
Michuom ei puou pumkhat a hung hi’u.”
A det ding zie mai chuh Lal Isu’n a tii,
“Pathien gawp chuh kuoman khen kihen”
Pumkhat ahi tau hi lei leh van hetin,
Kilungsiet na’n kizawm det uhen.
Isun A Sapchuomte A hehpih bang khan,
A hinna amau A piek bangin;
Zie monei dingpa hin le hehpih hen la,
Tehkal thu thieng hi ngai gel uhen.
Lalpa, amau nih hi Na khutah vawpin,
Liehkhuh in Na phatnan vuk inla;
Lungkham leh kipah hun in kihet sakin,
Na piek, nasepna dingin pieu hen.

Chung Pathien vabang pil lungsieta dim,

songs.title: Et chimloh pakcha din mi a pieng hi

lines: Lalthangpuia
Et chimloh pakcha din mi a pieng hi,
Pawm chim puong ie, kipak zing ka;
Pawmlai vawnsen cha hi.
Damsawt ta hen, zuo minlun chawian din,
Khang in, hung lien meng hen la Aw;
Lal sepaih gal do di’n,
Zion galthuom mangin Lalpa,
Vang hun pien Aw.
Chun-leh-zuo vawnchawih in ei nem pen ie,
Phungguol namtin kipahna chuh;
Vawnsen hung pieng cha hi.
Awi ing ie, zaila leh chu’n thehnem in,
Ka saulun sung dung leh vaiah;
Vawnsen pakbang chawi ka.
Sietlei leh Thangvan a ka zuo Minlun,
Na min pak bangin chawi ingka;
Vawnsen paibang kuoh hi.

songs.title: Lalpa hehpihna Isu Krista chuh en un

lines: Sam 98:1
Doh is D S.S. 304
Lalpa hehpihna Isu Krista chuh en un,
Ei venna leh ei hehpihna chuh;
Chitin namtin in pakchau a lungsietna lien,
Amah pakchau mi lungsiet pa chuh.
A tatna lopi ziekin Amah pakchai tiu,
A phatna leh a chitna phuong un;
Chitin namtin inpakchau a lungsietna lien,
Amah pakchau mi lungsiet pa chuh.
A lungsietna lien tak mai pakcha’n lasai tiu,
Mi gilo tan dinga hungkum chuh;
Lalpa Pathien bangkim hihthei leh Lal Messiah,
A Cha Lalmang ei lungsietpa chuh.
Lei leh van a Lal, Immanuel chuh en un,
A vakna chun ei hun sun eng hen;
Zie eng achun van Kanaan gam chuh zuon hitiu,
A Lalna gam chuh I tun na’ng un.

A gam sung cheng achun kumsawt chan inle,
A thilbawl cheng chengin (2)
Chawian un au, aw, ka thagau, chawian un!
Chawian un, thagau saltangte A tandawk,

Chawian un, A thilpiek leh venna ziekin,
I paucham nau ei dawn ziekin chawian un.
Amah chuh chawian un, I lungkham unle,

Ginna leh kinepna ziekin chawian un,
A gam nuomah lungdeih te kituok khawm ding.

songs.title: Tang gamla tak achun Kross melsie tak a ding

lines: Doh is B8 Worship in Song 196
Tang gamla tak achun Kross melsie tak a ding,
Thawkna leh zahhuoi taklat na;
Ka ngainai zie Kross chuh mi mangthaite dinga,
Ngaihum pen leh phapen thihna.
Kross melsie tak chuh ken ka ngainai,
Ka gallak haw ka ngak masieh in;
Kross melsie tak chuh tuzing ingka,
Nikhat tei Lallukhuk then na’ng ka.
Aw Zie Kross melsie khawvel mite muhsit chuh,
Kei vang lunglai ei kuoipen hi;
Pathien Belam No chun van lopina nusie’n,
Kalvari tieng pu di’n A hung.
Zie Kross melsie Pathien thisan behna achun,
Hawihna maktak chuh ken ka mui;

A zahhuoina kipaka puo’n;

Mihing hi bang ahim Lalpa?

songs.title: Khawvel gitloh a mangsa tandawk kit din!

lines: Luke 6:30
Khawvel gitloh a mangsa tandawk kit din!
Pathien in A Cha changkhat neihsun ei piei;
Tatsa gitloh a mangten hinna lama het na’ng un,
Thilpiek a nasem dingin Lalpa’n ei sam.
Pieu inla, tichun piekin um un lau,
Thilpiek in Pathien zo thei ngei puon lau;
Pathien in mihing thil a ba ngei puoi,
Vangsakna nak ahi ngala.
Gingchate, thupiek khauh takmai I muu hi,
“Chieh unla, Chanchin Pha thu gen un!” A tii;
A chiehdawk theilo te’n le mawhpuokna lientak I nei,
Thilpiek a nasem dingin Lalpan ei sam.
Gingchate, khawiah go na khawlkhawm ding um?
Thagau bawma na khawlkhawm u chun mun lau;
Ginna a na piek ding chuh Lalpa’n A ngak zing ahi,
“Bangzat in a nei ginchak ngam ding?” A tii.
Ka na za tai Lalpa nei sapna Aw hi,
Kristien cheng Pathien thu gen dingin nei sam;
Ka hun piei ka neih cheng leh ka sapum ka hinna tawh,
Nanga ka hi, Na thisan in nei chaw tai.

lines: Doh is D Redemption Songs 321 - T.S. 275
Sana leh dangka haw a tatdawk ka hi puoi,
Lei sum leh paiin ka thagau tan zolo;
Kross thisan lul chuh ka hinna suongphum ahi,

Sana leh dangka a tat kei puoi,
Dangka a tat ka hi puoi;
Isu thisana tat ka hi zawi,
Hehpih man simsen loh in.
Sana leh dangka haw a tatdawk ka hi puoi,
Ka lunggil thiemloh a kichan zing laiin
Kross thisan lul chuh ka hinna suongphum ahi,
Ka hukdampa thihna maiin ei tan thei.
Sana leh dangka haw a tatdawk ka hi puoi,
Thienthona dan thupiek chun ei dal laiin;
Kross thisan lul chuh ka hinna suongphum ahi,

Sana leh dangka haw a tatdawk ka hi puoi,

Aw lungsiettu Pathien in,
I lunggil sung ahin;

A thukin a sang na e!
Khawvel chitna sangin;
Pathien hehpihna thu hi,

songs.title: Isu’n ei vak sak, vak thiengtho takin

Isu’n ei vak sak, vak thiengtho takin,
Zana thaumeivak neu a vak tawbangin;
Zie thimna khawvel ahin vak hitiu,

Isu’n ei vak sak mi dangte a di’n,
Thimna chitin in khawvel hi a tuomvel;
Gitloh, lungkhamna lakah vak hitiu,

Kamlala
Kapin a tau ngei puou,
Buoina a zo tau hi;
Van Salem khawpia,
Lai tuol lengten;
$ Gitloh gal a zotau,
Thihna a lau ta puou,
Aw, kipakin la a sau (2) D.S.

Thimin a tuom zing hi;
Lungkham lusun chate,
Kapin a mau;
$ Nau bang I nuihnau le,
Tuoiin muol a liem hi,
A w ka gam ding ka ngai hi. (2) D.S.
Aw, thisan, na vangin,
Khawpi tun ka kinem;
Lui gala lungtuokte,
Kimna gam nuom;
$ Aw, ei pui kai in la,
Angel vamte lakah
Aw zaila sak ka nuom hi (2) D.S.
Gam thiengtho a Lal hung pieng chu,

Sun aksi eng chun ei pui zel intin,

Beimanna gama leng sa nung chu,

Pakin la saitiu Lal thak a pieng tai,

Lawplo a um dem Lal thak chu,
Van mipite chun ahun khen tau;
A ngaiin van khuo a thip zo tai,
Kapin lei a thil ui,
Kumsawt Aksi chun le a zuon zel a,
A pienna Bethlehem tang a hun tun tai.
Aw tuhin ei le chieh hitiu,
Mun thawmhau lam chu zuon zel hitiu;
Lei lalte’n Amah do mahleu le,
Mipihaw cheng inle;
Kei chu ka Lal deih, ka lunglai nem pen !
Mun thawmhauh um ale ei umpih ina.
Doh is G S.S. 19
Vangphat hung kuonna chung Pathien,
Vannuoia min chawian hitiu;
Pa, Cha, Thagau pumkhat ngei hi,
Angelte’n le a chawian ui, Amen.
Ralngam
Lal pien hun kipahum I tung kit tau.
Lawp tak leh kipakin la saitiu;
Thihna thim nuoia chute di’n vakna lopi a tung tai,

A sakmin-Mak, Lemguotthiem Lalpa,
Kumsawt Pa, Cham Lal lopi ahi;
A gamin beih tik ni nei puon tin,

Ginnan chung kawlva bang valeng leng;
Chun lieng Mari pawm sietlei thangvan Lal liengvai va muitiu
I neih gothil cheng cheng va piei tiu
Ginna’n ka galdawt chung thangvan vangkhuo.

Henkawl ei sut ding Lalthak hung pieng chu.

Doh is F Tune S.S. 9
Ka kikhawpnau a haih tiengleh,
Ka kawm u-ah Lalpa umin;
Ka lungthim leh ka chennau In,

Lienkhawpau
Khawvel buoiumna khel lam akhun,
Lalpa’n gam khat A guot a,
Zie chu A mi telte chenna dingin,
Zie chu A mi telte chenna dingin,

I khawsaknau chu van ahi ngala,
Zie apat chun Hukdampa I ngak zing,
Bangkim A thu’n a hih theih ziekin,
I tawmlai taksau hunsiem lopi in a.
Lei avang ling-le-khau a tama,
Gu leh thang in a dim zo,
Ginna tha zap in leng sang sang chiet hitiu,
Ginna tha zap in leng sang sang chiet hitiu,
Lalpa siem van sang nunnuom akhun. (2)
Leng leng leu hing chung thangvan akhun,
Sietlei hi nungtieng sawn in,
Thih-le-nat mei zinna khel lam akhun,
Thih-le-nat mei zinna khel lam akhun,
Van Lal lung chu su awi ngei hitiu. (2)
Chunglam akhun na mit len zingin,
Hukdampa na ngak hitiu,
Chunglam, chunglam, chunglam, en zing hitiu,
Chunglam, chunglam, chunglam, en zing hitiu,

Eden chulnung pakthing bang alun kit nan,
Khawvel hukhing din Lengmang a pieng;
Pielgal nunnawp puon bang I silh theihna din,
Pathien cha’n mun nuoinungpen A hun tel tai.
Lampak hitiu, Vawnchawih hung piengpa chu,
Chawih-atna’n lam bangin pak hitiu;
Ziebang lawma ei dinga Leng hung pieng chu,
A pieng puou pieng kit ta puona kumsawtin.
Malai miten muh a nawpuh zie ni hi,
Mu loin sang tamtak muolliem zo,
Chung Pathien Vawnchawih nausena A pienni,
Tulai mi’n gobang I chan I hampha ngei.
Tuma, tunung vannuoia minsak lakah,
Hukdampa bang kuomah pieng puon au;
Malai mi thiengtho Simeon tawbanga,
Mu-a kipak cheng mi hampha pen a hiu.
Lei leh vana simsen loh mipi lakah,

Israel te’n mang banga apaih nunguh,

Hukdampa, Na vanglim nuoiah,
Chawlhdamna nuom a um;
Na theihna in buoina tincheng,
Apat ei puidawk in.
Na lungkham A kawmah tunin,

Na lungkham A kawmah tunin,

Bangdi’n lungkham na’n I dim dem,

lines: Zatam dinga kipahna chu,
Simsen loh di’n nau bang kahna,

Mung ka ie nunlui muol liem nung,
Pek tin chungah chuong mahleh gitlohna gal lien,
Na felna zalin kei lungngai puong ie.
Eden thim nuoiah nau bang ka kap ui,
Na gam nuom thangvan ka tun tieng,
Ka gitloh teu tui bang thieng ding,
Lal Immanuel gam ninnuom achun.
Hehpihna thak zel ding lam thil ingka,
Hun sangmuol liem ni puon bang thak,
Thagau Thiengtho ei hihhalh in,

songs.title: Ka Pathien, Na vangsakna chu ka mui

lines: Isai 53:5
Doh is G S.S. 131-T.S. 4
Ka Pathien, Na vangsakna chu ka mui,
Hinna, kipahna lungmuonnate chu.
Hallelujah! lopi Nang a!
Hallelujah! Amen!
Hallelujah! Lopi Nang a! ei hihhalh kit in!
A thisan luonna apatin ka mui,
Ka kulhpi leh bitna, ka muonna Pathien.
Ka thihna ding mawh thing kross ah A puoi,
Tu’n chu mi gilote le a suokcha tau.
Belam No pieksa ziekin pawm ka hi,
Pathien Amah ngei in A lemguot ahi.
Zie khawvel ahin gimtheih thuok mah leng,
Ka mun ding van ahi, Krista kawm achun.
Ziehi hun mu’ng ka, Amah lemguot chu,
A lopina keile ei chanpih ina.
Hung kit pai intin, ei hung pui ina,
A Lalchutphah kawmah ei chutsak ina.

songs.title: Aw Lal Pathien, ka ngaihtuoh tieng mak ka sa’i

lines: Doh is C - T.S. 6
Aw Lal Pathien, ka ngaihtuoh tieng mak ka sa’i,
Na khutsuok leh Na thilsiem haw cheng hi;
Aksi ka mu’n, van gi lopitak ka zai,
Na thilhih theihna’n mun tin a zel suok.
Ka thagau in Nang pakna la a sa’i,
Na lopi ie! Na lopi ie;
Ka thagau in Nang pakna la a sa’i,
Na lopi ie! Na lopi ie!
Gammangpi thingnuoi a ka vakviel lai in,
Vacha’n thing a la hawih a sak ka zai;
Muol sang lopihaw chu ka etviel tieng leh,
Luicha luonggi, huihchim nun git ka za’i.
Pathien in A Cha neihsun chuh hawilo a,
Thi dinga A hun sawl chuh mak ka sai;
Kross achun ka gikpuok cheng chuh A pawtai,
Thisan luong in ka gitloh a la mang.
Thawm lopi tawh Krista A hung kit tieng leh,
Van a ei puih tieng ka lung kipak ding;
Kingainiem in Amah ho in khun ing ting,
“Lalpa, Na lopi na e!” ti’n gen ka.

songs.title: Malai Pharo suok a tang te

lines: Doh is F S.S. 880. - T.S. 7
Malai Pharo suok a tang te,
Pathien in a pui dawk;
A thil bawltheih dan suklatna’n,
Tuipi luong A chawlhsak.
Tuipi luong A chawlhsak,
Tuipi luong A chawlhsak;
Isu tawh ka kinaih tieng gal lauh ding umlo,
Tuipi luong A chawlhsak.
Gitloh na’n ka lung a chawk buoi,
Setan thupiek ziekin;
Mahleh Lalpa’n eithamuon hi,
Tuipi luong A chawlhsak.
Ginlah, lauhna’n ei bawm mahleh,
Isu tawh um khawm kau;
A hehpihna’n ei ching intin,
Tui luong chawlhsak in a.
Lal Isu, ka hun a tawp tieng,
Na gam vakhawih mu’ng ka;
Chun, Nang in ei pui in na tin,
Tui luong chawlhsak in la.
Suakliana
Hossana ti zelin aw Halleluijah Amen;
Lal Krista a hung pieng ie Bethlehem a chun,
A paukam suok hehpih thu namtin damna ahi.
Lawpin kiko hitiu, “Hossana” tiin
Aw Bethlehem tang chungah,
Kumsawt kawlni no a suok aw, gen viel hitiu;
Kuole zie hinna vakchu pakbang lawpa pawm ta’n
Albang dah, luonthi nulna thuok talo ding.
A makin a lopi ie, kichamna Lengmang chu,
Hehpih damtui a luon sak sietlei gam ahin;
Gitoh apata I pawtdawk theihna ding ahi,
Hehpih gam Lal ahi I Lalpau Isu.
Pa hun tiem a hungtung tai ei di’n damna ahi,
Hehpihna a luong let hi Kalvari a chun,
Amak zie kuoa gen thei sietlei mihiem aw hin,
Hehpihna gamah naubang ei pui ina.
Zion lopina Lalmang, albang mang ei hawlpa,
Van khawpite’n it mahleu a nang zo puou ie;
Bangkima bangkim chunga Lalpen hen la Amen’
Ei hehpihna kuoman a nielthei puou ie.

songs.title: Abraham Pathien, Isak Pathien, Jakob Pathien

lines: Sam 84:1
Abraham Pathien, Isak Pathien, Jakob Pathien,
Alpha leh Omega, Abul leh Tawp!
Israelte A puidawk a gamgaw gam ah,
Mana’n A vak hi;
Jordan gallam a kaitau ui, Kanaan gam ah,
Pathien umpihna maktak mai a nei ui.
Na umna chu (2) kipak a um,
Na umna ah (2) lamdanna mak a nei ui.
Kei gilo a, liengvai leh hansie puo chung ahin,
A thamuonna maktak a hungtung tai;
Tuipi bang in ei chup kimvel, ka gen thiem puoi,
A hehpihna le;
Sapman um leh ngaihman um ka paupih Lalpa,
A hehpihna chawian ing ka, Hosanna!
A hehpihna (2) a makna e!
A hehpihna (2) chawian ing ka, Hosanna!
Thepna huihpi a nung mihiem theihna khel lam ah,
Guol ding neilo in thihna luiguom ah;
Ei tuomvel ie, beidawna leh lungzinnate’n,
Ei hukdawk ding in,
Bethlehem leh Kalvari tang chu hawhpai in,
Zopa lopi, Lal Isu’n ei hukdawkta’i!
Ka mamawh haw (2) A neikim a,
Ka mamawh haw (2) Amah ah kana muta’i.
Muol a liem zotai ka etchimloh leh ka hehpih,

Thihna Jordan ei kaihsan tai, lunglam ka vai,
Heilo pak chawi in!
Thamuonna mak ka gen sengpuoi, aw Lal Isu’n,
“Hehpihna ziek chauh ahi,” tih ei hilh hi.
Thamuonna mak (2) ka gen thiempuo’i,
Thamuonna mak (2) Lalpa ah ka na mutai.
Thiemgau te’n a genlawk uh Lal Messiah
Kaisar nilopi ah a hung tungtai;
Lal thak deihum ahi chawian hitiu,
Lal thak deihum ahi chawian hitiu.
Aw van mithieng leh Belamputen,
Miching zingzin singkhuola min;
Chung si-al leh mi thiengtho te’n,
Lawp takin Lalthak mimbang pieng ei hilh.
Lal cheng cheng Lal guolin a hung pieng puoi,
Bethlehem bawng In tawmah a pieng ie;
A min ‘Mak’ Lalpa’ chu chawian hitiu,
A min ‘Mak’ Lalpa’ chu chawian hitiu,
A ngelten thakna’n van zai a vawl ui,
“Lei mi zatam singah cham leng hen,” ti’n;
Krista chamna Lal chu chawian hitiu,
Krista chamna Lal chu chawian hitiu.
Hukdamna dak Lal Jubili aw chu,
Lei leh van gam chengah a thang suok tai;
Lal Immanuel chu chawian hitiu,
Lal Immanuel chu chawian hitiu,

songs.title: Pathien hun lui a ei panpih

lines: Sam 90:1
Doh is C S.S. 513. - T.S. 10
Pathien hun lui a ei panpih,
Hun thaka kinepna;
Huih lauhum a ka kiselnau,
Leh ka kumsawt In uh.
Na Lalchutphah lim nuoi achun,
Na mithiengte a cheng;
Na ban tun mai le kei u di’n,
Ka hinnau khawp ahi.
Tanghaw ana dindawk mau leh,
Lei akisiem ma’n le;
Kumsawt in nang Pathien na hi,
Lamdang ngeilo kumkhuo’n.
Nang ngaih in kum sang tampi le,
Nitak khat bang ahi;
Ni suoh kit kal a zan beihna,
Zanven bangin a chawm.
Hun in tuilien luong zing bang in,
Mihingte a tawk mang;
Zingkal a mang a man bangin,
Hetloh in hun a bei.
Pathien hun lui a ei panpih,
Hun thak-a kinepna;
Nang chu damsung a ei vengpa,
Leh ka kumsawt In hi’n.
Lal David suon Aksi vak hawihtak chun,
Bethlehem A salh vaka;
Vakna thu chu puongin a gen viel ui,
“Chungnung penah lopi pen hen” a tiu.
“Chungnung penah lopi pen hen!” ti’n la asau,(2)
Zailan awi ui, van Angel mipiten;
“Chamna thu leng hen”ti’n zaila a sau.
Belampute’n belam a ven lai un,
Lal sawlchak lopi tak chun;
“Bethlehema Hukdampa hung pieng chu,
A kiengah va chieh un” ti’n a hilh hi.
Thangvan mipite khu galin dawn diu,
Lal Krista a khen niu chun,
Nuoi simlei hi ding in gal thil ui.
“Chungnung penah lopi pen hen” a tiu.

Gitloh huoisie ngaidam ding a,

Gitloh simsen loh ngaihdamna,

Aw, lungsietna gensen loh chuh,
Pathien thilhih mak ahi a;
A pakna chun khawvel dim hen,

Nangmah bang in mi kuo-a um?
Nei ngaidam zel in Nei na deih (2)

songs.title: Lalpa ah I kipak ding um

lines: Doh is B8 S.S. 780 - T.S. 13
Lalpa ah I kipak ding um,
A neihzawh dan sut un;
A Thu sung ah ginna’n latsak,
A tam zie ngaihtuoh un.
Ngaihdamna, muonna, hatna,
Thienthona leh Pielgal a um;
Cheng hih Isu vang in kei a,
Pakna zaila chuh Amah kawm tung hen!
Pathien hehpihna chun gitloh,
A ngaidam suokkei tai;
Ngaihdamna, kichamna ka nei,
Isu thisan chamna.
Hehpihna’n gitlohna zo di’n,
Zawhna kim ei pie a;
Lunggil ah Thagau Thiengtho chun,
Gitloh A thiensak sek.
Pathien kawma mi puihna ding,
Thagau in ei pie tai;
Amah, Lal Krista ei piek khah,
I lung u ah A cheng.
Ginna’n vangpiekna cheng chang in,
Ginna naupangtak in;
Pathien in Krista vang ngei in,
Ei piek A tiem ahi.
Upa Rokunga
Doh is Ab
Vannuoi misimpina bawlin,
Lalpen Kaisara chun;
A chiel vel hi namtin vawnchawih,
A gam sunga mite,
Aw Bethlehem ka hun ngai hi,
Belampute gam giehna;
Serafimte zaila sakna chu,
Ka Lal pienna mun a hi.
A liengvai ngei van Lal cha chu,
A zalna gan kuongah;
A hung pieng hi Mari vawnsen,
Bawng In tawm nuoi a chun.
Chungnung penah lopi henla,
Vannuoi mi cheng cheng di’n;
Lei ah kumsawtin cham leng hen,
Chamna Lal A pieng tai.
Isu ka kawm u-ah umin,
Zan khawsawt nungin le;
Lawpin taikhuo ei vak pihin,
Na min chawian dingin.
Doh is E8 S.S. 17 - T.S. 15
Pathien in gilo A hehpih,
Puk a sesa nung chu;
Hukdamna bukim lultak chu,
Man bei in mi A pie’i.
Aw, hehpihna mak ahi,
Pathien ei hehpihna!
Ka Hukdampa a hung kumsak,
Kalvaria thi dingin.
Ginna’n Amah kei a ka ti’i,
Pathien Cha thokit chu;
A thih ziekin tatna ka mu’i,
Thisan sawpthienna tawh.
Hehpihna’n bukimna a tun,
Mithiengte A hetsak;
Lunggil gitloh a sukbei sak,
Krista mai gin vang in.
Gingchate, kipak in chieh u’n,
Hun na pie ding ahi;
Lei a na hetlawk uh go thil,
Van a bei talo ding.
Setan nuoisieh a guolzo in,
Tatsate’n la sau hen;
Lalpa Krista thihna zal a,
Guolzo a nunnuom in.
Thangleu?
Ka gitloh ziekin van Lal cha thiengtho,
Lei ah a hung a;
* Khawvela mihiem min a zik lai un,
Bethlehem bawng In sungah a siel ui,
Ka hinna dingin (2) D.S.
Mi tin a dingin Hukdampa Lalpa,
Nausen in a pieng;
* Van mipiten kipah la a hun sau,
Chungnung pena Pathien lopi pen hen;”
Ti’n a hun gen ui (2) D.S.
Aw A min chu –Mak, Lemguotpa Lalpa.
Chamna Lal ahi;
* Chamna hung leng hen khawvel chung ahin,.
Khawsak michingte’n le a hun zui ui,
A gam tawp puona (2) D.S.
I Joh. 3:1
Doh is D8 S.S. 21 - T.S. 17
Ngaiun Pa hehpihna nasa,
Ei piek tawpneilo chuh;
Gilo mangthai “Pathien cha a,”
Sim tel I hih theihna’n.
“Ngai un, ei hehpihzie chuh,
Pa’n eihaw ei hehpihzie chu a nasa nazen e;
Pathien chate hi ding a,
Sim tel a I um theihna’n!”
Amah apat gamla talo,
“Thisan lun” ziek’ I naih;
“Deihtaka pawmin I um tau,”
Pathien lunggil sung ah.
Lopina bangti I chang dem,
“Tih a kilang nai puoi,”
Lalpa deihum I muh tiengleh,
Amah mel bang pu’i tiu.
Zie bang kinepna chuh nei in,
I thientho diu ahi;
Chawmlo a I muh pai ding uh,
Lalpa thokit bang in.

songs.title: Pathien ei hehpihna a lopi na e!

lines: Doh is A Joanna Welsh Tune Book - T.S. 18
Pathien ei hehpihna a lopi na e!
Mi gimthei hing hawilo vang ei pie zing hi;
Gitloh ngaihdamna leh lungmuonna ei pie’i,
Gitlohna gal zo dingin ei panpih thei.
Sietlei teutui in ka gitloh thieng theilo,
Gan tamtak thisan inle ei tan thei puo’i;
Isu thisan lul I kithawihnau ahi,
I gitloh cheng na lo in ei hihdam thei.
Khawvel Tanpa kieng ah kumsawt lopina,
Lei leh van mi chengcheng in Amah pie’i tiu;
Ama’n ei hukdam tak ziekin ka kipak,
Kumsawt in mi cheng in Amah pakchai tiu.
Tu apatin Chanchin Pha a hungtung ta’i,
Salhvakpa A suoktai, Amah i mu tau;
Gamtin apat namtin hung kikhawm un tin,
Van Lal hi chawian in zaila hun sa’n au.
Ezek. 34:26
Doh is B8 S.S. 306 - T.S. 19
“Vangpiekna guohpi hung zu’n tin,”
Hehpih thutiem chuh ahi;
Halhthakna phat hung tung intin,
Hukdampa’n A hun sawl chuh.
Vangpiekna guoh chuh,
Vangpiekna guoh I ngai ui;
Hehpih guohmal a hung chak hi,
Guohpi hung di’n I ngen ui.
“Vangpiekna guohpi hung zun tin,”
Halhna deihum hun tun in;
Muol leh dam gam tin, mun tin ah,
Guoh tampi hung zu gi chuh.
“Vangpiekna guohpi hung zu’n tin,”
Kei-uh ei hun pie’n, Lalpa;
Halhthakna chuh ei hun pie’n la,
Hung in na thu limbawl in.
“Vangpiekna guohpi hung zu’n tin,”
Aw, tuni’n le a zu thei;
Pathien kawm ah ka kiphuong ui,
Tuhin Isu ka sam ui.
Sawngkhawkhai
Vanmang vawnchawih hung pien ni lenkawl ah,
Ahung eng tai Bethlehem tang ah;
Gitloh zanthima suihlung mawlte di’n,
I chung lenkawl ni a hung suok tai.
Lampak hitiu chamna Lal vawnchawih,
Kumsawt tawplo Lal lai vul zel ding;
Sietlei leh thangvan ah lal tan tin,
A gamin tawpni him nei puona.
Chung si-al saktieng kawlah ngobang lang,
Zingzin michingten sul a zui ui;
Thangvan mithiengten simlei gal dawtin,
Chun lieng vawnsen naubang a awi ui.
Vanmang vawnchawih pienna dai bawng In ah,
Chieh in aw Lautha sing va lawi in;
Zie chun na Lal sakmel tuibang tawm lai’
Chun nem silhpuon hui in va mun la.
Doh is Ab Rokunga
Lal David vang khawpi tuolnuom a chun,
Sunni muolliem kuonin;
Singkhuol nungak thiengtho liengthei Mari.
Gieh na’ng mun a chang puoi’
Bawng In sung a bel hi
Ngaitie zie mun tawm leh thawmhau a chun,
Zan khuo a hung sawtin;
Enna lopi tak chu a hung tungtai,
Bethlehem bawng In ah,
Lal thak a hung pieng tai.
A tel chuom puoi Lal In leh mun lopi.
Mun niem a tel zaw ie!
A mak na e! zie Lal deihum pen chu,
A hehpih lei mite’n,
Amah a deih puou ie,
Hehpihna chu a hung kilak ma chun,
Pa kawma um a hi;
Tanpa Pathien mihiem a hung chan hi,
Ka tha’n a het phetin,
Lunggil in mak asai
Aw Lalpa Isu, Nang hung kilak in,
Ka lunggil sung ahin;
Hetna thagui lunggil hi tuomvel in,
Ei umpih zing inla,
Kumsawt, kumsawt chanin
Doh is G Saidailova
Lal pienni muol a liemsa,
A hung vak kit tai;
Muh ka nuom singkhuol luna,
Van Lal cha hung pieng chu;
Na sunga van Lal cha hung pieng chu,
Chun liengthei Mari’n a chawi;
Lal Immanuel chu.
* Chung nungpena chung nungpenah,
Pathien lopi zing henla D.S.
Amen, Amen, Pathien lopi zing henla Amen.
Kristmas ni a hung tun tieng,
Bethlehem ka ngai;
Bethlehem tang ngaih chulnung,
Pak bangin a lun ie;
Thangvan mite pakna zaila gi,
Ka lunggilah a cham ie;
Ngilhni umta puona.
Aw nang Bethlehem khawpi,
Na hawih diek na e;
Na sak min hi van nuoi ah,
Aw chul thei ta puona;
Thangvan aksi vakin ei pui hen,
Bethlehem dai kawm achun;
Nausen deihum ka lunggil,
Ah hung pieng kit hen;
Chun thehnem in hui ingka,
Ka kumsawt Lal dingin;
Kumsawt in chamna hung leng tan tin;
A min thiengtho pahchaknan;
Daihni nei ta puonna.
Thangngur
Ngai un Bethlehem dak agii,
Van mi a hung kikhawm;
Van Lal Immanuel chawian di’n,
Belam chingte a hung ui,
Aw, ei hawn le chawian hitiu.
A gi a hawih na e!
Kristmas’ dakin ka lung a kuoi;
Bethlehem ei hetsak hi,
Michingte guola chieh dingin;
Ka thagau, nang le kisa’n.
Michingte mapui van Aksi,
Bethlehem ei tunin;
Van lal kuolna bawng In tawmah,
Sunsawt chawmsak ka nuom hi,
Mi ngaihin munniem himahleh.
Lalpa Kristmas vang hun pie’n la,
A lawpte lunggilah;
Gam tuolthing pak lunlai guolin,
Van Lal lopina dingin,
Van kipahna chu paksak in.

songs.title: Ka Pa, Ka Pathien, In apat

lines: Matt. 10
Doh is A8 S.S. 718. -T.S. 23
Ka Pa, Ka Pathien, In apat,
Gamla taka ka um laiin;
Lunggil a ti di’n ei hilh in,
“Nang thu hi hen!”
Guol lungtuolte ka gamla tieng,
Lungkham, thawmhau in um mahleng;
Nanga kipie’n zie gen zing ka,
“Nang thu hi hen!”
Ka lunggil lungkham tak ahin,
Na tha zintung in, hihnuom hen;
Adang cheng chu Nangah ka nga’i,
“Nang thu hi hen!”
Ka utna nicheng’ hihhat in,
Nang deih thilbawl utna ei pie’n;
Tih haksatna cheng la mang in,
“Nang thu hi hen!”
Mitthi puma ka pauchamna,
Leh ka hinna hung beih tieng;
Luigal nuomzaw ah la sa’ng ie,
“Nang thu hi hen!”
Thangngur
Eden huona ei suonteu mawl ziekin,
Gitloh thihna’n vai a hawm ie;
Thihna thazakna thim nuoiah,
Mipi sang tamtak a mau ui,
Hukdampa piek tiem chu ngakin.
Halleluia, Amen, Amen !
Van hehpih pak si-al mel a lang tai;
Ka tha nunnuom in zaila sa’n,
A mangsa van pielgal a khun,
Aw hun pui kit ina.
Lal lunggulh Tanpa hung pien ni ding chu,
Abra’m, Mosie, Lal David in;
Ngaiin gamla tak a thil ui,
Ginnan a Hukdampau ni chu,
A na muu a a kipak ui.
Van hehpihna pak Si-al mel hawih chu
Zuiin ka tha lungkham lo in;
Thihnan a tha hun zak khum in,
Gitloh galin hun huol mah leu,
Bittak in nang hun pui ina.
Gitloh a thiemloh chan ka lau ta puoi,
Lal thisan lul ka gin ziek in;
Van hehpihna tuipi kiting,
Kalvari-a hung luong dawk khan,
Ka kieng ka kimah ei chup hi.
Thup. 19:16
Doh is B8 S.S. 203. - T.S. 24
2nd tune ah - “Khuksak u’n, Lalpen chuh.”
Lal Isu min chawian hitiu,
Angelte’n chawian hen; (2)
A min pakthing bang chawi hitiu,
Khuksak...un, khuksak (3) Lalpen chu khuksak un.
Pathien thihpihte’n khuksa un,
Maicham apat samte’n; (2)

Khuksak...un, khuksak (3) Lalpen chuh khuksak un.

Lungsiet a hun hukdampa chuh,

Nanghaw Jentel migilote’n,

Leisiet a mi I bawnchau in,
Phungguol leh namtin in; (2)
Lalna chengcheng Amah pie’i tiu,
Khuksak..un, khuksak (3) Lalpen chu khuksak un.
Thangvan a mithiengte haw tawh,
A ma ah khun hitiu; (2)
Kumsawt la chuh sakpih hitiu,
Khuksak...un, khuksak (3) Lalpen chu khuksak un.
Sam 8:9
Doh is F III Alexander 1976. - T.S. 25
Isu min thilbawlthei pak un,
Angelte’n le pak hen;
Lallukhuk chu hun lau in la,
Khuksak un mitin Lal.
Khuksak hitiu, Khuksak hitiu,
Khuksak hitiu, Tanpa Lien mitin Lal chuh;
Khuksak hitiu, Khuksak hitiu, Lal chuh,
Khuksak hitiu, mitin Lal.
Namtin leh phung tina mite,
Sietlei chung a umte’n;
Lalna cheng chu Amah pie’i tiu,
Khuksak un mitin Lal.
Chunglama zatam mel muhloh tawh,
A keng bul akhun; ding;
Kumsawt la chuh sak pih hih hi ting,
Khuksak ding mitin Lal.
Thangngur
Nunnawpna Krismas na pak ka tan lai un,
Kumpi muolliem ding hi zuih guo a;
Chawnban huntu mahleng nungtieng nei sawn hi,
Ka hun phal puou ie.
Muolliem loin cham in.
Ka hun ngai ui cham in;
Seino guol in gibang ka hunkhen phal puou;
Nunnawpna Kristmas
Kumpi muolliem ding hi zuilo thei kei puoi;
Chieh loa nichuong thei ding kei puoi;
Na nawpna pakuh tun muolliem ding kei tai,
Dam takin chibai
Ka hung kivel kit tieng,
Dawn bang kituok hitiu;
Vangsakna thak tawh kilawp kit ngei hitiu
Dam takin chibai.
Nuoi simlei um tunga Lalpa guot bangin
Gibang kikhen lo thei I hi puou;
Na la gihawih lunggil ah daibang a cham,
Nunnawpna Kristmas.
Pathien in ei veng hen,
Dawn bang kituok kit di’n;
Na thutiem vangsakna kha puon hung kitin
Dam takin Krismas.

songs.title: Pak un! pak un, Lal Isu I Tanpau deihum!

lines: Doh is A8 S.S. 208. - T.S. 26
Pak un! pak un, Lal Isu I Tanpau deihum!
Simlei, la sa’n, A hehpih mak phuong un;
Amah chawian hen, van Angel lienpen inle,
Hatna, zahna A min thiengtho piei tiu,
Belampu bang’ Isu’n A mite A pui,
A chawnban in nitum in A veng hi.
Pak un! Pak un!
A lopina chungnung phuong un;
Pak un! Pak un! kipahna la’n sau in!
Pak un! Pak un! Lal Isu I Tanpau deihum!
I gitloh ziek un A thuok in, A thi’i;
Amah Suongpi, kumsawt hukdamna kinepna,
Chawian un! Isu khetden a um chu!
Pakna la sau, Isu’n I lungkham A puo’i,
Tawpbei hehpihna thuk leh mak A nei.
Pak un! Pak un! Lal Isu I Tanpau deihum,
Thangvan tuol ah, ‘Hosanna!’ ti’n a sau;
Lal Isu Hukdampa’n kumkhuo’n vai A hawm hi,
Pak un! Amah Thiemgau, Thiempu, Lalpen!
Khawvel zawhna tawh Krista lei ah hung ding,
Hatna leh lopina Lalpa chang hen.

songs.title: Luipi gal lam mun hawih nuomtak akhun,

lines: Sol. La. 5:6
Doh is B8 S.S. 93. - T.S. 28
Luipi gal lam mun hawih nuomtak akhun,
Mi sang zatam tuibang kigawm diel!
Van ah Hukdampa lungsiet, thutak a dim,
Tawh tanbang kikim thei kuo a um?
Aw, A lienpen ie sang-zatam lai ah,
A pahchakna tuibang luong zel hen;
“Amah bangkim bangkim ah A hawihpen hi”
I kumsawt zaila diu chu hi hen.
Amah bangkim, bangkim ah A hawihpen hi,
Nem dildiel in A hun sam zing hi;
A hukdamna athawn-aval a piek hih,
Ka thagau, bangdi’n pawmlo ding maw?
Amah bangkim, bangkim ah A hawihpen hi,
A aw ngai un, A hun sam zing hi;
“Hung un! hung un! lungkham leh puokgik pawte,
Ka kawm ah na puokgik uh hung ngau!”

songs.title: Chawian un Lal Krista I Lalpen!

lines: Thup. 19:16
Doh is G S.S. 94. - T.S. 29
Chawian un Lal Krista I Lalpen!
Kumsawt in A chawiat la gi hen!
Lopina, zahna A min piei tiu,
Tu leh kumsawt chan in.
Chawian hitiu, chawian hitiu,
Gam lopi ah Lalpen chawian ding;
Chawian un, chawian un,
A pahchak la sau un.
Chawian un, van sang a Angelte’n,
A Lalchutphah gihawih in awi un;
Namtin in chawihatna la sau hen,
“Lalte Lal chawian un.”
Galhat ahi, gitlohna A zo,
A thu’n I lunggil ah vaihawm hen;
A min ziekin guolzawhna mu’i tiu,
Kumsawtin chawian un.
Sawngkhawkhai
Zawlnei genlawk van Mang Vawnchawih.
David suona hung pieng ding;
Lengmang Kaisar Lal gam kimvel ah a than laii’n,
Angel lopi hung tuol kum in, A hun phawng ui Belampute;
“Ngaiun tuni’n David khawpi achun,
Hukdampa a pieng tai, A min Lal Krista chuh,
Na het nang un Nausen puontuom Gankuong sung achun mu’n lau.”
A min mak chamna Van Lalmang,
Lengmang Pathien hat chungnung;
Kumsawtpa Lalmang hung hin tin,
A gamin tuoi ni nei puona,
Kumsawt tawplo Lalmang hung hina, Amen.
Tichun Van mi thiengtho simsen
Loh ten kipakna la san;
Bawng-In tawma Nausen mimbang pieng a chawian ui,
Singkhuola zing-zin michingte, Leh van aksi vak hawihtak chun;
A hun zuon ui van Lal vawnchawih Nausen,
Mimbang a a pien na, Bethlehem a Bawng-In
Belamputen le kipak in; Lal chibai a va buk ui.
Sietlei hingmi namtin vawnchawih,
Thihna dailim a leng te;
Van Lal pienna lawm din Bethlehem ah chieh hitiu,
Zie gam thiengtho a Nausen chuh, A min ‘Mak’ ‘Lalmang’ chu ahii,
I neih go thil phate chawiin kipah
Na zaila sakawm in, Chibai vabuk hitiu,
Hallelujah lopi pen hen, Kumsawt Lengmang hung pieng chuh!

songs.title: Isu Na thu ka ngaihtuoh in

lines: I Pet. 2:7
Doh is A S.S. 60. - T.S. 31
Isu Na thu ka ngaihtuoh in,
Ka kipahna alien;
Na mel tak chu ka hun muh tieng,
Ka lawpna sang in a
Khawvel aw hawih chengcheng ahin,
Gihawih tincheng lak ah;
Mihing Hukdampa Na min hi,
Ngaihnawp ka sapen hi.
Kisikte lungmuonna Na hi,
Liengvaite lawpna tawh;

Ei hehpih zie ka genthei puoi,
Lalpa, hun chawian zing ingka (2)
Ka hukdampa chu a thi tai,
Kalvari ah, Kalvari ah;

Khawvel hawihna pen sang inle
A niem lai pen le a hawih zawi

Bang guol phetin a hawihta dem(2)
Puna
Hukdampa’n ka gitloh tanin,
Lei ah albang A vai:
Gilo hing taklote guolin,
Thing ah a thawk sak ui.
Aw hinna Lal thiengtho tak chun,
Kei di’n A thuok zo tai;
Thihchana lungkhamna thuokin,
Eihaw ei tandawk tai.
Hukdampa’n “Ka dang a chak hi”
Ti a kiko lai khan;
Mipi sang tamtak lak akhan,
A pie nuom a um puou.
A lampi chu thil zel leuhing
Kalvari tang tieng in,
“Lalpa ka hun zui ngam puou hi”
A gingte’n a tiu ui.
A lungkham A thavaih bang khan,
Panpih a ngai zing hi;
A deih bang thil hih zel dingin,
Ka theihna a tawm ngal.

songs.title: Lalpa lunggil leh aw’n pakcha’ng ka

lines: Doh is B8 S.S. 899. - T.S. 34
Lalpa lunggil leh aw’n pakcha’ng ka,
Amah achun kipak ka;
Ei lungsietna mak chuh la’n sa’ng ka,
Ziehi ka la hi’n a.
Ka gitloh cheng Ama’n A lamang,
A min thieng pak un! A min thieng pak un!
Ka gitloh cheng Ama’n A lamang,
Halleluijah A min chuh.
Ka gitloh cheng tawh Amah ka zuon,
Muonna leh chawlhna mu di’n;
Ka ngetna ngaihtha’n ei suohchak sak,
Ziehi ka la hi’n a.
Ka hat tawppen inle pakcha’ng ka,
Thihna A zawhna ziek in;
Kumsawt chan in Amah chawian ka,
Ziehi ka la hi’n a.
Kuole a hawl nuom di’n mun a um,
A nuom tapoh hung un la;
Kipahna bukim kawihsa’n a um,
Kipak in la sa’i tiu.

Mi sang tamtak in la sa’n au,
Hukdampa chawian in; (2)

Ei lungsiet Lalpa, ka Pathien,
Hatna ei hun pie’n la; (2)
Zie leisiet gam thim chung ahin,

Isu minin lauhna nawhmang,

Gilo di’n ngaihnawp um ahi,
Hinna, damna, muonna. (3)
Leisiet zinmang Nuoisiehpa chun,

Kamlala
Tuhin khawvel buoina hi tawh,
Sim leh mal ah vak mahleng;
Van in nuoma ka lawih tiengleh,
Mungka kipahna kim chu.
Thihna luigal ka kaih tiengleh,
Kalvari tatna thisan;
“A lopi ie Hallelujah”
Tin hailo in chawian ka.
Hehpihna tincheng chu neiin,
Makhan Lalpa a vakvai;
Aw ka thagau thil zel inla,
Hukdampa chu na muh ma’n.
Jerusalem tawh suok inla,
Aw Kidron luigal lamah;
Hukdampa chu vahawl zelin
Kalvari na tun masieh.
Hansie huolvel zie tang achun,
Lau loin chieh zel inla;
Thagau, na nawpna kim ina,
Ka Hukdampa thisan ah.
Thagau vakvaite cheng cheng chu,
Kalvari ah chieh khawm ui;
“Aw hehpihna a mak na e”,
Tin a pak chim ngei puou hi.
Patea
Jerusalem indan chungnung achun,
Ka Lalpan a thisan a hawm ie;
Khutichun, lungngaihna mei zing nuoiah,
Ka Lal thavai naubang a kap hi.
Aw nanghaw, Jerusalem mite,
A lungsiet na chanuh heu inla;
Na nat tincheng uh a hun sukdam sak,
A lungngaihna hengilh lo zen un,
“Jerusalem khuo kulh pawlam achun,
Thiemgau thih dan ahi puoi” a tiu;
Mahleh entie, Kalvari lampi khu,
Mipi lakah ka Lalpa ka mu’i.
En tiem u, Kalvari tang chung achun,
Van Lal cha thisan chu a luong ie;
Khawvel gitloh cheng thienna ding ahi,
Van Lal nunnem thisan hung luong chu.
Hun hengilh ngei hiel puong ka, Lal Isu,
Kalvari lam chu hung nga nang ie;
Kei dinga na thawkna ka lungsung ah,
Ka nuktan tieng geiin hezing ka.
Doh is F M.K.H. 62. - T.S. 37
Ei Hukhingpa chuh zuiin,
Kipahna la sa’ng ie -
Zatam chung chuong tahen,
Ei khawtuohna’n A luong tuok in,
Thisan in ei chaw’i-
A min chuh lopipen hen.
“Hallelujah, kumsawt Lalpa,
Lopipen hen,” tih hi;
Ka kumsawt la chu ahi,
Ei Hukhingpa, ei hung Tanpa;
Migilo Tanpa lopipen hen,
Ei khawtuohna’n A luong tuok in;
Ka hinna’n A thi’i-
A min chuh lopipen hen.
Thim nuoi leh hatlohna ah,
A vanglien ka belh;
Sing-zatam chungchuong ta hen;
Sietlei dogal tam lak ah,
Lau lo a ei pui zing,
A min chuh lopipen hen.
Ka kawm a vak in, ei veng,
In ei luongmuon hi;
A min chuh lopipen hen,
Jordan lui ei pui kaiin;
Van gam ei tun ina,
Amin chuh lopipen hen.

songs.title: Zing khawvak sang in Na hawih zaw’i

lines: Sol. La 5:16
Doh is A8 S.S. 98 - T.S. 38
Zing khawvak sang in Na hawih zaw’i,
Aw, ei Hukdampa, Lalpen;
Na lopi, lalzie la a sak,
Ka lungthim a kipak hi.
Zing khawvak sangin Na hawih zaw’i,
Na vakzaw’i sun laitak sang inle;
Na umna mun lopi achun,
Thimna leh dahna umlo.
Vakna’n puon banga kizem in,
Lal lopina lukhuk khu’n;
Lalgam a thuneihna chengcheng,
Kumsawt in Nanga ahi.
Aw, Na hehpihna lopina,
Na zahngaihna lopi tawh;
Na hehpihna chun Lalgam ah,
Kei di’n mun ei bawlsak hi.
Ka khawvel hun hih a beih tieng,
Leisiet hinkhuo a beih tieng;
Amuna-mun sang tamzaw tawh,
Kumsawt in la sa ta’ng kau.

songs.title: Krista chanchin hawih ka muh in

lines: Doh is G S.S. 88. - T.S. 39
Krista chanchin hawih ka muh in,
Lunggil in pak la sa;
Kei din a thii Kalvari ah,
Krista ka la hi hen.
Krista chanchin hawih ka muh in,
Kipahna la sa’ng ie;

Na thagau in ei hilh inla,

China

A lungkhamna panpih a um puou maw,

Nu nauhaw chu lungkham tak in,

A thihna ding tang a tun tau.
Bangtina a bawluh va en diu in;
A put thinga etnawp din a khai ui,
Mipin a nuihsan.

Sun leh zan in tamtak ka dawng ta a;

Thagau thiengtho, Nang in ei hung hilh in,
A pienna bawng In leh A thihna Kalvari;
Leimi suihlung mawl te’n,
Joar ei Tunpa hi,
Gen zo thei a um puou,
Hin khawpi ka tun lawh.
Bethlehem ah van bungpi a kek hi,
Suohlam mi leh Belampute puipa;
Si-al lien, kei le ei hung puiin,

A pien in leng Herod gal a hung lien,

Ka gitloh leibat dit di’n Lalpa,

Khuo ei tuoh manin maw,

songs.title: Ngaiun zie thusim maktak mai hi

lines: Doh is D8 III Alexander 77. - t.S. 63
Ngaiun zie thusim maktak mai hi,
Khatvei mi mang I na hiu;
Mahleh Van Lal lopi hung kum chun,
Man sim guolloh in ei tan.
I henkawl buh kuo a ei sut?
Bang A bawl em?
Tu’n khawia um?
I sikgen in Vanah A um.
Angel I mun luoh theih ding umlo,
A chungnung pen hilele;
Mi nuolsuot Kross a khetdena um,
Pathien thumte laka khat.
Zie thusim maktak hi chieh zel hen,
Lung leh lei tin chawktho hen;
I thiempu Lal, I sikgen a pang,
Amin chu Krista Isu.
Hukdampa di’n na kipum piek dem?
Lungthim niemin na khu’n dem?
A lungsiet hedi’n nangle hungin,
Tun nang hun hukdam ina.
V.T. Kappu
Kalvari tang khu gal thil leu hing,
I Lalpau in A thawkna chu mui tiu;
A thisan luong haw leh a lu a linglukhuk,
I gitloh ziek ahi maw tih chu he tai tiu.
I gitloh ziekin melma hiem,
A thuok zo ngei maw!
Ziebang lawma hehpihna hi,
Kuomah cha’n a nei puou.
Ana na lawm lawm e Lalpa thawkna!
Ka enchim thei puoi ka Lal thawkna chu;
Melmate’n guolnawp bawlnan mang, Kalvari ah,
Tawtbawlna’n a mang ui Roman sepaihte chun.
Ka hehpih hukdampan A thawkna chu,
Hetngilh guol ei puoi, A dangchakna chu;
Ngilh ni ka nei thei puoi lainat a um taluoi,
Khawvel gitloh ziekin thihna haksa A thuok.
Kalvari tang khu en kit zel ingka,
Ka enchim thei puoi ka Lal thawkna chu;
Lungmuon ding nei ! loin ka Lalpa a um a,
“Aw, he pa! ei nusie kin” tin A kiko hi.
V.T. Kappu
Ka Lal thawkna ka ngaihtuoh in,
Kah lohna guol ei puoi;
A mai a betnau leh, liemna A thawkna chu,
Ka ngaihtuoh ni hin chu naubang ka kap
A na taluoi ! ei tatna,(2)
Khawvel Hukdampa chu;
A luong a chieh pih tau,
I Lal lungnem a hi gimthei mahleh.
Juda mipiten mawhchang in,
Hun na guot mahleule;
Ken vang ka hun ngai ie, ka Lal lungnem Na hi,
Keihaw gitloh ziekin tha Na kie tai,
Nei zo thakie mi’n a gal un,
Van Lal thi a gal puou;
Thihna’n nau bang a awi, I Lal lungsiet um pau,
Than sungah a siel ui mi et nuom loh
A thokit tai, I Lalpau chu,
Chawlhna gam zuon dingin;
Olive tang chunga meipi’n a puito in.
Chawlhna gam A zuon tai, I Lalpau chun.
Chawlhna gam na zawt tak ziekin,
Khawvel a ngui zo tai;
Hung kitin aw Lalpa khawvel dahum ahin,
Nei tatna thugen in, nunnuom ungkau.
V.T. Kappu
Hukdampa hih ka hetma chun,
Midang Pathien ahim ka tii;
A chanchin pha ka vak sim leh,
Ka pa, ka mansak kha ahi.
Ka manna lauhuma ei hawlna chu,
Gimtheih tincheng A hung thuoka;
Ka thagau hukdam na di’n
A chanchin vak gen zieng hin le,
Lunggil a sukipak ngei aw;
Thagau a hetsakna vang chun,
Mitthi a luong lo thei puoi.
A bukima muh chu ka nuom ngei aw,
Ka gitloh thienna ding thisan
A luonna pawn ngei kha le.
A thih ding kuon khan le Isu,
A melmate di’n A paucham;
“He pa, amau hi ngaidam in,
A thilhih a he puou” tin.
Hehpihna a le a tawpkhawk ngei ie!
Pathien hehpihna Kalvari;
Khela genthei a um puou.
Mi gilo keihaw a dingin,
Na kipie zo ngei ie Isu!
Na silhpuon le na chang puo maw?
Na puonak di’n phun a san ui.
Hinna pie khawp hiel a ei Hehpihpa,
Ka thih ding kuon chanin Lalpa;
Lungin hun ngilh hiel puong ka.
Ngulsang
Nawpna leh kipahna nanga,
Ka nawpna leh ka kipahna;
Aw Lal Isu nangmah nei piek ngei a hi.
Aw, a na ie pa, Kalvari tang,
Na thawk nat zie ka en ngam puoi;
Na thihna tuolthing!
Mipi tamtakin a deih puou,
Israel chate’n a nawlhsau;
Jentel Sapchuomte’n kalvari ah pawm ui.
Jentel Sapchuom I vangnei ngei,
Lei a thilthawn piek chauh lo le;
Hukdamna leh van Lallukhuk I chanbeh.
Pienthakna thagau nang lo chun,
Tung thei puong ie van gam nuom chu!
Aw van Lal thagau thiengtho ei pui zelin.

lines: Sam 31:2

Pathien Chapa ngei ahi ie,

A luong puonnem in a tuom ui,

Huon than awng achun a siel ui,

Hukdampa Lalpen chu;

Khawvel gitloh leh thihna A zo tai.
Thihna hatna A nuoisieh tai,
Galhatpa chawian un;
Hallellujah ka hukdampa.
Pakna’n khawvel zailan hung dim kit hen.

Ti’n Lalpan namtin A hilh ie;

Doh is D S.S. 540. - T.S. 73
Hukdampa mak Isu ka Lalpa ahi,

* Zie chun A khutin ei lieh hi (2)

songs.title: Lalpa Nang ka hun naih hi

lines: Doh is G S.S. 639. - T.S. 79
Lalpa Nang ka hun naih hi,

Na tha limnuoi bitna mun,
Ah umzing ing ka;
Gitloh, ginlah huihhat in,
Muntin ah ei mut mahleh;
Eipui in guolzo ing ka,
Lalpa ka hun naih.

Suongpi leh Bitna;
Thepna tui kinawk mahleh,

Huihpi’n ei sulau puona,

“Pa nang thu hi hen,”
Lungkham laiin ngilh puo’ng ka,

Lalpa ka hun naih.
A lalna kum sawtin lun zing intin,

Len-guol deih leh Angel vamte cheng tawh,

A Lalpau min pakcha’n.

Ka ngai na e khen lohna gam;

Kahna i tuokkit sek.
Zailan chawian hitiu i Lalpau chu,
Khawvel cheng hi bei mah lele;
Kumsawt chanin chawihatna la’n,
Daihni nei ta pouna.
A lul nau e thilhing chitin,
Lungguol in tang hih hawih ui;
Van Mang paknan zaila a awi ui,
“Aw Lal lopipen” ti’n la a sau.
Aw Hallelujah, chungnungpen,
Lei mun thawmhau leh Na sulnung gamthip ahin;
Nang hun ngaia chauin a mau ui,
Suihlung muonna Lalpa hung lengin.
Sietlei hin khuo zanbang thimah;
Lalpa min thei bang lo ka;
Hin kiemlo gam tun kal ka ngak lah,;
Hung vakin, kumsawt tawplo gam chu.
Damlai ni kawlah tum mahleh,
Ka ngak Kanaan khawpi chu;
Hung vak ina nitum senglo gam,
Nawpna kim tana Lallukhuk tawh.
Lal lenna Zion gal muongah,
Aw lei leh van Lalpa chu;

Angel tawh Lalchutphah kimvel in.

Kalvari hehpihna thisan zalin;

Hallelujah, Hallelujah!
Chawihatin um zing hen Belam No chu,

Aw, Thagau lengin kipahna gimlim,

Kipakin a awi ui gimthei chate’n,
Nang na um leh lei van gam a chang.
Kumkhaw gam leh kumsawt a beih masieh,

Aw na lunlai ni hi bei ta puon a,
Nang ka ngai pen ie ei umpih in.
Aw khawvel in he leu ka Lal lopi,
Van Angel lak ah lawp na tha zakin;
Kalvari Belam No hehpihna hi,

Aw lopi pen Hallelujah ah,
Pak bang chawi kau Immanuel;
Chawihatna leh lalna cheng cheng,

Hallelujah, Hallelujah Amen,
Khawvel mihing phungguol namtin,
Angelte tawh lung kiguol in;
Na tatna thisan luon zal in.
Cheng khawm kau Salem thak nuomah
Hallelujah, Hallelujah Amen.
A thukin a sang nazen e,

Ei hilh thiem u, hinna go thil,

Hallelujah, Hallelujah Amen.
