Van Lal cha gilo Tanpa,
Ka ma tieng pak thing bang lun zing hen.
Thil dang sangin, Na lopi zawi ka Hukdampa,
Na thilsiem pakbang ka lawp;
Thilsiem sangin Na hawihzaw ie ka Hukdampa,
Na hehpihna mel ka gen thei puoi.
Lei hi Lalpa, Na thilthawn piek masa ahi,
Ka sim seng puoi lei nawpna;
Thangvan gamnuom Na vangsakna bukim ahi,
Kalvari tangah kei nei pie ie.
V. Hawla
Khawvel ahin malzin ka hi,
Aw ka ngai sek ngei ie ka inkuonte;
Ka cham sung hin buoina tinchengte’n,
Tuilien bang’ nicheng in ei tawk.
Aw hun ei daltu hi a beih tieng leh,
Mundet lam chu zuon ta’ng ka;
Ziechun ngailo in ka chenna hi,
Buoina cheng tawh pawtsan tang ka.
Lungkham dak gi thangvelte leh,
Buoina tincheng thawm gi ka zakte hin;
Ka kumsawt gam ei ngaihsak zawdiek,
Ka Pa mel ni bang a vakna.
Ka zinna gam thalek ahin,
Ka Lal gam lutpih tak ka nei puoh ie;
Hinna thu vaithak nei ki vang le’ng,
Khutngawn in ka gam zuon ing ka.
Ka Lalgam chun ni a ngai puoi,
A melhawih na’n khawpi sung a salhvak;
Vaihawmna Lal chutphah chunga chu’n,
Pahchakna gihawih te’n a bawm.
Jerusalem khawpi hawih chu Zion,
Martar haw leh Angel vamte lenna;
Mi gilote chu Krista zalin,
Leng un au zie gam ni tum lohna achun.
Hallelujah Lalpa lopi Amen,
Hallelujah Amen Hallelujah;
Ei hukdam dingin a hung pieng ie!
Aw ka Lal Immanuel,Halleluiah.
Kraws chung achun thisan lul a luong tai,
Isu thisan lopi Kalvari ah;
I hukdamna diua hung luong kha,
A lul ie Isu thisan Hallellujah.
A hungkit ni a mipi kikhawp tieng,
Gawtmuna I suohchak nau Jubilee;
Chapangte kipahna Lalpa chu,
Chungnung penah Hossana’tin a sau ui.
Jerusalem kipahna Lal Messie,
Jerusalem kipahna Lal Messie;
Lal mina hung a kipahpih tau,
A lul ie Isu thisan Hallelujah.

songs.title: Ei Hukdampa’n ka sikin thih a hun tel a

lines: Kolosa 2:13
III Alexander 54 - T.S. 82
Ei Hukdampa’n ka sikin thih a hun tel a,
Hing hawilo kei gilo hukdamna’n;
Bangti-a engbawl leh muolphole A thuok zel,
Ka gitloh simsen loh ngaihdam na’n.
Ka gitloh Kross chungah ka Lalpa’n a puo tai,
Bangzat a tam le a ngaidam nuom;
Lungkham gen theihloh hiel thuokin Kalvari ah,
Ka gitloh man bat ei ditsak tai.
Lalpa’n ei lungsiet zie hi gen zo seng puong ka,
Gilo vawmpen ei silthieng kit tai;
Ei tandawk tai gitloh suokin lut nawn puong ka,
Van mite umdan in um tang ka.
Kross chung achun ka gitloh cheng cheng nusie’ng ka,
Bangdi’n em ei sukbuoi theih kit ding;
Lal Isu’n Kross chungah a khenden zo vek tai,
Kross chun khawvel tawh ei khendang tai.
Ei hukdampa chu gitloh san ta hiel puong ka,
Ni chengin A na sepsak zawng ka;
A min thieng chawih-at na’n zaila go chuh ang ka,
Ka deihchuom pen hi ei Hukdampa

songs.title: Sawmkuo leh kuo chuh bittak in aum

lines: Luke 15:6
Doh is A8 S.S. 97. - T.S. 83
Sawmkuo leh kuo chuh bittak in aum,
Belam hawn huongsung achun;
Khat chuh a pawtin tangah a mang ta a,
Sana huong apat gamla takah;
Belam chingpa nunnem chinna apat chun,
* Tang sang lam gam awng leh lauhum achun (2)
Lalpa, ziehin sawmkuo leh kuo a um,
Nang in ziechuh deihkhawp lo maw?
Belamchingpa’n a dawng a, Zie hih kei a,
Ka kieng apat a taimang ahi;
Lampi chuh haksa leh to himahlele,
* Gamgaw achun belam hawl di’n chieh ka (2)
Tatsate khat cha’n le a he puou hi,
Tui ka’n ding haw thuk zie chuh;
Leh Lalpa chiehna zanthim nasatak chuh,
Belam mang A muh kit masieh chuh;
Gamthip a Belam aw chuh A za ta a,
* Panpih ding bei leh thi dinga na chuh (2)
“Lalpa, bang thi a him lamtawna va,
Tanga lampi-a umhaw khuh?
Belam khat a man zieka thi pawt ahi,
Belampu’n a puih kit masieh chu;”
“Lalpa, Na khut bangin a sukliem ahim?
* Tuzana ling tampi’n a sut ahi” (2)
Tang sang, van nim, van gi lak apatin,
Leh kawlsie chunglam apatin;
Van kawtkhak a chun aw khat a gi to-in,
“Lawp un, belam ka mu tai!” a tii;
Lalchutphah, vela Angelte lasak in,
* “Kipakun, Lalpa’n A mudawk kit tai” (2)
Eph. 2:8
Doh is E8 S.S. 337. - T.S. 84
Kah-in ei huk puona!
Ka mai mitthin dim mahleh;
Ka lauh a suhai thei puoi,
Ka gitloh sil thieng puona;
Kah in ei huk puona.
Isu kei di’n a thi tai,
Isu’n thingah a thuok tai;
Suohchak sak di’n ei ngak hi,
Aman ei hukhing thei.
Sepin ei huk thei puoi!
Thil thiengtho pen ka hih thei;
Ka ngaihtuohna thiengpen le,
Ka tha a suthak thei puoi;
Sepin ei huk puona.
Ngakin ei huk puona,
Mi beimang, thiemlo, ka hi;
Bilin zahngaih aw kazai,
Mawk ngak leng-thi ding ka hi,
Ngakin ei huk puona.
Krista ginin ei huk,
Na cha kap ei gin sakin;
A nasep chuh ka gingchai,
A banhat ei kawl sakin,
Krista ginin ei huk.
I Pet. 2:24
Doh is F8 S.S. 855. - T.S. 85
Hukdampa gen ka za’i,
“Na hatna a tawm hi;
Kivengin paucham in,
Na bangkim keiah mu’n.
Isu’n A din tai,
A kawmah ka ba’i;
Ka gitlohna ni’n cheng chuh,
Vuk bangin a sawp vam.
Lalpa tuhin ka mu’i,
Nangmah theihna maiin;
Pha’kna a hihdam thei,
Lunggil khauh a hih nem.
Thilpha him ka nei puoi,
Nei lungsiet theih nadi’n;
Ka puon haw sawp vam ka,
Belam No thisan in.
Ka thagau tatsa chuh,
Than apat a thawh tieng;
“Isu’n A din vek tai”
Ti’n kipak zing tana.
Van Lalchutphah ma ah,
Bukim a ka din tieng;
Ka zawhna cheng ngang ka,
Lal Isu kengbul ah.
Suakliana
Lalmang Na Thagau chun ei pui zingin,
Lei mun gimtheihna laka hin;
Hukdamna kulhpi sunga leng dingin,
Nang hun gingte pui hatin.
Van gam zuonin ei puiin,
Zinmang dona cheng zo di’n;
Thepna dogal chu zo ngei ungkau,
Chun Na vak ah leng ungkau.
Van Lal Thagau I kipuih sak laiin,
Zinmang tawngsie a mang zel hi;
Khawvel buoi leh dahumna nuoisieh in,
Van gam laituol ah leng kau.
Lalpa Thagau puih loh chun khawvel hi,
Sang tamtak manna gam ahi;
Gam nuom mang loin ei tun tei intin,
Lalpa, Na hatna muongin.
Dahum cheng nuom takin thuok zel hitiu,
Hatlo Lalpa’n panpih ei tiem;
Thagau in lam tawnin ei pui intin,
Mun lopi I tun chan un.
Doh is G S.S. 648. - T.S. 87
Isun kei ei lungsietna chuh,
Thing hansedawla thuok dingin;
Thagau suokcha ka hih theih nan,
Gen sangin a lien zawi.
A lungsiet gen sangin a lien,
A lungsiet gen sangin a lien;
Isun kei ei lungsietna chu,
Gen sangin a lien zawi.
Lungkhamna haksa a thawk chuh,
Leh aw, ling lukhuk A khuk chuh;
Kumkhawsawt a ka hinna din,
Gen sangin a lien zawi.
Lalchutphah ma-ah ei ngetsak,
Lalpa ah lungmuonna ka nei;
A thisan lul mantam zie chuh,
Gen sangin a lien zawi.
Ei naih tienga kipahna chuh,
Lauhna a chawlhna ei piek chuh;
Amah a kinepna chien tak,
Gen sangin a lien zawi.

songs.title: Lalpa ka neih zakcha puong ka

lines: Doh is E S.S. 883. - T.S. 88
Lalpa ka neih zakcha puong ka,
Amah chuh panpih ka;
Amah thu chuh zah bawl zing ka,
A Kross lopina tawh.
Kross achun, Kross achun vak ka muh patna ah,
Ka lunggil gikpuok chu a kilik mang;
Ziechun gin ziekin mitvakna ka mu’i,
Tun chuh nicheng in ka kipak tai.
Pathien, Isu Amin ka he’i,
Amin chuh ka taksang;
Ka thagau suzahhuoi puonna,
Ka kinep thawn puona.
Lalchutphah banga thutiem det,
Hun guot atun chanin;
Amah khuta ka vawpsak chuh,
Phatak in A vawp thei.
Ka min mantak lo chuh pu’n tin,
A Pa masang achun;
Van Jerusalem thak achun,
Ka Thagau mun piena.

songs.title: Kross maktak chuh ka ngaihtuoh tieng

lines: Doh is E8 S.S. 115. - T.S. 89
Kross maktak chuh ka ngaihtuoh tieng,
Lopina Lal Cha thihna chuh;
Ka punna pen manna’n ka ngai,
Ka chapona chuh ka ngainiem.
Pathien Krista thihna lo chuh,
Lalpa bangmah dang suong puong ka;
Mantaklo thil ei hip haw cheng,
A thisan ah ka pie vek hi.
A lu, A khut, A keng enin!
Lungkham hehpihna a luongkhawm;
Ziebang chuh a umkhawm ngei em?
Linglukhuk lopi hungsuok tawh.
Khawvel cheng hi keia hileh,
Pie vek lengle tawm taluo’na;
Tawbang Pathien lungsiet mak chuh!
Thagau, hinna, bangkim A deih.
Nuoi simlei ka len lai hin,
Zinmang dogal sielang a lien;
Ka ngai ie, henkawl nang bang ei sutpa,
Ka kulhpi leh ka bitna pen, Ei nungsawn lo zen uo;
Galdawt ing ie Lalpa,
Lungngaihna meipi zing mahleh;
Ka lautha chawlhna ding Zion,
Leh Na sakmel hawih chu.
Pak thing bangin hung lun zelin,
Setan sausuon thim bang zingah;
Khawvel ninnuom chena muong dente hi,
Na lungsietna thun phawng dingin,
Nungsul hawi lo dingin.
Maa I lawpnau leh nawpna,
I Lalpau mel deihum tuoi nung;
Tuhin lo bangin chul tadih mahleh,
Nunnuom a I lenna dingun,
Pakthing bang lun kit ding.
Gel zing hitiu, Zion vangkhuo,
Lungdeih len-guol peh bang kimna;
Lungtuokte luonthi nula khensa te’n,
Sun nitin hai bang ei ngak ui,
Kumsawt ninnawp lasa’n.
Doh is G (Lah is A) K.H. 128. - T.S. 90
Lip tha’n,
Isu lopina liehpen chuh;
I lungsung hi hunkhawh vak hen,
Kalvari tanga A thawka;
A hehpih lang kha chientak in,
* Tun zietak ahin, (2) lang kit hen.
Mun dang,
Limbang ka belh ding la umlo;
Isu liemna ngallo hi chuh,
Na kitupna a hin thildang;
Ei liehkhuh thei dang a um puoi,
* Ziechun ei selin, (2) ei selin.
Ka u’m,
U hi vang ei pie chiet inla;
Isu’n ka lak u ah um hen,
Umpih tak di’n ei siem in la,
Sacrament tak chuh hi ngei leh,
* Hihden theihna le, (2) ka ngai ui.
Zie zan,
Lungkhamum zan chun Lal Isu’n;
Changthak lan vangphatna A piei,
Phelsuoh in “Zie hi,” ti’n a gen;
“Ka taksa a hi-nang u ding,
* Nei hetzing nang un, (2) zie hih un.”
Tichun,
Uain khawn chu le A la a;
Kipah thugen nungin a tii,
“Ka thisana Thuthun thak chuh;
Zie khawn hi ahi-na dawn uh,
* Nei hetzing nang un, (2) zie hih un.”
Lalpa,
Sacrament hih Nang hezinga;
Thiemchang, nuom di’n ei panpih in,.
Changthak leh uain a hin Nang
Ei hun zawm in la-bangmah in,
* Hun nang ki hen la (2) cheng zing in.
Kamlala
Van huihchim, ka hun ngai ie hung lengin,
Ka suihlunga meipi zing mut thielin;
Thim leh lungngaihna hin kei ei nanga,
Ka zawt lai kumsawt pielgal a lieh hi.
Lalpa bangkima kei dinga Bangkim,
Hinna khuktui Na hi, ka hun ngai hi;
Lopina leh van mun ka ngai chuom puoi,
Van chu Nang Na hi, naubang ei dawnin
Tuona Eden pak tana lengsa nung.
Albang I vai sietlei gitloh thimah;
Mahleh Kalvari a ngabang leng te,
Kumsawt gam Eden thak nuom khun a sam.
Simlei pakcha lun hawih cheng a hung vuoi,
A nawplau leh gi hawih tin cheng a dai;
Lal deihum Na sakmel a tuoi thei puoi,
Naubang ei nem ie kumsawt chan inle.
Na min theibang ka lawh tieng thim a bei,
Sietlei gam lunghel um zailan ka awi;
Nunnawp puon bang thak zel ka gen seng puoi,
Na engin kei di’n taikhuo a vak ie.

songs.title: Ka Thagau tuomvel zan chuh a thim na e

lines: Luke 2:33
Doh is G S.S. 82. - T.S. 92
Ka Thagau tuomvel zan chuh a thim na e,
Hukdampa lungkhamna a lien hi;
A vak deihum in ka thagau a salh tieng,
Thimna nawhmang in ei hukdam tai.
Kalvari lam chuh zuonin keidi’n a chieh,
Keidi’n A chieh, keidi’n A chieh;
Kalvari lam chuh zuonin keidi’n A chieh,
Ka suokchak na’n A thii.
A masang ah gilo kithing in ka khu’n,
A ngaihdam leh lungsiet helo in;
Aw nem tak chuh ka za’i, na lung hun hei in,
Ngaihdam neitai, na bat ka din tai.
Hukdampa lungsiet, lungsietna mak ahi,
Kalvari di’n Lalchutphah nusie’n;
Uain kithawk bangin Amah A thi tai,
Kumkhuo’n Amin pakin genviel un.

songs.title: Luinak a um, thisan a luong

lines: Doh is G
Luinak a um, thisan a luong,
Kalvari a pawt chuh;
Gilote di’n zie luipi chuh;
Gitloh thienna ahi.
Aw, kalvari lui hawih tak (3)
Kei di’n na hung luong dawk.
Gilo, thi ding khetdenpa khan,
Thienna lui chuh a mu’i;
Amah bangin gilo mahleng,
Ei hih thiengtho thei hi.
Lalpa deihtak, Na thisan lun,
Zatam in a he puou;
Hukdamte chun ziehi a muu,
A puokgik kilik mang.
Ginnan hinna lui chuh ka mu’i,
A luong ka gam chanin;
Ei hehpihna ka thupi pen,
Ka thihna geiin le.
Hukdamna kawt a ki hawng ie Kalvari tangah,
Lungngai liengvai mun nei lo ding;
Nuom taka I lenna ding un,
A siem zo tai, Van Lal In chu.
Ka hun zuon hi aw ka Lalpa,
Na mun siem chu;
Gitloh galchu hung lien mahleh,
Nangin ei na kai huoi inla.
Ka thagau na Hukdampa thihna Kalvari ah,
Sun leh zanin va leng in la;
Ziechun na chenna ding gam nuom,
Thilin na lungngaih nem ina.
Thil lui cheng cheng tun a bei tau, a thak dawk kit tai,
Gitloh gala liemte tho un;
Chenna dingin a siem gam nuom,
Nuoma I nawplen na ding chu.
Immanuel lei leh van thak khawpi nuom achun,
Aw bangtikleh ka tung ta dem?
Ka ngai na e kumsawt gam khu,
Lawm guol peh bang kimna ding chu.
Thangngur
Lalpa, Na min zahum hen la,
Na gam chu lopi takin hung tung hen;
Enin Na gam chu sukneu guon,
Lei thuneihna suolin a mang;
Na sakmin hun chawisang kitin.
Aw Isu ka Hukdampa,
Na min hun chawisangin;
Phaicham pak lili khawtang ngui a hin,
Suolna nuoisieh dingin hung pak lun in,
Gingte laka gitloh um hin,
I Lalpau min thimthu sie’n alel hi;
A minsiet ding I phal dingum?
A melsiet ding I tiem dingum?
I thagau uh damna ahi.
Isu’n “Ka min agensiet un,
Suihlung a na taluoi” A tii;
A min thiengtho chawisang ding leh,
A dikna silhpuona nei di’n;
Tatsa mihing a um puou em?
Gitloh na’n taluo a nei puoi,
Thagau sang-za a puimang zota ie;
Zuomang vawnchawih thiengtho penle,
Khawvela a hung lenlai khan;
Thisan pawtin a matsak hi
Suol vangin muonna um lo,
Khawvel dahum ahin;
Van gam ka ngai ie, Ka Pa In nuom khu,
“Gitloh meipi a zing ta puoi” a tiu.
Doh is F S.S. 630 - T.S. 97
Hukdampa thisan a luong em?
Ka Lalpa chu A thi’m?
A luchang thiengtho chu A pie’m?
Mantak loh kei tatna’n.
Nang hun neidi’n ei panpih in,
Ginum a umzing di’n;
Na Lalchutphah a Na chut tieng,
Lalpa ei hezing in.
Kross a lungkhama A mauna,
Kei gitloh ziek ahim?
Hetphakloh A hehpih-na mak,
Het guolloh hehpihna.
Nisa thimna a kisel in,
A lopina a chawl;
Thilsiem mihiem gilo sika,
Siempa Krista thih in.
A Kross chu a hunglat laiin,
Kenle ka mai sel ka;
Ka lunggil kipak a dimin,
Ka mitthi luong ina.
Hehpihna lei ka bat lungngaih,
Mitthi’n dinzo puona;
Lalpa ka hinna ka hun pie’i,
Zie mai chu ka bawltheih.

songs.title: Kross dailim nuoia chun ei chawlhsak in

lines: Doh is A K.H. 136 - T.S. 98
Kross dailim nuoia chun ei chawlhsak in,
Ziechun Hukdampa thisan a pawt tai;
Hinna tui ziechun a luong,
Migilo thienna dingin;
Kross dailim nuoia chun ei chawlhsak in.
Kross dailim nuoia chun kei chawl ingka,
Zie mun chu thagau nawpna pen ahi;
Tun ka kipak mah mah tai,
Kei ei hukdam tak ziekin;
Kross dailim nuoia chun kei chawl ingka.
Kross dailim nuoia chun ei umsak in,
Pathien deih ziemai achun hih thei ka;
Mi taktak hung hidinga,
A deih bang ka hih theihna’n;
Kross dailim nuoi achun ei umsak in.
Kross dailim nuoi achun ei chawlhsak in,
Isu thisan a pawtna nuoi akhan;
A kengpek chu tu’n ziechun,
Nituma ka kipah na’n;
Kross dailim nuoi achun ei chawlhsak in.

songs.title: Ka Lalpa mawh a chan sak ui

lines: Doh is G M.K.H. 137 Tune S.S. 902
Ka Lalpa mawh a chan sak ui,
Ka gitloh sik in A thi tai;
A maban hih ding a guot un,
Amah ding kross pun A chieh tai.
Tuhin Isun ei ngen zing hi,
Ka dang a chak hi A ti ie (2)
Ling lukhuk leh puonsan a pieu,
Dogalte’n a chiehpih tau ie;
A min “Luguh mun” lam achun,
Mawhna a ngau, Amah chungah.
Kalvari-ah gimna A puoi,
Midang a um puou panpih ding;
He Pa, bang dinga ei taihsan?
Thavai in kiko thing lekah.
Samari nu’n tui a pie puoi,
Aman tuinak a hihdawk zing;
Thing leka A umlai khanle,
A pie nuom puoi van nim inle.

songs.title: Aw, tu’n ka mui thienna lui chuh!

lines: Doh is E8 Redemption Songs 144 - T.S. 99
Aw, tu’n ka mui thienna lui chuh!
Luikhuk thuk leh lien chuh;
Ka Lal Isu’n A hukdam thei,
A nak liemna apat.
Thienna lui chuh ka mui, ka mui!
Ka kidieh, aw ei silthieng tai;
Lalpa pak un, ei silthieng tai,
Ei silthieng tai, ei silthieng tai.
Thilsiem thak a hungum ka mu’i,
Thisan thugen ka za’i;
Thu a gen hindan lui a thii,
Thisan luiah tummang.
Van vaka leng dingin ka tho,
Gitloh, khawvel chungah;
Lunggil thieng puon, puonvam silh in,
Ziechun Kristan vaihawm.
Lungsietna mak vana kipan,
A thisan lun pie di’n;
Isu, Amah maiin a hei,
Khetdena um Isu.
Ka lunggil gilo buoksa hi,
Na Temple in suok sakin;
A sunga hin Aw ka Lalpa,
Kumkhuon hung cheng zing inla.
Na umna chu (2)
Kumsawt kipahna a suok.
Aw khatvei bek ki mu leng Aw!
Khatvei bek Nang hun mu leng;
Khawvel hawihna haw cheng sangin,
Aleh za’n Nang na hawih zawi.
Kipieng ka ie, (2)
Nangmah tawh cheng khawm dingin.
Aw hawk thielin ka gitlohna,
Ka thagau hukdam in la;
Ka chimta ie thima um chu,
Hung lengin van eng lopi.
Na hung en chun, (2)
Ka lung kipahna’n a dim.

songs.title: Van In zuon din kross lampi ka hawh a ngai

lines: Doh is A8 III Alexander 33. - T.S. 100
Van In zuon din kross lampi ka hawh a ngai,
Zielo chu lamdang um lo;
Kawtkhak vak chuh ken muthei ngei puong ka,
Kross lampi chuh ka mansak chun.
Kross lampi’n In ei tun ding (2)
Chieh kawma het chuh thil nuomtak ahi;
Kross lampi’n In ei tun ding chu.
Kross bul a chun ka puokgik a kiemang tai,
Lalpa ka muh tak ziekin;
Lungthim zang takin lam ka hawh pan tai,
Ka lunggil pakna lan a dim.
Thisan kitheh khum lampi ka hawh a ngai,
Hukdampa lampi bawl chuh;
Chunglam gamnuom a chun kalto thei leng,
Thagau, Pathien tawh chenna ah.
Ka Lalpan kross lampi chuh A hawh masai,
Kei di’n Kross chungah A thii;
Pathien Belam No di’n lam hak ahi,
Tu’n hinna lamthak ka mu ie.
Khawvel lampi chuh zinbang in ka tha tai,
Achung hawhkit ngeilo di’n;
Lalpa’n, Hung in, ei ti’n, In ka zuon tai,
Kawt hawnsa a ei ngakna ah.
Taivela
Kei di’n sawltha leh sunni vak talo,
Thimin ei bawm ie aw ka Hukdampa;
Na gam lopi tun kal ka ngaklah ie.
Ka Hukdampa chu ka ngai na zen e aw,
Na hehpihna chawnban in ei kaiin;
Hukdamte lailenna gam ninnuom ah.
Van kawtthel a khun Belam No Aw chun,
“Ka cha, hungin na gitloh puokgik tawh;
Hun na dawn ingka” ti in ei sam ie.
Na hehpih zie leh Na lopi zie chu,
Kuoa gen thei ding lei mihingte hin?
Van mite’n le a gen zo thei puou hi.
Na lungkham Aw bawna lei a lin chun
Na lopin tawh Na hungkit tieng leh,
Lei leh van in hun thuok zo hiel puon au,
Zie bang ni lopi chu hung tung in tin,
Na melmate lauin kiling un tin,
“En tie ei Tanpa!” tin kiko ung kau.
Gitloh khukpi lama chun chieh zelin,
Lam achun kipahna ka hawl laiin;
Zie lui thima thawmgi chu ka zakin,
Lauhna’n ka hung dim kit ngala.
Aw, Isu kei lam hung nga kitin,
Lalpa Na lam mangin, ka vakvai ie.
Gitloh man chu thihna ahi taa,
Ka pal ngam puoi thihna luipi lien chu;
Mahleh chiehna danga um puoi Lalpa,
Lungmuonpa Nang ka hun ngai hi.
Kum tamtak ka vak mang san nung inle,
Na hehpihna’n kei nei na veng zela;
Bang chenga ka Bangcheng Na hi Lalpa,
Sietlei hin pakin la sau hen.
Zinmang dogal sang-za laiah Lalpa,
Na chawnban in naubang eipui zelin;
Van gam ninnuom laituola leng dingin,
Lalpa Nangin nei hun tel tai.

songs.title: Tang hawihtak mai a um, gam gamla tak mai ah

lines: Doh is E8 III Alexander 80
Tang hawihtak mai a um, gam gamla tak mai ah,
Tuipi khel gam nuomtak mai a chun;
A min “Luguh mun” ah Lalpa chuh a thi tai,
Kei leh nang leh khawvel ding ahi.
A thawkdan ka hetin ka mitthi a luong hi,
Zie tang chuh ka en bangtik inle;
A sik a chun Isu’n A thuoka a thi tai;
Kei guola gilo ngaihdamna di’n.
Lungkhamin A chieh hi kross giktak pu kawmin,
Ling lukhuk kiphek chuh khu kawmin;
Kross ah a khenden ui, mipi’n a nuihsan ui,
Tang hawihtak a chun a khaikang ui.
A lungdawn zie ka hei, Amah a kan lai un,
Hukdampa thingah a khenden ui;
A Kross chuh phawng ding in, mipite mitmuh in,
Kalvari tangah a khaikang ui.
Thimin A mel a lieh suongpi cheng le a khii,
Lungdawnna aw thangviel a zak un;
I Lalpau aw ahi, thihna huoisie thuokin,
I bawna gitloh ngaihdam na di’n.
Amah a nuihsan ui, A thihding kuon chanin,
A guolte lungkhamin a kap ui;
Amah a taihsan ui, nat tincheng in a bawm,
Mahleh tang achun a taihsan ui.
Nisa’n a en ngam puoi, lei le a kiling hi,
A siempau a khetden tak ziekun;
Ngai un, thihna apat, Belam No mawhpuopa,
Than sung apat Tho kitin A hung.
Thangngur
Ka pa na hi ka Pathien ngei na hi,
Leia zinmang suoka ka tan laiin;
Na hehpihna thimthu a hung tunga,
“Hung kitin ka hun tan zo tai” tiin.
Na hehpihna thupiek zawp chu,
Lung kisik a um ngei puoi Lalpa;
Sietlei leh thangvan a mi le.
Aw Lalpa Na vangsakna lopi hi,
Nang sangin zatam in a ngailul zawu;
Taksap vanga luonthi a naihlai in,
Na gam leh Na felna’n ei gamlat ki’n.
Nang ngei Isu ka hun neih chun,
Bang dang ka ngai ta dem maw Lalpa;
Bangkima ka bangkim Na hi.
Nawpna hawlin a vak ui sang tamtak,
Mu loin than thim sungah a liem ui;
Lopina lim a delh uh lei nawpna,
Mu leh changte di’n kumsawt a ting puoi.
Nang ngei Isu neih tak Na hi,
Kumsawt chana lopi leh hawih deuh deuh;
Lei leh vana vangsakna lul.

songs.title: Thumak ka gen chim theihloh chuh

lines: Doh is E8 S.S. 81
Thumak ka gen chim theihloh chuh,
Kalvari chanchin ahi;
Bangti’n a, Pathien Cha chang khat,
Gilo kei di’n A hung thih?
Kalvari tang
Ka ngaihtuoh tawp thei puoh ie!
Nanghaw van Angel thiengtho leh,
Serafim lopite haw;
Nichenga Lalpa nasem leh,
A deihguol thil bawl sek haw.
Kalvari tang
Chanchin nei hih thei puou maw?
Aw, ka thagau zie tang achun,
Sun, zanin va leng zingin;
Na Lalpa kross leka um chuh,
A hingin va mun na tin.
Kalvari tang
Chanchin hun na hilh ina.
Sim leh Mal, Sak leh Thang a um,
A keng bulah khun u hen;
A tek-akhang, alien-aneu,
A min pakin la sau hen.
Kalvari-ah
Amau din A thawk ziekin.
Chi gimthei lungkhamna lei ahin,
Lungkham luonthi tawh Nang ka hun sam;
Ka Lalpa’n ei umpih zing inla,
Nam gimthei, liengvai pak banga lun ding.
Aw, hung lengin Lalpa ka hun ngai,
Kalvari-a nei hehpihna chu;
Ka chungu-ah puon bang hung zakin,
Nam gimthei, liengvai pak banga pak ding,
A haksatna munah um mah leng,
Lalpa, Nanglo midang sam puo’ngka;
Senlai nau bang ka kahna gamah,
Nam tin lungmawl lakah Nang hung vakin.
Gitlohnan ei naih zel mahleu le,
Thihna luiguom ah leng mah leng le;
Lalpa, Na Thagau in ei puiin,
Nei hehpihna thing banga hung pak ding.
Gimthei mah leng Aw van Lallukhuk,
Gitloh gal laka semgim te ding;
Na gam vanga ka gimtheih nate,
Ka Pa anga pak gimlim in a pak.
Ngama
Ka Pathien Aw, ei khawtuohpa,
Na lam ka mansak nung inle;
Na lungsietna Aw hawih takin,
Na hehpihna thu lopi chun;
Ka lunggil sung a fang viel ie (2) DS
Na vangsaknan lei Na khuha,
Thilhih theihnan Na dawm kanga;
A chungah kei le ka leng ie,
Ka gitloh ziekin Lal Isu,
Thah in A um kalvari ah (2) DS
Na hehpihna a thuk taluoi,
Mihiem chitnan a pha zo puoi;
Ka neu taluoi puong seng puo’ng ka,
Ka puma ka kipiek khel chu;
Hih theih dang ka nei puoi Lalpa (2) DS
Keile Lalpa, keia dingin,
Na cha neih sun Na hun sawl hi;
Ka theihtawp suohin pang ingka,
Ka thil bangkim hun taihsan in;
Ka pumin hung kipieng ka ie (2) DS
Ka leisiet hinkhuo a beih tieng,
Na thagau in ei pui zelin;
Nanga ding maiin hing ingka,
Ka hinna thanmuol a lem tieng;
Kumkhuo’n Na kawmah um tangka (2) DS
Lungsietna a kihawm ie!
Chitin leh namtin te di’n;
Hukdampa naka put chu,
Hehpihna lopi ahi.
Gilo, gimthei liengvaite,
Lungsietna gam nuom chang ui;
Thisan thieng taka ei tat zalin,
A nuom tapoh in zuon un.
Lungsietna hun sung ahin,
Lut unla, gamnuom chang un;
Na gitlohnau cheng pumin,
Hukdampa’n silthieng ina.
Gamtiem chang dinga guotsa,
Gammang lo hiel din chieh tau;
Sapna Aw chu ngaiphau in,
Kanaan gam Lalpa ahi.
Nunnawp Aw gi chu ka zai,
Vak lopi ka muh phatin;
Ka suihlung lawpna’n a dim,
Thisan lul tatna ziekin.

songs.title: Sut phakloh thil lul genthei leng

lines: Eph. 3:8
Doh is E8 S.S. 205 - T.S. 107
Sut phakloh thil lul genthei leng,
Aw, A lopi zie gen thiem leng;
Hukdampa vak achun,
Lengin, van kingkang tum ing ting;
Gabriel lasak sakpih ka,
Pathien pak na la hawih (2)
A thisan lul pakla sa’ng ka,
Gitloh lauhum a ei tatna;
Pathien lungnatna’ pat,
A dikna lopi lan sa’ng ka,
Ziechun Van van kimin ei thuom,
Ka tha vak zing tana (2)
A hindan hawih chuh la’n sa’ng ka,
Hehpih kima A kivanna;
Lalchutphah a chawihat,
Chawihatna la hawihpen chuh sa’n;
Kumsawt chanin chawian zingka,
A lopi zie phuong ka (2)
Ni kipahum hung tung intin,
Lalpa’n ei hung puihna ni chuh;
Amel chuh mung ka ting,
Hukdampa, Suohpih, Guol te tawh;
Kumsawt mun achun um tang kau,
Hehpih a guolzo in (2)
Luke 24:6
Doh is D S.S. 152 - T.S. 108
Thanah A hung kuol hi,
Hukdampa Isu;
Ni hung tung ding A ngak,
Ka Lal Isu.
Than apatin A tho tai,
Dogal lopi taka zawhna tawh;
Thim thuneihna apat Guolzo in A tho,
Mithiengte tawh kumkhuon vaihawm din A hing,
A tho tai, A tho tai!
Hallelujah A tho tai.
Thawnin than a ngak ui,
Hukdampa Isu;
Thawnin a tiemteh ui.
Ka Lal Isu.
Thihnan a tuthei puoi,
Hukdampa Isu;
Thihna kanna hih tan,
Ka Lal Isu’n.
Patea
Ka lopina ding leh ka bitna mun,
Gal lauhum leh kihchak um lohna;
Gamgaw apat hin ginna’n ka vak mui,
Kumsawt gam chun ei tuom vel ahi.
Ni chengin en ka, ka tun masang cheng,
A hehpihna nun khawnuom gam chu;
Mite’n zie mun chu lui di’n gingchau ui,
Ka gen thei puoi, thakin a kilang.
Zie phat tieng chu leh namtin chitin ten,
A lopina vak zam vel a chun;
Hukdam haw mel vak hawih leh lopi chu,
A muh tieng uleh gingcha tan au.
Chun, dantak leh A cha hehpih haw chu,
Kumsawt Zingsawl Aksi vakhawih chu;
Kei a ahung hiu umsahaw cheng tawh,
Kumsawt nawpla chu sakhawm taitiu.
Ka thagau lungkham leh vakvai kawmah,
Krista’n A hehpihna thu hing chu;
A na hetsak phal tak mai ziek chun Aw,
Hallelujah chawian chim puong ie.

songs.title: Hukdampa hing na ka sem, tun khawvel ah A um

lines: Matt. 28:6
Jubilee Songs 96. - T.S. 110
Hukdampa hing na ka sem, tun khawvel ah A um,
A hing hi tih ka hei, min bang cheng gen mahleu le;
A hehpih khut ka mui, A lungmuon aw gi ka zai,
Ka ngaih cheng leh ka kawmah a hung nai zing hi.
A hing, A hing, Krista tunin A hing,
Ei kitawnpih in ei hopih, hinna lampi chipah;
A hing, A hing; hukdamna mi pie di’n,
Bangti’n na he’m? tih nei dawt leh,
Ka lungsung ah A hing.
Khawvel muntin chengah Aman ei enkawl ka hei,
Ka lunggil lungkham sek mahleh lungdawng ngei puong ka;
Huihpi leh guohpi nuoiah eipui hi tih ka he’i,
Atawp leh A hung kilatni hungtung ina.
Lawpin, lawpin aw Kristien, kipak takin la sa’n,
Lalpen Krista chu kumsawta chawihat in um hen;
Amah hawlte kinepna, Amute Panpihpa,
Mi lungsiet, Pha leh zainem amah bang umlo.

songs.title: Ngai diu kingkang sang-za gi chuh

lines: Doh is G S.S. 149 - T.S. 111
Ngai diu kingkang sang-za gi chuh,
Pahchakna la a sau ie;
Isun vaihawm, van a kipak,
Hehpih Lalpan vai a hawm.
En in, van chutphah a chu’n,
Isun vannuoi vai A hawm;
Hallelujah, Hallelujah;
Isun vannuoi vai A hawm.
Leng lopi’n kumsawt in vaihawm,
Lalna cheng nanga ahi;
Na lungsiet ’pat khenthei umlo,
Nanga dinga Na siemte.
Na zahngaihna lim nuoiah;
Na mel hawih chuh mu dingin!
Hallelujah; Hallelujah,
Na mel hawih chuh mu dingin.
Hukdampa hung kilang mengin,
Ni lopi chuh hun tunin;
Sapna aw lauhum git tiengleh,
Lei leh van taimang ina.
Sana kingkang tawh la sa’n,
“Lopi Lalpen Lopi hen;
Hallelujah; Hallelujah
Lopi Lalpen lopi hen.”
Ka gal kangthal chuh kawih puong ie,
Kei ka chenna dogal hatna;
Ni cheng in thempa’n ei them hi,
Aw, Ka Tanpa chu taihsan dingin.
Ei hung thuomin Immanuel,
Na thagau in ei hung thuomin;
Zie khawvel gitloh kulhpi hi,
Nang di’n hun do kit ingka.
Chau leh nguia ka um laiin,
Nang di’n taihmel ka put laiin;
Galhatte dinga Lallukhuk,
Aw, Na siem chu hun gen kit zelin.
Aw zuk entie ei Hukdampa,
Na thisana na tatsate;
Sietlei sau dai kulh thim sungah,
A tang ui, Lalpa simsen loh te.
Nang na tel chun sietlei dogal,
Zo ing ie Na thisan ziekin;
Na vanglien go luohpih dingin,
Aw henkawl nang bang hun phel ingka.
Dan leh taikhuo a hung vak tieng,
Ka Hukdampa chu mu’ng ka ting;
Ziechun galthuom chu kawih tangka,
Aw, puon lopi ei silhsak ina.

songs.title: Lalpa chuh hung vak ding ahi

lines: Matt. 25:6
Lalpa chuh hung vak ding ahi,
Kisazo san umun;
A van In hawih apat hung ding,
Kisazo san um un;
I diknau Lalpa chuh ahi,
A telte vangpie din A hung;
A pa chutphah ah phuong ina,
Kisazo san um un.
Na kisazo dem, Moneipa hung tieng (2)
Na thaumei a vak na dem?
Zing, sun, zan himahlele?
Na kisazo dem Moneipa hung tieng?
Leiah hungkit pai ding ahi,
Kisazo sa’n um un;
Khawvel vai hun hawm pai ina,
Kisazo sa’n um un;
Van mi’n Hallelujah tin au,
Isun tatna a hun ken tieng;
Lalpen tuok di’n thaumei guongun,
Kisazo sa’n um un.
Ngaiin, mitin di’n hung ina,
Kisazo sa’n um un;
Pengkun sapna zapai taitiu,
Kisazo sa’n um un;
A thupiekin Vaihawmna ah;
Gamtin, muntin, mi sam intin,
Chutphah ma ah dingvek hitiu,
Kisazo sa’n um un.
Dogal a lien ie khawvel ah,
Nuoi zinmang dogal ni chengin a hung lien ie;
Na Thagau a nei puih loh chun,
Na min thiengtho hi Lalpa panpih ngam puong ka.
Ma-a sinsakte Na thuom bang kha n,
Na Thagau in ei thuom inla;
Ginna’n Na sakmel ei muh sakin.
Kipak in Na min chawian ka.
Kalvari tang chungah Lalpa’n.
Ka gitlo ziekin lungngaih gimum cheng A thuok;
Hetngilh guol loh A lungkhamna,
Gitloh ziekin A lungkhamna I ngilh zo tau.
Ei ngaidam in Aw Lal Isu.
Kei din Na lungkhamna kihet ngilhsak mahleng;
Nang mai ei khawtuohpa Na hi ,
Ka hung ngai ui, Lalpa Na mel ei muh sakin.
Na gam tungding dingin Lalpa,
Na tatsate gitloh suok apat puidawk di’n;
Dogal lienhaw zo zel dingin,
Ka taisie sek, Immanuel, ma pui kitin.
Ka Lal Kraws chu ka ngaisang pen,
Khawvel sum chu ka ngainep hi;
Ziechun aw nam chitin cheng din,
Kipahna bukim a um hi.
Aw, ka ngaina ie pak bang chawi ing ka.
Ka Lalpa Kraws chu ka bitna pen;
Lungkham chate Nangmah vangin ,
Ka ma lamah Aw, lawpna’n kawl a eng.
Khawvel hawihna leh lopina,
Etin lungkham a khawk diek ie;
Kumsawt a ka thagau chawl leh,
Kipahna dang him mu puong ka.
Gitloh huihpi van nim lakah ,
Leh gal maa ka din kuomin;
Ka kulhpi leh ka bitna pen,
Kalvari Thing ka ngai na ie.
Tuisuohgiet van leh khawvel in ,
Belam No thihna lopi chu;
Pak zaila sau hen kumsawt in,
Hallelui, Halleluijah Amen.
Ma khan Mosie’n Kanaan a thila,
Luoh zolo in Lal thuthun a paw ie;
Kanaan gam lopi leh a hawihna a mu’i,
Kisika ngaiin kap in a maw !
Aw, ken le Kanaan thak chu ka thil ,
Ka hatna suongin tung thei puong ka;
Mahleh Lal Jehovin ei pui intin,
Gam nuom zie bang lawm chu va mu tang ka,
Kanaan khawvui leh nitum kawl eng,
Puipa Mosi chun a vak gal thila;
Jordan galkaih chu Lal in a phal ta puoi,
A hehpihte cheng a khen mai tai .
Lunghel um tang ka ngai na zen e,
Lalna’n a kilawm ie kumsawt gam chu;
Ziechun Zopa Belam No Lal a chu ie,
A sika Lalna pakin a um.
Kanaan pakcha leh khawtang mawi chu,
Puipa Mosi’n nungtieng a sawn ta ie;
Ngailo guolin Salem tang a kal to tai,
Israel chate ngai ina maw?
Gitloh sepaih gal nicheng I do zing ui .
Thih theihna gu manga ei do chun;
Ka gim ten ta a,
Lal Isun A galthuom ei hun piek nung chun,
Ngam takin ka delh kit thei zel ie.
Vang ei pie zel in tin,
Ka gin chu gitloh huih in mut mahleh ling diek lo
A det muncham suongpi sang inle.
Lau kiu zuonzel un gitloh thilbawl theihna,
Belam No Lal sepaih nang zolo;
Gitloh, thihna chun,
I malam vannim le a vak kit zo tai,
Zion khawpi a lang en tiem u.
Kidona lopi Na hun tiem tun sakin,
Lal Isu, Mikael sawl dawkin;
Setan chu man hen,
Sepaih hawn gal zawh leh han kal ngaklah ui;
Gehen Lal gilo dogal ai in.
Na angsung muonna tuhin chu ka tung tai,
Pakna la thang suok hen lei leh van;
Mi cheng cheng kawmah,
Gitloh thihna thima um ei hukdawk tai;
Ngaih man a um ka paupih Lalpa.
Tawia
Nuoi simlei ah thepna leh gitlohna hai puona,
Ni chengin thepin I um zing ui;
Ka mitmuh leh bila ka zakhaw hin,
Gitloh ah ei tun.
Mahleh Ka Lapa hehpihna lopi chun,
Sihlung hei A ngaidam;
Sihlung hei in ka hung ie Lalpa (2)
Ka gitloh ngaidam in.
A hehpihna vangin chang bang damin I um ui,
Mahleh A hehpih I haih zing ui;
Kalvari a tatna ngailo bangin,
Lei pak ka na lawp.
Khawvel hawihna cheng cheng hi kumsawt a ting
Mahleh a hawihna I hawl zing ui; [zo puoi,
Khawvel a hin nun nuomin leng mahleng,
Vak mang ka na hi .
Beimangte hawla hukdam dingin Lalpa Isu’n,
Hehpih in ei hawl gimthei chate;
Gitloh thihna thima kimang cheng cheng
Te tho kit hitiu.
Doh is G Tune S.S. 82 - T.S. 115
Nanghaw, Lalpa hungkitna ding ngaktehaw,
A hungkitna ding chuh genviel un;
Gamla takhaw a chun vakviel viel unla,
“Hungvak ding ei tai” tin genviel un.
Nitiem chuh a naitai, A hung kitna ding,
Ni chuh tawmin, hun a chawm tai;
Tatsate’n la sau hen a hungkit muokna’n,
Namtin kiguong zo un.
Nanghaw Lalpa hungna ding ngakte haw chun,
Ipmu chuh phawng un, paucham sak un;
Vana Moneipa chuh hungvak ding eitai,
Entiem u, A hung kipan ei tai.
Zion Lalpa chungnung chawian zing hitiu,
Thiemgaute’n le a na gen u chuh;
Lasa’n chawian un, Lalpa chuh Angelte’n,
Ama ah kipahna thu gen un.

songs.title: Lalgam lopitak ei ngak Van khelgam achun a um hi

lines: Luke 21:28
Doh is B8 S.S. 168. - T.S. 120
Lalgam lopitak ei ngak Van khelgam achun a um hi,
Ziechun mithiengtho kum chengin a kikhawm;
Kin takin nite chuh a bei, Lalgam hungtun nai dingin,
Lalgam hungtunna ding chuh a naita ie!
Aw Lalgam hungtunna ding a naita ie (2)
Ka thagau kisazo in pengkun hunggi pai intin,
Lalpen chuh, A lopina’n kilang ding.
Chunglama Lalgam lopi guotlawk chuh kinepna ahi,
Hukdampa hung kilang ding kinepna tawh;
Aman khawvel khatvei puksa sal apat ei tandawk tai,
Lalgam hung tunna ding chuh a naita ie!
Lalgam hungtung chu tawh I Lalpau deihtak mel chuh mui tiu,
Lalgam latman Lalpen kilang masa ding;
A min chu Hallelujah, A thisana ei Tanpa chuh,
Lalgam hungtunna ding chuh a naita ie!
Khawvel in angaksawt bektak ziekin anguizo ta ie,
Lauthawng in mite lungle a dawng hiel tai;
A mau chuh lalgam thu hilh hitingun lan hihhalh hitiu,
Lalgam hungtun ding a naih takzie thu chuh.

songs.title: Mihiem Chapa A hungkit tieng zie zing khawvak hawih achun

lines: Doh is C S.S. 159 - T.S. 121
Mihiem Chapa A hungkit tieng zie zing khawvak hawih achun,
A lopina vak chuh I muh tieng uleh;
Gamtin leh chitin apat A mite a sap khawm tieng leh,
Tatsa kikhawp lopi ahi na ding e!
Kikhawpna lien! Kikhawpna lien!
Hehpihna gam nuoma tatsate kikhawpna lien hina;
Kikhawpna lien! Kikhawpna lien!
Chunglam In nuoma tatsate kikhawpna!
Nuomsa Isu a thite A sapa a thawh tieng u leh,
Than khuk thim sung leh tuisuohgiet apat in;
Taksa se theitalo pun vanah Amah chu tuok unau,
Kikhawppi lien, lawp um ahi na ding e!
I mit un khawpi a umna tamtak vak tak a muh tieng,
A lui thip leh dam hieu a luong I muh tieng;
Thihna’n ei khen I guolteu tawh kipak a I kikhawp tieng,
Khawppi lien kilamtuoh na lopi hina.
Lalpen hung kit tei ding ahi, A hungna ding a nai tai,
Nitiem kipahum chuh I muh tieng u leh;
Tieng chuleh mitphet kal lo a I vo uhi kitheng ding,
Amah kawma cheng zing ding I hitau hi.
Matt. 25:6
Doh is E S.S. 185 - T.S. 117
Thaumei dimsa’n, I gawzo dem,
Moneipa hung tieng?
I vakhawu le a thiengna dem?
Moneipa hung tieng.
Zie zan lopi tak a chun,
I thaumei a vakna dem?
Moneipa hung tieng.
Kiguong zo un! Kiguong zo un!
Kiguong zo un! Moneipa hung tieng!
Lawpna aw gi I za ding um?
Moneipa hung tieng;
Kipah aw gi I za ding um?
Moneipa hung tieng.
Zie zan lopi tak achun,
I thaumei a vak na dem?
Moneipa hung tieng.
I kiguotna vaigei lo di’n,

Lalpa a dingin mun awnsak un;
Lalpa pawl chu kipahna ahi.
Lalpa, ei nungsawn kit ta ki’n,
Ka lunggil thuneihna chu chang tan la;
Hung cheng den mai ta uo Lal Isu,
Thildang bangmah le ngai ta puongka,
Zion la sa’n kipak zing tang ka.

songs.title: Ni vak achun chieh in, vak hawihtak achun

lines: Matt. 4:19
Doh is B8 S.S. 1099 - T.S. 127
Ni vak achun chieh in, vak hawihtak achun,
Zing khawvak hawih ahim, leh zan dai lakah;
Awl a masuon zelin, nichenga pangin,
Lam chenga Isu zuiin.
Zuiin, Isu chuh zui hitiu,
Zuiin, nichengin zuiin;
Zuiin, ei puihna mun chengah,
Isu chuh lam cheng ah zui hitiu.
Nisat vanglai ahim, zan thimin ahim,
Chavang hun nuom ahim nipi ahim in;
Hukdampa sapna he’n awi dingin kinin,
Lam chengah Isu zuiin.
Sana nivak ahim, leh mun lim achun,
Huihpi hat lai ahim, a haih tieng ahim;
A zahngaihna gingcha’n ni beihna chengin,
Lam chengah Isu zuiin.

songs.title: Ka sapum leh ka hinna hi

lines: Doh is E K.H. 174
Ka sapum leh ka hinna hi,
Lal Isu kawmah ka pie tai;
Buona bangmah lau ta puong ka,
Ka neih cheng tawh ka kipumpiek (2)
Lal Isu mai hi hinna pen,
Kumsawt Pa Chamna Lal ahi;
Amah kawmah hinna A um,
Gitloh ngawlna a pukte di’n (2)
Khawvel ah mihiem a um em?
Mi thiengtho leh gitlohna bei;
Mihing Chapa, Lal Isu mai,
Gitloh, buokna neilo ahi. (2)
Khawvel neihzawh leh nawpna hi,
Beimanna leh thepna ahi;
Mahleh pielgal neihzawhna chuh,
Kumsawt chan inle kang puona. (2)
Isu’n ka gitloh A tan tai,
Suok apatin ei puidawk tai;
Ziebang bawlthei chu a um em?
Gitloh suoka ei tatdawk chuh. (2)
Doh is A8 Tune S.S. 327
Ka paucham nau ei Lawhtinpa,
Lungmuonna ka ngen ui;
Lungkham in lungzing mahleng le,
Aw Lalpa, ei haw ki’n.
Nangmah bangin um ka nuom hi,
Nangmah ei khawtuohpa;
Diktaka ka um theih loh hin,
Aw Lalpa, ei haw ki’n.
Na kipahna mu hawi kei puoi,
Gilo ka hih ziekin;
Na kienga hung hawi ka hi puoi,
Aw Lalpa, ei haw ki’n.
Ka vengte leh ka chanau te’n,
Ei deihlo mah leule;
Guolte’n ei nusie zo mahleu,
Aw Lalpa, ei haw ki’n.
Nuoi leiseta na hungkum in,
Thing Kross ah Na thi a;
Vana Na ngetsak tak ziekin,
Aw Lalpa, ei haw ki’n.
Sapchuom haw laka um dingin,
Thihna lau lo dingin;
Vana phataka um dingin,
Aw Lalpa, ei haw ki’n.
Mihing, mithi ngaihtuoh dingin,
Lopi leh zahum in;
Meipi laka Na hung kum tieng,
Aw Lalpa, ei haw ki’n.
C.Z Huala
Lei Lalpuon lopi chu dawng intin,
Lei pakcha hawih cheng le vuoi ina;
I damlai niu hi le hung tum ngei ngei ina,
Aw heh, Lal Isu chu ka nei tai.
Lili pak hawih Lal Isu ka nei,
Kei di’n a pak kumsawt gam hawih ah;
Gimumna-ah aman ei umpih ina,
Lili pak hawih Lal Isu ka nei.
A lungsietna gam vak hawih achun,
Amah chu Zingdawng Sawl No ahi;
Gimthei in, lei ahin liengvai in um mahleng,
A gam noma ei pui ding ei nai.
Tuhin kapin um tadih leng le,
Thihna ni chu ka hung chan tieng leh;
Lau ta puong ie, thana um ei kaitho in tin,
Ka mitthi ei thiek hul sak tana.
Ka guol deihten zie khawvel ahin,
Ei nusieh un ka lung a hel ie;
Lungkham, puong ie thawmhau a ka um lai hin le,
Lili pak hawih Isun ei umpih.

songs.title: Na kawm ei naihsak in aw ka Pathien

lines: Jakob 4:8
Doh is G S.S. 581 - T.S. 126
Na kawm ei naihsak in aw ka Pathien,
Kross gikpuo himah leng kei ei phawng ding;
Ka la hizing ina.
Na kawm ei naihsak in (2)
Aw ka Pathien.
Vakvai banga umin, ni a tumin,
Thimna’n kei ei bawma, suongah ka chawl;
Mahleh ka manglam in.
Ka lampi kilang hen, van lampi chuh!
Ka kawma Na sawl cheng, lungsietna ziek;
Angelte’n ei hilh ding.
Ka thawh tieng lungthim nuomin ka hun pak,
Ka lungkhamna ziekin, Bethel sa’ng ka;
Ka lungkhamna ziekin.
Kipahna tha zakin, Vanah leng leng,
Ni, tha, aksi khel chunglam ah leng ka;
Ka la hi zing ina.

songs.title: Ka thagau in a zawm ta a

lines: Ka thagau in a zawm ta a,
Krista Gerep hing chu;
Sawttak ka na thahtham ta a,
Mahleh ka nei kittai;
Pathien ah michuom ka na hii,
Isu’n ei lak machun;
Lauhum ah ka tha A hukdawk,
Gitloh cheng ei ngaidam.
Ka neih chengcheng tawh ka zuona,
Tatna thisan achun;
Thagau Thiengtho a hung luta,
Pathien Cha ka hung hii;
Ka gitloh cheng, A ngaidam tai,
A thisan ka hetin;
Chun, Van gamnuom tung ngei ing ka,
Krista ka gin phawt chun.
Mei leh tuilien in ei um vel,
Mahleh ei dal zolo;
Khawvel a lopi nate hin,
Ei subuoi ta puon au;
Krista Hukdamna ka neih chun,
Bangmah awtcha puong ka;
Thiemloh chan ding lau ta puong ka,
Ka Pa lung A awi tai.

songs.title: Puipa, huihpi a hung nung hi

lines: Mark 439
Doh is C S.S. 61 - T.S. 124
Puipa, huihpi a hung nung hi,
Tui kinawk chuh a sang hi!
Van la a hah nim mah mah mai in,
Belh ding, panpih ding umlo;
Ka manthai diu khawk salo maw
Bang di’n Na ip thei em
Mitphetkal chenga a hung hat zinga
Thihna a hung naih lai hi’n
“Huih leh tui kinawk ka thu’n a nung ui,
Hai kei un!
Huihpi mutin tui kinawk mahleh,
Dawi leh kau, mi leh sa bang cheng hung mahleh;
Kuong chuh tui a chun tum thei diek puona,
Tuipi, lei leh van Lal a um ziekin;
Ziehaw hin Ka thu a awi chiet ui,
Hai kei un! Hai kei un!
Ziehaw hin Ka thu a awi chiet ui,
Hai! hai kei un!”
Puipa, lungthim a lungkham in,
Tuni’n lungdawng in ka khun;
Ka lunggil lungkhamna a lien ie,
Tho inla, ei hukdam in;
Gitlohna tuihat leh thawkna’n,
Ka thagau a suol hi;’
Mang ding ka hi! mang ding ka hi! Puipa,
Kin inla hung hih thipin.
Puipa, lauhum chuh abei tai,
Chawlhna nuom ahung kipan;
Nisa’n tui tawilo chung chuh a salh,
Ka lungthim a kipak hi;
Um zingin aw Tanpa deihum,
Kei ngawn ei nusie ki’n;
Kipakin, kuongchawlhna nuom tak siem ka,
Nuom takin zie chun chawl ka.
Upa Zasiama
Aw Lal Isu, sietlei gamdai ah;
Lungngaih tin cheng khuom bang do in
Ei pui in aw, Na lampi-ah
Aw ka Lal Isu.
Thihna luiah ei pui kaiin
Lungngaih kahna khel gam nuomah
Lungtuok sam gibang khente tawh
Dawn bang kituok khawm di’n.
Simlei khulsin luonthi nulna hi,
Sanggah liengthei kei ka kahna,
Pak bang tuoi hen nuoi simlei hi.
Lungngaih ka kahna.
Aw ka ngaih ka Lalpa anga chun,
Chang bang kikhenna um lo-in;
Henkawl nang bang ei sutpa chu,
Zaila’n awi hitiu.
Zingdawng Sawl No, Hukdampa Lalpa,
Ka lunggil gilo thim ahin;
Hung vak inla, Na gam thiengtho,
Chu ka muh theihnan.
I Thes. 4:17
Doh is A8 S.S. 917
“Lalpa tawh cheng khawm di’n!”
Ahi ahi, Amen;
Thihna pat hinna a um,
Manthai theihlohna chuh;
Zie lei taksa ahin,
Amah beiin ka vak;
Zan bei zelin, ka naih deuh deuh,
Nicheng in In ka naih.
In ka naih, In ka naih,
Nicheng in In ka naih.
Ka Pa In van sangah,
Ka thagau in a naih;
Ginna mitin ka gal muh hi,
Sana kawtkhak a lang;
Ka thagau a chau hi,
Ka lunggulh gam tung di’n;
Mi thiengthote luoh ding In van,
Chunglam Jerusalem.
Meipi hung zing mahleh,
Lungtupna chau mahleh;
Noah vakhu bangin ka leng,
Tuilien, huihpi lakah;
Meipi a kithiel tai,
Huihpi, tuilien a hai;
Ka lungthim lawpin, a kipak,
Lungmuonna chu ka nei.
Zingkal leh nitak in,
Sun leh zan, bangtik inle;
Van lapawl ngaihnawp um ka zai,
Lei chung pauchuuom beita;
Zie thawkitna thu chuh,
Zie zawhna la gi chuh;
“Lalpa tawh kumsawt a um ding,
A hi, a hi, Amen.”
Doh is A8
Isu na dawnna bang ahim,
Tuni’n a hun hukdam nuom?
“Ei hun zuonin” ti’n A hun chiel,
Bang dinga vaigei nalai ding?
Isu nei sam hi tih ka hei,
Nang apat vakmang ta puong ka;
Tho in ka Hukdampa zuon ka,
Lawp dingin Ama’n ei na ngak.
Na vaigeih banga phachuom ding?
Na niel leh na tha mangthai ding;
Isu lo hukdam thei umlo,
Kross thihna’n Ama’n A din tai.
Isu nang tan dinga thi kha,
Mun hun bawlsak di’n a chieh;
Lopina ah A hun na ngak,
Amah zuonin, vakmang takin.

songs.title: Isu khut a kan sak ui, Huona a paucham petin

lines: Matt. 26:53
Doh is E8 - T.S. 282
Isu khut a kan sak ui, Huona a paucham petin,
Zahhuoi in kawtthel a puiin;
Hukdampa chilsiet khum in,
Gitloh bei leh thiengtho, kilhden un thiemloh ti’n a gen ui.
A sam thei hi Angel sangsawm te,
Leisiet susie a Amah tan di’n;
A sam thei hi Angel sangsawm te,
Mahleh, A thi tai nang leh kei di’n.
A lu thiengtho tak chungah linglukhuk a kawih ui,
Nuihsan in ‘Lengpa en un” ti’n;
Sapsiet na tawh zep kawm in,
Amin thiengtho nuihsan in, Amah maiin bang cheng a thuok tai.
Kross a a kilhden lai un, Anu a kawma ding,
“Numei na chapa en in” ti’n; Tui ka duh” ti’n ka kiko;
Kuoma’n dawn ding a pie puoi,
Mihiem gitloh nasep a zo tai.
Mi gilote kawma kipie’n, Zahngaihna a ngen puoi,
Kross zahhuoi amah mai a pu’n;
“Zawh ei tai” ti’n a kiko,
Thi dingin a kipie a, Hukdamna mak tak chuh A zo tai.
Kei ka chenna zie lei mun hi,
Gamgaw, gamthip lungngaih na mai;
Zielam a khun awl leh chieh ka,
Belam No Lal Isu kawm ah;
Kei ka chenna ding gamnom khu,
Ka ngai ie khensate lenna;
En zel ing ka, tatsate nawp-
Lenna gam nuom chu.
Ka tup gam nuom ka chenna ding,
Leiah gimtheih thuok mahleng le;
Ei Hukdampa’n gimtheite di’n,
Hinna tuikhuk pha a luonsak.
Aw ei Tanpa Na thawkna chu,
Nei hehpihnan ngai thei leu hing;
Bangkim a ka bangkim na hi,
Ka thagau din bangkim na hi,
Sana khawpi nuoma leng di’n,
Na thawkna hin a chawzo hi,
Aw nei khawtuohna a hi ie,
Kei migilo hi.
Aw Lal Isu mu thei leng chu,
Lungdeihte tuola lennau chu;
Kalvari hehpihna ziekin,
Chitin, namtin te a leng ui;
Keile Na thawkgim na zalin,
Gamgaw gamthip hun pawtsan ka;
Hehpihna Lalpa ei puiin,
Lungsietna gamah.
Khawvel lopi leh hawihna hi,
Beizel ina, a hawihna tawh;
Hukdampa kawm ah leng ingka,
A lopina gam vak hawih ah;
Leisiet kipahna ngai puong ka,
Chun A hehpihna chunga chun;
Kumsawt kipahna la sai tiu;
Belam No kawm ah.
Patea
Ka damlai huihpi a beih tieng leh,
Ei hukdampa mel deihum chu mutang ka
Tichun, ka kipahna chul puo’na,
A mela van pakcha chu lun zing ta’na
Aw hinna Thing, na bak nuoiah.
Van a Angelte a leng ui,
Aw, ziechun kei haw hung chawl kau,
Israel tang thiengtho a chun.
Zie khawpi hawih ngai a ka kahna,
Chun lungkham buoina thihna theih hi le chu
Tatna thisan zala lungdeihte,
Khawvela hin Aw, a na khen tang ka ting,
Chieh zel hitiu aw, Zion chate
I nawplenna diu gam lopi a nai tai
Tulai lungkham kah leh buoina hi,
I kipahnau pakcha’n hung lun ngei ina.
Ti chun khawpi hawih ka tun tieng leh,
Ka lenna gamthip lam hi nga ta puong ka
Belam No leh A Lalchutphah chu,
Etnawp maktak leh kipahna bukim na’ng.
Upa Zasiama
Zingdawng Sawl No, Hukdampa lalna gama chun,
Lei lungkhamna leh buoina cheng tawh;
Damlai lungngaih mei zing ta puona,
Kap a kikhenna bei tana.
Lili pak leh lopina vak zam vel,
Belam No leh a tatsa te lenna;
Van khawtuol nuom leh Angelte,
Muh ka nuom ngei ie.
Thilun van lopina tung masate haw chun,
Pak na’n gihawih lopi a lem ui,
Leia a len guol ten thil mah leu,
Ngaiin nungsul hei ta puonau.
Zing tha puin van Jerusalem thak hawih ah,
A leng tau ui van gam nuom achun,
Lunglai ei kuoi hi a mel vak un
Ka lungguk ah a dai thei puoi.
Chung thangvan gitna khel Lalpa chenna gamah,
Ni vak leh thaumei ngai talo in,
Zan thim lungngaihna cheng bei tana,
Belam No chu a vak zing hi.
Chhawna
Pielgal gam nuom chu ka tun tiengleh,
Khawvel beimang ding hi taihsan ing ka;
Aw, hinlai taksa hi ngai puong ka,
Hinna thing leh Lalpa chu tung ka.
Tun ka nuom hi, pielgal gam nuom,
Thokit chate laituol a lennau;
Thihna, pulthawk, kahna bei tana,
Aw pielgal kei din hung kihawng in.
Gamnuom ka thilin ka lung a hel,
Belam No leh A tatsate lenna;
Aw, khawvel ngailo in ei nusieu,
Zie gam chu ka tung thei tadih puoi.
Dan takleh taikhuo hung vak ina,
Tih ka hetin ka kahlai ka hai sek;
Lei gimum na ei tuom tehaw hi,
Pel ingka zie gam chu ka tun tieng.
Ziechun ma a thuoka, liem sate,
Kipakin a leng ui gimthei chate;
Hukdampa leh a tatsate tawh,
Kikhen loa I lenna diu chu.
Sam 86:1
Doh is A8 S.S. 577 - T.S. 293
Phat chengin ka hun ngai,
Zahngaihna Lal;
Na Aw dam hieu banga,
Ei lungmuon bei.
Ka hun ngai Aw ka hun ngai,
Phat chengin ka hun ngai;
Vang ei pie’n, tun Hukdampa,
Ka hun zuon hi.
Phat chengin ka hun ngai,
Ei umpih in;
Thepna hatna a bei,
Nang na naih tieng.
Phat chengin ka hun ngai,
Nawp leh nat in;
Hung mengin hung chengin,
Hin phatchuom na’n.
Phat chengin ka hun ngai,
Ei sinsak in;
Na thutiem chu kei ah-
Hih bukim in.
Phat chengin ka hun ngai,
Mi thiengtho pen;
Nanga ei hihsak in,
Pathien Chapa.
Chhawna
Lalpa’n A hehpihte gam A guotsak chu,
Khawvel Kanaan gam sanga le nuomzaw chu,
A aw nemin a mite nicheng in ei sam
A gam nuom taka chun cheng dingin.
Ni chengin ei sam ie,
A aw nem ngai un
A hehpihna hun zuon un, hun zuon un.
Jordan luipi lien mah leh,
Lalpa gama chun hung lut tei un.
Aw, ziechun Hinna Thing leh lenthang khawvui
Thilin ka ngai hinna pakcha lun lai chu,
Thienna luipang hawih leh kumsawt hinna mun nuom
Lalpa lungsiet te laituol lenna.
Aw, ziechun kumsawt a eng Lalpa Isu,
Leh Angelte tawh kipahna la sai tiu;
Krista mel ente chun gitlohna lau loin,
Lawpin Amah chu a chawian ui.
Ka thilchim loh ka lunghelna,
Lei lungngaih khel gam nuom,
Damlai lungngaih meipi zing hi,
Kahna gam pel ing ka.
Lei lungngaih luonthi hul intin,
Nau bang ka kah bei ina;
Lalpa na mel muh ka ngaklah,
Beimang maiin nuoi simlei.
Kalvari ah Lal Isu chun,
Van gam dawngkawt a hawng;
Va gal dawtin Aw ka thagau,
Na kumsawt gam a lang.
Ka kahna zan thim bei intin,
Jordan luipi gal ah;
Guol deih ka kipahna pen te,
Laituol lenna gamah.
Tik le thuongte ka tung deimawh,?
Thangvan tuolnuom a chun;
Thihna lui ka galkaih tieng leh,
Kahna gam ngai puong ie.

songs.title: I gam lungsietum ka Lalpa Isu hung leng hen

lines: Doh is F Rev. K. Thuomngell - T.S. 280
I gam lungsietum ka Lalpa Isu hung leng hen,
Malai Galili gam a A len bang khan;
Zingdawng Sawl No Lalpa Isu,
Hung suok henla namtin suihlung,
Ni bangin vaksak hen,
Zan thim nuoia umte A vakah,
Nga bangin leng hitiu.
I gam lungsiet um ah,
Lal Isu lili pakin lun leh;
Suihlungah kipahna leh,
Muonna chuh nei hiting;
Sietlei gamdang cheng sang I gam chuh,
Gam vangnei hung hina.
Thiemna, chitna, thaihkawi in I gam hihhawih puona,
Lal Isu nga banga A lenloh ngal chun;
Sietlei thiemna, chitna haw hin,
Kipahna kim leh lautha muonna;
Ei pie thei puona,
I gam suhawih dingin Lal Isu,
Nga bangin hungleng hen.
I gam muoltin ah lawnlei heisa pakin a lun,
Lengnga buolna dingin damtui thieng a luong;
I gam hawihna leh nunnawp na’n,
Kipahna kim leh nunnawp na kim;
Ei pie thei puona,
Nunnawp kimna dingin Lal Isu,
Nga bangin hungleng hen.

songs.title: Lalpa Isu, ka puma thien ka nuom hi

lines: Sam 51:7
Doh is A8 S.S. 569
Lalpa Isu, ka puma thien ka nuom hi,
Ka lunggila cheng zing dingin ka hun deih;
Milim cheng hihsien la, melma nawhmang in,
Tun nei silin chun vuk sangin vam zawng ka.
Vuk sangin, vamzawng ka, vuk sangin,
Tun nei silin, chun vuk sangin vam zawng ka.
Lalpa Isu gitloh cheng lamang vekin,
Na thisan lun chun ka gitloh silthieng in;
Zie thienna chu thildang cheng sangin ka deih,
Tun nei silin, chun vuk sangin vam zawng ka.
Lal Isu van chutphah apat ei enin,
Ka puma kipie dingin ei panpih in;
Ka pumin kipieng ka, ka hetna cheng le,
Tun nei silin, chun vuk sangin vam zawng ka.
Lal Isu, kingainiem in zie hi ka ngen,
Lal deih um, Na keng liem bulah ka ngak hi;
Thienna ding, Na thisan luong ginnan ka mui,
Tun nei silin, chun vuk sangin vam zawng ka.
Lal Isu, gunchuh taka ka ngak na hei,
Hung inla, keimah ah lunggil thak siem in;
Nangmah hun hawlte kuomah Na niel ngei puoi,
Tun nei silin, chun vuk sangin vam zawng ka.
C.Z.Huala
Ni cheng ka kawmah um zing in Aw Lalpa,
Keile Na kawma um ka chim puoi;
Ka ngaih ni hin chawlhna gam ei thil sakin,
Zaila sang ka lungkhamna meipi nuoiah.
Kipahna luigal ka tun tiengleh,
Lungkham taka ka khensahaw kha;
Ka Lal mel liem nung kha awih pih ingka,
Ziechun van pielgal pak chu lun zing tana.
A tuoi vak na e I kipahnau ni chu,
Aw, Kalvari hung lun kit inla;
Zaila’n awi ingka na pak lun hung tanin,
Kipakin gam thiengtho lam nga kit ingka.
Ma a I nawpnau pielgal mansak mahleng,
Kalvari ah khuo a vak kit tai;
“Zion gam nuom a hawng kittau” a tiu ie,
Tho hi tiu. I chamtat na kawlni a suok.
Tuhin le lung kiguol in vak thil leuhing,
Lungkham ni a guol deih ngaih cheng tawh;
Nawpna zaila Lalpa kawma sak ding chuh,
Ka thil kuom leh a ngaiin ka mau sek hi.
C.Z. Huala
Damlai tuipi kinawk khel lama chun,
Ka lunggulh gam vak hawih chu a um;
Ka ngaklah ngei ie, Hukdampa lawia,
Lenkhawm phat ding, len guol ngaih cheng tawh.
Ei tun in Aw, ka Lalpa deihum,
Lili pak lunna Na mun hawih chu;
Aw bangtik phat leh kei ka tung dem;
Hukdampa mun tiem khenlohna gam.
Ka hun ngai diek hi, Lalpa lungkham nin,
Ginnan ei thilsak in ziegam chu;
Aw, hung hawih diekin ka lunggil sungah,
Chun hai ingka lungkham ka kah chu.
Tu khun ei ngak zing ui, ka lungdeih te’n,
Hukdampa lenna Zion a khun;
Aw bangtik phat leh keile ka tung dem?
La sak pih ka, kikhen talo din.
Ei na kai inla Aw ka Hukdampa,
Ka mauna gamgaw gam apat hin;
Zuon zel ingka Belam No Lal lenna,
Aw khenlohna gam kumsawt pielgal.
Redemption Songs 285
Doh is A K.H. 204 Old Sankey 203 - T.S. 285
Lungsiet takin aw Lalpa,
Ei hun hen, ei hun hen;
Kithing kawmin ka hung hi,
Ka gitloh ngaidam in;
Ka gitloh ziek, Na thi tai,
Na thi tai, Na thi tai,
Mahleh Na zahngaihna chun,
Ka gitloh ngaidam in.
Aw Isu ei puiin,
Lungkham kit ta puong ka;
Aw, ei Hukdampa pen,
Ka gitloh ngaidam in.
Mang mahleng le lungsietna,
Ngen ingka, ngen ingka;
Hinna lam ei kawkmuh in,
Ka gitloh ngaidamin;

Tun kei kawmah genin.
Ka lunggil cheng tawh hun zui ka,
Tunin Nang tawh tawn din;
Gilo mahleng ei nusie kin,
Ngaihdam, silthien ka ngen.
Na hehpihna lunggil bang pun,
Mihing mana pang ding;
Lensehna ding mun ei hilh in,
Galili a bang khan.
Suihlung a hel nin ka khawdak a,
Lunglai nem a kim puou gam ngaih chu,
Aw, ka chenna gam pawtsan ni hungtung intin
Kahna bei tan a.
Aw, ka gam ngaih chu pakcha hawih in a bawm ie,
Albang dah hin Na vanglim bel ka:
Lalpa gam nuom ah ngabang leng ingka.
Nawp chang thei leng, chung leng van chang leng,
Thangvan sanga lengin va chieh ka;
Kalvari tang thing hansedawl chunga,
Chun va chuong ingka.
Vangkhuo ah leng, leng lenguol ngaih tawh,
Ka suihlung len puonbang a bang dem?
Guol kim a lenin suihlung hel suhai puona,
Kah lai hai puona.
Khaile, lunghel khuom bang do hitiu,
Chung Pathien vangin chang bang dam leng,
Lautha vangkhuo ah lai tuol leng khawm hitiu,
Lei nungtieng sawn in.
Hun leh kumte abei zel,
I nunnawp lai niuhaw tawh;
Ni vak hawih leh khawvel pakhaw hi,
Kei di’n lungkham, kahna mun leh gam ahi.
Aw, I kumsawt khawpi galmuonna mun,
Tatsate lenna gam ka ngai na e aw;
Lungngaihna leh thavaihna cheng,
A um ta puoi kah sawlbang bang tan a.
Sietlei lungkhamna haw leh,
Kah luonthi’n pal bang ei nang;
Gamthip gamgaw ka mauna gam hi,
Pel a hehpihte tawh len ka nuom na e.
I nunnawp niteu a tuoi,
Sietlei pak lunhaw cheng tawh;
Lei nunnuom puonbang a chul kit sek,
Pak bang lunna kumsawt gam ka ngai na e.
Nau bang ei nem in Lalpa,
Thakie pulthuok liengthei cha;
Ei kai in aw, Na lenna gam ah,
Buoina gam sietlei hi ngai kit ta puong ka.
Patea
Chunglam Jerusalem thak khu,
Mi thiengthote khawpi ahi;
Belam No Lal Immanuel in vai a hawm,
Matieng Zion gam nuom chu mu bang ka ngai.
Nuoi simlei mun sangin a nuomzawi kumsawt gam chu
Sun ni cheng in mi zatam in sihsiel bang a zuon ui
Zion tang chunga Belam No zaila’n a chawian ui
Immanuel Na thisan chu,
Ka kumsawt zaila ding ahi;
Mi thiengtho gam ka tun tieng zaila tuoilo sa’n,
Kumsawt tuolthing Lal nunnem lim bel tang ie.
Hallelujah Aw Hukdampa,
Sietlei thangvan Nang a ahiu,
Na thisan lun in nei tan tai, Nanga ka hiu,
Ka hun ngak buoina Jordan mei zing nuoi ah.
Lalpa, Na hung ding a nai tam?
Sietlei lungkham meipi’n a bawm
Kanaan gam leh Na sakmel ngaih a hai thei puoi,
Zing tha pu’n khuo thiengtho a len ka nuom ie.
Doh is G S.S. 357 - T.S. 284
Zaila’n ka kiengah sakit in,
Hinna thu maktak chuh!
A hawihnau chu ei muhsak in,
Hinna thu maktak chuh!
Hinna leh hawihna thu,
A gin dan ei hilh in!
* Thu hawihtak chuh, thu maktak chuh!
Hinna thu maktak chuh! (2)
Mi cheng kiengah Krista’n A piei,
Hinna thu maktak chuh;
Gilo lungsiet sapna ngaiin,
Hinna thu maktak chuh!
Man beia piek I hiu,
Van gam I tun theihna’n!
Gospel sapna’n gamtin athawng,
Hinna thu maktak chuh!
Ngaihdam, muonna micheng A piei,
Hinna thu maktak chuh;
Isu mai Hukdampa,
Kumkhuo’n A hih thiengtho.
Pautinkhup
Lei gimum thihna gam ahin,
Zion khawvak ngaktute;
Muong taka ana ipmute,
Lalpa tuokdi’n kaitho un,
Ni lopi tak hungtung ding chu,
Kawlni suok bangin I Lalpau hungvak intin;
A Aw zate than apat hungtho ding,
Van leh meipi kalah,
Khensate tawh I Lalpau tuok dingin va leng hitiu.
Lungkhama kapte hai tau in,
Hun sawttak ngak talo ding;
Lungkham mauna’n van a thawng hi,
Lalpa ngai buoita kiu in.
I Lalpa thutiem bangzel in,
Hun a lamdang thil a thak;
Lunggil buokna’dim suthieng un,
Thagau thiengtho samlut un.
Lei leh vana thil cheng sangin,
Muh ka nuom ie ka Tanpa,
Keidi’n Saron pak bang na lun-
Ni chuh hungtun sak ta uo.
Matt. 9:12
Doh is D S.S. 390 - T.S. 161
Krista’n gilo te a pawm,
Zie thu hi micheng hilh un -
Van lampi mansakte leh,
Migilo pukte kiengah.
La’n sau in, sa nawn zel un,
Krista’n gilote A pawm;
A thu chien takin gen un,
Krista’n gilote A pawm.
Hungin, chawlhna hun piena,
Gingin, A thu adik hi;
Migilo pen le la’n a,
Krista’n gilote A pawm.
Ka lungin thiem ei chansak,
Vaihawmna ah thiemchang ka;
Buokna cheng ei sawpthieng pa’n,
Dan thil nget ei taksak tai.
Krista’n gilote A pawm,
Keile ka gitloh cheng tawh
Buokna mawhna ei sawpthieng,
Amah ziek’ Van ah lut ka.
Thup. 21:25
Doh is C S.S. 372 - T.S. 160
Kawtkhak khat kihawngsa a um,
Zie kawtkhak vak apat chun;
Gamla taka Kross vak alang,
Hukdampa hehpih a phuong.
Aw, hehpihna athuk na e!
Kawt chuh keia di’n hawn ahim?
Kei di’n .... Kei di’n!
Kei dingin hawn ahim?
Mitin di’n kawt chuh hawn ahi,
Hukdamna hawlte adi’n;
Ahau, avai, alien, aneu,
Namtin, chitinte a di’n.
Lungsietna kawt hawn lai ahi,
Dogal te do ham ham un;
Hailo in Kross pu zel unla,
Lallukhuk tiemsa ahi.
Zie taka Kross I put u hi,
Luigal achun nga tai tiu;
Hinna Lallukhuk khu taiting,
Amah lungsiet zaw tai tiu.
Isai 6:8
Doh is F S.S. 813 - T.S. 163
Isu Aw ngaiin, A kiko,
“Tuni’n kuo a nasem ding?
Buh amin tai at ding ngakin
Kuo a buhphal lakhawm ding?”
Ngeih takin Lalpa’n mi A sam,
Kipahman tampi A tiem;
Kipak taka dawng ding kuo a?
“Zie’n ka um, kei ei sawlin.”
Tuisuohgiet gal kai thei loin,
Gam thim pha lo mahleu chin;
Awilo naicha ah na mu thei,
Kawtbul ah na panpih thei;
Tampi pie thei kimahleh chun,
Meithai piek zat na pie thei;
Isu di’n tawmcha na bawl le,
A muh in lul tak hina.
Vansawlchak leh Paula bangin,
Thugen thiem kimahleh chin;
Isu lunsiet thu na gen thei,
Micheng dinga A thih zie;
Vaihawmna hungtung di’n gilo,
Lauhsak zo kimahleh chin;
Hukdampa angsung nuom achun,
Naupangte na pui thei hi.
Mi cheng di’n hinna A piek thu,
Van gam lampi kawkmuh di’n;
Zion kulh sanga dingin gal
Veng hi thei kimahleh chun;
Na paucham na leh thilpiek in,
Pathien deih guol nasem thei;
Thiemgau ban dawmkang mi ginum,
Aron bangin nasem thei.
Mi pitingsa haw laka chun,
Sinsak thei kimahleh chin;
“Ka Belam No vakin a nek -
Phak dingun an pien” A tii;
Lau kawma naupang na puihte,
Gam phazaw chu na tun tieng;
Kipahna man a na muh ding,
Na suongmantam hung hinau.
“Ka sep theih bangmah a um puoi”
Kuomah zakin ti hiel ki’n;
Mi thagau aman zing laia,
Lalpa’n A hun sap lai hin;
Kipak in A na chu semin,
A nasep ah kipak in;
A hun sap lai hin dawng kinin,
“Zie’n ka um, ei sawl in” tiin.
Saihnuna
Gal in dawn un ngomei zam kal akhun,
Tuol a lennau Zion tang ah;
Suihlung guol in tuol a leng ui,
Mu bang ngailo, lobang chul lei gam hi.
Ngilh ni umlo nau bang ka kap,
Lalpa Na gam ngai in;
Suihlung guol in tuol a leng ui,
Lal nunnem chawian in.
Ei ngailo in gam nuom ah a leng ui,
Nunghei lo ma tieng a sawn ui;
Simlei hi nungsawn gam a hi,
Pak lai sun ni a liem suihlung a hel.
A hun hung tung ding chu ka ngaklah ie,
Nunnawp pielgal ei pui kai ding;
Kikhen lo in lungtuok te tawh,
Kumsawt pak tan in Lalpen chawian kau.
Sinsak sawmlenih te, Isu’n a sap haw chu-
Peter Andrew Jakob, a suohpih Johan,
Phillip Thomas Matthai, Jakob Alphai chapa,
Thaddai Simon Juda leh Bartholomai.
Eile ei sam hi, eile ei sam hi;
A sinsakte I hiu nang na hi keile;
Eile ei sam hi, eile ei sam hi,
A sinsakte I hiu, A na sem dingin.
Ralngama
Adam suon gitloh thihna thim nuoi ahin,
Namtin naubang kap in a mau ui;
Kei banga albang dah vannuoi ah umlo,
Ka tuoi dawng lungdeih paklai a chul tai.
Ngaiin Zuomang sau lunlai gal in ka dawn,
Albang dah, naubang kah leh lenpul thawk umlo;
Lungdeih I khen Zuomang kawm tungsa ten,
Nawpna Lalpa limbang a bel ui.
Sabang ka tat ding dan ka gel sau ngam puoi,
Bang ka tita dem ka thavai hi,
Naubang kah ei nem ding sietlei ah umlo,
Zuomang nunnem, nawpna pak Nang lo ngal,
Buoina huihpi lungkhamna kinawk lak ah,
Ka thil nung lama hung nga ta puou;
Hehpihna Lal ngabang lenna Zion tang,
Zuon in kahlai puon bangin bang tan au.
Keile ka hinkhuo beih a, tha ka kiek tieng,
Lalna gam ninnuom ah leng tang ka;
Lungdeih I khensau lai ah vabang buol in,
Belam No liem thuoksa zailan awi ka.
Sanghnuna
Nuoi simlei kumsawt gam a ting puoi,
Lungkhama naubang kahna maw Lalpa?
Nunnawpna’n sang muolpi a liem,
Lawpna pak a tuoi.
Aw ka galdawt thangvan sang khu,
Angel lenna gam lopi achun;
Tatsaten chawlhna galmuong ah,
“Khawvel beimai ta hen” a tiu.
Aw ka ngai paktin lunna gamnuom,
Chullo ding Lal nunnem vangkhuo sat thak,
Ei kai - in, naubang ei puiin,
Kaplai ei nemin.
Belam No gam Zion ka tun tieng,
Guol lungtuok gibang khenna ngai puong ie
Lungsiet khawpi namtin chitin,
Nunnawp kimna ah.

songs.title: I hinnau Lalpen chuh I na he puou in

lines: Doh is B8 Tune S.S. 675 - T.S. 251
I hinnau Lalpen chuh I na he puou in,
Tuhin muh di’n a um hi;
I Pau kumkhuo a I hawl uh I he puou,
A hihnuok in I kikhawm.
Hung tau uo! Hung tau uo!
Amah minin kikhawm hitiu;
Sak, Thang, Sim leh Mal, hung tau uo!
Van hinna an um dingin.
Belam, guolin Lal kawm apat I taimang,
Gitloh hamling in ei nang;
Ei vengpa’n puih kit dingin ei sam zing hi,
Lunghei in, pakin zuon leng.
I pi leh I pu chana I deih penuh,
Ei hawlin A hung tung tai;
Zieziekchun pakchai tiu, ei Tanpa pha chuh,
Vangsakna guoh hung zu hen.

songs.title: Na gitlohna lui ah hun puo’n

lines: Sam 36:9
Doh is F S.S. 352 - T.S. 167
Na gitlohna lui ah hun puo’n,
Na lungkham gikpuok cheng tawh;
Tui achun thuk takin phumin,
Ziechun zankhaih na mu’n la.
Kin meng inla! banga na ngak?
Vaigeih ziekin na tha manthai sak ki’n;
Isun hukdam di’n A hun ngak,
Zahngaihna’n A hun chiel hi.
Na hihbang in lui ah hung in,
Isu’n nang A hun ngak hi;
Na gitloh sandup bang mahleu,
Vuk bangin hung vam un au.
Hukdampa thugen zie ahi,
Lunghei a, taksangte chuh;
Kuole Amah taksang nuom chun,
A khuta hinna mun au.
Na damna di’n luiah hungin,
Lungmuon, thugen Aw ngaiin;
Migilo khat kisik vangin,
Van Angel a kipak ui.
C.Z. Huala
Ka ngaina e Lalgam lopi,
Siemthak leia hung lang ding chu,
Kumsang vaihawm ding nilopi,
Lenkawl chu tun hung engin.
Gam lopi ka kumsawt gam,
A ngaiin ka lieng taluoi;
Gam lopi ka kumsawt gam,
A ngaiin ka lieng taluoi.
A cham sawt ngei ka Lal gamtiem,
Gam luoh thu la ding thangvan ah,
Ngaiin zaila’n pak bang chawi ka,
Lei Zion a ngui zo tai.
Sietlei lalte kawmah Lalpa,
Ka lungkhamna ka genthei puoi;
Mi chengcheng te kawmah Lalpa,
Ka hun ngaih ka gen thei puoi.
Ka hun ngai ie ka Lal nunnem,
Na thawkna ngilhni nei puong ie,
Na lautha’n hinna lenkawl eng,
Nuomah nau bang ei pui in.
Rev. K. Thuomngel
Mel muh phak loh van Jerusalem thak,
Angel leh Zuo Minlun laituol lenna;
Tik leh lei gimna taihsan in ka tung dem,
Thangvan khawlun Lalpa vangkhaw sat thak?
Nuoi simlei gamthipa ka len lai hin,
Vangkhaw lunlai ngaiin ka mau;
Mu bang ka ngaih vangkhaw nuom chu,
Tik leh thuongte ka tung dei mawh?
Lalpa ngaia nau bang kahna gam hi,
Albang mang hen lungkhamna nuoi simlei
Albang dahna mei zing nuoi a hin Lalpa
Na sakmel kipahum ei muhsak in.
Lungkhamna dahna dawn bang ka tuok nin
Lungkham puong ie Minlun Lal vangin
“Lau kin, ngaiin hun veng zing ingka” A tii.
Ei hehpihna tawngka nemtak mai chun
Thihna Jordan luipi ka kan ding tieng,
Lalpan a khut lopi’n ei pui in tin,
Lung lau loa Jordan luipi ka kan tieng,
Lalpa vangkhaw thakah ngabang leng ka.
V.T. Kappu
Mu bang ka ngai, kumsawt gam nuom,
Leh Suongmantam khawpi hawih tak sip zum chu
Nisa sangin a vak zawi a tiu
Muh ka nuom ngei Lalpa saulun
Van mite lenna.
Van In nuom zawtna tuonglam chu,
A sika kensie ziekin bei man ka lau,
Gitloh nan puon bang ei tuom ziekin,
Silhpuon bang chan ding ka lau ngei
Van gam tuol nuom chu.
Lalpa, Na lautha puih loh in,
Sietlei mi na van gam nuom tung theilo ding
Lau tha al bang manna gam ahi
Nang hun gingte chungah Lalpa;
Suolin thimthu lel.
Galzo te Zuomang gam nuomah
Sunni sanga vakzawn laituol leng un au,
Nuoi simlei lungzinna leh buoina
Nunnawp nan pak thing bang lun ding
Lo bang chullo ding.
Len ka nuom van gam tuol nuomah.
Kumsawta I chawlhna ding chu a hawih ngei;
Lalpa siem Salem Vangkhuo nuomah,
Laituol nga bangin leng leu hing;
Ninnawp kim tana.
Thanher
A thanuoi dailim nuoi achun,
Tatsate kichawl dam tan au;
A maua kumsawt guo bang hinna,
A chantieng uh-kipak tan au.
Cheng untin kichawldam tan au,
Lungsietna Lalpa chawian in;
Kumsawt ninnuom laituol leng tan au,
A thanuoi dailim nuoma chun.
A thanuoi dailim nuom achun,
Alang dah sawl-ang bang tan au;
Hinna damtui a nga bang buolin,
Vuk sangin le vam zaw tan au.
A thanuoi dailim nuom achun,
Kah leh lungdawnna umta lo;
Gitloh huihpi leh thepna gal lien,
A bei tai khawpi nuom achun.
Gam ninnuom a laituol lengte,
Nuoi simlei lungngaihna pel in:
Van kingkang gihawih tawh van tuolnuom,
A lengui Lal Krista lawiin.
Lienrum
Ni tum ngeilo Zion khawpi,
Ngaia tauin sun tin nau bang ka kap;
Tatsa te puon lopi silhin leng ui,
Kei di’n mun a um dem zie gam achun?
Mu bang ka ngai, mu bang ka ngai,
A mun lopi a hawihna cheng sangin;
Lungsietpa Lal Krista mel deihum chu,
Muh ka nuom lungkham sawl bang banna di’n.
A hawih zie gen senloh gam khu,
Thisan in A hawng tai zalenna gam;
Ka thagau zie gam ngei chu en zingin,
Nuoi simlei hi pak bang tuoi ding ahi.
Lungdeih Hukdampa tuollenna,
Tun theih loh ding ka lau ie Lal Isu;
Thisan in ei silin, Thagau in ei puiin,
Lal nunnem gam nuom mu bang ka ngai ie.
Rova
Van Lal nunnem Immanuel gamnuom,
Ngaiin ka mau ka thil sun nitin in;
Sietlei pakbang tuoi tienga ka chen nang,
Aw ka gel chim thei puoi gamlun ding chu.
Kumsawt gam ding ka gelin,
Sietlei pakbang a tuoi kal ka ngaklah;
Gam thiengtho tun kal ka ngaklah,
Phamsate tawh laituol I lenna ding.
Simlei ah albang vaiin kap mah leng,
Van lal nunnem kawm hung tung ngei ing ting
Naubang kah luonthi ei nul sakin tin,
Naubang nuiin gamnuom tuol leng tang ka.
Lungkham sawl-ang ban na dingla um lo,
Nuoi simlei hi lungkham nan a dim hi;
Naubang ei puiin kumsawt pielgal ah,
Naubang ka kah sawlbang in bang tang ie.
Pielgal gamnuom hawih thuong ka tun tieng leh
Ka Lal nunnem in eina pawm intin
Damna siktui thiengin ei sil intin,
Kumsawt guobang hinna chu chang tang ka.
V.T. Kappu
Ginnan vankhuo galin ka dawn,
Khawvel gimum thuok zote chu,
Naubang nui siusieu in ka mui,
A kipahnau zaila gihawih,
Ka lunggil ah daibang a cham,
Gam nuom tunkal ka ngaklah ie.
Ei hun enin van Lal thiengtho,
Mi lungsiet um leh hatlo hi;
Zinmang in henkawl ei buh hi,
Na gam hung tun nuom mahleng le,
Thimna leh lungkhamna haw hin,
Sunni chengin ei bawm.
Ngaklah manin tung thei puong ie,
Tih lunggila ka gel phat leh;
Lungkham in naubang ka kap hi,
Tun kal ka ngaklah ziek ahi,
Lalpa, Na gam thiengtho tak chu,
Ngaia kapin zailan ka awi.
Awla bangkim ka gel gelin,
Albang ka vaih dan ka kihei;
Ka kah khawsawtna ding chauh in;
Kaplai naubanga nuihna ding,
Nuoi simlei ah mu zo puong ie,
Ka hun ngai lothei puoi Lalpa
Kaplai naubang nui thei puong ie,
Lalpa, nei hung puih mahin chuh,
Ka lungkham vanah bei tan a,
Ka umdan khuo’n a lel ma chun,
Van gam tunkal ngaklah mah leng,
Lalpa hung tung thei puong ie maw ?
Nuoi simlei gimum ahin le,
Lalpa naubang a nei puih chun;
Bangdin albang in ka vai dem?
Nei umpih hi tih ka hetin,
Kaplai hi naubang a nui in,
Nuoi simlei gimum a chawmsak.
Doh is G S.S. 823 - T.S. 181
Hungun Lalpa hehpih
Te’n kipah la sau un;
Lung kiguolin la sau unla, (2)
Lalchutphah kimvel un. (2)
Zion lam zuon I hiu,
Khawpi hawih, Khawpi hawih tak;
Chunglam Zion zuon I hiu ui,
Pathien khawpi hawih tak mai chuh.
Pathien he ngeilo te’n,
La sakding niel mahleu;
Van Lalpen chate haw vang chun (2)
Kipahna la sai tiu (2)
Zion tang chun thil ki -
Pah um tampi ei tun;
Van gam tuol I tun mau inle (2)
Sana tuol len ma’n le (2)
Kipahna la sai tiu,
Luonthi cheng le hul hen;
Immanuel gam zuon I hiu (2)
Chunglam khawvel nuom zaw (2)
Sawikhawlien
Gam lungsietum gam hi,
A chungah ka lenga;
Gitloh leh lungkhamna haw hin,
Ni chengin ei bawm hi.
Aw, bei mai in (2)
Khawvel gimum gam hi;
Guolphahaw leh ka Hukdampa,
Ngaia nichenga ka mauna.
Ka ngai kumsawt gam nuom,
Lalpa Zion khawpi;
Khawvel hi a nawpna pumin,
A mang zel a nawpna.
Ka ngai ka Pa gam khu,
Kikhen a um ta puoi;
Mi thiengtho leh Angel vam haw,
Ni chenga a lennau.
Gam lopi ka tun tieng,
Ka vaihna lei gam hi;
Ngaiin thil ta puong ka Lalpa,
Na mel hawih ka muh tieng.

songs.title: Chanchin Pha thu gi chuh ngai un

lines: Chanchin Pha thu gi chuh ngai un,
Krista’n thing ah A thuok tai;
Zahngaihna lui chuh a pung tai,
Hehpihna’n a luong zak tai,
Migilo, liengvai, (3) nang dinga thi chuh en in. (2)
Aw zie tang achun va chieh in,
Tuni’n hinna chuh mu’n la;
Krista’n A hun chiel hi lui ah,
Na gitloh cheng sawp thieng di’n,
Uoi-ai-ki’n la nang, (3) aphat laiin hung mai in. (2)
Hehpihna lui a luong zing hi,
Sang tam takin a chang tau;
Tuhin le a thak bang ahi,
Hukdampa naka put chuh,
Beimang ki’n la aw, (3) nang di’n Krista a thi tai. (2)
Krista chuh I lawi hung hin tin,
Van akhun kituok hitiu;
Chun van tuipi a kisil in,
Ei Tanpa lungsietna ah,
A hauhsakna leh (3) A lal zie chuh mu tai tiu. (2)

songs.title: Isu sapna aw chuh ngai un

lines: Matt. 11:28
Isu sapna aw chuh ngai un,
Nanghaw migilo hungun;
Chawlhna leh muonna hun pieng ka,
“Hungin, nanga ding ahi,”
A hukdamna chuh (3) nei dingin tuhin hungin. (2)
I chung thangvan sangtak akhun,
Um mahleh A hun sam hi;
Ginna’n A aw gi I he thei,
“Nangu migilo hungun”
A hukdamna chuh, (3) tuhin neiin kipak in. (2)
Sapna aw gi hai pai ta’n tin,
Tuhin chuh A hun sam hi;
Migilo sapna chuh ngaiin,
Thisan hinna lam zuonin,
A hukdamna chuh, (3) tuhin neiin kipak in. (2)
Isu kawm mai achun mu’n la,
Hinna nanga ding tum chuh;
Sesum leh dak-go khi lo a,
Pathien thilthawn piek ahi,
A hukdamna chuh, (3) tuhin neiin kipak in. (2)

songs.title: Thusim Lui chuh ei hilh in

lines: Doh is C S.S. 1181 - T.S. 179
Thusim Lui chuh ei hilh in,
Chunglam muhloh thusim;
Isu leh A lopina thu,
Leh A hehpihna thu;
Het nuom takin ei hilh in,
Naupangte hilh bangin;
Hatlo, gimthei, panpih bei,
Gitloh a nin ka hi.
Phuonzak ding
Thusim Lui chuh ei hilh in, (2)
Thusim Lui chuh ei hilh in,
Isu hehpihna thu.
Thusim Lui chuh ei hilh in,
Ka lak theihna dingin;
Tatna maktak chanchin leh,
Pathien ngaihdamna thu;
Thusim chuh ei hilh zingin,
“Zing tunga daichim” kai;
Suna a hung hul bangin,
Ka hengilh vak ngala.
Aw nem hieucha’n ei hilh in,
Guntak, tihtakzet in;
Gilo ka hi hezing in!
Isu, hukdam ka ngai;
Thusim chu ei hilh zingin,
Lungkham, lungzin laia;
Bangtik ale kei dinga,
Lungmuonpa chu Na hi.
Thusim Lui chuh ei hilh in,
Khawvel lopina hi;
Kei di’n bangmah lo ahi,
Tih haksa ka sak tieng;
Ahi, khawvel lopina’n,
Ka thagau a thep tieng
Thusim Lui chuh ei hilhin,
Krista hih damna thu.

songs.title: Aw suohpih na gen tam, Lalpa ngaihdam zie?

lines: Doh is A8 S.S. 898 - T.S. 178
Aw suohpih na gen tam, Lalpa ngaihdam zie?
A vela na genna chuh kiza sawn hen;
Kross’ a A thihna ah Hukdam di’n na hung,
Avela na genna chu kiza sawn hen;
A vak nuom achn tuhin na leng em?
Gitloh nin cheng apat na thieng em?
Suna na nawpna zana na la ahim?
A vela na genna chu kiza sawn hen.
Na genna chuh kizasawn hen,
Genin, genin, gen sawn in;
Thusim ngaihnawp um chuh genin,
Hun panpih ina, lopi di’n,
A vela na genna chuh kiza sawn hen.
Na sepgimna ah Hukdampa a um em?
A vela na genna chuh kiza sawn hen;
Isu’n zainem takin A hun enkawl em?
A vela na genna chuh kiza sawn hen;
Sepgim, natna a nang hun panpih thei,
Amah bang guol dang muzo puon la;
Nang dinga A thilbawl khawvel in heu hen,
A vela na genna chuh kiza sawn hen.
Thu deihum chuh na lei in agen ngei em?
A vela na genna chuh kiza sawn hen;
Thildang cheng sanga lunggil kipak sak zaw,
A vela na genna chuh kiza sawn hen;
Khawvel mi lunggil natna’n a dim ui,
A chawlhna hawl uh a thawn ahi;
Thu leh la’n Isu chu amau hetsak in,
A vela na genna chuh kiza sawn hen.
Na galdona haw a na zawhna haw chuh,
A vela na genna chuh kizawn hen;
Ziechun galdo tung mite panpih ina,
A vela na genna chuh kiza sawn hen;
Gitloh sepaihte tawh I kido ui,
Hukdampa, Krista tawh vaihawm ding;
Lalpa tatdawk te’n thagau mang mat guou in,
A vela na genna chuh kiza sawn hen.
Rev. Mangdal
Mim bang pienna nuoi simlei ah,
Melma dogal siel ang a lien;
Sanggah keia ding tumin,
Van nuoi thimpi a zing ie.
Aw van Lal chungnung pen
Ka limbelh Lal nunnem
Felna ni vak tuoi lo, Zion Lal
Ka lampi thim hun salhvak in
Lam bang etchim loh ngaih minsel
Chun leh zuo ngaihpan a sam ie
Zuomang chung Pathien ang lai,
Sihsiel ang na zuon ta maw?
Ngaih ding dieng, na nung sul ahin
Sung In giel tui bangin a dai
Kuongtap la mei a val lo
Dahluot huiva bang ka mau.
Khen lohna chatuon khawpi ah
Ngilhloh cheng tuoi loin laileng
Hin tuoilo nawp kipan ding
Chatuon lal, limbelh ang ah
Zingdawng Sawl No suoh ka ngaklah
Tatsa tui bang luongkhawm ta ding
Lalpa’n tui bang ei gawp tieng
Dah cheng sawl ang bang tang ie.
Zion kawlni, hung suok mengin
Melma dogal cheng tawmna di’n
Salem Lal Thimthu lel tieng
Lei do cheng dah muolsuok ding.
Thangngur
Lei hi a ngui zo tai
A chunga mihiem haw tawh
Gitlohna leh gimtheih na’n a dim zo
I mi ngaihum hawu leh,
Guolpha a chieh zotau.
Aw Belam nunnem in,
Gam thak, A va bawl chu;
Aw, ka thagau nang le
Zie gam nuom chu hawl in
Khawvel pawtsan tienga
Na umna mun dingin
Dikna gam a zo tau
Aw, kumsawt gam lun ding chu
Lei gimum hi albang in mang mahleh,
Lal Krista na gin chun
Gam thak ah leng inla.
Ma a pi leh pute’n
A muh phak loh uh gam chu,
Thisan zalin ken ka na mu ta ie,
A zawtna lampi chu
Lal Krista hi ahi.

songs.title: Pathien lopi hen thil lopi A hih a

lines: Job. 5:9
K.J.C. Redemption Songs 7
W.H. Doane
Key A8 - T.S. 182
Pathien lopi hen thil lopi A hih a,
Khawvel A hehpih a, A Chapa ei pie’i;
Gitloh khuhna ding in A hinna A pie’i,
Micheng lut theih na’n Hinna Lampi a hawng.
Lalpa chuh! Pakchau un!
Lei in A aw za hen;
Lalpa chuh! Pakchau un!
Mihingte kipak hen,
Chapa Isu min in Pa kiengah hungun!
Lopina pieu in, thil lopi A hih tai.
A thih na’n tatna bukim ei siem sak tai,
A gingcha cheng kienga Pathien in A tiem;
Migilo pen inle Amah a gin chun,
Zie hun laitak chun Isu’n A ngaidam hi.
Thil lopite ei sinsaka, ei hilh tai,
A Chapa Isu ziek’ I kipahna sa’ng!
Thiengtho zaw, sangzaw dinga khangto zel di’n,
Isu I muh tieng maksak na’n dim hitiu.
Sam 89:1
Doh is E8 S.S. 73 - T.S. 177
Mihing Hukdampa mak leh lopi,
Thusim ngaihnawp a um na e!
Migilo dinga Thipa thu chuh-
Gen ingting, gen zel zel ingka.
Aw, thusim mak, thusim mak tak chuh!
A kigen kha laka hawihpen;
Lopi takin vel gen ka,
Thusim mak tak mai chuh,
A mel hawihna ka muh tieng leh.
Lopina mun apat A hung a,
A thisan lul A hung pie tai;
Kumsawt tatna chuh A hung siem tai,
Ei Hukdampa A lopi ngei!
A zahngaihna luipi banga luong,
A hehpih teh theihloh manbei;
A lungsietna kumsawt a kiting,
Kei nasan ei hung hukhing tai.

songs.title: Tatsa ka hih genzak nuom ka sai

lines: Doh is A8 E.C. Humnal 408
Tatsa ka hih genzak nuom ka sai,
Belam No thisan a tatsa;
Zahngaihna tawp neilo-in ei tan,
A cha ka hi, kumsawt chanin.
Tatsa, tatsa,
Belam No thisan a tatsa;
Tatsa, tatsa,
A cha ka hi, kumsawt chanin.
Tatsa, Isu-ah ka nun nuom hi,
Nawpna, pakna, ka gen zo puoi;
Ama’n kumsawt chanin ei umpih,
A mun vak ah umzing ing ka.
Ei Tanpa nun nuom ka ngaihtuoh a,
Sunni tumin ka ngaihtuoh hi;
Thip mai thei ka hih tak loh ziekin,
Kumkhuo’n hehpihna la’n ka sai.
Dan leh ka kipahna Lalpen chuh,
Lopina mun achun mu’ng ka;
Hehpihna’n ka kalsuon cheng A pu’i,
Zan khawthim ale la ei piei.
Lienrum
Ka vakvaih na gam thip gamdai hi chu,
Dah a um nalawm lawm sek na e!
Khenna ni leh dak atung hi,
Ka guol leh ka pai ngaih haw hi.
Ana na e maw! Aw ka Lal nunnem,
Thagau thiengtho in hung inla;
Na hungtun kal ka ngak lah ui,
Ka gam uh lungsiet um sungah.
Zie malgam tangpi thavai chung ahin,
Na tha zakin Lal Immanuel;
Tatsa dawng ngikngiek hawcha hi,
Aw ka Lal nunnem hung entan.
Tuonna ei suonte Evi leh Adam
Lalpa’n a guot Eden huon thiengah,
Eden huon hawih tuola lenglai
Aw ka Lal nunnem na chan maw!
Aw Lalpa Pathien leh thagau thienglim
Eden hehpihna huih a nun lai hin
Thisan paktan a lenghaw chung,
Thepna meipi hun hawk kieng ta’n.

songs.title: Gamla taka awilo thim laka cheng te

lines: Doh is A S.S. 1090 - T.S. 184
Gamla taka awilo thim laka cheng te,
Thagau simsen louh mang den thei ding haw;
Kuoa chieh ding hukdamna thu gen dingin?
Isu lam ena bang cheng thuok ngap di’n?
“Thuneihna cheng cheng piek Ka hi!
Thuneihna cheng cheng piek Ka hi!
Gam tinah chieh unla Chanchin Pha thu gen un,
Ngai un tel zel ingka” A tii.
En un, khawvel kawt kihawng ah chiel na hiu,
Krista sepaihte tho unla lut un;
Kristiente halh un, theihtawp in pangkhawm un,
Chanchin Pha’n gitloh hatkawl tan sak un!
“Bang dinga halh lo?” Pathien aw chun a tii,
Bang dinga halh lo? tih thu gensawn un;
Thil lauhum na’h hukdam di’n Isu a thii,
Hinna, hukdamna thu chuh phuong zak un.
Namtin in, Pathien chuh lopi hen ti a,
Guol zawhna la sak ding phat a nai tai;
Tatsate hukdamna achun kipak un,
Hallelujah, Lalpen ti’n kiko ding.

songs.title: Thusim chu gen ka nuom hi

lines: Sam 66:6
Doh is A8 S.S. 43 - T.S. 180
Thusim chu gen ka nuom hi,
Muh loh chunglam thusim; Isu leh A lopi zie,
Leh A hehpihna thu!
Thusim chuh gen ka nuom hi,
A dik ka het ziekin;
Ka utna a hih bukim,
Thildang hih theih loh chuh.
Thusim chuh gen ka nuom hi!
Ka thupi pen chuh hina;
Thusim lui tak gen ding chuh,
Isu hehpihna thu!
Thusim chuh gen ka nuom hi,
Mak deuh deuha lang chuh; thildang ngaihtuohna cheng sang,
Leh zanmang sang inle;
Thusim chuh gen ka nuom hi,
Kei dinga pha pen chuh;
Aziek chuh ziechu ahi,
Tu’n nang ka hun hilh chuh.
Thusim chuh gen ka nuom hi!
Gen kit zel a nuom hi! ka gen chengin hawih deuh deuh,
Mak deuh deuh in alang;
Thusim chuh gen ka nuom hi,
Mi kimkhat zak ngei loh;
Hukdamna thu chuh ahi,
Pathien Thu Thieng apat.
Thusim chuh gen ka nuom hi,
A phat zie hete di’n; gilkiel, dangchak thuok laia,
Chawlhna nuom bang ahi;
Lopina mun ka tun tieng,
La THAK chuh sa’ng ka ting;
Ziechuh THUSIM LUI hina,
Ka deih mah mah zing chuh!
Sam 43:3
Doh is G S.S. 1085 - T.S. 291
Salhvak in, Aw Salhvak mengin,
Gam gamla tak chan inle;
Tanpa deihum tak min ziekin,
Hukdamna kim thu tunin.
Salhvak in, Aw Salhvak mengin,
Tuilien khel tuikuol chanin;
Thusim maktak chuh hetsak in,
Hehpih, lungsiet manbei chuh!
Zan thim lungkham na a thagau,
Thi dingte chuh hetsak in;
Kinin, kinin a niu abei,
Phat kintak in abei zel.
Salhvak in Lalpa’n thu ei piei,
A thu Thiengtho ngaihtuoh un;
“A tawp chanin hun umpih ka,
Ka Chanchin Pha gen un ti’n”.

songs.title: Lunggil ngui hihhalh ding a um

lines: Doh is A S.S. 802 - T.S. 175
Lunggil ngui hihhalh ding a um,
Nite a beih zel lai hin;
Thagau mangthai ding a tam ie,
Nite a beih zel lai hin,
I tup gam I zawt lai in;
Kipak zing zing thei leuhing;
Aw, thilpha bawl chiet hitiu,
Nite a beih zel lai hin.
A bei zel! A bei zel!
Nite chuh, A bei zel!
Aw, thilpha bawl chiet hitiu,
Nite a beih zel lai hin.
Mawk ummai na ding phat umlo,
Nite a beih zel lai hin;
Na mel zingkhuo bangin vak hen,
Nite a beih zel lai hin;
Khawvel tauna’n a dim hi,
Lungkham leh kahna’n adim;
Na suohpih puk phawng dingin.
Nite a beih zel lai hin!
Hehpihna guiin ei kan khawm,
Nite abeih zel lai hin;
Khat khatin I kinusie zel,
Nite a beih zel lai hin!
Mahleh chi pha I tuh hawu,
A sa leh liep a khang ding;
I lunggil hih nuom zing ding,
Nite a beih zel lai hin!
Upa Rokunga
Doh is E
Ma khan Eden huon thiengtho
Mun hawih leh nuom taka khan
Ei suonte Evi leh Adamte chu
Chung Pathien guot bang zelin
Nupan tuok khat hung suokin pumkhata siem a hiu
Lawptak in kipahpih hitiu
I suohpih teu nupan hi
Pathien in vangpie hen la veng bit zel hen
A khawvel damlai niu a beih masieh in.
Chunga Pathien samsuih in
Pumkhat in a kisiem ui
Lal ma ah khenloh thimthu kitiem ui
Tichun Pa deih lam guolin
Dah leh nawpsak lai in le a thutiem uh det hen
Lalpa ka hun vawpsak ui
Ka suohpih teu nupan hi
Damlai go lul vangsakna hun pien la
Amau di’n ni bang vakin
A damlai niu a tum tieng leh Na kawmah puiin.
Upa Rokunga
