Siempa Pathien in lei danin,
Ma a Ana siem chu;
Pasal changa um phal loin,
Panpih ding A siem tai.
Lawpin chawian hitiu,
Kichenna thiengtho hi,
Khen loh thim thu a tiem u hi,
Nangma’n vang hun pien la.
Lungkham leh buoina a thawk un,
Nangman thawkpih zelin;
A chung u ah ni bang vakin,
Vangsakna’n hun vukin.
Na min loin thu a tiem tau
Nangman na hetpih in;
Khenlohna khut a suih u hi,
Kanin, hehpih gui in.
Rev. Thuomngeil
Ei suonteu kawma chung Pathien A thuguot chu,
Nupan leh pumkhat a hung uma;
A suonteu sietlei chung luoh dima,
Ganhing leh thilsiem chunga leng chang di’n;
Chungnunna chu A pie tai.
Aw, Lalpa panpih in a thutiem uh nit di’n,
Chawnban kiluoia a thutiem uh;
Vang hun pien la, chang bang damin,
A sietlei hinkhuou gui bang sau hen.
A thutiem uh nit din lunggil dik tak hun pien la,
Kihehpih a ki-enkawl tuoh di’n;
Phungbang vukin, vawn zatam chawi din,
Damsunga Lal nasema kimang di’n,
Nang vawp inla pui zelin.
Chung Pathien min loa, kitiem in a kigawm tau,
Sam gi bang kikhen kit talo din;
A nuom a haka kipanpih di’n,
A kithutiem nau suguitung dingin,
Lal Pathien in umsak hen.
Zie kichenna hi Lalpa Nangin hetpih inla,
Krista leh Sapchuom etsak dik di’n,
Na min lopina hung hi hen la,
Sietlei hinkhuo beihman A chung u ah,
Chung sunni bangin vakin.

songs.title: Kipah Aw gi chuh I zau

lines: Doh is G S.S. 1079 - T.S. 192
Kipah Aw gi chuh I zau,
Isu’n a hukdam hi!
A thu gam tinah gen un,
Isu’n a hukdam hi!
Gamtin ah A thu puou in,
Lamto leh tuilien gal ah!
Pang un! Lal thupiek ahi,
Isu’n A hukdam hi!
Tui kinawk mahleh gen un,
Isu’n A hukdam hi!
Gilote kawmah gen un;
Isu’n A hukdam hi!
Tuikuol gamte’n la sau un,
Tuisuohgiet in gensawn hen;
Leichung kipak zing ta’n a,
Isu’n A hukdam hi!
Sepgim, dahna ah lasau,
Isu’n A hukdam hi!
A thih leh hin tawp loin,
Isu’n A hukdam hi!
Lungkham lai inle sau in,
Lunggil panpih ngaih lai in;
Than nuoisieh in zawh lasau,
Isu’n A hukdam hi!
Huihnung inle phuongzak hen,
Isu’n A hukdam hi!
Nam tin tuhin kipak hen,
Isu’n A hukdam hi!
Hukdamna manbei phuongun,
Tuipi chung leh gamtin ah;
I guolzawhna lau zie hi,
Isu’n A hukdam hi!

songs.title: Bang ka bawl die Lalpa tuni’n?

lines: R.C. Paddock Tune : III Alexander 165
Doh is A8
Bang ka bawl die Lalpa tuni’n?
Na Chanchin Pha thu phuong dingin;
Tuipi khela mite hilh din,
Hinna thak Nanga kimu chuh?
Lalpa, tunin ei pui zelin,
Kal khata masuon zel dingin;
Thil tamzaw diek bawl thei dingin,
Lalpa ei pui in ka zawh ma’n.
Lalpa, khupdin in paucham ka,
Tuni a Na thu gente dingin;
Gamdanga chengte a dingin,
Thagau mangten a hun pawm na’n.
Ka thilneih ka hun piei Lalpa,
Mite’n Na thu a het na’ng un;
Midangte’n le Na thu ngai hen,
Kei banga tat ahih na’ng un.
Lalpa, chieh ingting, gen ingka,
Gitloh thima chengte kiengah;
Krista gilote dinga thi,
Micheng dinga khetden a um.
Upa Rokunga
Doh is A flat
Lalpa, Na vangsakna lopi
Tuhin ka chang kit tau
Ka khut tawmuh vang Na pie a
Temple hawih Na In sak na’n.
Lalpa Jeho Na min lopina ding
Na thagau Thiengtho in ei hung luohpih in
Na In thiengtho hung hi hen la,
Hung chengin Nang di’n ka pieu.
Aw nanga dinga semgim te’n
Kipahman chang u nau
Tu a patin kumsawt chanin
A kipahnau sang ina.
Lalpa zie In lopi ahin
Thupha ka hun chawih un
Na ngaihdamna Aw hawih tak chun
Ei dawngin. Na In ahin
Thagau chau di’n chawlhna In nuom
Van guol a vakna ah
Gilkiel, dangchakte lut unau,
Kumsawt kipahna mun au.
Luke 23:33
Doh is E8
Ei puihna chengah zui ingka,
Amah muon dan chuh ka hetai;
Kei ading ahi, ka hechien,
Amah A thii Kalvari-ah.
Sun leh zanin Isu’n ei pui,
Ama’n lamtawn in ei pui ding;
Kei dinga Guol dik pen ahi,
Kalvari ka hezing zing hi.
A thupiek haw ka kipahpih,
A khuta ei puih ka nuom hi;
A deihlam kei dingin a phai,
Kalvari-ah thi’n A thiensak.
Lung lau loin ka chieh zel hi,
Hukdampa a nai, nuom ka sai;
Nikhat tei Amah chuh mu’ng ka,
Kalvari Isu chuh ka Guol.
Sawngkhawkai
Chunga Lautha hung leng inla,
Mi tin lunggilah hung chengin
Ka khutsuok uh In tawm nuoi ah,
Kumkhuon Lautha’n hung chengin
Aw hung chengin
Lung gilo dawngkawt hawng kit in la
Lopina Lalpa
Mitin lunggil ah hung chengin
Lei mihing khutsuok tawm tak
Na Temple in hung chansak in la
Mi tin lunggil ah hung cheng in.
Kuom bang luoh ding sau-In tawm
Na In thiengtho hung hi hen la
Tuona gamdai lengvan lummei
Lautha’n vabang hung buolin
Lalpa Na vangsakna lopi
Lawpin tunin ka chang kit tau
Ka thilbawl uh ka thilpiek teu
Na lopina hung hi hen.
Doh is B T. Khuma
Aw Lal Pathien Na kawmah kipah thu ka gen ui,
Na lungsietna’n nei na enkawl in nei pui khawm hi;
Thisan zieka unau mun tin, gamtina mite,
Na min pakcha leh chawian dingin ka kikhawm ui.
Ka kikhawppi nau hi (2)
Aw Lalpa nangin vang hun pien la,
Na min lopina dingin;
Na Thagau Thiengtho in ei pawl zingin.
Ka vaihawmteu hi Nangin hun panpih zing inla,
Na gam let na’nga kitup taka vaihawm dingin;
Amau leh a lawiteu chung ale chingthei taka,
Vaihawm dingin chitna leh lemhet na’n hun thuomin.
Thagau a dingin vangsakna ka muhna dingun,
Na chanchin Pha gente Nangin hun panpih inla;
Hinna thak, hatna thak, kipahna thak mu dingin,
Aw nang ngeiin Na chanchin Pha hun phuongin ka tiu.
Aw Lalpa, Pathien ka ngetnau Na kawm tung henla,
Na mina hung kikhawm na lungsiet-Na mite hin;
Ka hatnau, ka thiemnau ka hun pieu na gam letna,
Dingin Na vangpieknan ei hun vukin, Aw Lalpa.
Hun tui bangin a luong zinga,
I khawvel damlai niteu le;
Ngak neilo-in sunni chengin muol a liem zel,
Khawvel nunnawp albang mang zel;
Hawlin ni chengin ka uma,
Muong ta kiu un, suohpihte haw,
Tawpna ni a nai tai
Khawvel ahin nawpna hawlin,
Sang tampi thanmuol ah liem zel;
Mahleh nawpna mu leh neite, nei den um lo,
“Muonna, bitna,” a tih lai un;
A tawpnau phat hungtung intin,
Muong ta kiu un suohpihte haw,
Tawpna ni a nai tai.
Aw hung tiemu u-leh-naute,
Hukdamna thu hung ngaithau in;
I Lalpau hehpih Aw nem in A hun sam hi.
Na hun kikhelhsak sak ta ki’n,
Na chan ding chu ka ngai ngam puoi,
Muong ta kiu un, suohpihte haw,
Tawpna ni a nai tai.
Thihna’n zawh lah a nei puoha,
Natna’n le lauh a nei diek puoi;
Gawtmun inle kuomah gawt zawhloh a nei puoi,

Muong ta kiu un, guol-le-paite,
Tawpnan hun huom khan a.

Tune:S.S 976
Nunnawpna hun kum deihum
Zamuol na liem ding chu
Suihlung khuombang ka gelin
Suihlung na suhel ngei
Sim lei namtin vawn chawihte
Nunnuoma ka lennau
Zamuolpi na liem ding chu
Aw ka hun phal puou
Na vangletna zal zoin
Nunnuom in ka leng ui
Thiemna, chitna, nek leh chak

Chung Pathien phatna zalin
Seino guol haw cheng tawh,
Chang bang dama nunuom in
Na sung ka leng ui.
Kumsul vei, aw nang hun pha,
Khangthak guolte pienna;
Chung Pathien vangsakna thil,
Go deihum ka chan nau,
Za muolpi na liem ding chu.
Bangma’n nang thei puontin;
Chang bang damin chieh ta’n la,
Zal mangpha manin.
Vankhama
Doh is A flat
I hinkhuou leh ninnuom puon bang chulsa,
Pak bang tuoiin sangmuol a liem zo tai;
Mu bang ngaiin nau bang kap mahleng le,
Lenthang kumkhuo zatam in ei hal tai.
Muikhuo zina chung sawl tha vak nuoia,
Theisen lawm guol nau bang kilawp lai kha;
Zamuol liemin chung thangvan tuol nuom ah,
Hai bang ei ngak, ngaih lenpul do mah leng.
Hun leh phat kum sang a hung beih tieng leh,
Zuo min lun sietlei leh thangvan Siempa’n;
Hinkhuo ninnuoma lenpul I do hih,
Tuoi theilo in puon bang ei vuk ina.
Ka hun pakchau lenthang kumkhuo kihei,
Khanno guol di’n vangphatna hung hi’n la;
Zatam ma lo tui bangin hung nem hen,
Kumsul veisa thavang ngailo dingin.
Kum lui mangta ni leh tha kum kihei ta,
Tuzing kumthak ni no a hungsuok;
Khum zawl apat hungtho dawkun taisieu in,
Kipak in lawm hitiu, ni no hungsuok hi.
Hung un, hung un, Lalpa chawian hitiu.
A lungsiet hengilh ding kuo ahim?
Kum tunga damtaka ei vengpa ahi,
Kumsawt kumsawt in Amin lopi zing hen.
Hinkhuo tawpa chieh masa I ngaih teu chu,
Tuni’n van gam nuomah a leng ui;
Bang di’n lei ah amau puldo ding I him?
Kum tunga ei vengpa Pathien chawian un.
Kipahna thu leh sepgah chawiin hung un,
Tuni’n Pathien a hung vang pie di’n:
Hukdampa’n na chanchin na phuon a deih hi,
Kum tunga mawhna phuongin suol haihsan ta’n.
Kum lui thai ting kum thak lawpna’n lasai tiu,
Na bawn un Inkuon in hungtel un;
Dan leh Pa vangpiek na cha’nte kisik ding,
Kipak in lawp hitiu, Pa leh Hukdam pa.
Lal Krista Hukdampa Lalpen,
Chawian zing hitiu mi tin in;
Kipaka kikhawm kit dingin,
A lungsietnan ei na hukdam hi.
Chawian zing hitiu I Lalpen chu,
A ven bitna zieka damin;
Kikhen pihsa guol ngaihhaw tawh
Kipak takin I ki mukit tau.
Krista mina suohpih ngaihte,
Na meluh muh ka kinem ui;
Nei lamtuohnau welcome phung leh,
Khuong pi gitin ka lung a hel ie.
Nei na lamtuohnau la hawih hin,
I chung thangvan khu le thawng hen;
Leisiet mi leh van mi thiengte’n,
Lalpa pakna’n la sa khawm u hen.
Zie guol chun ni tawpni tieng leh,
Ei lamtuoh hen van Angelte’n;
Thagau Thieng hung leng hen tunin;
I lunggil nguisau hung hihhalh hen.
Mit muh phak loh gam apatin
Tun ka mu tai ka guol ngaihte,
Pathien chawihatna ni hi hen,
A min thieng lopi zing hen, Amen.
Chawian hitiu Lalmang chungnungpen chu
A lungsietnan ei na huoia
Thih leh natna apatin ei hukdam a,
Dam takin I kimuhtuoh kit chiet tau ui
Aw chawian hitiu, I Hukdampau chu
Sim leh mal, sak leh thanga kikhensa;
Kipakin I kimu kit ui, Lalpa minin
A paknan Aw gi hen, Hallelujah. !
Ka hun lamtuoh ui zie welcome phung ahin;
Ka changlam un ka hun sang ui
Krista chamna leh lungmuonna chang chiet un
Kipah nunnawp ni hi hen Krista minin.
Kipah nawpna halhna thakin leng kit hen
Lunggil leh thagau nguisa le
I chennau thingtang leh I sau gawngsa le
Lal Krista chawian din no kit hen tuni’n.

songs.title: Kross lam zuonin ka hung hi

lines: Doh is G S.S. 477 - T.S. 197
Kross lam zuonin ka hung hi,
Chagah, hatlo mitduk hi;
Thildang chengcheng ka nusie’i,
Hukdamna kim chuh mu’ng ka.
Lalpa, Nang ka hun ging hi,
Kalvari Belam No chuh;
Na Kross ma-ah ka khun hi,
Tun ei hukdam in, Isu.
Ka lunggil in a hun hawl,
Gitlohna’n sawttak ei vawp;
Zainem in Isu’n a gen,
“Na gitloh cheng hihthieng ka.”
Ka neih cheng Nang ka hun pie’i,
Ka guol, ka phat, ka neih cheng;
Ka tha, sapum, leh bangcheng,
Kumsawt a Nanga dingin.
Isu’n ka lung A luoh dim,
Amah ah ka bukim hi;
Amah-ah damna ka mu’i,
Belam No chuh lopi hen.
Lalpa ka hun ging zing hi,
Kalvari Belam No chuh;
Na Kross ma ah ka khun hi,
Tu’n Isu’n ei hukdam tai.
Lianvela
Alang dahna lenvui a kai,
Simlei gamdai ah;
Lalpa mina guol lungtuok te,
Khenna kawlni a suok.
Gibang khen zo puong ie (2)
Aw ka len-guol ngaihte,
Lalpa, Na Lautha hung lengin,
Sun naubang ei nemin.
Sun leh zanin ninnawp zai lan,
Na min ka pak ui;
Gibang khenna lenkawl a eng,
Albang dahnan ei bawm.
Na sakmin chem bang chawian kau,
Lautha ninnawp na’n;
Na lungsiet lenvui kai nuoiah,
Van mi nun ka sin ui.
Gibang kikhen mah leu ungle,
Lautha ei puiin;
Lungkham lenpul khuombang do hi,
Naubang ei hung nemin.
Hun leh ni lenkawl a liem
Lungtuok gibang khennan
Albang dahna meipi’n ei bawm,
Gibang khenlohna gam ka ngai
Lal nunnem vang khawpi thak nuom
Aw, lungtuokte, kikhen tai tiu
Damtakin zal mangpha
Pathien galvan bukim lau inla
Nuoi zinmang dogal zo zel dingin
Albang dah luonthi nula
Lungdeih gi bang khente
Khaubang chieh lai veng zelin la
Thepna dogal hung lien mahleh
Lalpa Nangin mapui zelin
Zion thimthu sut dingin
I lennau dang mahleh
Hinna lenkawl enna munah
Mi thiengtho leh Angel te tawh
Kumsawt laituol ah leng taitiu.
Rome 13:11
Doh is D S.S. 154
Aw, ka thagau, tho in;
Na gitloh nungsawn in;
Tatna thisan lul chu,
Keia di’n a luong tai,
Kei di’n Lal ang achun A ding,
Ka min chu A khut ah a chuong. (2)
Chunglam ah A um zing,
Kei ei gensak dingin;
Hehpih a ei tatna,
A thisan lun ahi;
A thisan in gitloh khuhmang,
Zahngaihna chutphah ma a theh. (2)
Liemna mun nga A thuok,
Kalvari tang chungah;
Ziechun A paucham a,
Kei a dinga ngenin,
“Ngaidam inla, Aw ngaidam in,”
Gilo tatsa thih phal ki’n ti’n. (2)
Pathien tawh ka kicham,
A ngaihdam Aw ka za’i;
A cha di’n ei nei tai,
Lau kit ngei ta puong ka,
Lunggil muonna neiin ka naih,
“Abba, He pa, He pa! ti in. (2)
Kamlala
Dam sungin I Tanpau vangin,
Nunnuom in kikhawm mah leu hing;
Kapin I kikhen kit sek ui,
Aw ka ngai khenlohna gam nuom.
Hukdampa vangkhuo sat thakah,
Simlei a gibang kikhen te;
Kumsawt Lalchutphah kimvel in,
Aw bangtik leh I kikhawm dem ?
Ngo bang a lang Kalvari ah,
Galdawt leng khenlohna gam chu;
Nga bang lenna tang dang mahleh
Ginnan laituol lengkhawm hitiu.
Theibang lo leng Lalpa sakmin,
Thawmhau liengvai ei nem dingin
Naubang ei nem ding a um puoi
Sam tui bang tawm simlei nunnawp.
Nuoi simlei ahin le Ama’n
A lungsietna tha lim nuoiah
Nunnawp laituol lengkhawm kit di’n
Chang bang damin ei pui khawm ding.

songs.title: La ka nei hi sak ka nuom hi

lines: Doh is G Redemption Songs 379
La ka nei hi sak ka nuom hi,
Tat ka hih tak ziekin;
Tanpa, Hukdampa Lalpen la,
Tat ka hih tak ziekin.
Tat ka hih tak ziekin, (2)
A min chuh suong zing ingka;
Tat ka hih tak ziekin,
Hukdampa min chuh suong zing ingka
Lungawihna Krista chuh ka nei,
Tat ka hih tak ziekin;
A deih bawl kipahman sang pen,
Tat ka hih tak ziekin.
Hehpih vak leh thieng tak ka nei,
Tat ka hih tak ziekin;
Ginlah leh lauhna a nawhmang,
Tat ka hih tak ziekin.
Kipahna gentheih loh ka nei,
Tat ka hih tak ziekin;
A thisan leh dikna vangin,
Tat ka hih tak ziekin.
Kei dinga guotsa In ka nei,
Tat ka hih tak ziekin;
Ziechun kumsawt in cheng ta’ng ka,
Tat ka hih tak ziekin.
Lienvela
Khawvel ahin lungkham chate,
Sak, Thang, Sim leh Mala;
Kimuh ni hin Lalpa Isu ei lawp in la,
Lung kiguola na hehpihna chu gel khawmin;
Khawvel kahna cheng hih mangin.
Na Thagauin ei hih dimin,
Khawvel kah lai haiin;
Hun lawp ungkau Aw Na hehpihte hin,
Ma khan a hun deih puou;
Aw lopi takin hung leng ta’n.
Ka hilh ka gen chim theihloh te,
Na vanga lengkhawm in;
Kalah thimthu a gen u maw Na thisan in,
Muol tin leh tang tin gam tin apat hung khawmte;
Aw leng inla pawl thiengtho in.
Zie lei hi vang lungkham kahna,
Munin guot mah leh chin;
Thagau Thiengtho lopi leh vangsakna lul chu,
Mitin din pawm tak leh lunggil phatna hi hen;
Aw Thagau Thiengtho hun pie’n la.
Aw Lal Isu, thawmhau takin,
Keihaw ei umsak kin;
Aw Nang vanga ngaih cheng len-guol a hung kim hin,
Kumsawt a khawvel pak hawihna nunghei sanin;
Mitin lunggil sungah chengin.
Leisiet guol ngaih gi bang kikhenna din.
Kawlah ni a suok kit tai zal mangpha (2)
Nuoi simlei ahin lungmuonna umlo
Lungngaihna meipi’n ei bawm ki ging un (2)
Ni khat nawpna zai... la sa mah leu hing
Pak thing lun a muol bang in, a muol hi (2)
Gi bang kikhen ding nuoi simlei a ngui
Lunghelna khawvui a kai, chieh tauin. (2)
Chung thangvan kikhen umlohna gamah,
Luontui bang kigawm naitiu, dam takin. (2)

songs.title: Zan hung tung ina, sem un

lines: Joh. 9:4
Doh is F S.S. 778
Zan hung tung ina, sem un,
Zingkal in sem pan un;
Zing dai laka le sem un,
Zing pakcha lakah;
Ni san tieng inle sem un,
Sun hun inle sem un;
Zan hung tung ina sem un,
Chawlh phat a tun man.
Zan hung tung ina, sem un,
Nisa pi nuoi ale;
Phat cheng nasep nan mangun,
Chawlh phat hi pai ding;
Mitphet kal a hun chieh zel,
Thilpha khawl nan mangun;
Zan hung tung ina, sem un,
Na sep theih lai un.
Zan hung tung in, na sem un,
Nisa tum nung inle;
Khawvak a um lai chanin,
Semun, a beih man;
Vak kit ngei talo dinga,
Khawvak beih man sem un;
Zan hun tung ina, sem un,
Na sep zawh ma cheng.

songs.title: Zingkal kipatin zaidamna chi tuh in

lines: Doh is C S.S. 757 - T.S. 201
Zingkal kipatin zaidamna chi tuh in,
Sun hun ale tuh in, nitak lam geiin;
Buh min phat ding leh alak phat ding chu ngakin,
Lawptakin chieh hitiu, I buhphal chawiin!
* I buhphal chawiin! I buhphal chawiin!
Lawp takin chieh hitiu, I buhphal chawiin! (2)
Nisa nuoia tuh in, a lima le tuh in,
Mei zing leh phalbi huihvawt khawksa loin;
Dan leh lakkhawm phat leh, I sep I zawh tiengleh,
Lawp takin chieh hitiu, I buhphal chawiin.
Kap kawma chiehin Lalpa di’n chipha tuh un,
Lungkham, lungzinna hung tung zing mahlele;
Lungkhamna a beih tieng aman ei lawp intin,
Lawp takin chieh hitiu, I buhphal chawiin!

songs.title: Chieh in, na hun chengin semin

lines: Matt. 21:28
Doh is E8 S.S. 815 - T.S. 202
Chieh in, na hun chengin semin,
* Kipahnan Pa deih guol semin;
Ziechuh Lalpa Lampi ahi,
Nangin ziechuh hawh lo ding maw? (2)
Chieh in, semin a hun nai puoi,
* Manna chuh van lepna ahi;
Mihing in a hun demziek un,
Pathien hun dem ding gingcha ki’n. (2)
Chieh in, semin, sep phat ahi,
* Na lunggil sung hih kipak din;
A hepihnan a hun pakchai,
Na sepgimna chuh thawn puona. (2)
Chieh in, a phat laiin sem in,
* Khawvel buoina a hung lien ie;
Thatdahna paih in sem mengin,
Thagau hukdamna hung hina. (2)
Na kawma thimah mi a thiu,
* Thih lungmuonna la nei loin;
Meisel la’n la de vak zingin,
Thimna pen le vaksak ina. (2)
Sem zelin, chau loin vengin,
* Chingthei in mangthai pui dingin;
Khawvel muntin ah chieh unla,
Vakmangte chuh pui lut hamun (2)
Kipak takin na chuh semin,
* Sepgim chuh chawlhna nuom ahi;
Moneipa Aw he pai tan la,
Ngaiin “Hung ding ka hi” A tii. (2)
Doh is F S.S. 290 - T.S. 230
Chawlhdamna gam ngaiin ka mau,
Bangtik leh ka tung dem?
Bangtik leh ka galthuom kawih in,
Muong takin ka um dem?
Lal na chuh sem hitiu,
Isu hung kit macheng;
Lalna chuh sem hitiu,
A In a umkhawm ding.
Lei chungah kipahna umlo,
Lungmuonna la umlo;
Khawvel hi ka In ahi puoi,
Dahna gamgaw ahi.
Chawldam di’n Krista kawm ka zuon,
Vakmang talo ding leh;
A ang sung bel dingin ei hilh,
Van Ina ei puih man.
Hukdampa kawm chuh ka zuon tai,
Vakmang talo ding in;
Thihna lui ei kaihpih intin,
Ka van In chuh tung ka.

songs.title: Sem hitiu! sem hitiu! Pathien suokte I hiu

lines: Matt. 21:28
Doh is F S.S. 751
Sem hitiu! sem hitiu! Pathien suokte I hiu,
I Lalpau nungzuiin A sep bang sem hitiu;
A thilhih theihna’n I hatnau hihthak zel ding,
Sep ding i neih chenguh, theihtawp in sem hitiu.
Sem hitiu! Sem hitiu!
Sem hitiu! Sem hitiu!
Kinema ngak zingin,
Lalpa hung masieh, sem hitiu.
Sem hitiu! sem hitiu! gilkielte an piei tiu,
Hinna tuikhuk achun chaute chuh puih hiu hen!
Kross leh a puonlap chuh I suonpen uh hi hen,
“Hukdamna manbei” ti a I phuon lai u hin.
Sem hitiu! sem hitiu! sep ding I nei chiet ui,
Thimna lalgam leh gitlohna chu tawm un au;
Lalpa Jehovah min chuh chawihsan hung hintin,
“Hukdamna manbei” ti’n chawihat la sak hina.
Sem hitiu! sem hitiu! Lalpa hatna mangin,
Lalpuon leh lallukhuk kipahman in mui tiu;
Mi ginumte In a chuh I chen tieng u leh,
“Hukdamna manbei” ti’n tatte tawh la sai tiu.
Thangneikhup
Ka kum sawt In ding lem tang ka ie,
Kumsawt suongpi Krista chunga lem in;
A hun laiin theihtawp in sang ka,
Ka umna lei hi hung bei pai tana.
Kumsawt hinna In det Krista chu ka neita ie,
Damlai huihpi leh tuipi hung kinawk mahleh;
Krista zalin ei chuppha ta puona.
Aw enviel tie gamlui khawvel hi.
Lungngaihna leh natna’n a dim zo tai;
A chung ah lungmuonna um ta lo,
Sietna huihpi a kinawk tak ziekin.
Aw sietna tuipi a hung lien tai,
Zion chaten Insang lemto tai tiu;
Thagau thiengtho hinna’n kithuom in,
Hinna sangpen Insang chungnung ahii.

songs.title: Khawiah a um um, buh lakhawm dingte?

lines: Matt. 13:30
Doh is G S.S. 749 - T.S. 204
Khawiah a um um, buh lakhawm dingte?
Gitlohna lo a buh phal lakhawm ding?
Thutak kawite manga sep ding ahi,
Buh at zaw ma’n kuomah chawl thei puon a.
Khawi ah buh atte, kuo a hung ding?
Buh at zawh tieng lopina chuh chang dingin;
Kuo a ei huh ding, lakhawm dingin,
Gitlohna lo a buh pha um haw chu?
Mun tinah chieh unla, a va hawlkhawm un,
Ham sang mahleh buh chuh mu zel unla;
Muntin hawl unla, kaht le hengilh kiu,
Van Ina di’n a bawnin lakhawm un.
Buh amin tai, gamtin, muntin a um,
Tu’n khawvel in buh lakphat ding a ngak;
Buh at mi atawm, nasep ding atam,
A lak vak loh uleh, tampi mang ding.
Mihiem chate na kawiteu hun pan un,
Sana buhvui haw chu lakhawm dingin;
Lo neipa hung masang sieh in semun,
Tichun, vanah kipahna chang tan lau.

songs.title: Chi pha chuh tuh unla, zingkal khawvak tung apat in,

lines: (Home Mission Song)
Doh is B8 S.S. 1080
Chi pha chuh tuh unla, zingkal khawvak tung apat in,
Chi pha chuh tuh unla, sun nisat laiin;
Chi pha chuh tuh unla, mi lunggil sukipak zelin,
Chi pha chuh tuh unla, pha takin veng un.
Chi pha chuh tuh unla, Chi pha chuh tuh unla,
Gunchuh taka lungsiet khuta thehzak zelin;
Hinna changthak phelsuoh un,
Chanchin Pha tangko pih un,
Chi pha chuh tuh unla, khawvel gam tinah.
Chi pha chuh tuh unla, zingkal nisuoh tung apat in,
Chi pha chuh tuh unla, nitum nung inle;
Chi pha chuh tuh unla, ginglah lo leh lungawi takin,
Bang cheng Pathiena nga’n, Amah mai gingin.
Chi pha chuh tuh unla, kipumpiek na diktak neiin,
Chi pha chuh tuh unla, sana buh chi chu;
Chi pha chuh tuh unla, kichawl a mawkum mai lo in,
Nisa leh guohtui pie di’n Pathien ngen un.
Lienrum
Kum sang vaihawm ni hung naiin,
Kei banga liengthei albang vaite’n;
Thilsiem tincheng leh lei Sapchuomte hin,
Ngaiin ka thil ui, Isu hung naiin,
Lalpa, hungkum in, ka hun ngai ui,
Salem Zion tang lopi Lalpa;
Chun-leh-zuo leh phungguol a chieh zo tau,
Aw, ka Lal nunnem ka lu hung lieh in.
Phamsa ngai in ka kap, Lalpa
Khawvel Aigupta gamah ka vai;
Lalpa na vangsakna lul ka chan hi
Pak bang lawp manlo in muol a liem ie.
Phamsa ngai ka kah lai hinle,
Lili pak tat sate a lennau;
Ginna’n thangvan khu ka vak gal thila,
Lungdeih te lenna Zion tang a lang.
Ka ngai Jerusalem Zion,
Thiemgau, martar thisan a tatte;
Phamsa thokit leh ka lungtup gam khu,
Muh ka nuom ngei Aw lungdeih a kimnau.
Sam 37:7
Doh is C S.S. 710 - T.S. 207
Aw sepgim leh buoina khelah,
Chawlte di’n In nuomtak a um;
Kithenna um ngeiloh na In,
Kuo a chawl nuomlo ding ziechun?
Aw ngak hamin, phunchiek lohiel in!
Aw ngak hamin, phunchiek lohiel in;
Aw ngak hamin, ngakham in, phun loin!
Na puokgik in chau mahleh chin,
Khawvel thilin hun delh mahleh;
Dakin! chawlhna nuom tung inla,
Ngak hamin, phunchiek dah maiin.
Na lampi-ah ling um mahleh,
Aw Lalpa lu chuh ngaihtuoh in;
Na lunggil hih-lungkham mahleh,
Mi thiengtho zaw bawn a sun tai.
Gim mahleh chinle sem zelin,
Paucham bangmah hengilh loin;
Na chawlh nang ni anai ta ie,
Ngak hamin, phunchiek lohiel in!
Matt. 9:37
Doh is A8 S.S. 1086
Kawl kimvela buh umte chuh,
Lakkhawm phat a hung hitai;
Mun gam la leh anai ale,
A bawnin a min zotai.
Lalpa, buh at ding hun sawlin!
Ka hun ngetnau hi ngaiin;
Buhphal lakhawm ding hun sawlin,
Lakkhawm phat a kikhelh ma’n.
Zingkal tung leh sun lai inle,
Nisa tum ding kuon inle;
Mun tina buh lakhawm dingin,
Nasem ding mi sawldawk in.
Kinmeng in, buh kuoi ding ei tai,
Sana buhvui lakhawm in;
Atawpa van In na zawt tieng,
Kipak takin tung inla.
Sam 23:2
Doh is A8 S.S. 501
Lal nunnem Belam Chingpa’n,
Van gam phaicham hing nuomah;
Hinna tui luonna mun ah ei pui ina,
Chawlhdamna In nuom taka;
Van hinna tui dawn dingin,
A hehpihna thu leh sapna chuh gingun.
Kumsawt hinna tui dam dii-diei,
Mi thiengte laituol lenna;
Lal nunnem Belam Chingpa-
Vanga suklat kipakum!
Salem tuolnuom kumsawt hin kiemlo.
Lungkham, lungzinna beita,
Thihna, lusun na umlo;
Hinna thingnuoi dailim nuom takmai achun,
Hinna khawvak zam vel ah;
Lal nunnempa chawian in,
Van go thil gihawih tawh laituol leng dingin.
Salem tuol nuoma lengte’n,
Nun khuonuom lambang pakin;
Lal nunnem leh zaidam chuh a chawian ui,
Minlun Lalmang vangkhuo chuh;
Sanggah nin-in nuom tan tin,
Pak bang lunin la’n bangin hei tan au ie.
Daniel 12:3
Doh is D S.S. 789 - T.S. 208
Ka hukdampa chuh tuok dingin,
Khut ngawna chieh ding ka him?
Nikhat bek A na semlo in,
Amah chawian ngeilo in?
Ka hukdampa chuh tuok dingin,
“Khut ngawna chieh ding ka him?”
Thagau khatcha le puilo in,
Khut ngawna chieh ding ka him?
Thih chuh dah in ka lungkham puoi,
Lalpa’n ei hukdam ziekin;
Mahleh khut ngawna ka tuok di’n,
Ei sudah in ka lungkham.
Kum ka mawk mat beihsa cheng kha,
Tun sapkit theih hileu Aw!
A na kipak taka sepna’n,
Hukdampa di’n mang ing ka.
Mithiengte, tho un gunchuh un,
Sun ahih pet hin sem un
Thihna zan thim a hung tun man,
Thagau man di’n sem hat un.
Thup. 21:3
Khawvel thihna gam himah leh;
Van chuh hinna gam ahi;
Khawvel kikhenna himah leh,
Van kituok khawmna ahi,
I ngaih, lungdeih te I khena,
Pham ngaia lu i su’n hin,
Van khawpi nuom gal dawn hiting,
Lungkham banna’n mang hitiu.
Nitin tungthak ana tuok ui
A kipahnau a pung zel;
Thih leh kikhen a lau ta puou,
Nawp tawplo ding a chang ui.
Melma huoi sie thihna lal in,
Sung tin naubang a kah sak;
Kingaisie chuom um diek puoi tiu,
Kuomah um dem ding um lo;
Pathien hinna siemtu khan le,
A Chapa lu a su’n kha,
Mahleh van khuo ei tun zaw a,
Guolpha’n ngai zaw mai hitiu,
I nu, I pa I guol ngaihte,
I u, I nau I chate;
Nupa’n le thihna’n a khen a,
Lungkham banna ding umlo,
Pathien Cha thihna zopa leh,
Thih lungmuonna neitu chu;
Bel in kulhpi’n mang hiting un,
Lungmuong takin um hitiu.
Runchawng
Ka lenna gamgaw taihsan in,
Van Jerusalem thak nuom ah;
Aw bangtikleh thuong ka tung dem ?
Na kumsawt Pielgal gamah,
Aw ka ngai gibang khen lohna gam nuomah,
Hinna tui a luong!
Hukdam chate’n a dawn ui,
Kumkhuo hinna chang ui.
Belam No lenna mun lopi.
Ngaiin ni chengin ka galdawt;
Aw thagau thiengtho hung lengin,
Na gam nuom thuong ei tunin.
Dawngkawt gi hawih chu ahawng ui,
A gi hawih in ka lung ei len;
Mi thiengthote tuollenna ah,
Aw keile len ka nuom hi.
Zie mun a chun ka Lal deihum,
A mel nisa vanglai bangin;
A vak haw chu a zam vel-a,
Kumkhuo a damna dingin.

songs.title: Kipaka van gam zuonten lasau, hun sawt mahleh

lines: Isai 36:10
Doh is F8 S.S. 821 - T.S. 223
Kipaka van gam zuonten lasau, hun sawt mahleh,
Ginna’n la ngaihnawp um san chunglam a khun ka um;
Ngaiin, vangsakna tangah, tang lopi-ah ka ding,
Jordan gal chuh ka etin, Lalpa gamtiem ka mui.
La ngaihnawpum sa zel un,
La chuh na sak cheng un;
Ka lung kipahna’n a dim,
Ka pak seng puoi, Lalpa!
Sau un, lawpa Van zuonte, leia I um lai un,
Van la leh Isu I nicheng kipahnau hi hen;
Thusim lui chuh lan sai tiu, ei tatdawkna la chuh,
Kumsawt lapawl chuh ahi, van gam chana ding chuh.
Sau-un lawpa van zuonte’n, a phat sawt ta puona,
Pathien gam nuom tun chanin van la go chuh sai tiu;
Guol deihte’n ei ngak zing ui luipang lehlam a khun,
Luigal achun tuok hitiu, tui kinawk beihna ah.
Thangngur
A bei sawt ngei ie maw,
I khawvel damlai niteu haw hih
Kipahna pak chul kit ding ei tau,
I kikhenna ding un,
Kawla nisa a hungsuok kittai,
Kikhen lohna gam ngaih a um ngei ie,
Kikhen lohna mi gen gam nuom achun,
Len-guol ngaih kimin chawl hitiu;
Ei vengpa Lal Krista,
I Hukdampau deihum keng bulah,
Lungkhamna bei tana.
Khawvela hin chu Aw,
Kap leh mauin alang vai mah leh
Buoina khela khun gam hawih a um,
I Hukdampau Krista,
Zuia I hinnau I phal uchun,
Zie gamhawih achun naubang nui hitiu.
Nawpna pak lunna mun,
Hukdampa Krista lenna mun chu,
Ngaiin nichengin ka gal thila,
Van Angel vamte leh-
Guol deih gibang i khensau haw tawh,
Bangtik leh nunnuom in i kikhawm dem?
I len-guol ngaih cheng tawh,
I Pau nasem hitiu kipakin,
Hun hi nicheng a liemzing ie,
Zingsawl Aksi vak hawih,
A hung latna ding phat a nai tai,
Nasep zoa i chawlhna ding niu chu.
Aw, ka Lal Hukdampa,
Ka kipahnau pakin hung lunin;
Khawvel nawpna pak atuoi-zo ie,
Na mel a hin chu aw-
Kipahna tincheng a lang khawm hi,
Kipahna pak Saron pak hawih-Na hi.

songs.title: Pathien suongun, damsung in nuoi zinmang galsat un

lines: Pathien suongun, damsung in nuoi zinmang galsat un,
Bang tikchan inle, dogal chuh lauhum mahlele;
Pathien in ei piek, galvan bukim chuh a um hi,
Dogal satna phuol achun ding zing hitiu.
Malam zuon hitiu, galthawm a dai hi,
Kiko chiet un, dogal tai in a;
Malam zuon hitiu, galthawm a dai hi,
Galzo in malam zuon un;
Ei puipa nungsul chuh zui zel hitiu,
Gal lakah, gal hat lakah;
Dogal satna phuol a chun ding zing hitiu.
Lungsietna, thienthona puonlap hi dawm zing leu hing,
Manthaina um puona; zie puonlap nuoi a chun;
Nuoizin gal hiem-leh-thal laka A lim belte di’n,
Dogal satna phuol achun ding zing hitiu.
Hungun, suihlung kiguolin Puipa di’n do hitiu,
Hukdampa muon um ei thutiem thudik chu pawm un;
Zawhna thutiem det, pel ngeilo thudik chuh ei tiem,
Dogal satna phuol achun ding zing hitiu.
Neh. 2:17ff
- K. Siema - T.S. 303
Lalpa leh Agam dingin,
Nasem dingin hung kisau;
Nasep a hun tai na gamsung ah,
Hung halhdawk inla, entie;
Na gamsung kulhpi a chim zotai,
Kihechien in enin.
“Hung halhdawk in, (3)
Kingaihtuoh in!” Lalpa’n A tii.
Nehemia Persia leng khawn pie’n,
A na pang ta-mahlele;
Jerusalem siet a het phetin,
A lungkham mah mah ta a;
A umna mun luite chuh nusie’n,
Siempha di’n a chieh tai.
Nungak, tangval, nupi, upa,
Na gamsung lungsiet lo maw?
Na kulhpi bang dettak maite chuh,
Setan in phie ding ahi;
Hung halhdawk inla, vak enviel tie,
Nehemia ngaihtuoh in.
Nehemia mi ginum tak chuh,
Sanballat leh Tobiah te’n;
Muhsit bawlin nuihsan mahleu le,
A lung adawng diek ngei puoi;
Mite’n hun musit ta mahleu le,
Kipakin sem__ z_e_li_n_._____

songs.title: Lal puonlap zak dinga piek I hitau ie

lines: Sam 60:4
Doh is B8 S.S. 675 - T.S. 211
Lal puonlap zak dinga piek I hitau ie,
Lalpen sepaihte kiengah;
Sepaih bangin tu’n puonlap chuh I zak ui,
Tatsate banga la sa’n.
Masuon un, Masuon un!
Krista’h bangkim channa’n ngai un;
Lalpen chawihat na’n la sau uo,
Kross puonlap lim nuoi achun.
Tui kinawk bangin melma lauhum mahleh,
I puonlap khaisang hitiu;
A lim nuoiah Lal sepaih I hih ziek un,
Thudik mang galzam puoi tiu.
Gam leh tuipi chung mihiem chenna cheng ah,
Chanchin Pha thu phuongzak un;
Lal thisan bek puonlap chanchin chuh genun,
Lalpen sepaihte I hiu.
Zing khawvak lopi hungtun nang a nai tai,
Nicheng in a nai deuh deuh;
Lalpen masang ah melma chuh tawm tan au,
Kross-in khawvel nuoisieh ding.
Lalpa gam ding lak guon khawvel ahin,
Kei chieh zelingka ka puokgik tawh;
Hun kilepsan hiel puongka Lal Isu;
Melma dogal lien mahleh.
Gospel hehpih in malam zuon ka, (2)
Ka Lal deihum min hawih hi panpih in,
Tai puongka khawvel ma ah.
A nasep sunzawm zel ding kuo a um?
Kei ei hun tel tai ka Lal Isu’n;
Lawp takin Lalpa na chu semzel ka,
Thih chana ginum dingin.
Malam ah kasep ding ei guotsak tai,
Gospel henailo te pui dingin;
Gitloh gallien chu kidopih zelin,
Ei puihna phawtah chieh ka.
Aw hehpihna, Aw hehpihna mak chun,
Ei sawldawk in khawigam himahleh;
Muonna umloh na gamthip ahin le,
Thim mahleh chieh zel ingka.

songs.title: Krista’n sepaih hangsan leh thudik A deih

lines: Doh is E8 Redemption Songs 205
Krista’n sepaih hangsan leh thudik A deih,
Galsatna phuol ah nang dingin mun a um;
Khawvel gitloh do in, malam nawh zel un,
Galzawh tieng van gam nawp kiemlo chang hitiu.
Pang un! Kross galmite haw,
Lung laulo in, gingcha zing un;
Pang un! Kross galmite haw,
Suong un Lalpa, A thu ngai un,
Galzawh masieh pang un!
Setan in ei nang, petmang dingin ei them,
Mahleh ei lungsietpa vangin zo hitiu;
Malai a galmi dang, galhatte haw chuh,
Gimtheihna cheng zo in gam nuom a tung tau.
Hansanna chuh suoh in malam nawh hitiu,
Isu en zingin, ngakin, ngen zing hitiu;
I puonlap pei hitiu “Krista namtin Lal”
Hossana sam leng Nuoizin gal zo tai tiu.
Doh is B8 Sawngkhawkhai
Ngai un, Lalpa Jehovah,
Sietlei dogal cheng Nuoisiehpa chu;
Khawvel gitloh thawihna di’n Amah thi -
San ngei chuh chawiin mun thiengtho A lut pih tai,
Zie mun thiengtho a nga bang lengte chun;
Kipahna la sa’n,
Lalchutphah ma a ding, namtin laka mite;
Pau tin laka mite leh thilhing lite chuh.
“Zuomang Lalchutphah a chu leh,
Belam No kawm achun;
Lopina um hen” tiin.
Aw, lei chung cheng cheng in le,
Belam No gal zawhna la chuh sa’n;
Kum khawsawta I do zawh ngei loh uh,
Nuoi zinmang galhatpa tui bangin a tawm tai;
Galzawhna lopi Belam No thisan,
Zawhna lopi chuh;
Chawian in la sai tiu, nuoi zinmang nuoisieh na’n,
Lei mhiemte cheng cheng leh thilsiem cheng chengin.
Ngai un I van khawpi a van -
Mi thiengtho nga bang lengsate chun;
Belam No nunnem zawhna la hawih chuh -
Sa’n kipakin sun leh zanin a chawl ngei puou;
Van kingkang gihawih, van phaiphuleng gi-
Hawih chitin chengin;
Zawhna tumbak chawite hinna puon thieng silhte,
Lalchutphah kimvel a chawihatna la hawih chuh.
Khawvel lopina leh hawihna I hawllai hin,
Lungdawnna, lungzinnan ei tuomvel;
Mahleh kinepnan eihun zuon zelin atii,
Zie khawvel ahin thamuonna ding ka mu puoi.
Thamuonna leh nawpna neitu I Lal Isu’n,
“Ka kawmah hung unla hung zilun atii;
Ka namkawl anuoma ka puokle a zang hi,
Na thagau adingin chawlhdamna hun piengka.”
Khawvel duhamna chu milim hona ahi,
Dangka ngaihnat gitloh bul ahi;
Khawvel lopina, hauhna, gitloh nawpna te,
A tawpna chu kumsawt Gawtmun meidil ahi.
Ka thilin khawvel lopina azam viel ie,
A hawihna haw pak bangin alun;
Ka Hukdampa phatna leh a mel a lieh zo,
Aw Isu na mel hawihtak chu eimuh sakin.
Ka hun zuon hi Lalpa nangmai nawpna na hi,
Chawlhdamna leh puokgik kei dawntu;
Ka mu ta ie! damna, leh muonna, Lal Isu,
Kumsawt in kipahna pak bang lun zing tan a.
Tune: S.S. 1085
Lalpa thilhih theih leh hatna,
Muonga semdi’n kuon hitiu;
Sana buh lak ding a tama,
Sem dinga kuon ding umlo.
Hung unla, semdi’n kuon hitiu,
Hun a tawm vaigei ei tai;
Sana buhvui mantam haw chu,
Lalpa hatna’n khawm hitiu.
Nausen leh damlo gim bangin,
A umnau gam a he puou;
A hinnau a muolliem ma hin,
Hintui a thawn in dawn hen.
Hung unla, semdi’n kisa’i tiu,
Lalpa’n ei sawlna mun ah;
“Chungleng va leh gamsate ma’n,
Chieh meng un” Lalpan A tii.
Exodus 32:26
Doh is C S.S. 792
Kuo a Lalpa lam pang?
Kuon Lalna sem ding?
Mi dang hukdam dingin,
Kuo a panpih ding?
Khawvel nawpna nusien,
Kuoa galdo ding?
Kuo a Lalpa lam pang?
Amah di’n kuon ding?
Zainem in nei sama,
Nei lungsiet ziekin.
Lalpa di’n ka pang ui,
Nanga ka hiu ui.
Lopina chawihatna,
Mai lungtup lo in;
Sepaih In I pang ui,
Zawhna La sa di’n;
Mite hinna dinga,
A thih tak ziekin;
Isu min samta chuh,
A lam pang hin au,
Na hehpihnan ei sawl,
Nei lungsiet ziekin.
Isu, Nang in nei chawi,
Sana leh sum lo’n;
Na hinna thisan in,
Nang hun chawian di’n;
Na kawma hung cheng chuh,
Vangsakna’n na thuom;
Nang nei suthalawp a,
Nei suohchak sak tai;
Nei tatna lopi leh,
Nei lungsiet ziekin.
Kidona lauhum in,
Melma hat mahleh;
Lalpen sepaihte chuh,
Kuoman zo puona;
A puonlap nuoi achun,
Gal zo ngeingei ding;
A thu zuou ngeilo chun,
Zawhna thu ei tiem;
Lawp takin ka pang ui,
Nei lungsiet ziekin.
Sepgim lungkham buoina kinawk laka hin,
I Lalpa Pathien in ei pui zel;
Pa thutiem Ni lopi chu a hungtung tai,
Saltangte pawtdawkna ni lopi.
Chanchinpha deihum chieh zel inla,
Gamthim dang a saltangte pui di’n.
Ma a pilehpu te’n zie ni lopi hi,
Mu nuomin ana thil zing mahleu;
Mulo in thangvan sang a kaizo tau ie,
Van zawhna lopi chu chang dingin.
Aw damna, damna Gospel lengviel inla,
Kawl kimvel tiengin va leng inla;
Gimtheite nawpna, vakvaite di’n In nuom,
Na pak gimlim namtin damna din.
Aw nam chengcheng leh thilsiem tin cheng tenle,
Lalpa lopi pakcha’n Aw suoh un;
Kalvari hehpihna mak tak mai ziek in,
Ei uh di’n damna lui a luong tai.
Kisazo un gingtutehaw a kikhelh man,
I hinnau hi phat chawmcha a ding mai a hi;
Khawvel lopi leh a hawihna cheng chengte hi,
A matiema hung tuoi ngei ding a hiu.
I umnau lei In hi kiphie mahleh,
Vana In nuom zaw I nei ui;
Zietak ahin khaw mun det I nei puoh ngal un,
Khuo hungum ding chu I hawl zawu ahi.
Na neih leh lam na vangsakna cheng cheng te hi,
Kiletsak leh kilekna’n mang khapalh khan la;
Khawvel ahin bangmah I lutpih ngal puou a,
Bangmah pawt dawk pih diek lo ding I hiu.
Aw liengvai, Lalpa Aw nemin a hun sam hi,
Pathien in zie khawvel thila gimthei te hi;
Ginna a hausa ding leh Amah hehpihte,
Kawma a tiem gam chu chang ngei dingin.
Khawvel ahin haksa takin I um zing ui,
Galdawt hitiu thagau chawlhna mun det lam chuh;
Lungkhamna leh buoina gam hi I khelhtieng leh,
Lalpa kawmah I nawpnau kim tan a.

songs.title: Thepna achun lut kin, gitlohna ahi

lines: Thup. 2:7
Doh is B8 S.S. 698 - T.S. 234
Thepna achun lut kin, gitlohna ahi,
Na zawhnan zozel din hun panpih ina;
Hang takin do zelin, thim hatna zoin,
Isu lam en zingin, hunpui zel ina.
Hukdampa panpih ngen in,
Lungmuon, hihhat, hun veng di’n;
Ama’n A hun panpih nuom,
Nang hun pui zel ina.
Guol gilo nusie’n la, pau phalo mang ki’n,
Pathien min zah inla, mawka suoh lo in;
Lungnem, phachuom ngaiin lungthim dik takin,
Isu lam en zingin, hun pui zel ina.
Pathien in guol zote Lallukhuk piena,
Gin vangin zo hitiu, puk sek mahleu hing;
I Hukdampau in hatna thak ei piena,
Isu lam en zingin, hun pui zel ina.

songs.title: “Lalpa hatna leh A thilhih theihna mang un!

lines: Doh is G S.S. 686 - T.S. 221
“Lalpa hatna leh A thilhih theihna mang un!
A thu dik achun dettak in ding un”
Kidona phuol lauhum ah bittak in hun pui ina,
Lalpa minin na galteu zo unla.
Ding detun, thudik di’n,
Lal thupiek zawpa guolzo zel di’n;
Lalpa lopina dingin A thu a guolzo dingin,
Lalpa hatna achun ding det un!
Lalpa hatna leh A thilhih theihna mang un!
Dogal lau a kinunghei ngeilo di’n;
Thudik na panpih u chun na kawmah ding zing ina,
Amah hatna mangin masuon zel un.
Lalpa hatna leh A thilhih theihna mang un!
A thutiem haw zuou ngeilo ding ahi;
Na khut changlam chuh tu’n a thudik na panpih sungcheng,
Amah na gin chun gal zo zel inla.

Isu I “Bangcheng” hi ngala.
“Pathien I lama A pan chun,

Lalpa ah hat un, A theihna kipak un,

A thu ging un A thutiem a thawn ngei puoi,
Krista achun ahi, Amen;

Mi deihloh chanpih in;

Lopina ni ahung nai tai,
Lalpen sepai_h_te_ d_i_’_n._____
Cham ka’ng lo sel lal ahi tai,

Zie guol chun tel chuom te hawle,

Hung un, gel un phat chieh dan hi,

Gam hung tung ding kinem in,
Ngak zing hitiu kisazo diem in.

songs.title: Kross sepaih a pang ka hi nam?

lines: I Tim. 6:16
Doh is D S.S. 672 - T.S. 215
Kross sepaih a pang ka hi nam?
Belam No nung zuiin?
Amah ziekin ka thuok ngam nam?
A min ka phuong na dem?
Min achun Min lun ahi,
Ka sika thi pa chuh;
Lungsiet na’n lal lukhuk chang di’n,
Bangcheng thuok zel ingka.
Mi dangte’n kipahman sang di’n,
Theihtawp in a do ui;
Kei tawilo a mawk a um hi,
Van a puih ka hi dem?
Ka tuok ding gal umlo ahim,
Galdo lo ding ka him?
Khawvel gilo ka guol ahim,
Pathien kawm ei tun ding?
Galdo ka, vaihawm ka guot chun,
Lalpa, ei hihhat in;
Sem ing ting gimna thuok ngap ka,
Na Thu a ding zing in.
Gilo in mang mahleng,
Midang ka tel diek puoi;
Ka hinna pen ka na hepuoi,
Lalpa ei ngaidam in.
Na zah ngaihna gingin,
Na ang sung ka hun zuon;
Na lungsiet ban tuchan,
Na ngaihdamna ka hun ngen hi,
Lalpa ei ngaidam in.
Bang zat a tam ahim?
Bang chana thuk ahim?
Ka suol zungzam ka suiseng puoi,
Lalpa ei ngaidam in.

Kuo dinga thi ahim?
Ka gitloh nen silthienna di’n,
Krista thisan a luong,
Ka tha... chau a chawl tai,

A lopi na ding e;
Na hukdamna mun galmuong ah,

Thangvan sang leh khawvel cheng a hin,
A hawih pen na min ka hukdampa;
Ei nemding umlo sakmin haw cheng lak ah,
Nang lo chu ka Lal leh hukdampa.
Aw Isu na min a hawih diek hi,
La sa’n chawian ka ka thih geiin;
Kei dinga Lul pen na Chanchin pha hi,
Ka thamuonna pen leh kipahna.
Aw Isu ka Lal leh hukdampa,
A mak na e nei hehpihna chu;
Bang ziekin ahim kei migilo pen di’n,
Na hung thih tak le Van lal Chapa ?
Lalpa Isu na Chanchin pha hii
Ka lunggil ah hung cheng zing ta hen;
Nicheng ka hinna nang din pak gimlim in,
Hungsuok ta hen tin ka hun pie tai.
Kumsawt hinna lultak ka nei tai,
Zie khawvel zawha ngamna chu!

Zie hun laitak chun Isu’n A ngaidam hi.
Thil lopite ei sinsaka, ei hilh tai,
A Chapa Isu ziek’ I kipahna sa’ng!
Thiengtho zaw, sangzaw dinga khangto zel di’n,
Isu I muh tieng maksak na’n dim hitiu.
Sam 89:1
Doh is E8
Mihing Hukdampa mak leh lopi,
Thusim ngaihnawp a um na e!
Migilo dinga Thipa thu chuh-
Gen ingting, gen zel zel ingka.
Aw, thusim mak, thusim mak tak chuh!
A kigen kha laka hawihpen;
Lopi takin vel gen ka,
Thusim mak tak mai chuh,
A mel hawihna ka muh tieng leh.
Lopina mun apat A hung a,
A thisan lul A hung pie tai;
Kumsawt tatna chuh A hung siem tai,
Ei Hukdampa A lopi ngei!
A zahngaihna luipi banga luong,
A hehpih teh theihloh manbei;
A lungsietna kumsawt a kiting,
Kei nasan ei hung hukhing tai.
E.C. Humnal 408
Doh is A8
Tatsa ka hih genzak nuom ka sai,
Belam No thisan a tatsa;
Zahngaihna tawp neilo-in ei tan,

Tatsa, tatsa,
Belam No thisan a tatsa;
Tatsa, tatsa,
A cha ka hi, kumsawt chanin.
Tatsa, Isu-ah ka nun nuom hi,
Nawpna, pakna, ka gen zo puoi;
Ama’n kumsawt chanin ei umpih,
A mun vak ah umzing ing ka.
Ei Tanpa nun nuom ka ngaihtuoh a,
Sunni tumin ka ngaihtuoh hi;
Thip mai thei ka hih tak loh ziekin,
Kumkhuo’n hehpihna la’n ka sai.
Dan leh ka kipahna Lalpen chuh,
Lopina mun achun mu’ng ka;
Hehpihna’n ka kalsuon cheng A pu’i,

Ka hehpih, Ka hehpih, ka hehpih Lalpa,

Ka hun hehpih zie chuh, ka sep in phuong ding.
Ka kipak, ka kipak, aw, a gen a nuom,
Kipahna tuoi thei lo, tangsip ah ka ding;
Ka go chuh ka gal thil, ziechun um ka nuom,
Isu leh Angel leh, it leh ngaih cheng tawh.

songs.title: GO YE INTO ALL THE WORLD!

lines: Doh is A
Gamla taka awilo thim laka cheng te,
Thagau simsen louh mang den thei ding haw;
Kuoa chieh ding hukdamna thu gen dingin?
Isu lam ena bang cheng thuok ngap di’n?
“Thuneihna cheng cheng piek Ka hi!
Thuneihna cheng cheng piek Ka hi!
Gam tinah chieh unla Chanchin Pha thu gen un,
Ngai un tel zel ingka” A tii.
En un, khawvel kawt kihawng ah chiel na hiu,
Krista sepaihte tho unla lut un;
Kristiente halh un, theihtawp in pangkhawm un,
Chanchin Pha’n gitloh hatkawl tan sak un!
“Bang dinga halh lo?” Pathien aw chun a tii,
Bang dinga halh lo? tih thu gensawn un;
Thil lauhum na’h hukdam di’n Isu a thii,
Hinna, hukdamna thu chuh phuong zak un.
Namtin in, Pathien chuh lopi hen ti a,
Guol zawhna la sak ding phat a nai tai;
Tatsate hukdamna achun kipak un,
Hallelujah, Lalpen ti’n kiko ding.

songs.title: I LOVE TO TELL THE STORY

lines: Sam 66:6
Doh is A8
Thusim chu gen ka nuom hi,
Muh loh chunglam thusim; Isu leh A lopi zie,
Leh A hehpihna thu!
Thusim chuh gen ka nuom hi,
A dik ka het ziekin;
Ka utna a hih bukim,
Thildang hih theih loh chuh.
Thusim chuh gen ka nuom hi!
Ka thupi pen chuh hina;
Thusim lui tak gen ding chuh,
Isu hehpihna thu!
Thusim chuh gen ka nuom hi,
Mak deuh deuha lang chuh; thildang ngaihtuohna cheng sang,
Leh zanmang sang inle;
Thusim chuh gen ka nuom hi,
Kei dinga pha pen chuh;
Aziek chuh ziechu ahi,
Tu’n nang ka hun hilh chuh.
Thusim chuh gen ka nuom hi!
Gen kit zel a nuom hi! ka gen chengin hawih deuh deuh,
Mak deuh deuh in alang;
Thusim chuh gen ka nuom hi,
Mi kimkhat zak ngei loh;
Hukdamna thu chuh ahi,
Pathien Thu Thieng apat.
Thusim chuh gen ka nuom hi,
A phat zie hete di’n; gilkiel, dangchak thuok laia,
Chawlhna nuom bang ahi;
Lopina mun ka tun tieng,
La THAK chuh sa’ng ka ting;
Ziechuh THUSIM LUI hina,
Ka deih mah mah zing chuh!
Sam 43:3

Tanpa deihum tak min ziekin,

Salhvak in, Aw Salhvak mengin,
Tuilien khel tuikuol chanin;
Thusim maktak chuh hetsak in,
Hehpih, lungsiet manbei chuh!
Zan thim lungkham na a thagau,

“A tawp chanin hun umpih ka,

songs.title: WHILE THE DAYS ARE GOING BY

lines: Doh is A
Lunggil ngui hihhalh ding a um,
Nite a beih zel lai hin;
Thagau mangthai ding a tam ie,
Nite a beih zel lai hin,
I tup gam I zawt lai in;
Kipak zing zing thei leuhing;
Aw, thilpha bawl chiet hitiu,
Nite a beih zel lai hin.
A bei zel! A bei zel!
Nite chuh, A bei zel!
Aw, thilpha bawl chiet hitiu,
Nite a beih zel lai hin.
Mawk ummai na ding phat umlo,
Nite a beih zel lai hin;
Na mel zingkhuo bangin vak hen,
Nite a beih zel lai hin;
Khawvel tauna’n a dim hi,
Lungkham leh kahna’n adim;
Na suohpih puk phawng dingin.
Nite a beih zel lai hin!
Hehpihna guiin ei kan khawm,
Nite abeih zel lai hin;
Khat khatin I kinusie zel,
Nite a beih zel lai hin!
Mahleh chi pha I tuh hawu,
A sa leh liep a khang ding;
I lunggil hih nuom zing ding,
Nite a beih zel lai hin!
Doh is C
Chanchin Pha phuongzak un, mihiem umna chengah,
Mi lunggil sung lungkhamna a umna cheng ah;
Kristien chengin thu kipahum phuongzak uhen,
Lungmuonpa A hung tung!
Lungmuonpa A hung tung (2)
Van apat Thagau Thieng, Pa tiem chuh piek ei tai;
Chanchin Pha phuongzak un, mihiem umna cheng ah,
Lungmuonpa A hung tung!
Zan sawt chuh a bei tai, taikhuo a hung vak tai,
Lungkhamna leh thil lauhum cheng chuh a bei tai;
Tang hawihtak apata, kawl ni no suok bangin,
Lungmuonpa A hung tung!
Lalpente Lalpen chun, sukdamna chuh nei in,
Thagau saltangte cheng, pawtna thu A hun puoi;
Gitloh suoka pawt ten, zawhna la hun sa’n au,
Lungmuonpa A hung tung!
I lungthim gil ahin, Hehpihna thu lien hen,
Kumsawt lam mansakte, ma I puih theih na’ng un;
Khawvel gitloh thimah, eihaw ei hihvak di’n,
Lungmuonpa A hung tung.
Leisiet gam kimvel ah, zie thu hi kithang hen,
Van mi thiengte guola lei mite umna di’n;
Hehpih tawp neilo la, haih ni um ta puona,
Lungmuonpa A hung tung!
Doh is F
Greenland vuk gam apat leh, India gam apatin,
Africa gam haksa leh, gam dang tamtak apat;
Luilien panga chengte, leh tang leh phai a miten,
Gitloh hatkawl apat a, Hukdawk di’n ei sam ui.
Silon tuikuol nuom chungah, huihchim pha a hung nung,
Etna mun cheng a hawih a, mihing mai a gilo;
Pathien thilpiek simsen loh, changin a um ngal un,
Mahleh Pathien helo ten Thing, Suong bul a ho ui.
Eihaw chunglam chitna a Thagau hihvak sate’n,
Vakna pie lo ding I him, thim laka chengte chuh?
Hukdamna! Aw hukdamna, kiko pih zel unla,
Lei gam tawpa chengte’n le, Messia min a het na’n.
Huih nungin A thu tawk un, tui luong inle tawk un,
Tuisuohgiet lien tak banga, gamtin a luoh suok ma’n;
Belam No gilote ding-a thi chuh hungtun ma’n,
Tanpa, Lalpen, leh Siempa, Panpih in na pang un.
Redemption sons 233 - T.S. 194
Doh is A8
Na kuong tawl phatloh ziekin,
Kuong chawlhna mun nuom apat,
Tuilien in awl awlin a hun tawk zel hi;
A thukna lai lam zuonin,
Tuipi lien leh lauhum ah,
Tuilien in awl awl in a hun tawk zel hi.
A hun tawk gamla deuh deuh hi,
Tuipi lien leh lauhum ah;
Pathien lungsietna, bitna huongsung apatin,
Manthaina mun lam zuonin,
Tuilien in awl awlin ahun tawk zel hi.
Gam nuom lama thilvak chun,
Um ding dan a hun hilh zing,
Tuilien in awl awlin a huntawk zel hi;
Kuongchawlhna mun apatin,
Na kuong tawk mang pai khana,
Tuilien in awl awl in a hun tawk zel hi.
Gam nuom apata Aw chun,
A hun sapnau chuh ngaiin,
Tuilien in awl awl in a hun tawk zel hi;
Khai, suohpih, a Awu ngaiin,
A phat a kikhelh mahin,
Tuilien in awl awl in a hun tawk zel hi.
Doh is G
Kipah Aw gi chuh I zau,
Isu’n a hukdam hi!
A thu gam tinah gen un,
Isu’n a hukdam hi!
Gamtin ah A thu puou in,
Lamto leh tuilien gal ah!
Pang un! Lal thupiek ahi,
Isu’n A hukdam hi!
Tui kinawk mahleh gen un,
Isu’n A hukdam hi!
Gilote kawmah gen un;
Isu’n A hukdam hi!
Tuikuol gamte’n la sau un,
Tuisuohgiet in gensawn hen;
Leichung kipak zing ta’n a,
Isu’n A hukdam hi!
Sepgim, dahna ah lasau,
Isu’n A hukdam hi!
A thih leh hin tawp loin,
Isu’n A hukdam hi!
Lungkham lai inle sau in,
Lunggil panpih ngaih lai in;
Than nuoisieh in zawh lasau,
Isu’n A hukdam hi!
Huihnung inle phuongzak hen,
Isu’n A hukdam hi!
Nam tin tuhin kipak hen,
Isu’n A hukdam hi!
Hukdamna manbei phuongun,
Tuipi chung leh gamtin ah;
I guolzawhna lau zie hi,
Isu’n A hukdam hi!
R.C. Paddock Tune : III Alexander 165
Doh is A8
Bang ka bawl die Lalpa tuni’n?
Na Chanchin Pha thu phuong dingin;
Tuipi khela mite hilh din,
Hinna thak Nanga kimu chuh?
Lalpa, tunin ei pui zelin,
Kal khata masuon zel dingin;
Thil tamzaw diek bawl thei dingin,
Lalpa ei pui in ka zawh ma’n.
Lalpa, khupdin in paucham ka,
Tuni a Na thu gente dingin;
Gamdanga chengte a dingin,
Thagau mangten a hun pawm na’n.
Ka thilneih ka hun piei Lalpa,
Mite’n Na thu a het na’ng un;
Midangte’n le Na thu ngai hen,
Kei banga tat ahih na’ng un.
Lalpa, chieh ingting, gen ingka,
Gitloh thima chengte kiengah;
Krista gilote dinga thi,
Micheng dinga khetden a um.
Doh is F
Chanchin Pha dakte a giu, Gamtin leh tuipi chungah;
Hukdamna manbei kipah um, Nang leh kei ei hun tun ui;
Pathien khawvel hehpih, A Chapa neihsun A piei;
Amah gingcha taphawtte chun,
Kumsawt hinna changun au.
Chanchin pha dak a giu,
Gamtin leh tuipi chung ah;
Chanchin pha’n a hun tun,
Nang leh kei di’n vangsak na.
Chanchin Pha dakin ei chiel, Mitin guolvakna di’n;
Chielna ngaihsak loin um ki’n, Hehpih sapna chu niel ki’n;
“Hinna Changthak Ka hi, Thagau a gilkiel te An;
Na gitloh sandup bang mahleh,
Vuk bangin hung vam ina”!
Chanchin Pha dak vau lawkna, Nichengin a hung gi zel;
A vaigei taphawtte dinga, Thihna lauhum hung tung ding;
“Na hinna di’n taidawk in, Phaicham ale kichawl ki’n”
Na nunglam nga kit hiel kinla,
Kumsawt gawtna thuok kha’n la.
Chanchin Pha dak kipahum, Gamtin, muntin, a thawng hi;
Ngaihdamnabukim thuchuhpuo’n, KhetdenHukdampaziekchun;
“Chanchin Pha kipahum, Micheng dingin ka hun puoi;
Nanguh di’n Hukdampa a pieng,
Krista Lal, Lalpen chuh.”

songs.title: GLORIOUS THINGS OF THEE ARE SPOKEN

lines: III Alexander 327 - T.S. 186
Doh is B8

Bangin a hun sulawk dem?

Na galte lau ta puon la (2)

Alopi leh hawihna tawh.

Kipahna pha a nei puou (2)
Enin, kumsawt hehpihna ’pat,
Tuihing luite hung pawtin;
Na chate cheng cheng a vaka,

Lalpa a piepa guolin (2)

Lung lau loin ka chieh zel hi,

I keng mangthai hawl di’n,
Krista, Sapchuom di’n.
Krista Sapchuom di’n I ding,
Lunggil a kizawm in;
Tu apat I hinnau I pieu,
Krista, Sapchuom di’n.
Krista Sapchuom di’n I ngen,
Ni chenga sem zelin;
Gunchuh leh hangsan in,

I thuthun tudet in,
Krista, Sapchuom di’n.
Krista Sapchuom di’n la sa’n,
Kipak a chawian in;
Ei suohchak sak ziekin,
Zawhna ei tiem ziekin;
I thupiu hizing hen,
Krista, Sapchuom di’n.

Khawvel gam tina Chanchin Pha thu phuongzak dingin,

En un, chung gama um van In nuom chuh,
Theihtawp a panga, semgim te’n luoh ding;
Lalpa hehpihna Aw chun sam intin,
Kumsawt ni tawplo luoh tan au.
Isai 36:10
Doh is F8
Kipaka van gam zuonten lasau, hun sawt mahleh,
Ginna’n la ngaihnawp um san chunglam a khun ka um;
Ngaiin, vangsakna tangah, tang lopi-ah ka ding,
Jordan gal chuh ka etin, Lalpa gamtiem ka mui.
La ngaihnawpum sa zel un,
La chuh na sak cheng un;
Ka lung kipahna’n a dim,
Ka pak seng puoi, Lalpa!
Sau un, lawpa Van zuonte, leia I um lai un,
Van la leh Isu I nicheng kipahnau hi hen;
Thusim lui chuh lan sai tiu, ei tatdawkna la chuh,
Kumsawt lapawl chuh ahi, van gam chana ding chuh.
Sau-un lawpa van zuonte’n, a phat sawt ta puona,
Pathien gam nuom tun chanin van la go chuh sai tiu;
Guol deihte’n ei ngak zing ui luipang lehlam a khun,
Luigal achun tuok hitiu, tui kinawk beihna ah.
Deut. 31:6
Doh is A8
Galkap banga chieh in! Kristien sepaihte,
I maua na chiehsa, Isu chuh en in;
Krista I Lalpen un, galdo di’n ei pui,
Kidona phuol achun; a puonlap a phe’i.
Galkap banga chieh in Kristien sepaihte,
I maua na chieh sa, Isu chuh enin.
Isu min I sap tieng, Setan gal a zam,
Pangun, Kristien sepaih, galzo zel dingin;
I pahchaknau Aw gin, gawtmun hihling ding,
Suohpihte kiko un, ngeih takin lasau.
Sepaih tamtak bangin, Pathien Sapchuom um,
Suohpihte mithieng haw, nungzui I hiu ui;
I kikhen zak puou hi, pumkhat I hiu ui,
I tup, I Thugin leh Hehpihna kibang.
Lalna a hung bei thei, Lalgam a tuoi thei,
Mahleh Isu Sapchuom, um zing ding ahi;
Gawtmun kulh kawtkhak te’n, Sapchuom zo ngei lo,
Krista thutiem I nei; zie chuh thawn ngeilo.
Mipite, pang zelun, kei u lawi hung hiu,
Lopi, chawihat zahna, Lal Krista chang hen;
La ei hung sakpih un, galzawhna la chuh,
Mihing leh Angel te’n, kumsawt in san au.

songs.title: HEAR, THE TRUMPET OF THE ARMY!

lines: Pathien suongun, damsung in nuoi zinmang galsat un,
Bang tikchan inle, dogal chuh lauhum mahlele;
Pathien in ei piek, galvan bukim chuh a um hi,
Dogal satna phuol achun ding zing hitiu.
Malam zuon hitiu, galthawm a dai hi,
Kiko chiet un, dogal tai in a;
Malam zuon hitiu, galthawm a dai hi,
Galzo in malam zuon un;
Ei puipa nungsul chuh zui zel hitiu,
Gal lakah, gal hat lakah;
Dogal satna phuol a chun ding zing hitiu.
Lungsietna, thienthona puonlap hi dawm zing leu hing,
Manthaina um puona; zie puonlap nuoi a chun;
Nuoizin gal hiem-leh-thal laka A lim belte di’n,
Dogal satna phuol achun ding zing hitiu.
Hungun, suihlung kiguolin Puipa di’n do hitiu,
Hukdampa muon um ei thutiem thudik chu pawm un;
Zawhna thutiem det, pel ngeilo thudik chuh ei tiem,
Dogal satna phuol achun ding zing hitiu.
Neh. 2:17ff
- K. Siema - T.S. 303
Lalpa leh Agam dingin,
Nasem dingin hung kisau;
Nasep a hun tai na gamsung ah,
Hung halhdawk inla, entie;
Na gamsung kulhpi a chim zotai,
Kihechien in enin.
“Hung halhdawk in, (3)
Kingaihtuoh in!” Lalpa’n A tii.
Nehemia Persia leng khawn pie’n,
A na pang ta-mahlele;
Jerusalem siet a het phetin,
A lungkham mah mah ta a;
A umna mun luite chuh nusie’n,
Siempha di’n a chieh tai.
Nungak, tangval, nupi, upa,
Na gamsung lungsiet lo maw?
Na kulhpi bang dettak maite chuh,
Setan in phie ding ahi;
Hung halhdawk inla, vak enviel tie,
Nehemia ngaihtuoh in.
Nehemia mi ginum tak chuh,
Sanballat leh Tobiah te’n;
Muhsit bawlin nuihsan mahleu le,
A lung adawng diek ngei puoi;
Mite’n hun musit ta mahleu le,
Sam 60:4
Doh is B8
Lal puonlap zak dinga piek I hitau ie,
Lalpen sepaihte kiengah;
Sepaih bangin tu’n puonlap chuh I zak ui,
Tatsate banga la sa’n.
Masuon un, Masuon un!
Krista’h bangkim channa’n ngai un;
Lalpen chawihat na’n la sau uo,
Kross puonlap lim nuoi achun.
Tui kinawk bangin melma lauhum mahleh,
I puonlap khaisang hitiu;
A lim nuoiah Lal sepaih I hih ziek un,
Thudik mang galzam puoi tiu.
Gam leh tuipi chung mihiem chenna cheng ah,
Chanchin Pha thu phuongzak un;
Lal thisan bek puonlap chanchin chuh genun,
Lalpen sepaihte I hiu.
Zing khawvak lopi hungtun nang a nai tai,
Nicheng in a nai deuh deuh;
Lalpen masang ah melma chuh tawm tan au,
Kross-in khawvel nuoisieh ding.
Doh is B8
Ding un! Ding un, Isu di’n!
Nanghaw Kross sepaihte;
A Lal puonlap dawmsang un,
Mang ngeilo ding ahi;
Galzo a, zo zel dingin,
A sepaih puihuoi ding;
Melma nuoisieh ahih a,
Krista leng A chan nan.
Ding un! Ding un, Isu di’n,
Pengkun sapna ngaiun;
Kidona phuolah pang un,
A ni lopi a hin;
Nanghaw, Amah nasemte’n,
Gal simsen loh do in;
Lauhum na-ah hangsan un,
Hat takin do zel un.
Ding un! Ding un! Isu di’n!
Amah hatna muong un;
Na sapum ban thahatnau,
Senin do zo puon lau;
Gospel galvan chu lauin,
Paucham un la, do un;
Lauh umna na tuok tieng leh,
Chau in puk ngei puon lau.
Ding un! Ding un! Isu di’n!
Kido sawtta puona;
Tuhin kido thawm I zai,
Dan leh galzawhna la
Kuole guolzo te cheng chun,
Hinna lukhuk chang ding;
Lopina Lalpen chu tawh,
Kumsawta vaihawm ding.
Redemption Songs 205
Doh is E8
Krista’n sepaih hangsan leh thudik A deih,
Galsatna phuol ah nang dingin mun a um;
Khawvel gitloh do in, malam nawh zel un,
Galzawh tieng van gam nawp kiemlo chang hitiu.
Pang un! Kross galmite haw,
Lung laulo in, gingcha zing un;
Pang un! Kross galmite haw,
Suong un Lalpa, A thu ngai un,
Galzawh masieh pang un!
Setan in ei nang, petmang dingin ei them,
Mahleh ei lungsietpa vangin zo hitiu;
Malai a galmi dang, galhatte haw chuh,
Gimtheihna cheng zo in gam nuom a tung tau.
Hansanna chuh suoh in malam nawh hitiu,
Isu en zingin, ngakin, ngen zing hitiu;
I puonlap pei hitiu “Krista namtin Lal”
Hossana sam leng Nuoizin gal zo tai tiu.
Sawngkhawkhai
Doh is B8
Ngai un, Lalpa Jehovah,
Sietlei dogal cheng Nuoisiehpa chu;
Khawvel gitloh thawihna di’n Amah thi -
San ngei chuh chawiin mun thiengtho A lut pih tai,
Zie mun thiengtho a nga bang lengte chun;
Kipahna la sa’n,
Lalchutphah ma a ding, namtin laka mite;
Pau tin laka mite leh thilhing lite chuh.
“Zuomang Lalchutphah a chu leh,
Belam No kawm achun;
Lopina um hen” tiin.
Aw, lei chung cheng cheng in le,
Belam No gal zawhna la chuh sa’n;
Kum khawsawta I do zawh ngei loh uh,
Nuoi zinmang galhatpa tui bangin a tawm tai;
Galzawhna lopi Belam No thisan,
Zawhna lopi chuh;
Chawian in la sai tiu, nuoi zinmang nuoisieh na’n,
Lei mhiemte cheng cheng leh thilsiem cheng chengin.
Ngai un I van khawpi a van -
Mi thiengtho nga bang lengsate chun;
Belam No nunnem zawhna la hawih chuh -
Sa’n kipakin sun leh zanin a chawl ngei puou;
Van kingkang gihawih, van phaiphuleng gi-
Hawih chitin chengin;
Zawhna tumbak chawite hinna puon thieng silhte,
Lalchutphah kimvel a chawihatna la hawih chuh.
Joh. 2:5
Doh is F
Tumlam phaicham apat,
Hetsakna la a hung;
Ginumna, ginumna, ginumna, Krista di’n,
A la gi thang zel chuh;
Muol tinin a sak pih,
Zie ginumna, Krista dinga ginumna thu chuh.
“Zo zel din kuon un!” (2)
I lamkai pauin A tii;
A thupiek awi hitiu,
Gam la pai zieng hitiu;
Krista din I ginum nau, I ginum nau ziekin!
Mi hangsan te’n ngai un,
Sietlei kimvela thang;
Ginumna, ginumna, ginumna Krista din!
Tho un pang ngam dingin;
Hilhna thudik phuong un,
Zie ginumna, Krista dinga ginumna thu chuh!
Lawi muon um hun zawm un,
Setan gal nuoisieh din;
Krista dinga ginumna, ginumna ziekin!
Setan puonlap zak na’h;
Gospel phuong zak hitiu,
Zie ginumna, Krista dinga ginumna thu hi!
Khanglai’ hatna I ngau,
Tu’n Isu kengbul ah;
Krista dinga ginumna, ginumna ziekin!
Gospel phuongzak hitiu,
Khawvel gam tin chengah;
Zie ginumna, Krista dinga ginumna thu chuh.
Doh is F
Kanaan lam I zuon puonlap chawia lasa’n,
Gitloh do di’n sepaiha kipie I hiu;
Mahleh gal muna I kikhenzak lohna’n,
“Lalpa lama pang kuo?” ti’n I ki dawng ui.
Aw, I lakah kuo ahim thudika muon um,
Thutak panpih a ding Lalpa lama pang?
Aw, I lakah kuo ahim thudik a muon um?
Thutak panpih a ding, Lalpa lama pang?
Chemzam leh galvanhaw a te zawl zawl thei,
Setan vak Angel bang a kilat ziekin;
Mahleh lunggil ginum lohna a um thei,
Mukin, “Lalpa lamah ka pang” ti mahleh.
Vaihawmna nuoia um nalai I um um?
Pathien zahngaihna, ngaihdamna he nailo;
Lunggil khauh kingainiem in, A kawm zuonin,
A hun ngak hi, kinin, A lamah pangin.
Lungkham, natna leh bawlsietna khawksa ki’n,
Lungkham nawp la suok pai ding ahih ziekin;
I puipa muonum chuh zuiin A Kross pu’n,
Guolzo a kiko ding “Lalpa lam’ pang” ti’n.

songs.title: WHO IS ON THE LORD’S SIDE?

lines: Exodus 32:26
Doh is C
Kuo a Lalpa lam pang?
Kuon Lalna sem ding?
Mi dang hukdam dingin,
Kuo a panpih ding?
Khawvel nawpna nusien,
Kuoa galdo ding?
Kuo a Lalpa lam pang?
Amah di’n kuon ding?
Zainem in nei sama,
Nei lungsiet ziekin.
Lalpa di’n ka pang ui,
Nanga ka hiu ui.
Lopina chawihatna,
Mai lungtup lo in;
Sepaih In I pang ui,
Zawhna La sa di’n;
Mite hinna dinga,
A thih tak ziekin;
Isu min samta chuh,
A lam pang hin au,
Na hehpihnan ei sawl,
Nei lungsiet ziekin.
Isu, Nang in nei chawi,
Sana leh sum lo’n;
Na hinna thisan in,
Nang hun chawian di’n;
Na kawma hung cheng chuh,
Vangsakna’n na thuom;
Nang nei suthalawp a,
Nei suohchak sak tai;
Nei tatna lopi leh,
Nei lungsiet ziekin.
Kidona lauhum in,
Melma hat mahleh;
Lalpen sepaihte chuh,
Kuoman zo puona;
A puonlap nuoi achun,
Gal zo ngeingei ding;
A thu zuou ngeilo chun,
Zawhna thu ei tiem;
Lawp takin ka pang ui,
Nei lungsiet ziekin.
Eph. 4:1
Doh is G
Kristien, kiveng zingin, lauhum a nai!
Na zinna ah lau leh linga chieh in;
Thang leh thepnan a hun um kimvel hi,
Gitlohna a lut di’n thepin na um,
Kristien, kiveng zingin, (3) lauh um a nai.
Kristien, kipak zingin huihpi lakah,
Van chu nimin, lauhum in lang mahleh;
Van nim leh huihpi hung bei pai tana,
Hukdampa kawmah kumkhuon chawl tan la,
Kristien kipak zingin, (3) lauh um a le.
Kristien paucham zingin na pukloh na’n,
Na hukdampa sapding hengilh ki’n la;
Thepna leh buoina haw zongei inla,
Pauchamna galthuom a na kithuom chun,
Kristien kiveng zingin, (3) na puk loh na’n.
Kristien, kinem zingin, lungkham leh nat,
Van chawlhna na chan tieng leh bei tana;
Na kipahman vaihawmpa gen zan la,
“Na Lalpa kipahna ah lutin” ti’n,
Kristien, kinem zingin, (3) chawlhna mu’n la.
Thup. 2:10
Doh is B8
Kisau kido di’n! dogal a nai tai,
Puonlap dawmsang un, Lalpa di’n;
Kigalvan un, dettak in ding chiet un!
A thu thiengtho chuh mangin, pang un!
Tho un, sepaih! Lal puonlap nuoi achun,
Kisau unla, A thu gensawn un;
Malam zuon un! Hossana! ti’n sam un,
Krista chuh sepaih puipa ahi.
I galteu tuok di’n malam I zuon zel,
Panmun I het chun zo hitiu;
Phaw leh puonlap thieng taka vawp zingin,
Thudik a pangte, puk ngei puoi tiu.
Aw micheng Pathien, ka sapnau ngaiin,
Na zahngaih na’n ei panpih in;
Galzawh ahih a kidona beih tieng,
Na ma achun Lallukhuk khung kau.
Thup. 2:7
Doh is B8
Thepna achun lut kin, gitlohna ahi,
Na zawhnan zozel din hun panpih ina;
Hang takin do zelin, thim hatna zoin,
Isu lam en zingin, hunpui zel ina.
Hukdampa panpih ngen in,
Lungmuon, hihhat, hun veng di’n;
Ama’n A hun panpih nuom,
Nang hun pui zel ina.
Guol gilo nusie’n la, pau phalo mang ki’n,
Pathien min zah inla, mawka suoh lo in;
Lungnem, phachuom ngaiin lungthim dik takin,
Isu lam en zingin, hun pui zel ina.
Pathien in guol zote Lallukhuk piena,
Gin vangin zo hitiu, puk sek mahleu hing;
I Hukdampau in hatna thak ei piena,
Isu lam en zingin, hun pui zel ina.

songs.title: BE YE STRONG IN THE LORD

lines: Doh is G
“Lalpa hatna leh A thilhih theihna mang un!
A thu dik achun dettak in ding un”
Kidona phuol lauhum ah bittak in hun pui ina,
Lalpa minin na galteu zo unla.
Ding detun, thudik di’n,
Lal thupiek zawpa guolzo zel di’n;
Lalpa lopina dingin A thu a guolzo dingin,
Lalpa hatna achun ding det un!
Lalpa hatna leh A thilhih theihna mang un!
Dogal lau a kinunghei ngeilo di’n;
Thudik na panpih u chun na kawmah ding zing ina,
Amah hatna mangin masuon zel un.
Lalpa hatna leh A thilhih theihna mang un!
A thutiem haw zuou ngeilo ding ahi;
Na khut changlam chuh tu’n a thudik na panpih sungcheng,
Amah na gin chun gal zo zel inla.
Rome 8:31
Doh is G
Lalpa ah kipak un! A lungsiet pakchau,
Sala tangte ei pawt sak tai;
A thisana tatsa bang di’n I lau dem?
Isu I “Bangcheng” hi ngala.
“Pathien I lama A pan chun,
Pathien in ei panpih chun;
Kuo a ei do thei ding? ..... kuo? ..... kuo? ..... kuo?
Kuo a ei do thei ding, do thei ding?
Lalpa ah hat un, A theihna kipak un,
Nicheng in ginum in um un;
Setan hun thep tieng thudik chuh panpih un,
Amah chuh I hatnau hi’n a.
A thu ging un A thutiem a thawn ngei puoi,
Krista achun ahi, Amen;
Lei hi mang mahleh A thutiem mang puona,
Zie chuh Bible ah a chuong hi.
Lalpa ah um un, Amah thu chun nung un,
Kumkhuo hinna bul chuh ahi;
Thagau hatlo kithing Amah khuta um,
Kuoman sulawk thei tapuo’n a!
Doh is G
Lalpen sepaih I hiu,
Thisan a tat I hiu;
Lal Krista a dinga do di’n,
Sepaih in I kipieu;
Lauh um ah I um zing,
Mahleh lawpa lasa’n;
Lalpen sepaih Lawi-upa chun,
I lunggil A hih hat.
Lalpen sepaih I hiu,
A pahchak la saitiu;
Muonum in A na sem hitiu,
I Lalpen lopi chuh.
Lalpen sepaih I hiu,
A min kipak a pu’n;
Lal Krista kikhetden laia,
Kross chunga kitak chuh;
Lalpen sepaih I hiu,
Manna punna’n ngaiin;
I Lal Isu min chawihat na’n,
Haksa cheng thuok ngapin.
Lalpen sepaih I hiu,
Mi deihloh chanpih in;
Tun Amah I thuokpi u chun,
A kawmah lang hitiu;
A puonlap dawmsang un,
Hun sawt hita puona;
Lopina ni ahung nai tai,
Thup. 2:25
Doh is D
Ka lawite! en tiem u hetna,
Van a khun a um;
Ei panpih ding a lang ta ie,
Zawhna ding a nai.
“Na pang un la hung ding ka hi”
Lal Isu’n A tii;
Van lamah dawnna pieu un la,
“Nang ziek’ Pang kau” tiin.
En tiem u, dogal a hung ui,
Setan puih huoi in;
I velah mi hangsan puk ui,
I zolo vang ui!
En un puonlap lopi aphei!
Pengkun gi ngaiun!
I puipau min in zo hitiu,
Dogal tincheng chuh.
Gal lauhum sawtpi do mahleng,
Panpih ding anai;
Pangun, I Puipau A hung hi,
Lawite, kipak un.
I Tim. 6:16
Doh is D
Kross sepaih a pang ka hi nam?
Belam No nung zuiin?
Amah ziekin ka thuok ngam nam?
A min ka phuong na dem?
Min achun Min lun ahi,
Ka sika thi pa chuh;
Lungsiet na’n lal lukhuk chang di’n,
Bangcheng thuok zel ingka.
Mi dangte’n kipahman sang di’n,
Theihtawp in a do ui;
Kei tawilo a mawk a um hi,
Van a puih ka hi dem?
Ka tuok ding gal umlo ahim,
Galdo lo ding ka him?
Khawvel gilo ka guol ahim,
Pathien kawm ei tun ding?
Galdo ka, vaihawm ka guot chun,
Lalpa, ei hihhat in;
Sem ing ting gimna thuok ngap ka,
Na Thu a ding zing in.
Josh. 5;15
Doh is C
Sapna aw gi ngai un,
“Tuni’n kuo kuon ding?
Ka nasepna hawla,
Niel loa pang ding?
Kuo a gal matawnga,
Ka puonlap dawm ding?
Pathien leh A thutak,
Panpih a do ding?
Isu’n puonlap nuoi ah, sepaih ma A huoi;
Galzo hiting, dikna’n khawvel luoh suok ding.
Pathien hatna muongin,
Gal zawh macheng in;
Setan lawi chu do-in,
Kigalvan hitiu;
Thienthona leh thutak,
Panpih a do in;
Pathien dinga do di’n,
Pang khawm chiet I hiu.
Ngai un, a thawmgiu chuh,
Lasa’n chieh zel ui;
I Puipa, I Lalpau,
Chu lopi henla;
Gamla leh naia te,
Lungtup kibang in;
Galdo di’n a kuon ui,
A aw giu ngai un!
Krista sepaihte haw,
Kigal ging zing unla;
* Pathien hatna suongin ding un,
A kumawt cha zalin (3)
Lalpa vang a hatin,
A hih theihna muongun;
* Kuole Isu hatna muong chuh,
Zinmang sangin a hat. (3)
Mun cheng veng phau unla,
Thagau chau lo hielin;
* Hehpih leh thilbawl theihna chun,
Khawvel pumpi zo un. (3)
Buoina hungum mahleh,
Na zawh vek tieng uleh;
* Krista vangin nuom un natin,
Tawp chanin ding un lau. (3)
Hatna leh lawpna chun,
Do unla, pang zel un;
* Thim thilhih theihna haw cheng chuh,
Na zawh niu tung ina. (3)
Sam 62:2
Doh is E8
Dettak in ding un, khawvel buoina ah,
Huihpi nungin, tuikinawk sang mahleh;
Zie Suongpi hin hatna, hinna ei piei,
Gitlohna a hung naih tieng.
Suongpi chunga dingin! dettak in ding hitiu!
Krista Suongpi chung ngeiah;
I do ham ham chun bittak in ding hitiu,
Lalchutphah vel mipi lakah.
Thudik ah dingdet un, lunggil thieng pu’n,
Lunggil dik, hangsan leh ginna hatin;
Zie Suongpi mai hin zawhna ei piena,
Khawvel gitlohna lakah.
Thudik ah dingdet un, nang di’n phapen,
Ahun sawt mahleh, hung tung tei ina;
Suongpi hin chawlhna, muonna ei piena,
Damsung huihpi a beih tieng.
Doh is A
Lau ki’n! Pathien na phaw
Na kipahman lopi;
A hat na’n A zotai,
Lalpa na tha ahi!
Lau ki’n, A aw ahi,
Na kawma thugen chuh;
Dak inla, kipakin,
Lal Isu Krista ah.
Lau ki’n! A man a zai,
Na lungkhamna Aw chuh;
A thu hinna tui chun,
Na tha chau vang piena.
Lau ki’n! lungdawng hiel ki’n,
Hun umpih zing ina;
Hun panpih zel ina,
Hun hihhat zel ina.
Lau ki’n! Lawi tawmte haw,
Na Lalpau hungvak ding;
Lopina latsak din,
A Ina hun pui di’n.
Doh is A8
Khawvel vakna haw cheng cheng sanga,
Vakzaw leh lopi zaw;
Isu chuh ka vakna ahi,
Ka lunggil ah a vak.
Aw vak deihum chuh a vak hi,

Kamlala

Aw hinna Thing, na bak nuoiah.

Upa Zasiama
Zingdawng Sawl No, Hukdampa lalna gama chun,

Damlai lungngaih mei zing ta puona,
Kap a kikhenna bei tana.
Lili pak leh lopina vak zam vel,
Belam No leh a tatsa te lenna;
Van khawtuol nuom leh Angelte,
Muh ka nuom ngei ie.
Thilun van lopina tung masate haw chun,

Zing tha puin van Jerusalem thak hawih ah,

Chung thangvan gitna khel Lalpa chenna gamah,
Ni vak leh thaumei ngai talo in,
Zan thim lungngaihna cheng bei tana,

Pielgal gam nuom chu ka tun tiengleh,

Tun ka nuom hi, pielgal gam nuom,

Thihna, pulthawk, kahna bei tana,

Damlai tuipi kinawk khel lama chun,

Zuon zel ingka Belam No Lal lenna,

Phat beimangsa chu ka gel leh,
