Ka umna lei pakcha bangin;
“Kum khawsawta li bang ting ngeilo,
Ka ngai ie zuo lunlai chu.
Lei nawpna leh kipahna hi,
Naubang kahnan sangmuol aliem;
Aw van Thagau thelbang thawhsak in,
Ninnawp tuolthing bang sang ding.
Henkawl nang bang Na sut sate
Pak bang chulin muol a liem ui;
Aw Lalpa nungtieng sul hei sakin,
Tanpa zailan awi ung kau.
Patea
Zion tang leh van Aksi hawih,
Lalpa’n kei di’n a siem;
Dan le ziegam chu ka tun tieng,
Kipahna pak lun ding.
Hun bang ahimin tuhin ei nang,
Thisan zieka keia Zion tang;
Aw bangtik tak leh ka mu ta dem?
Hukdampa leh gam nitum ngeilo.
Tuhin buoina Jordan luipang,
Ah ka ngak Hukdampa;
Aksi khel gamnuom chawlh na chu:
Bangtik leh ka tung dem?
Phat nang chiehin, Zion chaten.
Gam lopi ka ngaklah;
Ka lenna gamthip gam ahi,
Taihsan vak ding kei tai.
Aw galhat Lal Immanuel,
Gam chu ka tun tieng leh;
Hehpihna lal puon thieng silhin,
Kumsawt in leng tangka.
Siamliana
Amah a kiengu-ah um intin,
Amauhaw chu a mite hi ta nau;
Pathien ngei chun umpih intin,
A mit u a mitthi chu thiek hul tan a.
Dangchak tapohte kiengah,
Hinna tuikhuka tui,
A thawnin na pieng ka,
Aw, thagau dangchakte chun va dawn u hen.
Thihna umkit nawn thei ta puona,
Lungkham naubang kahna natnate le;
Um kit nawn thei ding ei ta puoi
Thil masahaw cheng le a beizo tau hi.
“ Ngaitie thil bangkim ka siem thak tai,
Zikin, ziethu hi a ginchak um hi”
Chun ka kawmah a hung tung tai,
“Kei Alpha leh Omega a Bul leh Tawp.
A Masapen leh a Nunungpen,
Hinna Thing chungah thu a nei thei ui;
Khuoa a lut theihna diu a,
Kisuthiengtho haw chu a nau vak tana.
C.Z. Huala
Tuhin buoina tangsip a ding in,
Ngaklah in khaw thiengtho ka thil;
Tu chana ka ngilhloh lungtuok te,
Puonvam silh a a lennau,
Ei haw ki’n la, ka hun ngak hi,
Ka kahna gam za mah lele;
Tatsate tuol nuom a lennau chu,
Mun galmuong chu ei tunin.
Aw kei di’n khawvel hi hak mahleh,
Kumsawt taikhuo a hung vak tieng,
“Buoina cheng hi bei ding” a tiu ie,
Ka ngaklah ni lopi chu,
A sawt taluoi kei dingin buoina,
Pak bang tuoi hen lei dahum hi;
Muh ka nuom hi tatte tuol lenna,
Lungdeih peh bang kim tanau,
Damlai gamgaw hi ka pelh tieng leh,
Van mithiengte laituol lenna,
Kikhen loin chawlhna thing limah,
Hailo in la sak pih ka.
A kumsawt go luoh dingin sem zel hitiu,
Lungkhamna a hung let lai hin,
Ka kiengah um zel inla Aw
Ka hukdampa deih tak,
Aw nawpna gam nuom zuon hitiu,
Chawlh denna ding
Aw ka ngai ie khensate,
Kimna ding gam khu.
Lei nawpna tin cheng hi le hung bei ina,
Tuoi ta puona kumsawt lalna chu,
Gen zel unau khangthak chanin,
Agam tawp ta puona.
Mita muhloh gam nuom eihaw di’n a siem,
Zuon zel hitiu awle zie gam chu
Aw zie mun ngei chu ana hi
I kumsawt In diu chu.
Lei nawpna beikit mai sek muna chengte,
Kikhen lohna gam ei siemsak ziekin,
Hallelujah Hukdampa chu,
Chawihat in um zel hen.
Leisiet puon-In kiph7eltha mahleh,
Khawpi hawihtak mai chu ken ka nei nai;
Pathien in A siem, Zion chate lenna,
Zie chu ka kumsawt In.
Zion chate zalenna ding ni chu a naitai,
Na telna dem Aw suohpih?
Vaigei leh chun kumsawt kawt kihawn huomlo ding,
Damlai hinkhuo Lalpa a di’n pieu in.
Lei lungngaihna’n hun puimang khana,
Damlai nikhuo utchak thil a tam ie;
Pakbang I hinkhuo muolliem ding kuon cha hin,
Lalpa na sem hitiu.
Nitum kuon vai-chieh phat ahi tai,
Angelte leh mithieng chieh masate’n;
Khuongpi leh baja tawh eina ngak zing ui,
Vana kilamtuoh di’n.
Lalpa Krista lalna gam achun,
Leng leh lal chagah gimthei umtalo;
Tunkal ka ngaklah Zion chate lenna,
Zie chu ka kumsawt In.
Lungngaih mel him him a um puoi,
Angelte lailenna achun;
Khawvel lungngaih thuoka tauten,
Kahlai haiin Lalpa bel ui.
Lalpa zie gam chu ei thil sakin,
Zie khawvela ka lenlai hin;
Lungkham thuok a ka kahna hi,
Aw nem takin hun thuok ingka.
Aw zie muna lengte haw chun,
A khensa teu ngaih lohna di’n;
Hinna lungmuon tui a dawn ui,
Heiloh pakcha le a thiek ui.
En zel leuhing mun lopi chu,
Angel vam leh Zingsawl Aksi;
Khawvui a kai lung a hel diek,
Belam No tuollenna gam chu.
Mun lopi chu ka tun tiengleh,
Keile Lalpan ei umpih ding;
Angel thieng zalaia buolin,
Kumsawt in Lalpa chawian ka.
Pielgal gam nuom leh ka Lalpa,
Hehpih hung lang ding chu;
Thil zel ingka thepna huihpi;
Leh gitloh thim nuoiah.
Dan takleh thepna meipi leh,
Thimna a beih tieng leh;
Lang zel ina, A hehpihna,
Nawpna tuikhuk lul chu.
Khawvel buoina haw pawt sanin,
Hehpihna Lal deihum;
Pak ka ngaklah, nawpna chullo,
Van zaila hawih chu san.
Khawvel buoina laka Lalpa.
Na hehpih min lopi;
Pakcha seng puo’ng ka, Hukdampa,
Ka gitlohna’n ei nang.
Patea
Buoina kithiel in ka gam ding zuon ka,
Khawvel a hin ka tha a muong thei puoi;
Lalpa siem Salem thak chu thil ingka.
Aw thawhkitna ni lopi thihna zopa,
Khaw thiengtho a chun ei tun in
Luigal vangkhuo nuomah,
Buoi leh thihna zo in zaila sangka.
Ka kap hi Lalpa, Na mel mulo in,
Lunghel do in sunni ka tum zo puoi
Zion kulhpi, khawilam a um na him?
Pielgal ni vak hawih, ka lampi thimah,
Hung vak inla, Lalpa ka chieh thiem puoi.
Buoi leh than thim tak hin ei nang viel hi.
Ka damlai ni hi thanah pel ingka,
Mahleh ei ngak nau lam zuon zel ingka,
Luipi luong gi beihna ah chawl ingka.
Puna
Hun a tawm tai lei nawpna cheng le a bei zel,
Khawvel ah kipahna kim thei ngeilo;
Lalpa hung leng inla nilopi hun tun in,
Gimthei chate’n lei dahum pawtsan a nuom tau.
Aw, Eden thak nuom a chun ei pui kai in,
Lungngai taka khensate zalaia buol di’n
Kipahna kim tan tin hun pak zel ungkau
Khawvel hi ngaikit ta puong kau, Na gam achun.
Nang dinga thuoksa te’n gam nuom tun kinem ui,
Lei nawpna a mau di’n pak bang a tuoi;
Zion mipite leh hehpihna Lal mel chu,
Ni lopi hung tung ding chuh a thil chim ngei puou.
Lei lungngaih leh gimtheih buoina tin cheng nuoiah,
Nang hun gingten kipak in la a sau;
Amau di’n khuo vak hen Salem thak nuom a chun,
Na puih khawm phat ni lopi ngaiin a thil ui.
Lianvela
Beita mai hen lei chimum hi,
Lungdeih len guol kikhenna tawh;
Natna leh lungkhamna cheng hi,
Kumsawt kipahna la’n hungsuok hen.
Lungkham, buoina um ta puona,
Hukdampa tuollenna ahi;
Khawvel buoina thuok ta loin,
Aw ka thagau va chawl ding na hi.
Ka lungdeihte’n zawhna pakin,
Zion Lalpa a chawian ui;
Keile Isu tatna zalin,
Hehpihna gam nuomah ei puiin.
“Ngaiin, hungkitpai ding kahi,
A phat leh ni a tung zo tai;
Tuhin thil bangkim a thaktai,
Na Lalpa kipahna ah lutin”.
Hukdampan mun a siem zotai,
Gitloh a puksa thokit in;
La sa kawmin zuon hitiu,
Ei tatna a bukim zo tai.
Ei hehpihna lultak ziek chun,
Chawl ingka, Ka Pa gam achun;
Kumsawtin a vakah leng ingka.
I umnau lei in mauna hi,
Sie mah lele kumsawt In ding;
Eihaw a dingin A siem,
Gimthei chate I nunnawp nan.
“Kuole ka kawma hungta chu,
Nawhdawk puong ka” na tih ziekin;
Gitlohna tawh ka hunzuon,
Aw Lalpa, ei hih thiengtho in.
Khensate chu ngai mah leng le,
Lalpa gamah tuokkit hitiu;
Nei hehpihna Aw nem chun,
Tuhin Lalpa’n ei lungmuon hi.
Ginnan ka gal thila, ka chung van khuo a lang ie,
Lalpan A siem salem thak a khun;
Martar haw leh Angel vamte tawh,
Tuhin Lalchutphah ah ei ngak ui.
Zie chun ei ngak khenlohna ah,
Hehpih tatte a kimnau ah;
Lungkham, gimum thuoka maute le,
Chawldam tanau tih Lalpan a gen.
Tuhin kapin khen mah leu hing le I lungdeihteu,
Mi gen suongmantam sana tuol ah;
Khen na thu him gen um ta puona,
Khen lohna ni hung vak zaw tana.
Aw, tuhin lei lungkhamna cheng cheng a beih tieng leh,
Belam no leh Lalchutphah lopi;
A mi thiengte tawh kumkhawsawt in,
Zing sawl Aksi guolin vak tan au.
Bangtik leh Hukdampa, kumsawt munah nei tun dem?
Lungkhamna thu him genta loin;
Khenna, lungkhamna thuoka maute,
Kipahna tha zaka kikhawm ding.

songs.title: Ka Lung a Dawn Ni Hin

lines: Upa Zasiama
Ka lung a dawn ni hin,
Lalpa hung lengin ka lung sungah;
Liengvai chate chawlhna mun nuom na lenna chu,
Ei hilhin a chanchin,
Lei lungkhamna meipi nuoi ahin,
Van mun lopi chanchin chu gensen guol ei puoi,
Van kingkang phaiphuleng;
Ei muokna dinguh git hun ni chu.
Sietlei thavaih um gam ,
Lungdawngin luonthi nul mah leng le;
Thihna luigal ka kaih tiengleh, hehpih Lalpan,
Aw, ei na muok intin,
Lungdawn luonthi ei nulsak tan a.
Aw zie muna leng chun,
Khenna thu him him a gen ngei puou;
Khaw thiengtho leh Belam No chu thu leh zailan,
Angel vam leh seraf-
Te chawihatna la chu a chawl puoi.
Aw zie mun tung ding chun,
Sietlei gimtheihna hin ei dal hi;
Ka ngaklah ie, Na gam thiengtho ei thil sakin,
Zawhna tum bak chawia,
Salem thak sung fan kal ka ngaklah.
Ngurtawna
Lungngaihna kei di’n ana taluoi,
Lungsietna Lal deihum, kithielsakin;
Ngilh puong ie, Salem thak galdawt ingka,
Tun kal ka ngaklah ie pak hawih lunna gam nuom.
Aw ka ngai khenlohna gam nuom,
Lenguol lungtuokte tawh nawpna lasa’n;
Kipahna gen sengloh mui tiu,
I kipahna pen Hukdampa.
Gitloh meipi la kithiel gaw lo,
Kichamna Lal Zingsawl, hung nai kitin;
Nunnawpna Lal gam nuom zuon zel ungkau,
Thim leh lungkhamna hin pal bang ei nang mah leu.
Kapin hai bang ka ngak Immanuel,
Hinna damtui in sietlei chapsuok hen;
Nam tin di’n Saron pak hawih hun pienla,
Buoina mei zing nuoiah Lalpa ka ngak zing ui.
Lenguolte taikhuo vak ding ei tai,
Hehpih gam hawih ngo bangin a lang tai;
Thim thilhih paihin vak thuom a ngai tai,
Halleluia, ka Lal deihum ei umpih in.
V. T. Kappu
Pielgal ka ngai ka Lal lenna,
Lungkham umlohna gam nuom chu;
Bangtik leh ka tung dem?
Ka lungkhamna mitthi hi,
Bangtik leh a hul dem, tia ka ngaihtuoh in,
Ka ngaih Lalpa’n eihung puiin.
Hinna thingbak lim nuoi achun,
Keile ei chawlhsak in Lalpa;
Thepna chung sunni ka thuok zo puoi,
Hinna thing bak lim nuoi achun,
Kei le ei chawlhsak in Lalpa.
Khawvel dahum thuok zote chu,
A chungah puon In Na zakmaw?
Keile ei zak khum in,
Chawlhna mun nuom a um puoi;
Khawvel gamthip ahin, chawlhna ka deih vangin,
Thepna sunnipi a sa ie !
Zie khawvel gamgaw laka hin,
Chawlhna um dingin ka ngai a;
Chawlhna ding la umlo,
Chen den theihna la umlo,
Khawvel dahum ahi tih ka hetdawk phetin,
Ka ngai ie Hinna Thing limnuoi.
Aw Hinna Thing lim nuoi a chun,
Mi thiengthote a chawl zotau;
Kei hi bangti ka him?
Chawl theilo ka um hi;
Ka taksa hin ei nang hei lamdan ni tungleh,
Keile kichawl tang ka ting aw !
Laibata
Aw Lalpa, lungkham in ka dim hi,
Vangsiet na te’n ei um kimvel;
Kah leh mauna gamdai ahin,
Mitthi pumin Nang ka hun hawl hi.
Aw Lalpa, ka lungkhamna cheng cheng hi,
Na khuta ka hun vawpsak hi;
Nang mi lungkhamte Lalpa chun,
Kei lungkham le ei hung nemin.
Aw, Lalpa ka lungkhamna Nempa,
Nang lo chu laina ka nei puoi;
Kuo kawm dang em ka hun zawt ding,?
Nang mai ei khawtuohpa na hi ie.
Lungkham meipi keidi’n a zing hi,
Lal David bitna pen kulhpi;
Kei le hung kisel ding ka hi;
Gilo liengvai cha kei ka hung hi.
Malai Kanaan gam dung-le- vaiah,
Lungkham chate Na nem seka,
Gimthei chate’n a hun ngai ui,
Ken le ka ngaihpen chu Nang na hi.
Thangngur
Simlei nunnawp chawmcha bawn I thaklah chun,
Nunnawp tawplo van nawpna chu hawl hitiu;
$ Simlei maunan a dim hi,
Ken vang kipahna ka mu puoi; D.S
Nunnawp tawplo van nawpna chu hawl hitiu.
Hinna gimum chawmcha hi bawn I ngaih chun,
Kipah nawpna van hinna hi zawm hitiu,
$ Migilote chan ding chu,
Bible-in gawtmun a gen hi D.S
Kipah nawpna van hinna hi zawm hitiu.
Utleh, utloh thu him him chu dawng lo-in,
Nicheng thihnan sang tamtak a puimang zing,
$ Thih muon theihna I ngai ui,
Lei a umden ding I um puou D.S.
Thihna zopa Lal Krista hi bel hitiu.
Puipa I ngai zie khawvel gimum ahin,
Puipa I ngai khawvel I pawtsan nin le;
$ Thihna dak a hung tunga,
Van Ina ei tunsak dingin D.S.
Puipa I ngai Lal Krista Thagau ngei chu.
Patea
Nilopi hung tung ding ei tai,
Ka ngak ui Immanuel;
Gitloh leh thitha niem ni chu,
Hukdam chate I chamtatna ding niu.
Zie phat tieng chuleh lawpin la sang ka:
Lalgam guotsa kumsawt mun ding chang tang ka ting
A nuom na mai zen ding e, lawp a um na ding e!
Nun tawp lau loin leng tang ka.
Bangtik hi ding ei tam Lalpa,
Zawh na ni ka muh nang uh;
Leng in Jordan ka hung kaiha,
Nang di’n van aksi banga ka vak ding?
A hi ngut ie, kumsawt Lalpa,
Na khawpi satthak achun;
Na thisana Na chawksate,
‘Ka kawmah hung tauin,’ Na ti sek kha.
Aw, khawpi thak na hawih ngei ie,
Na sunga zosate leng;
A zawhnau la thak sak ding chu,
Khawvel beih taka dingin a kawihtau.
C.Z. Huala
Eden lui hi taihsan ding lam ahi,
Nichengin malam I en ui;
Buoina meipi kithiel ding dan ei puoi,
Kapa sunni tum a baihlam ngei.
Eden thak ka hun ngai na zen e,
Sunni tumin ginna’n ka hun en hi;
Aw, ma a ka len-guolte chiehsa cheng chu,
Nau bang nui siu sieuin ka mui.
Lungkham ka kah ni hin en vielleng chu,
Buoina meipi khela lang khu;
A hawih na e, lungdeihte tuollenna,
Lal Immanuel gam nuom ahi.
Khawvel a hin mang lo ding a um puoi,
Kapin lungdeih I tha zing ui;
Eden thak tuol nuoma lenghaw vang chu,
A kaplai nau bang a nui kit tau.
Ngai mah lengle na gam tun ma hin chu,
Ka kahna ding khuo a sawt ie;
Na guotsa gam thiengah ei pui in la,
Kap lai hi puon bangin bang tang ka.
Ka lungkham lunghel ni hin chu,
Aw, ka thil vel zie lei gam hi;
Lungngaih meipi’n tang cheng a bawm,
Ka tha lieng lungkham in a vai.
Aw ei puiin damlai lungkham,
Meipi zing nuoia hin;
Ei umpih in, Aw ka Lalpa
Kap lai chu hai ing ka.
Aw ka lung gulh aksi khel gam,
Angel vam lungguola lennau;
Kei lungkham liengvai ka kahna,
Lunggnaih meipi zing nuoi ahin.
Aw ka thagau na lungkhamna,
Zie lei dahum hi pawt san in;
Vakhu guolin va leng inla,
Gam nuom laituola leng dingin.
Zie chun lungkham kah leh buoina,
Um ta puona Kanaan gamah;
Aw Hukdampa ei pui zelin,
Thihna lui gal gam hawih achun.
V. Hawla
Ka Lal lenna Jerusalem thak chu,
Pakna gi hawih leh loipna chun a tuom;
A lopi zie pau tin chengten gen sek mahleu,
A kimkhat le a gen zo puou.
A kimkhat le a gen zo puou,
Khawpi hawih sung;
Lal chungnung pen Lalna,
A kimkhat kimkhen le a gen zo puou.
Mi thiengtho cheng cheng leh Angel vamte,
Khawpi sung suongmantam hawih chitin chengte;
Khang thak pilnel zat beih nunga le thak zel ding,
A kimkhat le a gen zo puou.
Namtin, chitin laka simsen lohte,
Nicheng Belam No Lalna gam a lut ui;
Thagau tamtak khawpi sung lutte kipahna,
A kimkhat le a gen zo puou.
Guolzo leh hinna Bu a min zikte,
Di’n Hukdampa chun A ngaihtuoh sak ahi;
A sepgim nau chawlhsan in Hukdampa vangin,
A hauhsakna chu chang tan au.
Doh is D
Ka buoina gamgaw gam ahin,
Ka Lal, ka Tanpa mel deihum;
Luigala A siem gamhaw tawh,
Ngaiin ka lung a helna e.
Zie gam hawih a chun chawl ingka,
Lalpa chenna gam hawih achun;
Vachawl ingka buoina khelah,
Kei di’n kumsawt gal muonna ah.
“Mun siem ingka, Lalpa’n A tii,
Gingchate kipaka chawlhna’ng;
Nagaita puongka ka khawvel hin,
A siem gam chu ka tun tieng leh.
Lei ah liengin mun neilo in,
Gamgaw dahum ah vak mahleng,
Lalpa’n kei dinga A siemah,
Chawl ingka luipi gal achun
Lasai tiu, Lalpa chawian in,
Belam No thahsa thokit chun;
“Hung kit tei ding ka hi” a tii,
Lawpun lungkhamte kipak un.
“Nang ka Lalpau leh ka Pathien deih uh,
Lopina leh chawihatna leh thilhih theihnahaw chu
Kitupna zieka mu ding mawng na hi,
Nangin thil bangkim Na siema Na deih zieka um leh siem,
Chu ahi chiet ngal un”
“Belam No a thahsapau khan,
Van lalchutphaha chûn,
Zie khawvel vai hi hawm ina,
Angel vamten a tiu.
Lalchutphah a chu leh A thilsiem te’n,
‘Belam No kawma chun vangphat nate, chawihat nate;
Lopinahaw leh vaihawmna haw chu
Kum khawsawtin um zing ta hen, a tih u chu ka he a.
Thilhing lite cheng chun.
“ Zie puonvam silhte hi kuote a him,
Khawilama kipata hung ahiu em?” ti’n ei na dawnga
Kei chun a kawmah “Na hei” Ka na tii,
Aman ka kawma “Ziehaw hi hun haksa taka pawtte
Kha a hiu hi” A tii.
Kamlala
Kapin a tau ngei puou,
Buoina a zo tau hi;
Van Salem khawpia,
Lai tuol lengten;
$ Gitloh gal a zotau,
Thihna a lau ta puou,
Aw, kipakin la a sau (2) D.S.
Aw khawvel ka etin,
Thimin a tuom zing hi;
Lungkham lusun chate,
Kapin a mau;
$ Nau bang I nuihnau le,
Tuoiin muol a liem hi,
A w ka gam ding ka ngai hi. (2) D.S.
Aw, thisan, na vangin,
Khawpi tun ka kinem;
Lui gala lungtuokte,
Kimna gam nuom;
$ Aw, ei pui kai in la,
Angel vamte lakah
Aw zaila sak ka nuom hi (2) D.S.
Khen lohna gam ka ngai ie;
Immanuel gam nuom;
Lungtuok gibang khennang lenkawl ah ni a suok,
Ka ngai khenlohna Zion tang hawih chu.
Ka ngai ie van khaw tuol nuom,
Gi bang khenlohna mun;
Ka Lal mel leh hinna tuolthing;
Saron pak hawih a lun.
Van Jerusalem hawih ah,
Hinna damtui a luong;
Mita muhlouh gam leh hinna tuolthing lim nuoi,
Salem tuolnuom ah nau bang ei pui in.
Lalna gam khawpi achun,
Van Belam No A leng;
Zan thim lungngaihna leh nau bang kahna umlo,
Zing dawng sawl No vakna gam ninnuom ah.
Lalna khawpi chanchin chu,
Gensen guol ahi puoi;
Lal Hukdampa leh serafim zaila sakna,
Lal tuollenna Zion tang lopi chu.
Zumi
Ka maah luigal khuo hawih chu a um,
Tun ka ngaklah khawpi hawih chu;
Lungdeih cheng cheng a kimnau mun,
Muh nuomin ka thil chim thei puoi.
Aw chieh lai I hiu, kichawl puoi tiu;
Lalpa hatna suongin, khawpi hawih zuon hitiu.
Zie khawpi hawih lam chu zuon zel hitiu,
Chawllo in chieh zel hitiu ie;
Galmuonna mun him a um puoi,
Lalpa kawm I tun ma cheng un.
Hechien maizen leng chu pak chim puong ka,
Gal lauhna ah leng mah leng le;
Van mun lopi tun tieng chu leh,
Pakna la daih ka gingcha puoi.
Aw, van Thagau Thiengtho hung leng inla,
Lung gilo khaksa hawng kitin;
Na gam hawihah ei pui inla,
Kipah tawp ngei lohna achun.
Siamliana
Jordan luipanga ka din chun,
Ka thil Lalpa chenna gam nuom;

Ei tatna thisan lun ziekin;
Kumsawta hinna chang dingin,
Namtin chitin a dingin A hawng tai.
Aw zie muna chun leng dingin,
Lalpa, Na hatnan ei puiin,
Khawvel nunnawp beimanna hi,
Ngaiin en nawn puong ie nunlui gam hi.
Hehpihna Lal gam zuon dingin,
Aw ka lautha nang le hawlin;
Khawvel hawihnan hun sam mah leh,
Lili pak Lal nunnem in A hun ngak.
Thangngur
Khawvel in “Sesum leh sana,
A lul,” ti’n a hawl viel ui,
Mahleh a lulnau chun Pielgal a tun zo puoi,
Van hawihnan Pielgal a salhvak
Ziechuh ahi ka gen nuom.
A chanchin gen thiem leng Aw thangvan khu,
A hawih zie gen thiem leng aw ka Lal lenna;
Mitin in suilung in gulh leu,
Van In nuomah hung lawi leu.
Khawvel lopina leh hawihna,
Ni tam tak a liem zo tai;
Mahleh van hawihna chu, khangthak tamtak beih nung
A thakin a hawih deuh deuh hi
Ziechuh ahi gen takpen.
Van In hawih lopi leh sang chu
Kawt chu khuna lut ahi
Aw Kalvari tang leh, Bethlehem bawng In ah
Kuol ding leh Kross A put ding khan
Kuo Lal puon tawh a chieh dem ?
Bangtik leh ka vaihna gam leh
Ka kahna gam hi beiin
Thangvan gam lopi leh hawih gen senloh gam lun
A bukim in a hung tung dem
A ngaiin nau bang ka kap.
Rev. Mangdal
Mim bang pienna nuoi simlei ah,
Melma dogal siel ang a lien;
Sanggah keia ding tumin,
Van nuoi thimpi a zing ie.
Aw van Lal chungnung pen
Ka limbelh Lal nunnem
Felna ni vak tuoi lo, Zion Lal
Ka lampi thim hun salhvak in
Lam bang etchim loh ngaih minsel
Chun leh zuo ngaihpan a sam ie
Zuomang chung Pathien ang lai,
Sihsiel ang na zuon ta maw?
Ngaih ding dieng, na nung sul ahin
Sung In giel tui bangin a dai
Kuongtap la mei a val lo
Dahluot huiva bang ka mau.
Khen lohna chatuon khawpi ah
Ngilhloh cheng tuoi loin laileng
Hin tuoilo nawp kipan ding
Chatuon lal, limbelh ang ah
Zingdawng Sawl No suoh ka ngaklah
Tatsa tui bang luongkhawm ta ding
Lalpa’n tui bang ei gawp tieng
Dah cheng sawl ang bang tang ie.
Zion kawlni, hung suok mengin
Melma dogal cheng tawmna di’n
Salem Lal Thimthu lel tieng
Lei do cheng dah muolsuok ding.
Thangngur
Lei hi a ngui zo tai
A chunga mihiem haw tawh
Gitlohna leh gimtheih na’n a dim zo
I mi ngaihum hawu leh,
Guolpha a chieh zotau.
Aw Belam nunnem in,
Gam thak, A va bawl chu;
Aw, ka thagau nang le
Zie gam nuom chu hawl in
Khawvel pawtsan tienga
Na umna mun dingin
Dikna gam a zo tau
Aw, kumsawt gam lun ding chu
Lei gimum hi albang in mang mahleh,
Lal Krista na gin chun
Gam thak ah leng inla.
Ma a pi leh pute’n
A muh phak loh uh gam chu,
Thisan zalin ken ka na mu ta ie,
A zawtna lampi chu
Lal Krista hi ahi.
V.T. Kappu
Ginnan Kalvari tang chung achun,
Gam ngaihum leh khuo thiengtho a lang ie;
Mi thiengthote lenna,
Zie khawpi chu kei le ka tun tieng,
Damsung buoina leh gimum hin,
Ei chuppha ta puona.
Ei chuppha puona tih ka het in,
‘Hallelujah’, ti’n Lalpa ka pakcha’i;
Ei na tatdawk ziekin;
Gitloh gikpuo leh thiemloh changsa;
Thisan in thiem ei chansak hi,
Gam hawih a leng dingin.
Gam hawih achun keile ka len tieng,
Khawvel gimum hi zuk gal thil ka ting;
Ka vakvaih na gam hi,
Ziechun ka mitthi pawt ta puona,
Ka Lalpan ei umpih intin,
Nunglam ngai ta puong ka.
Lalpa ngaia ka mauna gam hi,
Ka thagau in a pawtsan zawh tieng leh;
Lalpa’n ei pui intin,
A thazak chungah ei chuonsak in,
Jordan tui kinawk lauhum chu;
Ei lenkaih pih tana.
Zalawma
Van gam lopi tak chanchin,
Kuo ahim a genthei ding ?
Lungkhamna lei gimuma I len lai hin ?
Hukdampa Isu Krista’n sinsak a hehpih kawmah,
Van gam lopi zie chu a na hetsak tai
Aw van gam hawih leh nuom tak chu,
Len guol kima kikhen lohna gam ahi;
Hehpihna gam hawih zam vel,
Lopina vak hawih zam vel,
Keile tung ka, zie gam hawih leh nuomtak chu,
Zie khawpi vak hawih tak chu,
A min Jerusalem thak;
A khuo umna bang chu suongmantam ahi,
Mi gen minthang sana leh dangka a zephawih ahi;
A umna tuikawk suonga zephawih ahi.
Zie khawpi nuom tak achun,
Nisa vak a ngai ta puoi;
Tha leh aksi vak haw le ngai ta puona;
Lalpa chu a vak hin tin, Ho In le um ta puona;
Lalpa Isu mu’n Amah chu ho tai tiu.
A hehpihna leh phatna,
Chu chawian in la sai tiu;
Lungkhamna leh gitloh kihdak-umna haw,
Kidona um ta puon tin In hawih lopi kawtkhak ah;
Lalpa hehpihte mai chu lut thei unau.
Zamgen
Sietlei hingmi zatam suilung damna dingin,
Min lun Chung Pathien in vawn tuoidawng ei chawihsak;
Tuni hin ken le ka pawm hi ka etchim loh,
Chung Pathien in veng hen A vanglim nuoi ahin.
U leh nau in kipakin ei lawppih chiet un,
Kipahna chul theilo go thil bang ei piek hi;
Paktil bangin chawi hitiu nausen deihum hi,
A dam kumkhuo sawt hen a vanglim nuoi ahin.
A chun leh zuo’n kumsawta ka lungtup pen uh,
Thimthu leh laigilah siktui in um mahleh;
Chung Pathien venna leh thahatna zalzo in,
Anglai a pawmin vawnsen sakmel I mu tai.
Lawp chim puong ie vawnsen tuoi til dawng lai cha hi,
Chung Pathien leh a chun leh zuo suihlung tuok di’n;
Chang bang damin laituol nga bangin leng hen la,
Suihlung pilin a hinkhuo gui bangin sau hen.
Malsawmna lien, vangphatna lien thilthawnpiek hi,
Nausen deihum laigila pieng vawntuoidawng hi,
Gentheia alang vailo dingin sietlei ah,
Chung Pathien in khawtuoh zing ta hen la, Amen
Lienrum
Ka vakvaih na gam thip gamdai hi chu,
Dah a um nalawm lawm sek na e!
Khenna ni leh dak atung hi,
Ka guol leh ka pai ngaih haw hi.
Ana na e maw! Aw ka Lal nunnem,
Thagau thiengtho in hung inla;
Na hungtun kal ka ngak lah ui,
Ka gam uh lungsiet um sungah.
Zie malgam tangpi thavai chung ahin,
Na tha zakin Lal Immanuel;
Tatsa dawng ngikngiek hawcha hi,
Aw ka Lal nunnem hung entan.
Tuonna ei suonte Evi leh Adam
Lalpa’n a guot Eden huon thiengah,
Eden huon hawih tuola lenglai
Aw ka Lal nunnem na chan maw!
Aw Lalpa Pathien leh thagau thienglim
Eden hehpihna huih a nun lai hin
Thisan paktan a lenghaw chung,
Thepna meipi hun hawk kieng ta’n.
Lienrum
Chung Pathien vangsakna go thil
Vawnsen deihum kei di’n tuoilo pak
Muh loh laigil a damtui bang vung
Vawnsen pallai kei di’n a hung vul
Pak bang chawi ka, kei ngaih ding dieng
Chang bang damin suihlung pil hen
Sakmel eta pawm chim loh vawnsen
Laigil vangsakna go thilpha
Tuona chung Pathien thimthu tiemsa
Kei din vawn dawng a hung pak san sel
Sakmel deihum tuoisen chul mawh hen.
Chung Pathien vang gobang channa,
Vawnsen pallai zatam suihlung nem pen
Zuo chung Pathien, Na banzal nuoiah,
Ka hun piei damsung Nang nasem ding.

songs.title: Aw Pathien Na Min Lien Hen

lines: Khaikhawmang
Tune S.S 380
Doh is D
Thilsiem chung Pathien Min zanglawi bang thang hen,
Simlei nam tinin zailan chawi-an hen la
Aw Lalpa, Na thilsiem te hi vang hun pie’n
Na ma ah ka hun lan ui.
Thilsiem chung Pathien zaitha hat vangin
Thaithak sakmel kipahum I mu tau ie
Chawian un Lalpa a lien a neute haw
Aw Pathien, Na min lien hen.
A lien a neu lungtuok na Thilsiem Pathien
Thang hen la, lien hen, Na min kawl kimvel ah
Enkawl in, Aw chung Pathien, Na thilsiem te,
Sing zatam guo bang hinna’n.
Zaila leh thimthu’n chawian un, Lal Minlun,
A thilsiem haw gen vielun, kawl kimvel ah;
Van nuoi mi zatam guo bang I hinna di’n,
Chawian un, Lalpa Pathien.
Rev. K. Thuomngel
Lalpa chu chawian hitiu,
A lungsietna I muh u hin;
Thilsiem chengin,
Amah chawihatna la sau hen la,
Ei khawtuohna a let ziekin.
Lungsietna thilpiek, thaithak kipah um,
Kipahna la sa’n lawm hitiu;
Aman guoh zu, nisa, khawlum leh khaw vawt,
Thaichi gahna dinga ei piek ziekin;
Chawih-atin um hen, chawih-atin um hen, um hen.
Chawih-atin um hen, Amen.
Thaichi chu I va tuh a,
Hih theih dang bangmah I nei puoi;
Mah leh Lalpa
Hatna a etkawla umin tun,
Thaithak kipahum I mu tau.
Mel muh loh ginna mita
Ena sawttak hai bang I ngak;
Lalpa lungsietna vanga-
Etkawla um in tun,
Thaithak sakmel I mu tau ie.
Lalpa, ka hun chawian ui,
Na lungsietna ka muh u hin;
Ka pawihmawh chenguh Nangin,
Nei ngaihtuoh sak zela,
Chawih-atin um zing ta’n, Amen.
Sawngkhawkhai
Chung Pathien sam suihin tuona pi leh pute,
A kigawm ui sietlei luoh ding, vawnchawi di’n;
Chung Pathien lai tanna thimthu gui bang zawtin
Sietlei chungah vawn zatam chibang a hun theh ui
Aw Lalpa, ka ngetnau ngaiin
Zie thutiem hi Nang hun zawmin
Tu-a lungsietna gui khau bang zawp hi
Chin leh tuoi leh guol lungtuok ten
Chung Pathien leh lei mite angah
Ka hetpih chiet ui
Lalpa, Na dan thienga chawnban hun zawmte hin
Zuomang min siel thimthu duh ai bang samin
Damlai kawlni a liem man pallai lo bang chul leh
Thimthu tiemah kumsawt in kigawm det uh hen
Tuon leh tanga pi pu lung mawlte dungsun in,
Pai tin chawia ki lungsietna tawplo di’n
Chung Pathien samsuih thutiem lam bang pel loin
Phunglai chawi thiem pai kuoh di’n Aw Lalpa vang hun pie’n.
Upa Rokunga
Doh is E
Ma khan Eden huon thiengtho
Mun hawih leh nuom taka khan
Ei suonte Evi leh Adamte chu
Chung Pathien guot bang zelin
Nupan tuok khat hung suokin pumkhata siem a hiu
Lawptak in kipahpih hitiu
I suohpih teu nupan hi
Pathien in vangpie hen la veng bit zel hen
A khawvel damlai niu a beih masieh in.
Chunga Pathien samsuih in
Pumkhat in a kisiem ui
Lal ma ah khenloh thimthu kitiem ui
Tichun Pa deih lam guolin
Dah leh nawpsak lai in le a thutiem uh det hen
Lalpa ka hun vawpsak ui
Ka suohpih teu nupan hi
Damlai go lul vangsakna hun pien la
Amau di’n ni bang vakin
A damlai niu a tum tieng leh Na kawmah puiin.
Upa Rokunga
Doh is G
Siempa Pathien in lei danin,
Ma a Ana siem chu;
Pasal changa um phal loin,
Panpih ding A siem tai.
Lawpin chawian hitiu,
Kichenna thiengtho hi,
Khen loh thim thu a tiem u hi,
Nangma’n vang hun pien la.
Lungkham leh buoina a thawk un,
Nangman thawkpih zelin;
A chung u ah ni bang vakin,
Vangsakna’n hun vukin.
Na min loin thu a tiem tau
Nangman na hetpih in;
Khenlohna khut a suih u hi,
Kanin, hehpih gui in.
Rev. Thuomngeil
Ei suonteu kawma chung Pathien A thuguot chu,
Nupan leh pumkhat a hung uma;
A suonteu sietlei chung luoh dima,
Ganhing leh thilsiem chunga leng chang di’n;
Chungnunna chu A pie tai.
Aw, Lalpa panpih in a thutiem uh nit di’n,
Chawnban kiluoia a thutiem uh;
Vang hun pien la, chang bang damin,
A sietlei hinkhuou gui bang sau hen.
A thutiem uh nit din lunggil dik tak hun pien la,
Kihehpih a ki-enkawl tuoh di’n;
Phungbang vukin, vawn zatam chawi din,
Damsunga Lal nasema kimang di’n,
Nang vawp inla pui zelin.
Chung Pathien min loa, kitiem in a kigawm tau,
Sam gi bang kikhen kit talo din;
A nuom a haka kipanpih di’n,
A kithutiem nau suguitung dingin,
Lal Pathien in umsak hen.
Zie kichenna hi Lalpa Nangin hetpih inla,
Krista leh Sapchuom etsak dik di’n,
Na min lopina hung hi hen la,
Sietlei hinkhuo beihman A chung u ah,
Chung sunni bangin vakin.
Isu neih hinna nuom,
Kipahna thuguk chu;
Ka thagau muonna ei pie’i,
Isu neih chauh kipahna.
Isu neih chitna bulpi,
Isu neih hauhna bukim;
Isu neih chu vannuoi tawh kikhenna.
Isu neih hinna nuom,
Mihau hawn neizo lo;
Miching hawn a hethiem puou,
Kuo zieka dangchak ahim?
Van Kanaan ka In ding,
Khawvel ka khuolzinna;
Aigupta a hak taluo’i,
Ka Lal Isu ei puiin.
Ken Isu kanei hi,
Genviel leng vannuoi ah;
Taksanna’n ka muchien tai,
A thihna mel Kross bul ah.
Lal na semtu te a kiting puou,
Lalgam panpih ding I um puou maw?
Kumsawt gawtmun lam chu zuonin,
Thagau simsen loh a beimang zing ui.
Aw Krista a ding a pasalphate,
Simsen loh te a man zing lai un;
Mangthai dingte I puihloh chun,
Lalpa kawmah bang I gen dem ?
A thisan mawh I khut ah na ngen in a.
Lal nasemtu te a tawm taluou,
Panpihtu ding guol a ngai nau e
Panpihtu ding I um puou maw ?
I Lalpau bangziek a gimthei a him ?
Lal nasemtu te a tawm taluou,
Lalpa Isun nangle a hun sam,
Khawvel kipahna bei pai ding
Hun taihsan in Lalpa dingin sem in
Lal na semte panpih a ngai ui
I thil neihteu khawi ah a um tam ?
Lalpa gama dingin piei tiu,
A hun tawk nai puoi, a huntawk nai puoi.
Lienkhawpau
Khawvel buoiumna khel lam akhun,
Lalpa’n gam khat A guot a,
Zie chu A mi telte chenna dingin,
Zie chu A mi telte chenna dingin,
Lal lemguot hawih leh thuk chu ahi. (2)
I khawsaknau chu van ahi ngala,
Zie apat chun Hukdampa I ngak zing,
Bangkim A thu’n a hih theih ziekin,
I tawmlai taksau hunsiem lopi in a.
Lei avang ling-le-khau a tama,
Gu leh thang in a dim zo,
Ginna tha zap in leng sang sang chiet hitiu,
Ginna tha zap in leng sang sang chiet hitiu,
Lalpa siem van sang nunnuom akhun. (2)
Leng leng leu hing chung thangvan akhun,
Sietlei hi nungtieng sawn in,
Thih-le-nat mei zinna khel lam akhun,
Thih-le-nat mei zinna khel lam akhun,
Van Lal lung chu su awi ngei hitiu. (2)
Chunglam akhun na mit len zingin,
Hukdampa na ngak hitiu,
Chunglam, chunglam, chunglam, en zing hitiu,
Chunglam, chunglam, chunglam, en zing hitiu,
Ei pui ding van a khawsa I hiu. (2)
Upa Rokunga
flat
Doh is A
Lalpa, Na vangsakna lopi
Tuhin ka chang kit tau
Ka khut tawmuh vang Na pie a
Temple hawih Na In sak na’n.
Lalpa Jeho Na min lopina ding
Na thagau Thiengtho in ei hung luohpih in
Na In thiengtho hung hi hen la,
Hung chengin Nang di’n ka pieu.
Aw nanga dinga semgim te’n
Kipahman chang u nau
Tu a patin kumsawt chanin
A kipahnau sang ina.
Lalpa zie In lopi ahin
Thupha ka hun chawih un
Na ngaihdamna Aw hawih tak chun
Ei dawngin. Na In ahin
Thagau chau di’n chawlhna In nuom
Van guol a vakna ah
Gilkiel, dangchakte lut unau,
Kumsawt kipahna mun au.
K. Siema 1977
Solomon leh Nehemia Puitu
Ka lam u-ah Nangmah hung pangin
Ho-In zawhin a um taa,
Jerusalem Temple guol khan luohin
Thagau Thiengtho in hun luoh in
Na min thieng lopina ding leh
Hatlo te hat thakna dingin
Vangpiek na’n hun thuomin, Lalpa
Na Ho-In thieng sunga hung lut a
A gitloh nau thupha hung chawia
Nangmah masang a hung khunte
Kalvari thisan zalin ngaidam in.
Na chanchin Pha thu gentute leh
Na Ho-In sunga nasemtu te
Panpihtu nai zing ka Lalpa
Panpih in Thagau Thiengtho in thuomin
Khawvel mite thuneihna ding leh
Nang helote vaihawmna dingin
Aw Lalpa, Nangin phal ki’n la
Vengtu dingin Cherub ka ngen Lalpa.
Sawngkhawkai
Chunga Lautha hung leng inla,
Mi tin lunggilah hung chengin
Ka khutsuok uh In tawm nuoi ah,
Kumkhuon Lautha’n hung chengin
Aw hung chengin
Lung gilo dawngkawt hawng kit in la
Lopina Lalpa
Mitin lunggil ah hung chengin
Lei mihing khutsuok tawm tak
Na Temple in hung chansak in la
Mi tin lunggil ah hung cheng in.
Kuom bang luoh ding sau-In tawm
Na In thiengtho hung hi hen la
Tuona gamdai lengvan lummei
Lautha’n vabang hung buolin
Lalpa Na vangsakna lopi
Lawpin tunin ka chang kit tau
Ka thilbawl uh ka thilpiek teu
Na lopina hung hi hen.
T. Khuma
Doh is B
Aw Lal Pathien Na kawmah kipah thu ka gen ui,
Na lungsietna’n nei na enkawl in nei pui khawm hi;
Thisan zieka unau mun tin, gamtina mite,
Na min pakcha leh chawian dingin ka kikhawm ui.
Ka kikhawppi nau hi (2)
Aw Lalpa nangin vang hun pien la,
Na min lopina dingin;
Na Thagau Thiengtho in ei pawl zingin.
Ka vaihawmteu hi Nangin hun panpih zing inla,
Na gam let na’nga kitup taka vaihawm dingin;
Amau leh a lawiteu chung ale chingthei taka,
Vaihawm dingin chitna leh lemhet na’n hun thuomin.
Thagau a dingin vangsakna ka muhna dingun,
Na chanchin Pha gente Nangin hun panpih inla;
Hinna thak, hatna thak, kipahna thak mu dingin,
Aw nang ngeiin Na chanchin Pha hun phuongin ka tiu.
Aw Lalpa, Pathien ka ngetnau Na kawm tung henla,
Na mina hung kikhawm na lungsiet-Na mite hin;
Ka hatnau, ka thiemnau ka hun pieu na gam letna,
Dingin Na vangpieknan ei hun vukin, Aw Lalpa.
Hun tui bangin a luong zinga,
I khawvel damlai niteu le;
Ngak neilo-in sunni chengin muol a liem zel,
Khawvel nunnawp albang mang zel;
Hawlin ni chengin ka uma,
Muong ta kiu un, suohpihte haw,
Tawpna ni a nai tai
Khawvel ahin nawpna hawlin,
Sang tampi thanmuol ah liem zel;
Mahleh nawpna mu leh neite, nei den um lo,
“Muonna, bitna,” a tih lai un;
A tawpnau phat hungtung intin,
Muong ta kiu un suohpihte haw,
Tawpna ni a nai tai.
Aw hung tiemu u-leh-naute,
Hukdamna thu hung ngaithau in;
I Lalpau hehpih Aw nem in A hun sam hi.
Na hun kikhelhsak sak ta ki’n,
Na chan ding chu ka ngai ngam puoi,
Muong ta kiu un, suohpihte haw,
Tawpna ni a nai tai.
Thihna’n zawh lah a nei puoha,
Natna’n le lauh a nei diek puoi;
Gawtmun inle kuomah gawt zawhloh a nei puoi,
Hukdamna thu na ngaih loh chun,
Na chan ding chu ka ngai ngam puoi,
Muong ta kiu un, guol-le-paite,
Tawpnan hun huom khan a.
Zailan awi ing ka hun sang muol liem chu,
Zatam dinga kipahna chu,
Simsen loh di’n nau bang kahna,
Albang dah hin lawpin Lalpa angah.
Mung ka ie nunlui muol liem nung,
Pek tin chungah chuong mahleh gitlohna gal lien,
Na felna zalin kei lungngai puong ie.
Eden thim nuoiah nau bang ka kap ui,
Na gam nuom thangvan ka tun tieng,
Ka gitloh teu tui bang thieng ding,
Lal Immanuel gam ninnuom achun.
Hehpihna thak zel ding lam thil ingka,
Hun sangmuol liem ni puon bang thak,
Thagau Thiengtho ei hihhalh in,
Albang dah ei nemin, khuo vaksak in.
K. Thuomngell
Tune:S.S 976
Nunnawpna hun kum deihum
Zamuol na liem ding chu
Suihlung khuombang ka gelin
Suihlung na suhel ngei
Sim lei namtin vawn chawihte
Nunnuoma ka lennau
Zamuolpi na liem ding chu
Aw ka hun phal puou
Na vangletna zal zoin
Nunnuom in ka leng ui
Thiemna, chitna, nek leh chak
Na vangsakna ka muu
Chung Pathien phatna zalin
Seino guol haw cheng tawh,
Chang bang dama nunuom in
Na sung ka leng ui.
Kumsul vei, aw nang hun pha,
Khangthak guolte pienna;
Chung Pathien vangsakna thil,
Go deihum ka chan nau,
Za muolpi na liem ding chu.
Bangma’n nang thei puontin;
Chang bang damin chieh ta’n la,
Zal mangpha manin.
Vankhama
flat
Doh is A
I hinkhuou leh ninnuom puon bang chulsa,
Pak bang tuoiin sangmuol a liem zo tai;
Mu bang ngaiin nau bang kap mahleng le,
Lenthang kumkhuo zatam in ei hal tai.
Muikhuo zina chung sawl tha vak nuoia,
Theisen lawm guol nau bang kilawp lai kha;
Zamuol liemin chung thangvan tuol nuom ah,
Hai bang ei ngak, ngaih lenpul do mah leng.
Hun leh phat kum sang a hung beih tieng leh,
Zuo min lun sietlei leh thangvan Siempa’n;
Hinkhuo ninnuoma lenpul I do hih,
Tuoi theilo in puon bang ei vuk ina.
Ka hun pakchau lenthang kumkhuo kihei,
Khanno guol di’n vangphatna hung hi’n la;
Zatam ma lo tui bangin hung nem hen,
Kumsul veisa thavang ngailo dingin.
Hung un, hung un, Lalpa chawian hitiu.
A lungsiet hengilh ding kuo ahim?
Kum tunga damtaka ei vengpa ahi,
Kumsawt kumsawt in Amin lopi zing hen.
Kum lui mangta ni leh tha kum kihei ta,
Tuzing kumthak ni no a hungsuok;
Khum zawl apat hungtho dawkun taisieu in,
Kipak in lawm hitiu, ni no hungsuok hi.
Hinkhuo tawpa chieh masa I ngaih teu chu,
Tuni’n van gam nuomah a leng ui;
Bang di’n lei ah amau puldo ding I him?
Kum tunga ei vengpa Pathien chawian un.
Kipahna thu leh sepgah chawiin hung un,
Tuni’n Pathien a hung vang pie di’n:
Hukdampa’n na chanchin na phuon a deih hi,
Kum tunga mawhna phuongin suol haihsan ta’n.
Kum lui thai ting kum thak lawpna’n lasai tiu,
Na bawn un Inkuon in hungtel un;
Dan leh Pa vangpiek na cha’nte kisik ding,
Kipak in lawp hitiu, Pa leh Hukdam pa.
Lal Krista Hukdampa Lalpen,
Chawian zing hitiu mi tin in;
Kipaka kikhawm kit dingin,
A lungsietnan ei na hukdam hi.
Chawian zing hitiu I Lalpen chu,
A ven bitna zieka damin;
Kikhen pihsa guol ngaihhaw tawh
Kipak takin I ki mukit tau.
Krista mina suohpih ngaihte,
Na meluh muh ka kinem ui;
Nei lamtuohnau welcome phung leh,
Khuong pi gitin ka lung a hel ie.
Nei na lamtuohnau la hawih hin,
I chung thangvan khu le thawng hen;
Leisiet mi leh van mi thiengte’n,
Lalpa pakna’n la sa khawm u hen.
Zie guol chun ni tawpni tieng leh,
Ei lamtuoh hen van Angelte’n;
Thagau Thieng hung leng hen tunin;
I lunggil nguisau hung hihhalh hen.
Mit muh phak loh gam apatin
Tun ka mu tai ka guol ngaihte,
Pathien chawihatna ni hi hen,
A min thieng lopi zing hen, Amen.
Chawian hitiu Lalmang chungnungpen chu
A lungsietnan ei na huoia
Thih leh natna apatin ei hukdam a,
Dam takin I kimuhtuoh kit chiet tau ui
Aw chawian hitiu, I Hukdampau chu
Sim leh mal, sak leh thanga kikhensa;
Kipakin I kimu kit ui, Lalpa minin
A paknan Aw gi hen, Hallelujah. !
Ka hun lamtuoh ui zie welcome phung ahin;
Ka changlam un ka hun sang ui
Krista chamna leh lungmuonna chang chiet un
Kipah nunnawp ni hi hen Krista minin.
Kipah nawpna halhna thakin leng kit hen
Lunggil leh thagau nguisa le
I chennau thingtang leh I sau gawngsa le
Lal Krista chawian din no kit hen tuni’n.
Laibata
Lungguol takin Lalpa, ka lennau tang chungah
Kalvari tui hing ka dawnpih teu kha
Chawmlo kalin lenna tang dang ding ahi.
Aw na chieh nang tuonglam sau mahleh lau loin
Galhat Lalpa’n na ma pui ina
Dam takin guol ngaih chiehin
Lalpa vangsak in.
Aw na chieh lai ni chun Kraws chu bangmah lele
Lalpa Thagau Thiengtho in hun pui ina
Lungkhamna meipi leh gallien tawng zelin
Leia len-guol khen cheng Zion tang hawih chungah
Ginnan I lengkhawm ui lung kipakin
Hinna Thing leh ka Lalpa tha lim nuoiah.
Lianvela
Alang dahna lenvui a kai,
Simlei gamdai ah;
Lalpa mina guol lungtuok te,
Khenna kawlni a suok.
Gibang khen zo puong ie (2)
Aw ka len-guol ngaihte,
Lalpa, Na Lautha hung lengin,
Sun naubang ei nemin.
Sun leh zanin ninnawp zai lan,
Na min ka pak ui;
Gibang khenna lenkawl a eng,
Albang dahnan ei bawm.
Na sakmin chem bang chawian kau,
Lautha ninnawp na’n;
Na lungsiet lenvui kai nuoiah,
Van mi nun ka sin ui.
Gibang kikhen mah leu ungle,
Lautha ei puiin;
Lungkham lenpul khuombang do hi,
Naubang ei hung nemin.
Hun leh ni lenkawl a liem
Lungtuok gibang khennan
Albang dahna meipi’n ei bawm,
Gibang khenlohna gam ka ngai
Lal nunnem vang khawpi thak nuom
Aw, lungtuokte, kikhen tai tiu
Damtakin zal mangpha
Pathien galvan bukim lau inla
Nuoi zinmang dogal zo zel dingin
Albang dah luonthi nula
Lungdeih gi bang khente
Khaubang chieh lai veng zelin la
Thepna dogal hung lien mahleh
Lalpa Nangin mapui zelin
Zion thimthu sut dingin
I lennau dang mahleh
Hinna lenkawl enna munah
Mi thiengtho leh Angel te tawh
Kumsawt laituol ah leng taitiu.
Thangngur
A bei huoi huoi ie I damlai niuhaw hi
I kipahnau muol a liem kit sek
Vaihkit gawleu a kilawm puoi
Ngai in thil mah leng le.
Lungdeih len-guol ngaihte kikhen tadih mah leng
Lawp leh nuomin lungguol takin;
Damlai lam suk leh to ahin
I Lalpau na chu sem hitiu.
Zan thim nuoi leh sun lunghelna ahin le,
Lei gim theihna hin ei chawkbuoi sek;
I lungkham nau kipah suok hen,
A kaplai hai hitiu.
Lalpa, ei kai in Aw len-guol deih cheng tawh
Na lenna zaila tawh zuon thei din
Kikhen na him lau ta puong kau
Lungkham buoina khelah.
Mitthi thieka kikhenna a lau ta puou
Aksi khel gam nuoma lengte khun
Zaila a sau gihawih cheng tawh
Lopina gam nuomah.
Kamlala
Dam sungin I Tanpau vangin,
Nunnuom in kikhawm mah leu hing;
Kapin I kikhen kit sek ui,
Aw ka ngai khenlohna gam nuom.
Hukdampa vangkhuo sat thakah,
Simlei a gibang kikhen te;
Kumsawt Lalchutphah kimvel in,
Aw bangtik leh I kikhawm dem ?
Ngo bang a lang Kalvari ah,
Galdawt leng khenlohna gam chu;
Nga bang lenna tang dang mahleh
Ginnan laituol lengkhawm hitiu.
Theibang lo leng Lalpa sakmin,
Thawmhau liengvai ei nem dingin
Naubang ei nem ding a um puoi
Sam tui bang tawm simlei nunnawp.
Nuoi simlei ahin le Ama’n
A lungsietna tha lim nuoiah
Nunnawp laituol lengkhawm kit di’n
Chang bang damin ei pui khawm ding.
A hehpihna zieka ninnuom a kikhawmte,
Ka hung kikhen zak u hin Hukdampa;
Nau bang ei nem ding sietlei ah um lo,
Minlun Isu’n nau bangin ei nemin.
Aw Lal Isu ka lung-u-ah chengin,
Nei umpih in lunghel liengvai chate;
Na melah lungmuonna a um,
Ka hun ngai zing zieng ui.
Sietlei hi chu kapa kikhenna mun ahi,
Aw Lal Isu Na hehpihna vanga;
Na kumsawt gama tui bang kigawp tieng,
Kikhen kit ta puong kau Nang hun gingte.
Lunghel khuom bang do in Lal Isu ka hun sam,
Nga bang hung lengin ka lungthim u-ah;
Zingsawl Aksi sangin Na vak hawih zawi,
Na mel muonna leh kipahna’n a dim.
Lienvela
Khawvel ahin lungkham chate,
Sak, Thang, Sim leh Mala;
Kimuh ni hin Lalpa Isu ei lawp in la,
Lung kiguola na hehpihna chu gel khawmin;
Khawvel kahna cheng hih mangin.
Na Thagauin ei hih dimin,
Khawvel kah lai haiin;
Hun lawp ungkau Aw Na hehpihte hin,
Ma khan a hun deih puou;
Aw lopi takin hung leng ta’n.
Ka hilh ka gen chim theihloh te,
Na vanga lengkhawm in;
Kalah thimthu a gen u maw Na thisan in,
Muol tin leh tang tin gam tin apat hung khawmte;
Aw leng inla pawl thiengtho in.
Zie lei hi vang lungkham kahna,
Munin guot mah leh chin;
Thagau Thiengtho lopi leh vangsakna lul chu,
Mitin din pawm tak leh lunggil phatna hi hen;
Aw Thagau Thiengtho hun pie’n la.
Aw Lal Isu, thawmhau takin,
Keihaw ei umsak kin;
Aw Nang vanga ngaih cheng len-guol a hung kim hin,
Kumsawt a khawvel pak hawihna nunghei sanin;
Mitin lunggil sungah chengin.
Leisiet guol ngaih gi bang kikhenna din.
Kawlah ni a suok kit tai zal mangpha (2)
Nuoi simlei ahin lungmuonna umlo
Lungngaihna meipi’n ei bawm ki ging un (2)
Ni khat nawpna zai... la sa mah leu hing
Pak thing lun a muol bang in, a muol hi (2)
Gi bang kikhen ding nuoi simlei a ngui
Lunghelna khawvui a kai, chieh tauin. (2)
Chung thangvan kikhen umlohna gamah,
Luontui bang kigawm naitiu, dam takin. (2)
Pautinkhup
Hun a chawm taluo ie simlei nunnawpna,
Pak bang tuoiin sangmuol a liem zel hi;
Gi bang khenna’n lenkawl ah chung sunni a suok.
Chang bang damin guol ngaihte, Gi bang ki khen tai tiu;
Lautha puiha I gam leh vangkhuo zuon dingin,
Lal Isu’n nau bang ei pui hen lamtawn in,
Chang bang dama dawn bang kituok kit di’n.
Hansiedawl sietlei ah nunnawp peh bang kim theilo,
Gi bang kikhen tai tiu Lal na sem di’n.
Ginnan Kalvari-ah dawn bang kituok khawm di’n.
Sietlei hi guol ngaih chang bang kikhenna himah leh,
Hai bang I ngak ni lopi hung tung ding,
Tieng chuleh nau bang kahna nunnawpna suok ding.
Gi bang khenlohna ding thimthu la ki lel theilo,
Hun muol liemsa la sap kit theih hilo,
Gi bang khenlohna Salem thak mu bang I ngai.
Guol lung tuok sam gibang khenna nuoi simlei ah,
Lengin va bang na buol mahleng le;
Sam gibang khenna din lenkawl ah ni a suok,
Guol ngaih khenna’n thimthu, “Dam takin”
Tih sawlang bang theilo.
Chang bang damin sang muolpi liem mai tan,
Chung Pathien venna zal zo zelin;
Lungtup na gam ninnuom I tun tieng,
Lunglen thimthu khau bang sut lohna.
Thangvan gam ninnuom ah;
“Dam takin” tih sawlang bang tana.
Sietlei gamdai hi gibang kikhenna dinga,
Zuo chung Pathien in tawngsie A lawh;
Mahleh gibang khenlohna thangvan gam nuomah
Nga banga I len tieng “Dam takin,”
Tih sawlang bang tana.
Tuhin luonthi nulin gibang kikhen mah leng,
Chung Pathien vanga chang bang damin;
Dan leh gi bang kikhen lohna thangvan gamah,
Luonthi nula sam gibang kikhen-
Te tui bang kigawm ding.
V.T. Kappu
Gal in dawn leng thangvan khawpi,
Khen lohna gam ngo bang a lang;
Gibang khenni a hung tun in,
Khen lohna gam ka ngai.
A chawm ngei ie lei nunnawpna,
Pak bangin a tuoi kit tai;
Kikhen lo thei I hi puou maw,
Lenna mun a dan ziekin ?
Mu bang ka ngai khen lohna gam,
Nun nuom sawl bang I hei na ding;
Bang tik leh thuongte I tung dem?
Khenlohna vangkhuo lun.
Gimtheih thuoka I kikhen hin,
Bangtik tui bang I kigawm dem?
Nuoi simlei thuong nung I sieh tieng
Luon tui bang kigawm ding
Khen lohna vang khawpi ka ngai,
Simlei a gi bang kikhen ni’n;
Lungkham sawlang ban na’ng um lo,
Simlei gimum ahin.
I kikhen a I kah lai hin,
Thangvan gam nuom galin dawn leng;
Kikhen a um loh ka het in,
Tunkal ngakla’n ka kap.
Saihnuna
Kap lo thei ka hi puoi, Aw ka lungdeihte kha,
Nungtieng lam sul bang a hei kit ta puou;
Pielgal van sang saulun a kai zo tau,
Nungsul hei talo in.
Ka kap khawvel gam zau ahin,
Buolna gam tawha suihlung hel ni hin;
Malai nung tieng ngaiin ka mau,
Atho kit sek ngaihlai ni haw cheng khah
Suihlung ahel lunglai nemte sul bang heilo,
Nau bang kahna a sauta luoi Lalpa;
A lennau leh a meluh muh ka nuom,
Angel dungsun a hiu.
Zion lim thing bang bel hehpih lungdeihte tawh,
Galmuonna tang chunga lengin zai awi
Ka ngaklah ie zie gam hawih achun Aw
Laituol lengkhawm ung kau
flat
Doh is B
Guol deih samgi bang khenna di’n,
Phat leh ni a nai tai;
Kipak nunnuom alen lai ni,
Malai suok ding ei tai.
Na chieh na’ng tuong lam sau mahleh,
Lalpa’n hun veng ina;
Na vang khawpi na tun tieng leh,
Ei hun hezing in Aw.
Lung guola ni chenga lenna,
Buolna sau lun sungah;
Na sakmin gen hai thei puong kau,
Hun sawt tak nung inle.
Damtak in Aw, mangpha, mangpha,
I kituok kit masieh;
Chung Pathien in hun veng ina,
Damtak in Aw, mangpha.
Thangneikhup
Ka kum sawt In ding lem tang ka ie,
Kumsawt suongpi Krista chunga lem in;
A hun laiin theihtawp in sang ka,
Ka umna lei hi hung bei pai tana.
Kumsawt hinna In det Krista chu ka neita ie,
Damlai huihpi leh tuipi hung kinawk mahleh;
Krista zalin ei chuppha ta puona.
Aw enviel tie gamlui khawvel hi.
Lungngaihna leh natna’n a dim zo tai;
A chung ah lungmuonna um ta lo,
Sietna huihpi a kinawk tak ziekin.
Aw sietna tuipi a hung lien tai,
Zion chaten Insang lemto tai tiu;
Thagau thiengtho hinna’n kithuom in,
Hinna sangpen Insang chungnung ahii.
Lienkhawpau
Hun kipah um leh Hukdamna ni hin,
Maban tamtak ka nei,
Krista sep ban sem di’n;
Lalpa’n kei ei guot tai.
Damlai ni a beih ma hin,
Semhat hitiu Lalpa na;
Hun a dang tai, (2)
Vaihawmna ni a naitai.
Aw ka damlai hun na pammaih ta luoi;
Thawnin liemlo zen in,
Hukdampa melsietna;
Khuh di’n mat ka nuom tai,
Tutieng hin Lalpa khawvelah a tawm,
A tawmna sietlei hi;
Thisana chawksa nung,
Amah Lallukhuk di’n.
Hun a bei deuh deuh, Hun a buoi deuh deuh,
Buh tak leh lem sep na’n;
Tui suohgiet a fawn tai,
Lalpa thudik na di’n.
Thihna thim nuoi a um in,
Thagau sangtam amang zing;
Hukdampana Aw, Hukdamna helo in,
Hinna lampi mansakin, Thingbul suongbul aho ui,
Ei haw guola tatdawk sa ahiu.
Hukdamna Chanchinpha,
Gamtina phuongzak dingin;
Lalpa’n tuhin ahun sam,
A hun sam ahun sam zing,
Hukdamna huongah lun puilut un.
Lalpa’n A hun hehpih a,
Nanga dingin a hung thuok;
Na gitloh leibat haw ahun ditsak,
Gamthima Lalpa hehpih Thagau sang tam amang zing,
Amau pui ding kuomah aum puoi.
Amauhaw chu pui dingin,
Suohpih bang dinga nang muong ?
Hun a chawma ni a liem zing ngala,
Na leibat na dit loh leh Lal kawmah bang na gen die ?
Tu hi Hukdam theih na ni ahi.
Lalpa kei ka um hila,
Na hehpih te pui dingin;
Na deih bang taka nei mat di’n ka nuom,
Nang a ding in hing ka ting nanga ding mah in thing ka,
Ka theihna ka pum in ei mang in.
Lienrum
Kum sang vaihawm ni hung naiin,
Kei banga liengthei albang vaite’n;
Thilsiem tincheng leh lei Sapchuomte hin,
Ngaiin ka thil ui, Isu hung naiin,
Lalpa, hungkum in, ka hun ngai ui,
Salem Zion tang lopi Lalpa;
Chun-leh-zuo leh phungguol a chieh zo tau,
Aw, ka Lal nunnem ka lu hung lieh in.
Phamsa ngai in ka kap, Lalpa
Khawvel Aigupta gamah ka vai;
Lalpa na vangsakna lul ka chan hi
Pak bang lawp manlo in muol a liem ie.
Phamsa ngai ka kah lai hinle,
Lili pak tat sate a lennau;
Ginna’n thangvan khu ka vak gal thila,
Lungdeih te lenna Zion tang a lang.
Ka ngai Jerusalem Zion,
Thiemgau, martar thisan a tatte;
Phamsa thokit leh ka lungtup gam khu,
Muh ka nuom ngei Aw lungdeih a kimnau.
Aw kalvari tang khu ka vak thil a,
Ka hukdampa thihna tang chu;
Mi tizat tang, tang thavaih um a chun,
Ka thuok sikin A thuok.
Ka kipak ie Lalpa, ka kipak ie,
Zie bang lawma hehpihna mak;
Ka genthiem puoi na phatna zozai hi,
Hun pak chim thei puo’ng ka.
Zie bang lawm lawma hehpihna mak hi,
Suol tuipi a tummang sa nung;.
Na hehpih na’n nei hung puidawk ta a,
Nang chauh hun zui tang ka.
Na thisan in na hawng zalenna gam,
Zie mun chuh ei puitung ding in;
Na Thagau a nei hung panpih ziekin,
Ka lung a awi ngei ie,
Gen chim thei hiel puo’ng ka, na hehpihna,
Khawvel lopina genlo in;
Na hehpihna thu mai hi gen tang ka.
Lalpa ei panpih in.
Hallelujah amen, Halleluijah.
Amen....Amen Halleluijah;
Lalpa vangsakna tincheng eipie pa
Na min lopi zing hen.
Ka umna lei In hi mang mahleh,
Khuta sak loh kumsawt In ka nei;
Zie In chu ngaiin ka galdawt ka tung thei puoi,
Ka taksa sietlei In hin ei nang.
Gam ka nei gam lopi,
Hukdampa’n kei dinga A bawlsa;
Sietlei ah kumsawt chenna ding mun ka nei puoi,
Gam hawih zaw diek vana tih loh chu.
Ka umna lei ka mauna gam hi,
Aw, bangtikleh ka pawt san ta dem ?
Lungsietna Lal pakcha’n Amah chawian dingin,
Ka taksa sietlei In hin ei nang;.
Muonna leh chawlhdamna ka hawla,
Zie leisiet chung ahin a um puoi;
Ginna’n gam thiengtho ka galdawt ka tung thei puoi,
Ka taksa sietlei In hin ei nang,
Abraham mah bangin tuhin chu,
Ginnan gamtiem lam chu ka zuon hi;
Mi thiengthote le gam nuom chu chang chiet dingin,
Ka taksa sietlei In hin ei nang.
Kamlala
Lungmuonna kim kipahna kim
Hehpihna vak ka Lal melah
Pulthuok a nem thuok laia nem
Vakvaite din In nuom.
A umna mun cheng van ahi
A keng bula um hi a nuom
Lungkhamna leh thim nuoia chau
Nuomin a chawlhsak sek.
Suihlung ahel ka sa lei ah,
Mahleh hehpihna Lal vangin;
Ka lautha lungdeihte haw tawh,
Nunnuom in leng tan au.
Aw, I mi ngaihteu chieh ka mui,
Hehpihna vakah a leng ui;
A mau a mihiem hin beita,
Angelte dungsun in,
Ka hun ngai Aw, kipahna pen,
Na thawkna chun kah lai a nem;
Ka lenna gamgaw gam ahi,
Hun khen ding ka ngam puoi.

songs.title: Muot Thei A Tuh A Um !

lines: Khuonga
Muot theia tuh a um,
Muot theilo lo a tho di’n;
Limbawl loha tuh in I um,
Lopi taka kaihthawh dingin. (2)
Hatlo a tuh a um,
Thilhih theia tho di’n;
Taksaa tuhin I um ui,
Thagau a thodawk kit ding in (2)
Lei taksa a chuoma,
Van taksa a chuom hi,
Lei lopina a danglama;
Thagau lopina a dang hi, (2)
Lalpa chu Aw gi tawh,
Vansawlchak lopi tawh;
Pengkun in ei hun sam intin,
Lalpa kawma chun chawl dingin. (2)
Thihna um ta puon tin,
Kahna um ta puona;
Thihna gun eizo ta puona;
Melma nunung I nuoisieh tau. (2)
Thup. 21:3
Khawvel thihna gam himah leh;
Van chuh hinna gam ahi;
Khawvel kikhenna himah leh,
Van kituok khawmna ahi,
I ngaih, lungdeih te I khena,
Pham ngaia lu i su’n hin,
Van khawpi nuom gal dawn hiting,
Lungkham banna’n mang hitiu.
Nitin tungthak ana tuok ui
A kipahnau a pung zel;
Thih leh kikhen a lau ta puou,
Nawp tawplo ding a chang ui.
Melma huoi sie thihna lal in,
Sung tin naubang a kah sak;
Kingaisie chuom um diek puoi tiu,
Kuomah um dem ding um lo;
Pathien hinna siemtu khan le,
A Chapa lu a su’n kha,
Mahleh van khuo ei tun zaw a,
Guolpha’n ngai zaw mai hitiu,
I nu, I pa I guol ngaihte,
I u, I nau I chate;
Nupa’n le thihna’n a khen a,
Lungkham banna ding umlo,
Pathien Cha thihna zopa leh,
Thih lungmuonna neitu chu;
Bel in kulhpi’n mang hiting un,
Lungmuong takin um hitiu.
Runchawng
Ka lenna gamgaw taihsan in,
Van Jerusalem thak nuom ah;
Aw bangtikleh thuong ka tung dem ?
Na kumsawt Pielgal gamah,
Aw ka ngai gibang khen lohna gam nuomah,
Hinna tui a luong!
Hukdam chate’n a dawn ui,
Kumkhuo hinna chang ui.
Belam No lenna mun lopi.
Ngaiin ni chengin ka galdawt;
Aw thagau thiengtho hung lengin,
Na gam nuom thuong ei tunin.
Dawngkawt gi hawih chu ahawng ui,
A gi hawih in ka lung ei len;
Mi thiengthote tuollenna ah,
Aw keile len ka nuom hi.
Zie mun a chun ka Lal deihum,
A mel nisa vanglai bangin;
A vak haw chu a zam vel-a,
Kumkhuo a damna dingin.

songs.title: Na Lung A Awi Kei Nam ?

lines: Mihiemte hinna hi banga hia ahim ?
Meipi chawmcha hung kilanga mangkit bang hi ahi;
Simlei pakcha hawih lunlai atuoi bangin,
Mihiem phatlai paklun zamuol a liem paisek hi.
Aw, na khawvel hinna a beih tieng,
Bang lampi ahim, na hawh ding?
Na kumsawt mun ding na gel tieng leh,
Na lung a awi kei nam?
Hun leh tui luong laiin kuomah angak ngei puoi,
Mitphet kalsungle chawllo in zamuol aliem zing ui;
Khawvel ahin aum den ding a um puoi,
Khuolzin nichuong phet I hiu I leisiet hin khuo hi.
Na vanglai leh phatlai nihaw a vak sung hin.
Krista haw’n khawvel pakhawih chenin muong mahleh chunle
Aw thihna luiguom thim nahawh tieng chu leh,
Krista lo a muongtaka chiehpai ni kinem maw?
Pak zel unau lei nawpna haw su hawih dingin,
Kumsawt hinna lampi mansak theih na din ei themsek
Zui in pet mangsan ta leng I van lampiu,
Tuoikit untin I chan uh lungkham kah leh mauna.
Sietlei ah kipahna nawpna, hawl mahleu hing,
Lunggil leh ngaihtuohna mangin na theihna haw cheng tawh;
Bangtik kipahna tawplo na mu thei dem?
Mu ngei puonla Kalvari tuichim na tun ma chun.
Thangngur
A bei sawt ngei ie maw,
I khawvel damlai niteu haw hih
Kipahna pak chul kit ding ei tau,
I kikhenna ding un,
Kawla nisa a hungsuok kittai,
Kikhen lohna gam ngaih a um ngei ie,
Kikhen lohna mi gen gam nuom achun,
Len-guol ngaih kimin chawl hitiu;
Ei vengpa Lal Krista,
I Hukdampau deihum keng bulah,
Lungkhamna bei tana.
Khawvela hin chu Aw,
Kap leh mauin alang vai mah leh
Buoina khela khun gam hawih a um,
I Hukdampau Krista,
Zuia I hinnau I phal uchun,
Zie gamhawih achun naubang nui hitiu.
Nawpna pak lunna mun,
Hukdampa Krista lenna mun chu,
Ngaiin nichengin ka gal thila,
Van Angel vamte leh-
Guol deih gibang i khensau haw tawh,
Bangtik leh nunnuom in i kikhawm dem?
I len-guol ngaih cheng tawh,
I Pau nasem hitiu kipakin,
Hun hi nicheng a liemzing ie,
Zingsawl Aksi vak hawih,
A hung latna ding phat a nai tai,
Nasep zoa i chawlhna ding niu chu.
Aw, ka Lal Hukdampa,
Ka kipahnau pakin hung lunin;
Khawvel nawpna pak atuoi-zo ie,
Na mel a hin chu aw-
Kipahna tincheng a lang khawm hi,
Kipahna pak Saron pak hawih-Na hi.
Pautinkhup
Aw, Lalpa, naupangte’n ka hun chiel ui,
Na mel deihum leh Na pau kamsuok thum tak
Het ka nuom muh ka nuom ui.
Aw, nang ka Lal leh ka Tanpau, ka Puipau Na hi,
Ka kikhawpnau leh thilpiek,
Nang di’n lopina hi hen, kei u din vangsakna
Van chana kipahna di’n.
Malai khan naupan neuhaw Na lawpa,
“Ka kawmah hun pui un, gai, kiu in” Na tii,
Naupang kipahna a kim.
Puipa di’n Thagau Thiengtho, hung lengin,
Naupang neucha cha kikhawmhaw ma hung puiin,
Lal nasep khawk dan hilh in.
Ei ngaidam in Aw, Lalpa ei ngaidam in,
Ka hihding helo in, sawttak ka na chui,
Ka lawpna maidi’n, ka hun bel Lalpa,
Ei ngaidam in, Lalpa ei ngaidam in.
Kei mah ziekin thagau simsen loh,
A mangthai tau kumsawt thim nuoi ahin;
Na masang ah bang ka genta dem?
Ei ngaidam in, Lalpa ei ngaidam in.
Na hukdamna athawn in ka na nei tai,
Na malsawmna simsen loh in nei vuk sek,
Mahleh kei mai dingin ka na mangzo,
Ei ngaidam in, Lalpa ei ngaidam in.
Na lawpna pen Lalpa thagau mang hukdam,
Na na khawkpen khawvela chanchinpha gen;
Mahleh kuo mah ka hun pui puoh ngala,
Ei ngaidam in, Lalpa ei ngaidam in.
Na sapna hi kihetloh sak thei kei puoi,
Nangin neisawl thagau mang hukdam ding in,
Na thagau thiengtho in ei pui zel in,
Na gam adi’n ka hung ki piei Lalpa.

songs.title: Nang Lam Ka Hun Nga Tai

lines: Zie khawvela lawp leh muonga ka chut laiin,
Kalvari hehpihna thisan zalin,
Ka lunggil ah a hungtung ta ie,
Manthaina gam a leng ei tatna a hung hii.
Aw nangmah lam ka hun nga tai Lalpa,
Bangmah dang ka deih puoi khawvel ahin,
Ka Lal leh Hukdampa di’n ka hun pawm tai
Kalvari’ah nei tatna thisan zalin.
Sawttak ka Lalpa chu vakmang san mahleng le,
Bang ti a gitloh nen kai hi mahleng;
A hehpihna Aw nem chun ei sam,
Ka lungsung ah thamuonna bei theilo ei piei.
Ka Aw leh nei thilthawn piekte haw hi Lalpa,
Hun pha leh kipahum nei piek haw hi;
Na pahchaknan ka na mang ngei puoi,
Tuhin vang chu ka hun mang pan ta ie Lalpa.
Aw ka hun lui beita cheng kha samkit thei leng,
Ka ngaina e Aw ka Lalpa pakna’n;
Thih chana ei hung hehpihtu hi,
Ka hengilh sawt taluoi Lalpa ei ngaidam in.
Lalpa gam ding lak guon khawvel ahin,
Kei chieh zelingka ka puokgik tawh;
Hun kilepsan hiel puongka Lal Isu;
Melma dogal lien mahleh.
Gospel hehpih in malam zuon ka, (2)
Ka Lal deihum min hawih hi panpih in,
Tai puongka khawvel ma ah.
A nasep sunzawm zel ding kuo a um?
Kei ei hun tel tai ka Lal Isu’n;
Lawp takin Lalpa na chu semzel ka,
Thih chana ginum dingin.
Malam ah kasep ding ei guotsak tai,
Gospel henailo te pui dingin;
Gitloh gallien chu kidopih zelin,
Ei puihna phawtah chieh ka.
Aw hehpihna, Aw hehpihna mak chun,
Ei sawldawk in khawigam himahleh;
Muonna umloh na gamthip ahin le,
Thim mahleh chieh zel ingka.
Lalpa chieh dinga nei sawl na ta phawt achun,
Tangsangpen leh tuipi kinawk kal himahleh;
Na thu leh Kraws vaka nei thuom phawt chun,
Na hehpihna thu hi gen zel ingka
Chieh in sempan ngalin nite bei mang zing,
Kalvari tatna mak henailo te kawmah;
Na tawhna ta phawt chu na gam hizel ina,
Hattak leh hangtak in umphawt mai in.
Setan gallien chu lau loin nawh pai zelin,
Tawpchana na kawma umdi’n thu ka hun tiem;
Thu ka hun pie hila bangmah lau ki’n,
Hattak leh hang takin um phawt mai in.
Ka hukdamna Zion tang achun hun puiin,
Amau dingin mun nuom leh chawlhna ka guonggalh;
Hattak leh hangtakin va gen zelin,
Na kipahman Lallukhuk hawih ina.

Galhat miphakpa kawmah, Saltang numei naupang chun,

A ki diehna ding lui mai chun hihdam theihna a nei;
Ginnan a damtai tui achun, Sawt lamin.
Mipi laka numei khat, pau lo thip kei a um in;
Khunin, a puon mawng a tham, Sawt lamin,
A thildeih chu a mu tai, A thagau hukdamna tawh,
Luikhuk hawnsa a um achun, Sawt lamin.
Mitilgehpa lehkha sim Philip in a hilhchiena,
Lui achun a Baptis tai, Sawt lamin;
Sunggila Pathien nasep pawlama tiemtehna din,
Lui achun bawlin a um tai, Sawt lamin.
Khawvel lopina leh hawihna I hawllai hin,
Lungdawnna, lungzinnan ei tuomvel;
Mahleh kinepnan eihun zuon zelin atii,
Zie khawvel ahin thamuonna ding ka mu puoi.
Thamuonna leh nawpna neitu I Lal Isu’n,
“Ka kawmah hung unla hung zilun atii;
Ka namkawl anuoma ka puokle a zang hi,
Na thagau adingin chawlhdamna hun piengka.”
Khawvel duhamna chu milim hona ahi,
Dangka ngaihnat gitloh bul ahi;
Khawvel lopina, hauhna, gitloh nawpna te,
A tawpna chu kumsawt Gawtmun meidil ahi.
Ka thilin khawvel lopina azam viel ie,
A hawihna haw pak bangin alun;
Ka Hukdampa phatna leh a mel a lieh zo,
Aw Isu na mel hawihtak chu eimuh sakin.
Ka hun zuon hi Lalpa nangmai nawpna na hi,
Chawlhdamna leh puokgik kei dawntu;
Ka mu ta ie! damna, leh muonna, Lal Isu,
Kumsawt in kipahna pak bang lun zing tan a.

A lopi leh hawihna chenghin;
Thamuonna ahun tun thei puoi,
Zie lei hansie dawl nuoi ahin;
Thaklah ding him aum puoh ie,
Bangmah lo mai ana hiu ie.
Khawvela hatna cheng cheng hi,
Vanglai ni leh vullai nite;
Chawm lokala tuoi ding ahiu,
A nawpnau pumin a mang zing;
Khawvela nawpna cheng cheng hi,
Bangmah lo mai ana hiu ie.
Genthei liengvai chate chengin,
Ka ngai ui nawpna leh muonna;
Pathien Chapa Lal Isu chauh,
Mangthaite di’n hinna ahi;
A kawm ah nangle hung leh chin,
Kumsawt hinna chu chang inla.
Malai Martha’n a buoipih chu.
Hukdampa’n kipahpih lo;
Mari’n chanpha ana tel hi,
:Sukbuoi ding ei puoi” tin a hilh;
Mari chanpha chu na chang kha ngei tam?
I damlai ni hawu hi sawtta puona,
A liem zing nicheng leh zan chengin;
Ka Lalpa dinga hun chu mang loin,
Dan leh ti’n hun tam a liem mang zotai.
I damsung lungkham buoinate haw hi,
A mangthai zing a nawpnate tawh;
Kumsawt gam tungzo ding him a um puou,
Kumsawta um ding ka Lal na lo chu.
Van Kanaan gam hawih chu I zawt lai un,
Lungkham buoina te’n ei tuom vel a;
I damsung lungkham buoinate haw hi,
Paih in Mari chan pha chu chang hitiu.
Lal Isu hehpihna chun ei uh gilo a beimang,
Ei hung tatdawk ziekin a lopi na e;
Kumsawt hinna lultak chuh thimnuoi a mite kawmah,
Genzak dingin kuote a chiehdawk ding?
Gamtin mun tin a mite kawmah,
Na hukdamna thu kuo a kiko pih ding?
Kei chieh dawk ing ka Lalpa na hukdamna puong zak di’n,
Na thagau thiengtho in ei puizel in.
Semzel ingka Lalpa di’n sepgim chuh chawlhna ahi
Lallukhuk lopi I chan theih na dingun;
Ma a mihangsan tamtak chiehsate kha hezingin,
Lau loin hangtakin semzel hitiu.
Dai gam leh Arakan gam Tidim biel leh Matupi,
Fang suoka salhvak dingin Lalpa’n ei sam;
Aw Suohpih Lalpa chielna ngilh in kihet mawh sak kin,
Nang leh kei hi mawhpuotu I hiu ui.
Thagau mangthai khatmai bek ka hukdawk theihna dingun,
Na thagau thiengtho chemzam in ei thuom in,
Thim leh gimtheihna nuoi a puidawka salhvak dingin,
Kei uh KHANGLAI TE hi ei hun mangin.
Lalpa Aw-gi chu ngaitiem u,
Leisiet a mite’n;
A hungna ding ni anai tai,
I sepgah kimlo.
Hungtei dingin (2)
Van thamzawl mei chung ah;
Lopi takin hung kipuong ina.
Aman atel chuomte a puih,
Toh ni tieng chu leh;
A nutsiehte haw cheng vang chu’n,
Gimtheih thuok tan au.
Gawtmun meidil aumte chun,
Kum sang sawm-sang za;
Lunggimtheihna thuok kumkhuo ding,
Hin ding guo mah leu;
Van goluoh ding chengte vang chu,
Vak sing seng un au;
Pa lungkim na um theilo ding,
I sepgah kimlo.
Rev. Douzapao
Aw Gospel khuolzin khawilama chieh ding na him?
Nang hun ngaia dangchak sang tamtak aum tai;
En zinga mulo leh, za zinga zalo ten;
Na nasep hukdamna a ngak zing ui.
Muol leh tang sang lele chieh ding ka hi,
Lalpa thupiek zuilo thei ka hi puoi;
A hehpih nan ei sawl ka chamlo in,
Lal na ka sep ding him ahi.
Sietna suok in mi sangzatam thim nuoi ah um,
Kalvari suohchakna nisuoh lam helo in;
Gawtmun lamah din a them lungmuong Setan in,
A chieh zing ui Aw Gospel sam meng in.
Gospel sapna pawm nuomlo te cheng cheng chuvang,
Kah leh hagiel na thuok unau kumsawt chan in;
Zie chun kisik mahleu ngaihdam hi ta puon au,
A chung un a kumsawt thiemloh chuta.
Aw suohpihte Gospel sapna pawmkin meng un,
Gospel laktoh nani Rapture ni anai tai;
Hukdam chate cheng chu chung gam ah cheng unau,
Chawldam tan au Hallelujah tiin.
Johan 9:4
Pautinkhup
I damlai hun chawmcha sung hin,
I pau na sem hitiu ie;
Hun a muolliem zawh ma hin,
Lal na sem hitiu ie.
Aw, a kul, Lal na sem hitiu,
I thagau damna ahi;
Lal na sem hitiu;
A kul ie ! A kul ie ! ti’n gen kimvel un.
I Lal Isu Krista lo chu,
Pathien dang a um puoh ie;
Lei leh van vaihawmpa chu,
Nasep in pakcha’i tiu.
Lei lopina ngaina haw vang,
Gitloh leh pukna ahii;
Lungsietna leh kingaihniem.
Pielgal lampi ahi.
Vana ka pa phuhloh haw chu,
Bawh dawk vek ding tih ahi;
Thaklah ding aum puoh ie,
Lal na sem hitiu ie.
Saihnuna
Ka taksa lungkham mahlele,
Van lam ah tha’n ka leng sek hi;
Tuhin chauin mau mah le’ng le,
Tunung leh tha’n hung leng ka ie.
Damlai ni a beih ma hin Lalpa,
Hin kipahna him ka nei puoi;
Kumsawt Zion khuo hungvak ta uo,
Buoina chengcheng kipahna hung suok hen.
Gitloh a thi’n thim lak ahin,
Kumsawt vak lam chu ka hawl a;
Kei gimthei, chau leh sangawn hi,
Nunnawpna’n ei hih bukim in.
Vang khawpi hawih Sana tuol nuom,
Tung ta le’ng Pielgal khawpi chu,
Nun lui gam hi vak thil ing ting,
Ka kahna himhim ngai puo’ng ka.
I aw neih cheng suoh hitiu,
Lalpen chu chawi an hitiu;
Hinna Van Lal chungnung pakchai tiu.
Eden huona puih mang sa,
Lalpa’n ei ngaih tuoh zing hi,
Pak na zatam piei tiu chawi an un.
I Pathien chungnung pen in,
Ei lung sietna ngaihtuoh in,
Kipak in chawi an in lasai tiu.
Ei lung sietna ngaihtuoh in,
A thuk zie leh a san zie,
Ei tan ei sut tai Lal Isu’n.
I lungthim ginna piei tiu,
Lalpen thupiek pawm hitiu;
Thagau in ei puiin, ei veng hen.
Kipah huna ding I hiu,
Lalpan ei ngaihtuoh zing hi.
Hukdam di’n panpih di’n ei veng hen.
Hukdam na leh panpih na
Lalpen kawm ah chang hi ting,
Kipah na’n tawp leh mawng nei puo’na.

songs.title: Thianghlim, Thianghlim, Thianghlim! Engkimtithei Pathian!
songs.author: Rev. E. L. Mendus 1887-1982 Rev. Saiaithanga 1897-1980

lines: Thianghlim Thianghlim Thianghlim Engkimtithei Pathian Tuk tin zing tianah pawh zaiin kan fak ang che Thianghlim Thianghlim Thianghlim Zahngaithei leh Rinawm Pumkhat Pathian Pa Fa Thlarau Thianghlim.
Thianghlim Thianghlim Thianghlim Mi thianghlim zawng zawngten I lalthutphah hmaah lallukhum hlu an dah Cherub-ho zawng zawngte i ke bulah kunin Seraph-ho nen Chatuan Lal an fak thin.
Thianghlim Thianghlim Thianghlim Thimin a hliah che a Mi sualin i ropuina hmu thei lo mah se Nangmah chauh i thianghlim thianghlim dang an awm lo Hmangaihna fim famkim Pathian i ni.
Thianghlim Thianghlim Thianghlim Engkimtithei Pathian Lei leh van leh tuipuiin i hming an fak ang Thianghlim Thianghlim Thianghlim Zahngaithei leh Rinawm Pumkhat Pathian Pa Fa Thlarau Thianghlim.

songs.title: Lei leh vânten in aw chhuah r'u,
songs.author: Lalmama 1901-1959

lines: Lei leh vanten in aw chhuah r'u Hnam ze tinreng lawma auvin Kil tin leh ram tin thangkhawk se Lalpa Pathian Lalber tiin.
A thutiam rinawm nghet tak chu A finna famkim thil ruat nen Ringhlel leh do ngam tu nge awm?
Lalpa Pathian Lalber a ni.
Thil siam zawng zawngten fak rawh se A thu dikin a thianghlim si Roreltu fing leh dik tak chu Lalpa Pathian Lalber a ni.
Lal leh Pathian khat hnuaia mi n Chawimawina hla ropui sain Lei chung leh vante nghawr vel se Lalpa Pathian Lalber fakin.

songs.title: Lalpa chu chawimawi r'u, Pathian chaka chu,
songs.author: Thangkima Sailo 1895-1969

lines: Lalpa chu chawimawi r'u Pathian chaka chu Chhandamna mak tak leh kan pialral kalkawng Min hrilh tawh avangin amah chu fak r'u Meialh leh chhumding zingah min hruai zel a.
Angel-te u fak r'u in aw zawng zawngin A hmel ropui chuan mi rilru a chhun eng A ram ropui tak chu a zau deuh deuh vang A hnathawh zawng zawngin (2) Lalpa an fak aw ka thlarau fak ve rawh.
Thlarau vakvai hnenah tlanna hlu a pe Mi sualte tan faina lui a luantir a A tlan sate min hmangaih em avangin Kan tawngtai a chhang th'n Lalpa chu fak r'u.
Lalpa chu chawimawi r'u kan mangan laiin A khawngaihna thahruiin min rawn vuan ta Rinna leh beiseinaa hnehtute nen Hmangaihna ramah kan intawk khawm leh ang.

songs.title: Pathian ropui rawh se, chhandamna petu,
songs.author: Dr. Darchhawna b. 1936

lines: Pathian ropui rawh se chhandamna petu Khawvel hmangaih vangin a Fapa min pe Kan sual tlanna tura a nunna pein Chhandamna kawng a hawng mi tin luh theih nan.
Fak rawh u fak rawh u khawvel mi tinrengin Fak rawh u fak rawh u mi zawng zawngin fak r'u Pa hnenah lo kal r'u Lal Isua ringin Chhandamna chatuana nunna nei turin.
Thisena lei aw chhandamna famkim chu Ringtu zawng zawngte tana Pa thutiam chu Mi sual ber pawhin hei hi a rin duh chuan Lal Isua ngaihdamna a chang nghal ngei ang.
Thil ropui tiin thil ropui min zirtir Kan lawmna kan hlimna Krista Lal Isua Lawmna ber hlimna ber kan chan hun tur chu Chhandamtu Lal Isua hnen kan thlen hunah.

songs.title: Leilung pian hmain Thu chu a awm,

lines: Leilung pian hmain Thu chu a awm Pa Pathian nen chatuanin a inzawm Engkim a zain aman a siam A siam loh a awm lo khawvelan.
Chu chanchinah chuan hei hi kan lawm Thu chu tisaa changin a awm A ropuizia hmutuin a ziak Khawngaih leh thutakin a lo khat.
Thil dang a ni lo Thu kan tih hi Krista Lal Isua ngei kha a lo ni Mi rilru thuin a chhuak angin Pathian rilru a lang Kristain.
Pathian zawlneiin thu a hril chawk Angel-te pawhin a inhriattir bawk A tirh hnuhnun ber i lawm ang u Pathian mihring a Fapa ngei chu.

songs.title: Zîngah savaten Pathian an fak a,

lines: Zingah savaten Pathian an fak a Pangparin a ropuizia a entir fo A thil siam zawngin amah an chawimawi Mihring chauh lo chu zirtir an ngai lo.
Lei leh van mi nung kan tel ve ang Anni aiin a ngaihna kan hria Khawvel zawng pawhin sa rual sela Amah fakna hi an sa seng lo vang.
Nilengin i thatna kan hmu fo thin Chhun leh zan thlasik leh furte a awm thin Hun a thar angin lawmna kan lo chang Kumkhuain vantirhkoh nen kan zai ang.
Hriatna leh finna thiltihtheihnain Mi nung zawng zawngin amah lo fak rualin Kan tan a tih zawng kan sawi zo thei lo Kumkhuain a khawngaih kan hril seng lo.

songs.title: Kan fak fo vang che, aw Lalpa, kan Pathian,
songs.author: Rev. F. W. Savidge 1862-1935

lines: Kan fak fo vang che aw Lalpa kan Pathian Lal Isua i Fapa min pek avangin.
Haleluia Ropui i ni Haleluia Amen Haleluia Ropui i ni min tiharh ang che.
Kan fak fo vang che aw Lalpa kan Pathian I Thlarau Thianghlim kan chungah i leih si.
Fakin awm rawh se kan Lal Isua Krista Ama thisen hluin min tlan tawh si a.
Kan Pa Pathian hi fakin awm fo rawh se Aman min khawngaihin min hruai si thin a.
Min tiharh ang che i hmangaihna hlu chuan Kan rilru tikhat la min tieng ang che.
Aw Haleluia Lalpa ropui ber A fakna kil tinah fawn se Hnam tin Lal ropui leh zahawm ber chuan Mi thinlung chhungah thu han sawi leh rawh.
Hruai kir leh ang che kal bo tate Muthlute chu kai tho leh ang che Khawvel hruaitu Arsi ropui ber Bona ram leh lungngaihna ram chhun eng rawh.
Lal Davida leh hruaitu Mosi-a Lei arsi lian an her liam ta Tunah Lal Krista leh Thlarau Thianghlim Kan Puithiam Lalber leh kan Arsi chu.
Tui leh leilung reng an din chhuah hmain Hriat phak loh Pathian i lo ni Ni leh thla leh arsite zawng zawng khian I zarah enna ropui an nei ve.
Thuneihna ropui chawimawina sang ber Malsawmna nei tlak a ni e Leilung pian laia talh tawh Beramno A thisenin khawvel chhandam rawh se.

songs.title: Aw Lalpa, Davida leh a thlah Arsi,

lines: Aw Lalpa Davida leh a thlah Arsi I felna ram atan Nangin min buatsaih Ka lawmna tuifinriat angin a liam a Thih lui kamah zaiin i hming ka fak ang.
Aw Lalpa zaiin i hming ka fak ang Khawvela i siam zawng zawng zai se Lalpa chawimawi nan awte chhuah r'u Leilung hi zaiin a lo khat ang.
Mihring ka nih hma pawhin Lalpa Isu Thisena man dang beisei lova min tlan Chhiar sengin han hrethiam teh reng ila aw Khawvel zaia tikhat turin ka bei ang.
Lalpa khawiah nge ni hmun mi buatsaihna?
Daniela angin tukverhah ka thlir ang Rangkachak thianghlim leh a hmun ropui chu Hrehawmah pawh thingthi talin ka thlir ang.
Aw Imanuel lei leh van thar siam chu A dung leh vangahte han leng ve ila Buaina tinreng tuara ka then takte kha Van ropuina hain an hmel ka hmu ang.

songs.title: Engkimtithei Lalpa leh kan Pathian chu fak rawh u,
songs.author: C. Thansiama b. 1941

lines: Engkimtithei Lalpa leh kan Pathian chu fak rawh u Aw ka nunna amah fak rawh chhandamna min petu Mi tinte u a in thianghlim rawn pan r'u Lawm takin amah i fak ang.
Engkim chunga roreltu kan Lalpa chu fak rawh u Eng lai pawha ngilnei taka min enkawl rengtu chu Kan thinlung chhung duhsam thil zawng zawngte pawh Aman min ngaihtuah thin a ni.
Finna thinlung min petu kan Lalpa chu fak rawh u Hmangaihna kutin eng lai pawhin min chelh tlat fo thin Lungngaihna karah pawh aman min hnem fo A thla hnuaiah min thukru thin.
Engkim keimaha awmte hian amah chu fak rawh u Engkim thaw thei zawng zawngte hian amah chu fak rawh u Amen tiin a miten lo fak rawh se Lawm takin amah i fak ang.

songs.title: Aw, vân Lalpa chu rawn fak r'u,
songs.author: Lalmama 1901-1959

lines: Aw van Lalpa chu rawn fak r'u In lawm hla nen chawimawi r'u Tlan chhuah ngaihdam leh chhandamte Lawmin a hma i kun ang.
Fak r'u fak r'u fak r'u fak r'u Fak r'u chatuan Lalpa chu.
Fak r'u a khawngaihna vang hian Leh kan chunga a thatna Kan fel lohnate dawh theiin Kumkhuain mal min sawm a.
Fak r'u fak r'u fak r'u fak r'u A ngilneih a ropui em Kan chak lohnate hi hriain Pa angin min enkawl fo A angchhungah chuan min humin Kan dote min hnehsak thin.
Fak r'u fak r'u fak r'u fak r'u A thatna a thuk em e Nangni vantirhkohte pawhin A chawimawiah min pui r'u Ni leh thla a hmaa kunin Thil siam tinreng lo au r'u.
Fak r'u fak r'u fak r'u fak r'u Khawngaiha khat kan Pathian.

songs.title: Lal Engkimtitheia chuan, chatuanin ro a rêl dâwn,

lines: Lal Engkimtitheia chuan chatuanin ro a rel dawn A ropuina leh thuneihnate chu chatuanin a zual zel ang.

Aw lo kal ula nangni hnam tinrenga mite u Lalpa kan Pathian hmaah kan zain i kun ang u i kun ang u A ni ama hnenah chauh kan engkimte hlan vekin Khawvel thilte kalsanin kan Lalpa rawng chauh i bawl ang u.
Keini suala thi tawh hnu chatuan nunna min pe leh Pathian thisenin min rawn tlan leh a van ropuina chang turin.
Chhandamna mak tak mai hi hnam tin chi tin tan a ni Tu pawh a duh apiangin chhandamna chu a thlawnin an nei thei.

songs.title: Engkim kan hmuhte hian an fak a che,

lines: Engkim kan hmuhte hian an fak a che I thu ruat zawng zawng pawh an zawm zel e Va aw mawi neiten fak che an ning lo Hlim takin hla an sa fo.
Keinin kan awte hian fak kan duh bawk Nangman chuti-in min faktir zawk.
Nangmah fak turin engkim i siam si Thilnung thilnung lote awm apiang hi Hnial reng an awm lo mihring chauh lo hian Kan dam chhan loh kan ti fan.
Mawina te enna te ri zawng zawng nen Hmuin hre fel ila an fak reng che Kan mit timeng la kan beng tivar la Fak lo kan awm thei lo vang.
Min siam avangin Nang kan fak a che Chu kawng ngeiah pawh i ta kan ni e Kan hrem tuar zawkin min tlan avang khan Hemi ber hi kan fak chhan.
Haleluia aw Halelui Amen Kalvaria hmangaihna thisen zarah Tahna ram leh lungngaihna zan thim hi Hlimna van pialral khian a rawn en.
Lawmna a chul lo vang Haleluia Haleluia Fakin awm zel rawh se Beramno chu A hmangaihnain lungngaih a hnem.
Aw Thlarau leng rawh lawmna rimtui ber Haleluia tiin thlaler ram hi Lawmin an awi nuam e khawhar riangin Nang i awm chuan lei van a chang thin.
Kumkhaw ram leh chatuan a ral hma zawng Lawmna eng ropui van saron par mawi Aw i vul lai reng hi a chul dawn lo Nang hi ka ngai ber che min awm rawh.
Aw khawvel hian hria se ka Lal ropui Van angel zingah lawmna thla zarin Kalvaria Beramno hmangaihna hi Awiin an zai ve ang chatuanin.
Pathian mite u A thu puang rawh u A hming mak tak chu Ram tinah hril r'u Thil zawng zawng ngamtu leh Chhandamtu a ni Ram zawng zawng Lalber leh Khawvel awptu chu.
Lal ropui ber chu Min tlantu a ni Anin min hruai a A hmaah kan awm Mi zawng zawngin sa r'u A hla mawi ber chu Isua min Chhandamtu Amah fak fovin.
Chhandamna Pathian Khawvel Siamtu chu Mi zawng zawng auvin A Fapa fak r'u Angel-ho zawng pawhin Amah an fak a A hmaa kun theuhvin Chibai an buk thin.
Tunah hlim takin Amah fak theuh r'u Thil ropui ber pawh Amahin a siam Mi zawng zawngin tunah Zah theuh tawh ula Amah chawimawi fo r'u Chatuan thleng pawhin.

songs.title: Aw Pathian, Nang, Lalber i ni,
songs.author: Rai Bhajur 1858-1914

lines: Aw Pathian Nang Lalber i ni Kan rilru min en thin Engkim kan ruat hi Nangmahin I hmu reng thin a ni.
Nangmah i muhil ngai lo ve Keimahni min veng thin Rilru tha tak min siam ang che Lalpa Isua vangin.
I thu thuin kan awm duh e I thu nunna a ni Chuvangin min hre reng ang che Nangma mite kan ni.

songs.title: Kan Pathian kulhpui nghet a ni,
songs.author: Rev. Dr. Lalsawma b. 1930

lines: Kan Pathian kulhpui nghet a ni Himna hmunpui chhe thei lo Sualna tuilian fawn vel mah se A nghing lo vang kan himna.
Setana ral lian chuan Fing tak leh thiam takin Vervekna ralthuam nen Min tihchhiat a tum reng Leian hneh thei an awm lo.
Kan chakna ringin tang ila Kan theihtawp pawh a thlawn ang Mahse kan zam lo Tanpuitu Pathian mi ruat kan neih hi.
Tu nge ni in zawt maw?
Krista Isua ngei kha Sipaihote Lalpa Kumkhuaa pangngai kha Aman dovin a hneh dawn.
He lei hi ramhuai lo khatin Keini min tihchhiat tum se Kan hlau lo vang min hnehtir dawn Pathian ngei chuan A thuin.
Thim lal rapthlak ber chu Kan hlau long engtin pawh Thinurin thawk mah se A boral thuai dawn e Pathian thuin a that ang.
Pathian thutak an hneh chuang long Lei mi chakte pung khawmin Thlarau Thianghlim leh thilpekte Lalpan min pe min pui si.
Lei ro leh chhungkuate Kan nun nen la rawh se Taksa an tihlum thei Thutak an hneh chuang long Pathian ram a ding reng dawn.

songs.title: Aw Lal Pathian, i kutchhuak thilsiam tinrêng,
songs.author: Muka 1904-1998 Liandala 1901-1980

lines: Aw Lal Pathian i kutchhuak thilsiam tinreng Dawn changin mak tiin ka lo khat thin Zantiang siar zozai leh chung khawpui ri I thil tih theih boruak zauva lang nen.

Chutin fak che thlain a nuam Lalpa Aw ropui ber Aw ropui ber Chutin fak che thlain a nuam Lalpa Aw ropui ber Aw ropui ber Lentupui leh tukram phulleng fan changin Sirva zai mawiten sang thing tin awi e Khua chuan ila tlang sang tinreng atangin Dam ten luang e lui leh thlifim nuamte.
Lal Pathianin a Fapa chu zuah lovin Ka dawn seng lo dairial changin a tir Kraws chungah chuan ka sual a phur lawm takin Thisen chhuakin a thi ka sual tlanin.
Krista chu au thawm nen a lo kal hun chuan Min hruai ang vanah hlimin ka khat ang Lawm takin ka chawimawi ang a hma kunin Aw ropui ber tiin ka fak tawh ang.
Kan Pa van ropuia mi I hming zahawm se kan ti I ram thianghlim lo thleng se Kan ei tur min pe ang che.
Vana i duhzawng tih ang Lei chunga min ti sela Ram tihtheihna ropui nen Chatuan i ta reng Amen.
Kan Pa van ropuia mi Kan chung tisualtute hi Kan ngaidam angin Nangman Kan sualte min ngaidam lang.
Thlemnaah min hruai suh la Mi sual lakan min chhan teh Ram tihtheihna ropui nen Chatuan i ta reng Amen.
Hmanlai Farawa bawihte kha Pathianin a hruai chhuak A thiltihtheihzia entir nan Tuipui luang a chawlhtir.
Engkimin an awih thin Engkimin an awih thin Isua hnenah hlauh tur a awm lo Engkimin a thupek an awih thin.
Sualin ka rilru a tibuai Setana thupekin Mahse Lalpan min thlamuan a Ka buaina a tireh.
Kawng hlauhawmah kal mah ila Lalpa hniak hnung ka zui Khawngaih thahruiin min hruai a Ram ro ka pelh hma chuan.
Lal Isu ka hnuk chah hunin I ram eng ka hmu ang He khawvel buai hlauhawm ata I ram min hruai kai ang.
Aw rinna thuk nei ila Van angel-te nenin Chhandamna tuipui chhungah Thuruk awm en turin Awm dan pahnih inremin Amahah an luang hmun Infin lovin thianghlimin Famkim an awm dun.
Aw ka thla thlir zel langin A mizia mak tak kha A hnenah i nun pein I phur amah bel la I chak lohna a hriatpui Mihring a nih vangin Lei leh vanah thu a nei Pathian nih vangin.
Pathian thil rel dan chu A va mak em Hriat phak rual loh a ni A tum zauzia Thil te ber pawh a veng Van thil a rel kim e Pathian ruat ang zelin Engkim a thleng.
Khawvel ram pum pui hi Aman a veng A kutan an awm vek Ama relan Hetah lo thiat mah se Hmun dangah a din thar Pathian ram din tur hi A tum a ni.
Thim chhahna lai ber pawh A lo eng thin A buaina lai ber pawh Chiang tawk takin A lo veng fel thuai ang Thihna lui ralah chuan A thawh dan lan hunin Mak kan ti ang.

songs.title: Kan Pathianin min hruai zêl ṭhîn,
songs.author: Rev. F. W. Savidge 1862-1935

lines: Kan Pathianin min hruai zel thin Chu chu hriain ka lawm em em Ka thiltih zawng ka tih apiang Ama kutin min hruai zel thin.
Min hruai zel thin min hruai zel thin Ama kutin min hruai zel thin A zuitu fel tak nih ka duh Ama kutin min hruai zel thin.
A chang changin ka lungngaiin A chang changin ka lo lawm thin Hlauhawmah leh hlauhawm lohvah Ama kutin min hruai zel thin.
Thil eng pawh ka chungah thleng se Lungngai lovin ka lo lawm ang Huai tak pawhin ka awm reng ang Ama kutin min hruai zel thin.
Khawvela thil ka tih zawhin Ka sualte pawh ngaihdam niin Ka thih dawnin ka hlau lo vang Ama kutin min hruai zel thin.
Khawvelah Pathianin Hmun tinreng a awh kim Amah a hnai reng fo Thlarau chak lote tan A aw hriat phakin a hnai reng Ka tan a tha Pathian hnaih chu.
Lalpa a pangngai fo Khawvel buainaah pawh Mihring danglam mah se Ani a thuhmun fo Buaina tui fawna suanglungpui Ka tan a tha Pathian hnaih chu.
Hausakna chhui rual loh A hausakna phalin A thatna tawp lovin Thil nung tinreng a chawm A hmangaih far khat tuipui ang Ka tan a tha Pathian hnaih chu.
Lalpa Jeho Nang min hruaitu Ram thianghlimah min thlen la Kei ka chak lo min tanpuitu I kut chakin min chelh rawh.
Nunna chhang chu Ka duh e min chawm fo rawh.
Tuikhur fim tak chu rawn hawng la Damna tui luantir ang che He thlaler ram ka kan chhung hian Nangin min hruai zel ang che.
Chhandamtu chak Ka tha leh ka phaw i ni.
Jordan luipui ka thlen hunin Ka thlaphanna rehtir la Ka hmachhuan ram Kananah chuan Him takin min thlen ang che.
Chawimawina hla Kumkhuain ka sa ang a.
Kan Pathian kan Puipa pangngai Kan hma lam beiseina Kan hliahkhuhna khaw dur thlen lai Kan chatuan in Nangmah.
Nangma lalthutphah phenah chuan I mi an cheng muang thei I ban phar mai hi keini tan A tawk e phaw kan nei.
Tlang reng an lo din chhuah hma khan Lei la inrel hma hian Pathian i ni reng chatuana n Dang chuang thei lo chatuan.
Nangma tan kum sang sawm pawh hi Mitkhap kar a tling lo Tun hma tun hnu keinin kan ti Nangin tun i ti fo.
Hun hian lui lian luang zel angin Hring fa a len bo fo Zingah mumang a lo ral thin Kan inang rin tlak loh.
Kan Pathian kan Puipa pangngai Kan hma lam beiseina Kan hliahkhuhna khaw dur thlen lai Kan chatuan in Nangmah.
Lalpa kan lungpui kan himna Thlipui ruahpuia kan phen tur Hlauhawm tinrenga kan himna Thlipui ruahpuia kan phen tur.
